Ha! I'm more afraid that those old holes and gashes would burst that thing and I would be showered by the shrapnel!
Nothing beats the sound of a twin-carb, fork-ring steam engine burning pure firestone!
Bah! You wouldn't know a great steam engine if it smacked you upside the head!

1379.text: No two-bit traitor will stop the powder from getting to Ironband!
Help! I've only one hand to defend myself with.
Send them on! I'm not afraid of some scrawny beasts!
Ah, here at last! It's going to feel so good to get rid of these barrels.

1380.text: Sorry, Huldar... But it seems I've misled you.

1386.text: Her methods are cowardly.  She reminds me of the Forsaken apothecaries.
Remember how quiet it was before the elves came here? I miss that.
I'm not sure which one's crazier.
I'd give my pestle away for some earplugs.

1395.text: It's all their fault, stupid Alliance army. Just had to build their towers right behind my farm.
Spare some change for a poor blind man? ...What do you mean I'm not blind? ...I'M NOT BLIND! I CAN SEE!! It's a miracle!
I will gladly pay you Tuesday for a hamburger today.
Shine yer armor for a copper.
It's all their fault, stupid orcs. Had to burn my farm to the ground.

1397.text: Have a taste of Frostmane magics.
All you $R want is my weed.

Weak $C! You are no match for the Stonesplinter Tribe!
The only good $R is a dead $R!
The Stonesplinter Tribe shall see to your doom!
Die, $R!  These lands belong to the Stonesplinter Tribe!
The Loch belongs to the Stonesplinter Tribe now, $n!  Now die!

1416.text: Follow me, good Paladin.  I'll have your barding done faster than I could down a Dwarven stout.  Mmmm... stout.
Well, that should do it.  Come now, back to the shop to finish our business!
Amazing!  It worked!  $n, I have your armor.

1421.text: Curse you, $n!  One day, vengeance will be mine!

1423.text: Hello again, Antonio. Thank you again for the hat for my wife. She adored it.

Riverpaw Miner - Random Say on Aggro

1427.text: Ah, much appreciated, Corbett.  We'll get these on the racks immediately.
Ah yes, and promptly delivered.  As always, it's a pleasure doing business with you, Corbett.

1428.text: Corbett, dear.  Harlan needs a load of knitted shirts and pants as soon as we can manage.
Corbett, you there?  Harlan needs another load of knitted goods.  Can you take it to him?

1433.text: My pleasure, sugar drop.  I'll be back soon...
Business must be good down at the bazaar.  I'll get him resupplied right away!
Hm...after dropping this off, I think I'll head to that cheese shop for a snack.
I should have a few extra coins from this sale.  Maybe I'll buy myself some lunch...
Hey, Harlan.  Here's a load of knitted cloth for you.
Oomph!  Here's another load of supplies, Harlan.  It must be selling fast!
Well, I'm off then.  Take care, Harlan.
Glad to see you're doing so well, Harlan.  And I hope to see you again soon...
Good day, Elling!  Hullo Elaine!  Let me have a wheel of bleu cheese, eh?
Hullo, Trias clan!  A ball of your smoked mozzarella, if you please!
I should get back before Rema starts to worry...
Time to get back to the shop...

1439.text: My, that Black Claw stout packs quite a punch!
I feel... dizzy.  It's so hot... in... here...

1443.text: I hereby destroy these instruments of evil! For the Horde!

1444.text: Thank you, $n.  May the Light bless you, $Gbrother:sister;, and guide your path.

1476.text: Stormy seas out there.  The sea spirits must be restless....hic!
I saw a Sea Giant once.  It's not something I would care to see again.  Burp!
I'd go out and clear out some of those gnolls, but this leg has seen better days and I am afraid I'd just wind up dead.
Watch your step out there.  Many an adventure seeker has not returned from the marsh.  hic!

1493.text: YOU WERE SUCH GOOD SPORT THE LAST TIME...COME OUT!
SMOTTS!  HEY, SMOTTS!!  COME OUT AND PLAY!
DON'T LET THIS STATUE BE MY ONLY COMPANY.  COME OUT AND PLAY!
COME OUT TO JANEIRO'S POINT.  I'M WAITING FOR YOU, SMOTTS...
I PROMISE I WON'T KILL YOUR CREW THIS TIME.  HAH!  BUT MY BROTHER MIGHT EAT THEM!
HAVE YOU RUN OUT OF SHIPS TO SEND?  WHERE'S YOUR COURAGE?
DON'T YOU WANT TO FIGHT, SMOTTS!?

1497.text: Take a Candle of Beckoning from this crate, $n.

1498.text: Incredible!  I know he who wrought these enchantments...
This is unforseen.  The being who enchanted this is known to me...
$n, I have the information you seek...

1500.text: Hah!  Eternal undeath to the cursed Agamands!
Thank you, $n.  You have tempered the cold rage in my heart.

1506.text: You carry the taint of the Scourge.  Prepare to enter the Twisting Nether.
There is no escape for you.  The Crusade shall destroy all who carry the Scourge's taint.
The Light condemns all who harbor evil.  Now you will die!
The Scarlet Crusade shall smite the wicked and drive evil from these lands!

Here to visit the family?  Die, fool!
Mother, oh mother.  You should have listened to me...
They thought I was weak.  Haha!!
I am the head of the family.  Me.  ME!!!
I'm cold, lord.  When will you keep your promise?
My family hates me.  Frightened idiots, all of them!
Father?  Are you proud of me now? HAHAH!
Thurman my brother, who's laughing now?  Hah!

1667.text: These undead atrocities will be destroyed!
The Scarlet Crusade shall not fail in its mission!
We must be vigilant to eradicate this plague!
Keep up the good work.  This scourge will be cleansed!
The Scarlet Crusade will scour these lands!
Let none with the foul taint of plague live!

1716.text: More of the Warden's errand boys!
Tell the Warden this prison is ours now!
It'll be quick, but it won't be painless!
I'll crush your skull beneath my boot!

1719.text: All of a sudden they were everywhere.
They must have had someone helping them.
If the Captain finds out, it'll be the end of me.
What am I going to do?

1754.text: It's time for my meditation, leave me.
There you are. What news from Westfall?
Hmm, it could be that meddler Shaw. I will see what I can discover. Be off with you. I'll contact you again soon.
Ah, thank you kindly. I will leave you to the library while I tend to this small matter.

1755.text: VanCleef sends word that the plans are underway. But he's heard rumors about someone snooping about.
The Defias shall succeed! No meek adventurer will stop us!

1756.text: Of course. He awaits you in the library.
How dare you set foot in our city!
Looks like we're going to have ourselves an execution.
My family was wiped out by the Scourge! MONSTER!

1763.text: Get those parts moving down to the ship!
Anyone want to take a break?  Well too bad!  Get to work you oafs!

1770.text: The Sons of Arugal will rise against all who challenge the power of the Moonrage!

1776.text: Of course, my friend.  You are welcome to stay with us for as long as you like.
We have no choice.  If we fail to honor the presence of the Horde, then surely they will crush us from nearby Stonard!  I'm afraid that not even you and your friends would be able to stop them.
Be careful, Avuun.  One of the merchants that I trade with in Stonard has heard her raving about some horrible disease she's trying to perfect.  They say it's for use against the draenei!
Anchorite, we are honored that you are here, but I am curious as to what you truly believe you can accomplish?

The evil in these stones is strong, but it has been dispelled.

1931.text: My mind... my flesh... I'm... rotting...!

1946.text: You have disturbed my rest, $c.  Now face my wrath!

1950.text: It's good to see you again, Erland.  What is your report?

1951.text: I've been better.  Ivar the Foul got the better of me...

1976.text: How dare you set foot in our city!
Looks like we're going to have ourselves an execution.
My family was wiped out by the Scourge! MONSTER!

1978.text: Let's get to the others, and keep an eye open for those wolves outside...
Be careful, $n.  Those wolves like to hide among the trees.
We made it!  Thanks, $n.  I couldn't have gotten here without you.
Masses of wolves are to the east, and whoever lived at Malden's Orchard is gone.
If I am excused, then I'd like to check on Quinn...
Hello, Quinn.  How are you faring?
Try to take better care of yourself, Quinn.  You were lucky this time.

2015.text: A fine trophy your head will make, $R.
My talons will shred your puny body, $R.

Who is this mere $r that meddles with that which is past?  May the legend of Stalvan die along with you!
Let the legend of Stalvan rest!

2055.text: I assure you, overseer, the Royal Apothecary Society dearly wishes to make up for the tragic misguidance which ended so many lives.
We will cause you no trouble. We seek only to continue our research in peace.

2058.text: Be ready, $n. I hear the council returning. Prepare to ambush!
Well done. A blow to Arugal no doubt!

2080.text: Now let us place this rare earth in my planter...
Thank you again, $n.  This rare earth will be very helpful in my experiments.
I hope this frond takes root...
%s removes the seeds from the Glowing Fruit...
Let's see how these seeds grow in my prepared soil...
$n, underneath the moss, this heart looks like a seed!
Let's try planting it in some of my special, prepared soil...

2091.text: Your bones will break under my boot, $r!
Long live the Dragonmaw! Die you worthless $r!

2102.text: Your bones will break under my boot, $r!
Long live the Dragonmaw! Die you worthless $r!

2103.text: Your bones will break under my boot, $r!
Long live the Dragonmaw! Die you worthless $r!

2108.text: Your bones will break under my boot, $r!
Long live the Dragonmaw! Die you worthless $r!

2112.text: When will someone do something about the undead?
I can't even visit my father's grave in peace anymore.
Why haven't the Stormwind guards come?
I fear something dark is coming.
The light appears to have forsaken us.

2150.text: Ribbit! No!! This cannot...ribbit...be! You have duped me with...ribbit...your foul trickery! Ribbit!

2168.text: %s spies you tampering with the camp's fruit stores and attacks you!
%s emerges from the log hovel and catches you tampering with the grain stores!

2211.text: I raise my brew and hope to be rid of the likes of you!  Cheers, you no good scoundrel, $n!

2216.text: There we are, $n.  The toxin is ready.

2238.text: Have you freed Drull yet? I don't know where he's being held.
I will only slow you down, but no pink-skinned humans will keep me from freedom!

2239.text: Ah, it is good to be free of my bonds! Have you freed Tog'thar yet? The humans split us up after our capture.
Go on ahead without me! I will make my own way to Tarren Mill.

2274.text: %s sniffs the elixir then eagerly digs in!

2276.text: More agents of the Syndicate I'll wager! You'll never take back Alterac... or Southshore!

2284.text: Finally they show mercy!  They've given us something to drink!
And Shindigger Stout too!  Thank the Light!  I was parched!
%s raises his mug to his eye, and frowns.

2287.text: %s goes into a rage after seeing a friend fall in battle!

2307.text: Your undeath is not the end of your life, but the beginning. It is up to you to decide where your fate lies now.
You are free of His control. And while you will be judged by lesser beings, at least you have chances that the Scourge do not!
Terror, darkness, power? The Forsaken crave not these things; the Forsaken ARE these things.
My bones are weak, my eyes see only darkness, and my body feels only pain; but these things are good because my will is my own.

2316.text: Over here! Inside the room. Did you find the key to my chains? The human Borhuin has them.

2318.text: I tire of this nonsense! Prepare to die!

2338.text: Masters, I pledge this $r to you!
Carnage!  May I spill blood in His name!
Battle!  I can smell your fear, $c!
Intruders!  Good, I was getting bored...
My death matters little... the Hammer will still fall!
My life for my masters.  Rejoice!
Glory and blood for the Old Gods!
My lords!  I come to thee!
Your victory here only speeds your doom!

2359.text: %s begins to crack and break apart.
%s's strength dwindles as chunks of rock break off.
%s is reduced to rubble, but still continues to fight.

2396.text: I spent my whole life caring for these trees. Pruning and nurturing them... only fitting that they have joined me in death.
This orchard is now as barren and lifeless as my rotting shell. Once these trees bloomed with fruit but now there is only rot.
My trees.... they have withered up and died just like me.

2433.text: Revenge shall be mine at last!
I returned from the grave to take my revenge!
The undead shall feast on your soul, $n.
Die in the name of the Dark Lady, $n.

2435.text: Hear ye! Hear ye! *pant pant* Be warned citizens of Southshore: assassins are heading to our fair town!
Help me! Help! Assassins in the hills! To arms! To arms!
Guards to your posts! They must be after the Magistrate again. He must be protected! They could come from any direction!
The Southshore Crier grabs the back of his neck and his eyes go wide.

2440.text: Mmm... I love my delicious Southshore stout.
Southshore stout, how do I love thee? Let me count the ways...

2497.text: %s continues searching, placing more skulls in his crate.
I am done inspecting the skulls, $n, and I am relieved.  Yenniku is not among them...

2498.text: I'm sure I can find a use for this mixture...
Hm... if you're looking to adle wits, $n, then the secret behind Zanzil's zombies might just do the trick!

2519.text: %s presents the Mind's Eye and the Singing Crystals before him...
I have fashioned Yenniku's Soul Gem, $n...
I am eager to hear what so angry an orc has to say...
%s places Marg's head in the cauldron.
Peer into the cauldron, $n.  Marg wishes to speak...
Ah, good $n.  Now let us see what tale these heads tell...
There, $n.  You may now speak to the Bloodscalp chief and his witchdoctor.

2532.text: Stop! You'll pull her head off!

2533.text: I wonder if your dolly can swim!
I have your dolly! Nyah nyah!
What happens when I do this?!
If you want her back you're gonna have to beg!

2543.text: How interesting... the Stone possesses great magical potential, but in a purely raw form...

2546.text: Three cheers for $n -- Admiral o' the Bloodsail Bucaneer Navy!

2585.text: %s goes into a rage after seeing a friend fall in battle!

2597.text: I presume you come with good news?

2599.text: Things are going as planned, Lord Falconcrest. I assure you, it is only a matter of time.

2610.text: All hands to battle stations! Naga incoming!
If we can just hold them now, I am sure we will be in the clear.
Wait, $n!!! It looks like we're going to need some help here...

2616.text: Where in the Outlands are those shipments? For days they keep me waiting!
Orcs are smarter than those couriers! Where the blazes are they?

2624.text: What is happening? What force draws me to the Altar of the Tides!
Oh now you've gone and angered me! Time to see the true force of the Stone of Tides!

2634.text: Thank you again for your aid. May the wind always be at your back during your travels.

2691.text: Attack, my sisters! The troll must not escape!

2695.text: %s reads Sully's letter page by page.
This isn't fair!  My dearest Sully!  Come back to me!  No, $n!  Why did you bring me such news!

2696.text: Sure does seem like it's been a long time since anyone has relieved me from my post.
Well, that's what I get for oversleeping!

2700.text: %s begins to search through the badges of fallen Stromgarde defenders...
So many lost.  And so many more we must lose before this battle ends.
Thank you for these badges, $n.  I will send news to the families of the deceased.

2706.text: Easier than I expected... the sigil of Thoradin is whole, once again.

2713.text: Well then, let's get this started. The longer we're here, the more damage the undead could be doing back in Hillsbrad.
Alright, this is where we really have to be on our paws. Be ready!
Watch my rear! I'll see what I can find in all this junk...
%s begins rummaging through the apothecary's belongings.
I bet Quae'll think this is important. She's pretty knowledgeable about these things--no expert, but knowledgeable.
Okay, let's get out of here quick quick! Try and keep up. I'm going to make a break for it.
We made it! Quae, we made it!
Attack me if you will, but you won't stop me from getting back to Quae.

2733.text: You have my word that I shall find a use for your body after I've killed you, $r.
You will never stop the Forsaken, $r. The Dark Lady shall make you suffer.

2748.text: Who dares awaken Archaedas? Who dares the wrath of the Makers?
Awake, ye servants! Defend the Disks!
To my side, brothers! For the Makers!
%s breaks free from his stone slumber!

2755.text: What?  $n, you served me well, but...
Why have you summoned me so soon?  I haven't yet reached my full power!
No matter.  You were a fool to help me, and now you will pay!

2763.text: Stop!  Foolish $c, we cannot let you summon the creature Myzrael!

2764.text: Take that!  The Drywhiskers will prevail!
Stand firm, brothers.  And don't worry!  Size is on our side!
The Great One will smash you!
Aren't you a little short for your kind?
My life means nothing!  Our sacred task is all!
If you mean to free Myzrael, you will be sorry!
Die!  You will not free Myzrael!
No!  Leave us!  We must not fail our task!
May I bask in your shadow forever!
Master, your wisdom is matched only by your hugeness!
If I had a copper for each of your great deeds, I'd be a rich kobold!
You will keep us safe from the evil mistress, yes!
Oh, praise!  Your vigilance keeps Myzrael deep in the earth!
My only wish is to serve you, great one, until I die by your foot!
Your strength is of the mountain.  Your grace is of the winds!

2765.text: No!  Leave us!  We must not fail our task!
Stand firm, brothers.  And don't worry!  Size is on our side!
The Great One will smash you!

2768.text: Ok, $n. Follow me to the cave where I'll attempt to harness the power of the rune stone into these goggles.
I discovered this cave on our first day here.  I believe the energy in the stone can be used to our advantage.
I'll begin drawing energy from the stone.  Your job, $n, is to defend me. This place is cursed...trust me.
%s begins tinkering with the goggles before the stone.
Help!!! Get these things off me so I can get my work done!
Help!! I told you this place was cursed!
Almost done! Just a little longer!
I've done it! I have harnessed the power of the stone into the goggles! Let's get out of here!
Phew! Glad to be back from that creepy cave.
%s hands the glowing goggles over to Doctor Draxlegauge.
Doctor Draxlegauge will give you further instructions, $n. Many thanks for your help!

2775.text: Nothing will stop us!  You will die!
You've plundered our treasures too long.  Prepare to meet your watery grave!

2784.text: %s carefully studies Sara Balloo's note and lets out a long, solemn sigh.

2785.text: Ah!  There is my ratchet!  Now let's re-attach these scroll fragments.
There we are, $n.  The Scroll is fixed!  Hooray!
%s reads the ancient text $n fetched for him...
%s hunkers down to read Yagyin's Digest...

2786.text: I thank you, $n.  My associates who will do great things with these...

2790.text: I'll get to work right away, $n!
There you have it! The King should be quite pleased, if I do say so myself.
The King's guards should be along shortly to pick up the Memorial. In the meantime, come join me upstairs and let's finish our little chat, $n.

2792.text: %s watches as his blood begins to stir, and the guile of the raptor slips through him.
What is this power that flows through me? Is this the power of shamanism that Tor'gan spoke of...?
Amazing! I feel... renewed. My strength returns!

2817.text: %s cooks up a batch of spicy hot buzzard wings for $n.
There we are.  A new batch of flash bombs!
Look out!  We're under attack by a $n!
%s tosses dynamite through the air and it lands near by.

2852.text: The nightmare of Ursal is over! We are free!

2909.text: Go with speed... <cough cough> Find... <cough> Ryedol...
%s falls to the ground. His spirit is released with his last breath.

2911.text: By the stars! A spirit has been summoned!
It's a mystery of the past indeed! But a key to our future!
%s begins to manipulate the Stone of Relu over the two fossils.

2915.text: Karnik, me friend, I wish I could see you with me own eyes again, but we need'ta talk of Ragnaros. His influence is spreading.
I'll tell you more, Karnik, in time. But first, send this traveler'ta Belgrum--there's more business'ta attend to.

2916.text: You heard him, traveler. Speak to me again when you're ready to speak to Belgrum.

2917.text: Ok, $n, let's go find where I left that mysterious fossil. Follow me!
Something tells me this $n wants the mysterious fossil too. Help!
Looks like we've uncovered this $n. Now help me kill it!
Help me! This $n won't get off of me!
Can you get this $n off me?
Now where did I put that mysterious fossil? Ah, maybe up there...
No mysterious fossil here... Ah, but my copy of Green Hills of Stranglethorn.  What a good book!
I bet you I left it in the tent!
Oh wait, that's Hollee's tent... and it's empty.
Interesting... I hadn't noticed this earlier...
Oh wait! I'm supposed to be looking for that mysterious fossil!
Nope, didn't leave the fossil back here!
Ah, I remember now! I gave the mysterious fossil to Hollee! Check with her.
%s goes back to work, oblivious to everything around him.

2919.text: %s is ripped apart as it is banished from this world.

2921.text: Oh no!  It's out of control!  Run!
I guess I'd better do something about this!

2922.text: One day I'll be a real boy.
Gizmos... check. Doothingies... check. Wizzers... check.
It can get really hot here in the Badlands. But at least it's a dry heat.
I am well versed in over 4 languages.
Master, where have all the trees gone?
We can make it better, stronger, faster. We have the technology. We have the magic.
It is dangerous here, master. But I shall help stand guard.

2930.text: The Blackwood tribe is disrupting our sacred lands.
Something needs to be done about the Blackwood tribe.
A corruption taints our sacred forest.
The Blackwood tribe must not be permitted to interfere with the progress of nature.
I sense danger deep within the grove...

2931.text: %s seems much calmer now that it has eaten the remains of $n.
%s starts flapping its wings and sqwaking loudly.  You have a feeling that you are about to be its next meal!

2934.text: Accept my thanks, $n.  Yagyin's journal shall be yours.

2948.text: %s holds high the items $n gave him...
%s accepts $n's offering, and begins to chant...
%s transforms the items $n gave him into a totem of cleansing...
I have the totem of cleansing, $n.
The totem is made.  The well may now be cleansed.
$n, I have created the cleansing totem.
The deed is done.  The totem is made.
I have created the totem.  You, $n, must cleanse the well.
The items you offered were pure, $n.  This new cleansing totem is strong.

2983.text: %s stares to the northwest and lets out a long, drawn out howl.

2986.text: Until we meet again, brave one.

2991.text: %s gestures to the pitcher of water sitting on the edge of the well.

2995.text: You will not defile our sacred land!

3054.text: %s begins chanting as he mixes the well stones and ambercorn before the Tribal Fire.
The Water of the Seers is ready for your consumption, $n.

3057.text: The attackers have fled!  Strength and honor to the Horde!

3063.text: Hulfnar!  Thontek!  Stand and address me.
I want you both to demonstrate the techniques I have taught you for the benefit of the younger students here.  Ready...  begin!
Enough talk you two!  Commence fighting!
Now that's a War Stomp!  Good job!
That's how it's done class!  You better be paying attention!
Now that's putting your hoof down!
Good, good.  Now bow to each other.
Good job you two.  Now go have a seat.

3129.text: Step away from the Lieutenant's belongings!

3142.text: We will suffer no demon's servant in our lands!
What??  The Burning Blade is spreading!  We must investigate!

3149.text: The zeppelin to Orgrimmar has just arrived! All aboard for Durotar!

3150.text: The zeppelin to Grom'gol has just arrived! All aboard for Stranglethorn!

3188.text: I thank you, $n.  And my brother thanks you.

3208.text: $n, unlocking the secret of these collars is beyond my skills...

3216.text: Interesting, very interesting.  You found this in Durotar, $n?
The collar is indeed infused with demonic power, $n.  This bodes ill for our people.
Hm...it is good that you brought this to me, $n.
A dangerous device this is, $n.  I am glad you brought it to my attention.

3218.text: Please tell me that you didn't just do what I think you just did. Please tell me that I'm not going to have to hurt you...
As if we don't have enough problems, you go and create more!
You dare spill blood on neutral ground? OUT! OUT, I SAY!
We don't take kindly to miscreants, $r.
Believe me when I tell you this: You're gonna wish you weren't born, sissy!
Your actions shame us all, $c. I hurt inside as I beat you senseless.

3230.text: Hellfire Citadel is ours! The source of Illidan's fel orc army is no more! Magtheridon has fallen to the might of $n and $g his:her; allies!
The time for us to rise and strike at the fel orcs that remain is now! Do this for your Warchief! Do this for the Horde!n

3255.text: %s lets out a shriek, calling for help!

3276.text: A fine trophy your head will make, $r.
My talons will shred your puny body, $r.

3277.text: My talons will shred your puny body, $R.
A fine trophy your head will make, $r.

3278.text: A fine trophy your head will make, $r.
My talons will shred your puny body, $r.

3279.text: A fine trophy your head will make, $r.
My talons will shred your puny body, $r.

3280.text: A fine trophy your head will make, $r.
My talons will shred your puny body, $r.

3282.text: There's the stolen shredder! Stop it or Lugwizzle will have our hides!

3287.text: Go swiftly, $n. My fate is in your hands.

3291.text: Fresh Bread! Get your oven fresh bread here!
Get'em while they are nice and fresh! Loaves of bread here!
All kinds of bread here! Made fresh today. Get'em while they last!
Bread here! Loaves of your favorites! Nice and fresh!

3296.text: How dare you set foot in our city!
Looks like we're going to have ourselves an execution.
My family was wiped out by the Scourge! MONSTER!

3301.text: My sword Archeus served me well in life, but as at last my spirit may pass from the unhappy existence, I need it no longer.
I shall cling to the love of my daughter and hope that I will find forgiveness under the Light for my sins.

3338.text: The spirit of Echeyakee flows through you, $n.

3387.text: The rage of Ishamuhale runs through you, $n.
The speed of Owatanka is with you, $n.
Your path is steady, $n, for Washte Pawne's resolve is with you.

3388.text: May the spirit of Isha Awak give you strength, $n.

3390.text: %s places the spores within his alchemical instruments...
Ah, good.  These spores have rendered nicely.  Thank you, $n.

3395.text: I am summoned!  Intruders, come to my tent and face your death!

3396.text: Stand straight!  Your weakness sickens me!
Be alert!  The orcs and their allies are close!
Look fierce!  You are Kolkar, so act like one!

3413.text: Come and have a talk with me if you're going to go to Gnomeregan, $n!

3418.text: To reach The Crossroads, $n, follow the road east then north.

3419.text: %s fills a container with the toxin.

3421.text: The power of the Tear of the Moons is mine! Mine I say!
%s begins to rub the Tear of the Moons.
%s begins to make strange grunting noises. The Tear of the Moons drops to the ground and shatters.

3439.text: Alright, alright! I think I can figure out how to operate this thing...
Okay, I think I've got it, now. Follow me, $n!
Looks like we're out of the woods, eh? Wonder what this does...
Come on, don't break down on me now!
That was a close one! Well, let's get going, we're almost there.
Hm... I don't think this blinking red light is a good thing...

3442.text: Ok, let's take a look at this thing...

3446.text: Hey $n!  Don't forget to grab a crate, a manual and a command stick!

3448.text: $n. These shells tell me much, but I fear many more questions are now raised...

3451.text: Looks like you'll have to go ahead to Ratchet and tell Sputtervalve that I've wrecked the shredder.
I'll stay behind and guard the wreck. Hurry! Hopefully no one will notice the smoke...

3454.text: Frigate Ho! 'Tis an Orc vessel no doubt! Fire!
What's that on the horizon? Enemy ship no doubt! Fire!
Sails on the eastern horizon. Invaders no doubt! Fire!
What was that? Sea giant? Better safe than sorry. Fire!
There's something out there. Let loose a warning round!

3465.text: Stay close, $n. I'll need all the help I can get to break out of here. Let's go!
At last! Free from Northwatch Hold! I need a moment to catch my breath....
Now I feel better. Let's get back to Ratchet. Come on, $n.
Looks like the Southsea Freebooters are heavily entrenched on the coast. This could get rough.
$n heading this way fast! Time for revenge!
Almost back to Ratchet! Let's keep up the pace...
Ah, the sweet salt air of Ratchet.
Captain Brightsun, $n here has freed me! $n, I am certain the Captain will reward your bravery.

3484.text: I shall now begin the robe...

3502.text: Please tell me that you didn't just do what I think you just did. Please tell me that I'm not going to have to hurt you...
As if we don't have enough problems, you go and create more!
You dare spill blood on neutral ground? OUT! OUT, I SAY!
We don't take kindly to miscreants, $r.
Believe me when I tell you this: You're gonna wish you weren't born, sissy!
Your actions shame us all, $c. I hurt inside as I beat you senseless.

3503.text: %s digs its way out of the sand to protect its eggs.

3504.text: Is it true? Are there really crocolisks in the canals?
Why are we goin' this way?
I wanna see the Mage Tower.
Why do we always go the same way?

3518.text: Rolls, buns and bread. Baked fresh!

3519.text: Mist! I feared I would never see you again! Yes, I am well, do not worry for me. You must rest and recover your health.

3520.text: Seems like a hundred times a day I walk all the way to the well to get more water. No respect for their elders I tell ya.
Jack and Jill my wrinkled patoot! I do all the water luggin' 'round here.
Think I'm starting to wear a rut in the paving stones.
One of these days I'm gonna drown him in that blue robe. And all his brooms too.
O'course I'm talkin to myself. Only way to get decent conversation in this city.
As if I don't have better things to do in my old age than carry buckets of water.
Where's the water, Emma? Get the water, Emma? If'n it weren't fer me, that lot wouldn't know what water looks like.
Deja vu.  For a moment, I thought I was back home... before the plague...

3521.text: Take a stone from the table, $n.  You will need it for your quest.

3568.text: %s growls in acknowledgement before straightening and making her way off into the forest.

3582.text: Ah, I see you toil with relics of the past.
Be warned that even your creators are fallible.
Digging too deep into your past might bring an abrupt end to your future.

3583.text: Cliffspring Falls lies along the mountains to the east and north.
Thank you, $n.  And luck to you.

3584.text: I can make it the rest of the way, $n.  THANKS!

3616.text: %s studies the parchment from the Twilight Tome...

3626.text: What can I do for you?
Well hello, $n, what can I get you today?
Been a tough day? A nice ale should loosen those worries right up.
Good day, $c. What would you like?
Look what the cat dragged in. What can I get you, $n?
Do you think I need more pieces of flair?
Feeling hot? Get something to cool you off down at the Pig and Whistle!
Nightly brawls and great drinks! Get it all at the Pig and Whistle!
Get a free beer at the Pig and Whistle!
Talk to me for a free beer at the Pig and Whistle!
Smoother than and elf, stronger than an orc! No better drinks in all of Stormwind!
Tired of all those pansy spellcaster drinks? Try something stronger at the Pig and Whistle!
Back from a long journey? Rest and relax at the Pig and Whistle!

3627.text: Magical studies stressing your brain? Relax at the Blue Recluse!
Come for the beer, stay for the atmosphere!
The only place in Stormwind where magic and spirits mix, come to the Blue Recluse!
Free drinks at the Blue Recluse!
Feeling blue? Come on down to the Blue Recluse for a good time!
Head on over to the Blue Recluse. Where everybody knows your name!
Ask me how to get a free drink at the Blue Recluse!

3644.text: Anaya...? Do my eyes deceive me? Is it really you?
That the fates should be so cruel as to permit us only this after a thousand years apart...
Do you hate me, my love? That I was forced to destroy your living form, that your spirit be released from unhappy bondage.
No! Anaya... Anaya! Don't leave me! Please...
How, my love? How will I find the strength to face the ages of the world without you by my side...

3658.text: Best weapons in the Barrens here!
Step right up! Finest selection of weapons this side of Ashenvale!
Lizzarik has blades. Lizzarik has maces. Lizzarik has all your weapon needs right here!
Act quick! Once it's gone, it's gone! Get your weapons here now!

3660.text: Athrikus points at you as he bellows forth words that scrape apart the inside of your ears. They are the last thing you hear.
My... My powers have diminished... You shall pay for this insolence!

3663.text: A simple enough task to break this soulstone!
Then we must put an end to Athrikus Narassin. Tell me, spirit, where might we find the other soulgems, to undo his magic?

3664.text: We'll cut your throats and bleed you dry!

3667.text: Finally, my soul may rest... Oh, dearest Cerellean...

3669.text: You will never wake the dreamer!

3670.text: The coils of death will crush you!

3671.text: None can stand against the Serpent Lords!

3673.text: I am the serpent king! I can do anything!

3678.text: At last! Naralex can be awakened! Come aid me, brave adventurers!
I must make the necessary preparations before the awakening ritual can begin. You must protect me!
These caverns were once a temple of promise for regrowth in the Barrens. Now, they are the halls of nightmares.
Come. We must continue. There is much to be done before we can pull Naralex from his nightmare.
Within this circle of fire I must cast the spell to banish the spirits of the slain Fanglords.
The caverns have been purified. To Naralex's chamber we go!
Beyond this corridor, Naralex lies in fitful sleep. Let us go awaken him before it is too late.
Protect me brave souls as I delve into the Emerald Dream to rescue Naralex and put an end to this corruption!
%s begins to perform the awakening ritual on Naralex.
At last! Naralex awakes from the nightmare.
Attacked! Help get this $n off of me!
Deal with this $n! I need to prepare to awake Naralex!
I can't handle this $n alone! Help!
This $n is a minion from Naralex's nightmare no doubt!

3679.text: %s writhes in agony. The Disciple seems to be breaking through.
%s dreams up a horrendous vision. Something stirs beneath the murky waters.
Ah, to be pulled from the dreaded nightmare! I thank you, my loyal Disciple, along with your brave companions.
We must go and gather with the other Disciples. There is much work to be done before I can make another attempt to restore the Barrens. Farewell, brave souls!

3692.text: I'm happy to see you too, Grim! It looks like not all strangers are to be feared after all, huh, Grim? Terenthis shall reward this adventurer well.
Thank you again, $n. I'll make my way to the road now. When you can, find Terenthis and let him know we escaped.
%s roars as his form shifts and he runs off.
Well, now or never I suppose. Remember, once we get to the road safely, return to Terenthis to let him know we escaped.
We can overcome these foul creatures!
We shall earn our deaths at the very least!
Don't give up! Fight to the death!
We made it, my friend. Remember to find Terenthis and let him know we're safe. Thank you again.

3693.text: What was that noise? It sounded like a roar.
Grimclaw?! Easy there, my friend... where is your master Volcor?
Whoa, whoa there, my friend. One moment...
%s begins to cast a spell on Grimclaw.
There... that should help. Now, tell me what's happened, Grimclaw.
I understand, my friend. I shall find someone to help your master. Go back to him now, or at least stay close.
If you have the time, Grimclaw and his master Volcor could use your help. If you're interested, speak with me further...
Hello, Selarin. I'm afraid I cannot help you at the moment, but perhaps some of the adventurers here in Auberdine can...
I shall get started right away, $n.
Now... where was my thread and needle. Ah! There it is...
%s begins to cast a spell as you take the cloak from him.
Go now, $n. Find Volcor... and remember, the magics protecting you will fail if you interact with anyone, save for talking.

3694.text: Terenthis, Raene sent me to find you. The Sentinels are in need of help in Ashenvale.
Thank you, Terenthis. I shall remain here for as long as I can.
Hopefully I can send a worthy few to help Ashenvale and the Sentinels.
Thank you again, Terenthis. I shall return again if more help is needed. Until then, please send more adventurers to Ashenvale

3695.text: %s roars at Terenthis to get his attention.
%s begins to moan and roar at Terenthis while stomping his paws on the ground.
%s roars at Terenthis more, but this time the druid seems to understand the bear.
%s growls in your direction before taking time to sniff you.
%s faces southeast and whimpers before looking back at you.
%s roars in excitement as he rushes Volcor. When he reaches his master, Grimclaw licks his face.

3836.text: Don't make me go medieval on you.
Keep it up, $n, and I'll beat some manners into you.

3843.text: The ages have been cruel to you and I, my love, but be assured, it is, and at long last we are reunited.
Let it not trouble your heart, beloved. You have freed me from slavery, and for that I love you all the more.
Sadly, even this must be cut short... The ties that bind me to this world weaken, and pull me away...
Farewell, Cerellean, until we are joined once again...
%s's soft voice trails away into the mists, "Know that I love you always..."

3846.text: This statuette must hold a hidden compartment....
$n, I am in need of your help once again.

3847.text: The mixture is finished, $n.  Now we must save the child.

3848.text: Uh... the disease is potent.  And it attacks the mind...
I have survived the poisons of the Forsaken, $n, and I know now what must be done.

3849.text: Free from this wretched cell at last! Let me show you to the courtyard....
You are indeed courageous for wanting to brave the horrors that lie beyond this door.
Good luck with Arugal. I must hurry back to Hadrec now.
About time someone killed the wretch.

3850.text: Follow me and I'll open the courtyard door for you.
I have just the spell to get this door open. Too bad the cell doors weren't locked so haphazardly.
There it is! Wide open. Good luck to you conquering what lies beyond. I must report back to the Kirin Tor at once!
For once I agree with you... scum.

3892.text: Uh... Father...?  Are you there?  I'm hungry... can I have some stew?
Mmh... my eyes are not so heavy now, father.  Can we go out and play?

3893.text: A paladin! Slaying him would please the master. Attack!

3894.text: Here you are, Relara.  Take this...
You're awake??  Your cure must have worked!  Thank you, $n.
%s places the tear into a bowl of stew.
Eat this, my daughter.  It will help you feel better.
%s places a poultice on Relara's head.
%s crushes the moonstones into a cup of tea.
Here you are, Relara.  Drink this...
%s looks at $n, and then weeps with joy.

3899.text: Not quite so sure of yourself without the Purifier, hm?

3916.text: The rod's design is simple. Dartol didn't use his arcane knowledge in its creation... it is more druidic in nature.
Hehe... I made a pun, didn't I? Druidic in nature... I'm so funny.
Now, then... the rod. Let's see about putting it back together, shall we?
There! That wasn't too bad. What did you say you and Raene were going to do with this thing? It's powerful!

3925.text: %s goes into a rage after seeing a friend fall in battle!

3937.text: Fresh bread, baked this very morning.

3946.text: The numbers of my companions dwindles, goddess, and my own power shall soon be insufficient to hold back the demons of Felwood.
Goddess, grant me the power to overcome my enemies! Hear me, please, my need is desperate and my cause is just!
What... what is this? Could this be the answer to my prayers? Elune has granted me a weapon--this scythe--to defeat the demons.
I have failed... I have failed in my duty... failed my people... The worgen run rampant, and the Scythe of my goddess is lost.
This evil I have unleashed... In whose hand does the power my goddess granted to me now lie... By whose hand is it directed?

3975.text: Ah - I've been waiting for a real challenge!

3977.text: Mograine has fallen! You shall pay for this treachery! Arise, my champion! Arise!

3980.text: %s breaks the seal on Anton's letter and begins to read it.
By the Light! This is not good. There's something you don't understand, $n.
%s throws Anton's letter down on the table.

3981.text: Finally. The monster got what he deserved.

3983.text: I'll rip the secrets from your flesh!

3984.text: Sidney is late. I thought he would be home by now.
He must be overwhelmed with work at the Monastery. But still, he should have returned by now.
Well, I'm going outside to check. Something is amiss.
%s lets out a long, drawn out sigh.

3985.text: He's your husband, woman. How am I to know where he is?
Cleansing the world of impure scum isn't an easy job, Nancy. Someone's got to do it.

3995.text: %s drops the animal parts into the bubbling cauldron.
Ah, feel the magic seep into the cave, my little elves... muhahaha.
So much for the power of nature... muhahahaha.

4001.text: Hey! You're not supposed to be here! C'mon boys!

4004.text: I think the sounds came from over here. We'd better check it out.
What's going on here? Piznik! I knew we shouldn't have let you stick around!

4046.text: You were right to come.  My wisdom will be yours.
Go, my servant.  Send word of Stonetalon to Apothecary Zamah.

4048.text: Spirits of the forest come forth and heed nature's call!
Spirits of the forest, you are needed! Make haste to the Charred Vale!

4049.text: The spirits of Stonetalon still rage, $n.
I fear we may never soothe them...

4062.text: Still no sign of the final shipment of explosives.
No sign of the final explosives shipment to the west either.  Where are those lollygaggers?
This bridge should have been destroyed by now.  How long does it take for those lazy sods to get here from the Highlands!

4063.text: No!  Leave us!  We must not fail our task!
Die!  You will not free Myzrael!
The Great One will smash you!
Aren't you a little short for your kind?
My life means nothing!  Our sacred task is all!
If you mean to free Myzrael, you will be sorry!
Stand firm, brothers.  And don't worry!  Size is on our side!
Take that!  The Drywhiskers will prevail!
May I bask in your shadow forever!
Master, your wisdom is matched only by your hugeness!
If I had a copper for each of your great deeds, I'd be a rich kobold!
You will keep us safe from the evil mistress, yes!
Oh, praise!  Your vigilance keeps Myzrael deep in the earth!
My only wish is to serve you, great one, until I die by your foot!
Your strength is of the mountain.  Your grace is of the winds!

4064.text: Feel the power of the Blackrock Orcs!
You are no match for the Blackrock Orcs!

4065.text: Feel the power of the Blackrock Orcs!
You are no match for the Blackrock Orcs!

4275.text: Who dares interfere with the Sons of Arugal?
4275.comment: Archmage Arugal - Fenrus the Devourer dies
Archmage Arugal - Transforms player into a Worgen

4276.text: All right, watch my back while I get you some of this ore.
Look out! It sounds like more of them!
Just a little while longer, I've almost got it!

4283.text: You carry the taint of the Scourge. Prepare to enter the Twisting Nether.
There is no escape for you. The Crusade shall destroy all who carry the Scourge's taint.
The Light condemns all who harbor evil. Now you will die!
The Scarlet Crusade shall smite the wicked and drive evil from these lands!

4295.text: You carry the taint of the Scourge.  Prepare to enter the Twisting Nether.
There is no escape for you.  The Crusade shall destroy all who carry the Scourge's taint.
The Light condemns all who harbor evil.  Now you will die!
The Scarlet Crusade shall smite the wicked and drive evil from these lands!

4300.text: You carry the taint of the Scourge.  Prepare to enter the Twisting Nether.

The Light condemns all who harbor evil.  Now you will die!
The Scarlet Crusade shall smite the wicked and drive evil from these lands!

4306.text: Confess and we shall set you free.
You will talk eventually.  You might as well spill it now.
What?  Oh no, I don't care what you have to say.  I just enjoy inflicting pain.

4317.text: You will not defile our sacred land!

4393.text: The surface of the %s begins to bubble.

4394.text: The surface of the %s begins to bubble.

4421.text: Troublesome whelps. I'll teach you to interfere!
You outsiders will pay for encroaching on our land!
Our new allies will avenge us!

4429.text: Hm, these are pretty good bones you got this time, Pozzik.
All done! The modifications should give us a little boost in speed, but I don't think she'll hold up to too much bumping.
BANG! BANG! BANG!  I'm beefing up the car!!!

4452.text: %s places the crate of parts on the ground.
%s grabs a part and puts it in his pocket...
Let's have just a small taste...
Wait!  What am I thinking!  We have a job to do with this stuff.
Hahah!  $n, you make quite a partner!

4454.text: %s listens as $n tells him of $ghis:her; adventures in the Badlands.
Astounding!  So then indurium is the key!

4462.text: Feel the power of the Blackrock Orcs!
You are no match for the Blackrock Orcs!

4463.text: Feel the power of the Blackrock Orcs!
You are no match for the Blackrock Orcs!

4464.text: Feel the power of the Blackrock Orcs!
You are no match for the Blackrock Orcs!

4484.text: We must move quickly. Auberdine isn't too far away, but many enemies lurk in the forest.
It looks like we're in trouble. Look lively, here they come!
Assassins from that cult you found... Let's get moving before someone else finds us out here.
Hold! I sense an evil presence... Undead!
They're coming out of the woodwork today. Let's keep moving or we may find more things that want me dead.
I'll finish you off for good this time!
Well done! I should be fine on my own from here. Remember to talk to Delgren when you return to Maestra's Post in Ashenvale.

4488.text: You have done well, $n. Continue your search for knowledge, and remember the history you have learned.
I'm afraid not, $n. Now, feel the shame you have brought upon yourself.

4489.text: That is the wrong answer, $n. Be off with you.

4493.text: You carry the taint of the Scourge.  Prepare to enter the Twisting Nether.
There is no escape for you.  The Crusade shall destroy all who carry the Scourge's taint.
The Light condemns all who harbor evil.  Now you will die!
The Scarlet Crusade shall smite the wicked and drive evil from these lands!

4494.text: You carry the taint of the Scourge.  Prepare to enter the Twisting Nether.
There is no escape for you.  The Crusade shall destroy all who carry the Scourge's taint.
The Light condemns all who harbor evil.  Now you will die!
The Scarlet Crusade shall smite the wicked and drive evil from these lands!

4495.text: Look at what $n brought us!  Let's drink up!

4498.text: This should only take a moment, $n.
I call your true name, Azrethoc. Show your visage to me!

4500.text: Puny $r wanna fight Overlord Mok'Morokk? Me beat you! Me boss here!
Me still boss of ogres. Haw!

4501.text: %s begins to cast a spell over the hearts and tongues.

4508.text: Woo hoo! Finally getting out of here. It's going to be rough though. Keep your eyes peeled for trouble.
Up there is where Charlga Razorflank resides. Blasted old crone.
There's blueleaf tuber in this trench! It's like gold waiting to be mined I tell you!
There could be danger around every corner here.
I don't see how these foul animals live in this place... sheesh it smells!
I think I see a way for us to get out of this big twisted mess of a bramble.
Glad to be out of that wretched trench. Not much nicer up here though!
Finally! I'll be glad to get out of this place.
I think I'll rest a moment and catch my breath before heading back to Ratchet. Thanks for all the help!
Well, I'm off to Ratchet now! Best of luck to you!
$n heading this way fast! To arms!
Help! Get this $n off of me!

4509.text: In the throes of the Sundering, Ameth'Aran was at the whim of the terror that gripped the land. There was little hope for survival.
Athrikus came to us. He told us that he could save us from harm. He cast a spell upon us to protect us from harm.
When the shaking stopped, his true motives were revealed. We were trapped, and he was slowly draining our powers.
There were hundreds imprisoned by his spell. Now only a few remain in their prisons. He would speak to us sometimes.
He worried that his power weakened, that soon even we last of his precious soulgems would fade and die.
His lieutenant, Ilkrud Magthrull possesses a tome which might indicate the location of the remaining soulgems.

4543.text: No rest... for the angry dead!

4568.text: Take a chest of containment coffers and a cantation of manifestation, $n.  You will need them for your mission.

4576.text: One moment while I stitch this together...
There.  I am finished with your robe, $n.

4607.text: Ugh! What is that scoundrel doing sending his vermin to me? Get out of my sight before I take what is left of your life. And take this with you.

4618.text: %s takes the indurium flakes to his forge.
Now let's heat up these flakes...
So far they're holding.  Let's turn up the heat...
By Orgrim!  This indurium can withstand massive heat!
A successful test!  $n, this indurium is some amazing stuff.

4624.text: Please tell me that you didn't just do what I think you just did. Please tell me that I'm not going to have to hurt you...
As if we don't have enough problems, you go and create more!
You dare spill blood on neutral ground? OUT! OUT, I SAY!
We don't take kindly to miscreants, $r.
Believe me when I tell you this: You're gonna wish you weren't born, sissy!
Your actions shame us all, $c. I hurt inside as I beat you senseless.

4630.text: Okay, crew. Get to work on getting these bones installed.
Thanks again, $n.  Now I'll use this indurium to beef up my car!
Now for the next race, the car will be even FASTER than before!

4720.text: Bloody... Must have been the goblins... Let's see how bad the damage is.
Guess there's nothing more to be done. Blast!

4721.text: The Earth Mother watch over us; under cover of the night as in the day. Let this fire illuminate both our bodies and spirits and remind us of our honored ancestors, who are ever present and guiding our way.n

4792.text: Unless it's something I can eat, I don't want it.
Nothing. Wanna help me whip up some frog leg stew?

4798.text: We are quite safe from your pitiful band!
I shall rip your guts out!
Your eyes will make pretty baubbles!

4799.text: We are quite safe from your pitiful band!
I shall rip your guts out!
Your eyes will make pretty baubbles!

4809.text: Aku'mai demands more sacrifices, now you must die!
Intruders!  The Hammer shall fall upon you.
The Old Gods will be restored.  You will not be allowed to interfere!
Your blood shall be the catalyst for the Old Gods' return!

4810.text: Aku'mai demands more sacrifices, now you must die!
Intruders!  The Hammer shall fall upon you.
The Old Gods will be restored.  You will not be allowed to interfere!
Your blood shall be the catalyst for the Old Gods' return!

4811.text: Aku'mai demands more sacrifices, now you must die!
Intruders!  The Hammer shall fall upon you.
The Old Gods will be restored.  You will not be allowed to interfere!
Your blood shall be the catalyst for the Old Gods' return!

Your blood shall be the catalyst for the Old Gods' return!

Intruders!  The Hammer shall fall upon you.
The Old Gods will be restored.  You will not be allowed to interfere!
Your blood shall be the catalyst for the Old Gods' return!

4831.text: You should not be here! Slay them!

4880.text: Now let's look for the herb.
There must be one around here somewhere...
Come, $n!  Let's go over there and collect it!
%s picks the herb from the ground.
Ok, now let's get out of here!
I can make it from here.  Thanks, $n!  And talk to my employer about a reward!
Help!  The beast is on me!
I'm glad you're here!  Because I need your help!!

4895.text: He'll bring you mead, he'll bring you beer...
A grinning face from ear to ear...
He's served us all from year to year...

4926.text: Go to the Shady Rest Inn and follow the tracks. See where they lead and report back to me.

4944.text: %s places the scroll on the table, and reads...
By the Light!  This cursed spy was a good one!  I'm glad he's dead.
Thank you for this report, $n.  It is now clear that we must tighten our patrols near Theramore.
Tesoran! I need someone--Falgran Hastil, preferably--to take care of $n's lead on the prints near the Shady Rest Inn.

4961.text: Now you're gonna get it good, $n!
Okay, okay! Enough fighting. No one else needs to get hurt.
It's okay, boys. Back off. You've done enough. I'll meet up with you later.

4962.text: Oh, it's on now! Bet you thought I'd be alone too, huh?!
Okay, okay! No need to get all violent. I'll talk. I'll talk!
I have a few notes from the job back at my place. I'll get them and then meet you back in the inn.

4963.text: I'm glad the commotions died down some around here. The last thing this place needs is another brawl.

4966.text: %s, too injured, gives up the chase.
Please... please... Miss Proudmore. I didn't mean to...

4967.text: Go with grace, and may the Lady's magic protect you.
4967.comment: Archmage Tervosh - On Quest 'The Missing Diplomat' Finished

4967.text: Ah, Private Hendel. A pleasure to meet one of the men who would betray his kingdom for pride.
Why don't we deal with you now, Hendel? Lady Proudmoore will speak to you back in the tower.
I apologize for taking so long to get here. I wanted Lady Proudmoore to be present also.
We can only stay a few moments before returning to the tower. If you wish to speak to us more you may find us there.

4968.text: I had arranged for a secret summit between Warchief Thrall and King Wrynn, here in Theramore.
The king was to travel here by ship, in secret. But the ship never arrived, and King Wrynn disappeared.
Your help enabled us to connect the Defias to the mastermind behind the abduction, Onyxia, who was posing as a member of the royal court.
Meanwhile, the king managed to escape his captors, and returned to Stormwind to deal with Onyxia.
I will send word that you have discovered the link to the Defias. I was a fool to think them broken with the defeat of Edwin Van Cleef, and King Wrynn will want to make an example of all who remain.

4971.text: Whoa! This is way more than what I bargained for, you're on your own, Slim!

4973.text: Oops! That was a bit off. I didn't even hit the target!
That was a nice shot... but not perfect. Maybe a bit more to the left.
Barely hit the target that time. Hmmm,... maybe I need to adjust back to the right.

4979.text: ...receive 50 percent off deserter undergarments? What is this garbage?
...to create a fund for the purchase of hair gel? I like my hair the way it is, thanks!
...the deserters seek a Theramore where citizens will be free to juggle at all hours of the day? What is this nonsense?
...to establish the chicken as the official symbol of Theramore?! These guys are nuts!
...as a deserter, you'll enjoy activities like tethered swimming and dog grooming? How ridiculous!
This... this is a joke, right?
I'd never join anything like this. Better keep this, though. It'll come in handy in the privy...
What a bunch of lunatics! You actually believe this stuff?
That's the funniest thing I've read in a long time. You've just made my day!

4980.text: W-what do you want? Just leave me alone...
I swear, I didn't steal anything from you! Here, take some of my supplies, just go away!
I... Well, I may of taken a little thing or two from the inn... but what would an ogre care about that?
And I don't know anything about this fire of yours...
What was that? Did you hear something?
%s staggers backwards as the arrow lodges itself deeply in his chest.
Ugh... Hallan, didn't think you had it in you...
Must be your lucky day. Alright, I'll talk. Just leave me alone. Look, you're not going to believe me, but it wa... oh, Light, looks like the girl could shoot...

4983.text: I noticed some fire on that island over there. A human, too. Let's go check it out, $n.
That's Reethe alright. Let's go see what he has to say, yeah?
Just tell us what you know about the Shady Rest Inn, and I won't bash your skull in.
Look here, if you don't tell me about the fire--
Damn it! You'd better not die on me, human!
Looks dead to me. Not much use to us like this. You'd better go back and tell Krog what happened.
By the way, thanks for watching my back.

5042.text: You're going to be just fine.
Let me help you with those.

5046.text: Paval Reethe! Found you at last. And consorting with ogres now? No fear, even deserters and traitors are afforded some mercy.
Private, show Lieutenant Reethe some mercy.
Now, let's clean up the rest of the trash, men!

5088.text: Falgran Hastil reporting, sir. I will find where the hoofprints lead and report back to you.

5089.text: Alright! Alright! We surrender... Just put your weapons down, I'll cooperate!

5109.text: Fresh bread, baked this very morning.

5111.text: Bawk, bawk, bawk!  Happy Hallow's End, $n!

5184.text: It's Proudmoore! Get out of here!
She'll have our heads if we're caught!

5244.text: %s prepares to sting its victim as a last desperate move!

5353.text: I have given you an oathstone of Ysera's Dragonflight, $n.  When you are ready and able to aid us, use it, and then we may begin.

5355.text: Kill them before they get away!
I will have your energy and then your life!

5386.text: It wasn't my fault, Master Mazen!
It was a simple mistake. A wrong turn I tell you!
The swamp was horrible! I was so... so... scared!

5391.text: Help!  The beast is on me!
I'm glad you're here!  Because I need your help!!
Help!  Please, you must help me!
Thank you, $n.  I will remember you always.  You can find my strongbox in my camp, north of Stonard.
%s whispers to $n the secret to opening his strongbox.

5398.text: Hah!  Let us see the wooden human wave!
Hahah!  That was funny!  Funny wooden human!

5413.text: Finished!  And the results are amazing.  I must convey them to my associates Grimand, Mathiel and Klockmort!

5414.text: The serum will only take a few minutes to prepare, $n.
At last, the serum is complete, $n. Now, come closer. We must talk.

5416.text: %s takes a big swig of ale.
That was refreshing. Now there's information that needs to be told...
I believe the Forsaken are misleading the allies of the Horde.... wait... I feel so... dizzy...

5497.text: Here, $n.  Take a chest of containment coffers and a cantation of manifestation.  You will need them for your mission.

5634.text: Time to brew up a Kalimdor Kocktail! Hiccup!
Ok, who pushed me down? Was it you, $n? Someone turn the lights back on. Hiccup!
One more sip of the ol' fire water and I'll be ready to talk. Hiccup! Cheers!
So, $n, I'm ready to tell you what happened in the Swamp of Sorrows. Hiccup!

5635.text: Invaders! Invaders! We're under attack, boys! Get 'em!

5644.text: Elune be with us! Let's make haste from this evil fortress.
I will hurry back to Vahlarriel. Finish off those that you can--I should be fine on my own from here.

5661.text: Edward. Tyler. Prepare for your first challenge.
Not a challenge at all it seems. Let us see how you handle your second test. Lysta, bring forth the minions of the Lich King.
It is time to face your final challenge young warriors! Prepare for your hardest fight yet.
Well done Edward and Tyler. You are progressing along in your training quite nicely. We shall test your mettle again soon.

5662.text: You sorry sacks of maggot flesh can do better than that, now prove it!
Alright you sorry sacks of bones. Let's see what you've got. Strike your opponent, and don't stop till I say so.
What do you call that? If that's fighting then I'm Lothar himself!
These piles of wood and straw may show mercy, but the Lich King won't!
The sword isn't a tool, it's an extension of you. I expect better!
Stop! You maggots call that fighting? That is pathetic! Now put your hearts in it, you don't need them anymore anyway!
You're dead, not buried. Now show me your best!
You don't fight for yourselves anymore, maggots! You fight for the Queen now so show me something worthy of her!
Can you see yourselves? That is the most pathetic excuse for sword slinging I've ever seen!

5666.text: It has been a long time, Bethor, my friend.
When time permits, we must speak at length.  For we have much to discuss.
And thank you, $n.  Without your aid I may never have found my way to the Forsaken.

5676.text: Who dares summon the power of the void?
You will live forever in torment for this, pathetic warlock.

5677.text: Interesting... Now this is more than I expected. Delicious...

5693.text: This is Dalin Forgewright. He fled from Lordaeron when the plague struck, taking his love with him.
When he came upon the refugees at the Greymane Wall, he felt it his duty to succor them, sending his woman on to Hillsbrad.
And this is Comar Villard. Two weeks married, his wife was spirited away from the safety of Menethil Harbor.
Five and five years, and he still searches for her, though she was no beauty, and there were many ladies that would take her place.

5696.text: Theresa, take this to Father Lankester.
As good as I told you it would be, yes?
Didn't I tell you my new domination techniques would work?
So what do you think of my new toy?
How do you like my pet?
Isn't she just the most amazing little creation?
A little torture, a pinch of magic, and an ample helping of invasive surgery. She was conscious, of course.
Everyone has a weakness, it's just a matter of finding it.
It was simple once I broke her spirit.
I managed to discover that certain parts of the brain when removed or stimulated will make a subject much more docile.
You don't expect me to give up all my secrets do you?
A little ritual torture can go a long way.

5697.text: My Lord Abernathy sends this to you.

5698.text: Bravo, Gerard, you have exceeded yourself, yet again.
I am truly impressed, Gerard. I thought you were all talk, but I see I have been proven wrong.
I don't agree with your turning to alchemy to fix some of the problems, but I do agree with the results. Very well done.
Did you have to house train her, Gerard?
An amazing discovery you have made. I would love an opportunity to look at all of the failed experiments.
Very nice, Gerard. Next you will be breeding them.
Your pet is wonderful, Gerard, but she needs a collar with a bell I think.
Impressive, very impressive. Does she do tricks?

5699.text: I've never seen anything like it. No concentration or loss of awareness while the subject is dominated. What did you do to her?
Amazing! How did you manage a permanent dominate?
I don't approve of your experiments, Gerard, but I must admit the results are impressive. What exactly did you do to her?
She retains knowledge and speech, and even the self sufficiency to perform tasks for you. Precisely what did you do?
Truly amazing, Gerard. How did you do it?
Astounding. You managed to dominate her, yet she retains self awareness and function. How did you do it?

5700.text: If I could just find "Magic and the Ways of Power". Ahh here it is, what was it doing over here?
Very interesting. But if that's the case then my theory is wrong. I must reread the other sections to see what I missed.
"Magical Flows and How They Effect the World", by Maginor Dumas. That's the one I was looking for.
If this is correct then I have a lot more research to do.
I really need a better system for filing these books. Ahh that's the one I wanted.
But this can't be right. Where did I put that other book?
"Khadgar's Mystical Journal, Volume 8." I think this is the one I wanted.
Ahh, "Mystical Conjurings of the Archmages of Dalaran." Perfect.
If I could just find "Magic and the Ways of Power". Ahh here it is, what was it doing over here?
"Magic Maladies", no. "Magic Matricies", no. Ahh here we go "Magic Mysteries".
There's the mystical tome I was looking for.
Yes, yes. Hmm, it seems to cross reference another tome. Guess I have to find that one too.
That wasn't very helpful. Let me check the other one.
That's what I wanted to know. Now I just need to find where the flux variance is discussed.
So I was right about the energies. Let's see what the other tome has to say on the subject.

5702.text: If you're here, then it means you are prepared to begin the study of summoning demonic cohorts to do your bidding. We will start with the lowliest creatures you will be able to call and continue from there. Let us begin.
The easiest creature for you to summon is the imp. You should already be able to bring forth this minion but for completeness' sake I will start with him.
This foul little beast is the imp. It is small and weak, making it almost useless as a meatshield, and its damage output is mediocre at best. This creature is best used for support of a larger group.
Now that you have had a chance to study the imp, let us move on to the next minion you will be able to summon, the voidwalker.

This demonic entity is known as the Voidwalker. Its strength and endurance are significant, making it ideal for defense. Send it to attack your enemy, then use it as a shield while you use your spells and abilities to drain away your opponent's life.

If you've never seen one, it is a sight to behold. A very impressive creature both on and off the field of battle. Next, let us take a look at what I am sure all you male students have been waiting for. The succubus.

All right now. Aside from the obvious distractions a minion like this will provide against your more masculine foes, she is also capable of dealing out impressive amounts of damage. However, her fragile endurance makes her almost useless as a shield.
Study hard and you might one day be able to summon one on your own, but for now it's time to move on to the felhunter.
What you see before you is a felhunter. This creature's natural talents include spell lock and other abilities which make it unequalled when facing a magically attuned opponent.

When facing a spellcaster of any kind, this feral beast will be your best friend. Now, let us take a look at something a bit different. This next creature will aid your travels and make your future journeys much easier. Let's take a look at a felsteed.

I doubt you have had much occasion to see such a creature. These demonic equines will make your travels much faster by acting as your mount as long as you control them. However, they are difficult to control, so be sure you are ready before attempting it.n
There you have it. Our lesson on summoning has come to an end. A new class will begin shortly, so if you wish to brush up, feel free to stay around.

5709.text: This evil cannot be allowed to enter this world!  Come my children!

5710.text: The shield be down! Rise up Atal'ai! Rise up!

5721.text: Turn back! Do not wake the dreamer!
You know not what you do!  We must destroy you for your own good.

5734.text: Hmm, it would seem Keever needs a new subject. If that fool Abernathy keeps taking Keever's subjects, Keever may have to have a word with him.
Ahh, there we go. Now, Keever must try this vial and see if it works.
%s forces the fluid down the weary man's throat.
Not what Keever was hoping for. Keever may have added too much earthroot. Let's see if the second serum will do what Keever needs.
%s feeds the toad some of the strange liquid.
%s pokes the small fuzzy squirrel with obvious disappointment.
Well, that is just not right. The creature is far too small. Let us see what Keever's third batch will do.
%s feeds the squirrel some of the viscous fluid.
Keever is unhappy with this. Perhaps if Keever were to try a larger dose, that may fix this dilemma.
%s grabs the rabbit and pours the fluid down its throat, then sets it back inside the cage.
What is this? Did Keever ask for a sheep? Keever wanted a weapon of great power and all he got was this sheep. Keever is very disappointed.

5772.text: Who dares to seek me out?!
Come! Come to your deaths--if you dare!

5773.text: Pathetic Forsaken weakling. You wish to see my master? So be it.
Yes, come. My master and I shall be waiting.

5888.text: Peace and patience be with you, $n. Remain strong always.

5901.text: Spirits of Water, I give you praise, and I beg of you a favor. You have heard $n's pleas, and I trust $ghis:her; intent is noble. Please, will you aid us?
Thank you, great spirit. Thank you!

5907.text: Yes you may, Okla. But do not stray too far from home.

5955.text: Do we have much further to go?
I keep getting sand stuck in my toes.
I wish you could just pick me up and carry me.
Have you heard the one about the ogre, the goblin and the pit lord?
Torta, my love! I have returned at long last.
My dearest Torta, I have been gone for so long. Finally we are reunited. At long last our love can blossom again.
Yes, Torta. Whatever your heart desires...

5957.text: Don't make me go medieval on you.
Keep it up, $n, and I'll beat some manners into you.

6015.text: You have any idea how long I've been waiting here? And where's dinner? All that time gone and nothing to show for it?
Enough with the rambling. I am starving! Now, get your dusty shell into that ocean and bring momma some grub.
And try not to get lost this time....

6019.text: Always on the go, that girl.

6114.text: Farewell, $n.  And remember, a warrior never shows his back to his foe!

6119.text: Horrible! Well, all right, maybe it just needs a little cleaning up?

6123.text: Feel the power of the Dark Iron Dwarves!

6124.text: Feel the power of the Dark Iron Dwarves!

6142.text: It is done.  I have your weapon, $n.
It is done.  $n, your armor is ready.

6166.text: $n ran the Gauntlet!  Three cheers for $n!

6172.text: Thank ye, $G lad:lass;. Thank ye, greatly.

6175.text: Don't forget the orphans of Stormwind!
Help the children of Stormwind... victims of the war and plague!
Give to the charities who seek to help the victims of these hard times! Please.
Give of your hearts and your purses! Give to the children of Stormwind who have lost their parents.

6176.text: Follow, $n.  I will soon begin the summoning...
%s surveys the ground and nods approvingly.
I don't think it's strong enough.

6177.text: Thank you, $G lad:lass;. Thank you, greatly.

6182.text: To the house! Stay close to me, no matter what! I have my gun and ammo there!
Meet me down by the orchard--I just need to put my gun away.

The troggs...they never stop coming.  Die trogg!  Die!
This sickness clouds my vision, but I know you must be a trogg.  Die foul invader!
A foul trogg if ever I saw one.  Die!

6244.text: A thousand years ago, the immortal elves, demigods of the forest and dragons fought against the Legion on the slopes of Hyjal.
Anathera and Latherion fought back to back where the battle was thickest. Two lovers determined to survive the war together.
But it was not to be. As their foes pressed close, Anathera's armor was pierced by a demon's tainted blade. In the thick of battle, there would be nothing to save her.
Ignoring the battle that raged about him, Latherion dropped his guard to cradle his love in her dying moments. But the demons gave him no quarter, and quickly laid him low.
Where the two lovers fell, a tree would bloom. The elves call it the heartswood. It will surely serve your ends.

6245.text: So this... this is how it ends, my love...

6246.text: Anathera... I cannot bear to face the rest of eternity without you by my side... If you are taken from me, then let this be the day I also return to the earth...

6248.text: The Affray has begun.  $n, get ready to fight!

6251.text: I hope you're ready, $n. Follow me.
Come, my acolytes. Take the rods of channeling and create the greater summoning circle.

6266.text: Ok, let's get this orb made...

6391.text: %s is splashed by the blood and becomes irradiated!

6408.text: I am done.  Your armor is ready, $n.

6411.text: I have finished your leg guards, $n.

6487.text: You will not defile these mysteries!

6514.text: %s pounds his chest, calling for help!

6516.text: %s looks tired. He then yawns and lies down next to A-Me 01
%s snores loudly and cuddles up next to A-Me 01.

6523.text: Feel the power of the Dark Iron Dwarves!

6546.text: Gird yourself, $n, for the demon in this orb is a fel beast.
Ok, let's get this orb made...
Stand back, and ... hold your breath.  I haven't done this in a while.
It worked!  Amazing!  I guess I haven't lost my touch...
I just have one thing to check...
I'll just keep this here until we need it...

6557.text: %s begins to make a copy of itself!

6559.text: %s explodes into chunks of acidic slime!

6667.text: YARRR! Swabie, what have ye done?! He's gone mad! Baton down the hatches! Hoist the mast! ARRRR! Every man for hi'self!

6669.text: *Threshwackonator First Mate unit prepared to follow*

6729.text: Aku'mai is dead! At last, I can leave this wretched place.
Speak with me to hear my tale.

6735.text: I may have ninety-nine problems, but dancin' ain't one of them!  Happy Hallow's End, $n!

6740.text: Ooo, so strong!  Happy Hallow's End, $n!

6741.text: Bawk, bawk, bawk!  Happy Hallow's End, $n!

6746.text: I may have ninety-nine problems, but dancin' ain't one of them!  Happy Hallow's End, $n!

6748.text: Wrong!  It is YOU that will die, Tel'athion the Impure!

6784.text: Okay, okay... gimmie a minute to rest now. You gone and beat me up good.

6790.text: Welcome to the Scarlet Raven.  It's best to stay indoors these days.

6826.text: Let me grab a spell focus from inside my home here, and then we'll get started!
Bah, it isn't here.  Where did I have that blasted thing at last?
That's right, it's over by the bed.  Heh, sorry about that!
Fantastic then!  Let's get this thing fixed for you.
Success!  Huzzah!  The power source restored the necklace!

6846.text: The Brotherhood will not be hampered by insects.

6866.text: The Brotherhood will not tolerate your actions.
6866.comment: Defias Bodyguard - Random Say on Aggro

6866.text: Ah, a chance to use this freshly sharpened blade.
6866.comment: Defias Bodyguard - Random Say on Aggro

6866.text: Feel the power of the Brotherhood!
6866.comment: Defias Bodyguard - Random Say on Aggro

6868.text: Allow me to get some water for the inking reagent.
This will do nicely.  Now to the task at hand!
There we go, all finished.  The journal has been translated for you.
And now for a quick look at these gems.
Just as I thought, the gems and the necklace don't matter.  It's all about the power source.

6909.text: I know you are there, rogue. Leave my home or join the others at the bottom of the world tree.
The end of days is upon us! May the earth embrace my flesh and bones.
Filth! Filth everywhere! The forests must be cleansed!
It is hopeless. Cutting one down results in two new growths.

6911.text: We live only to serve the ancient one. DIE INTERLOPER!

6927.text: The Brotherhood will not tolerate your actions.

6929.text: Ooo, so strong!  Happy Hallow's End, $n!

6966.text: Oh! I almost forgot! I slipped you a set of thieven' tools. You'll need those where you're going.

6986.text: Now we just need to figure out how to get this thing working again.
Boy, you couldn't fix a sandwich without someone tellin' ya how to do it.

6987.text: Maybe I can fix it, pop.  Lemme take a look at it.
Sandwich?  What?  You makin' a sandwich for me, pop?

7033.text: WHO KILL GOR'TESH!?!? WHO DO THIS?!
$n KILL! $G He:She; kill you now! RUN! RUN!
Run for hills! Wait! We already in hills!

7034.text: WHO KILL GOR'TESH!?!? WHO DO THIS?!
$n KILL! $G He:She; kill you now! RUN! RUN!
Run for hills! Wait! We already in hills!

7035.text: WHO KILL GOR'TESH!?!? WHO DO THIS?!
$n KILL! $G He:She; kill you now! RUN! RUN!
Run for hills! Wait! We already in hills!

7052.text: Can we take a break? My feet are killing me and those ... those things down there are creeping me out.
I dunno, Jill. If Klaven comes down while we're slacking, we may end up as one of those things!
*Sigh* You're probably right, Raven. I'm going back on patrol....

7053.text: %s wildly flips through the pages of a large tome.
The sweet irony -- Stormwind forces cut down in defense of their city, only to rise and fight alongside the Brotherhood as instruments of destruction.
And should one die, two shall rise!
Now where did I put the Venture Company formulations?
You cannot hide from me, rogue. I can smell your fear.

7161.text: Make sure to visit the Gizmotronic Apparatus to grab a lockpick and an E.C.A.C. You will definitely need both to complete your mission!
%s points you to the Gizmotronic Apparatus.

7166.text: %s explodes, lighting the sky up in a brilliant fireworks display! It seems to be beckoning to you, rogue.

7168.text: What the squawk??? Squawk squawk, squawk? SQUAWK!

7207.text: Just /lay down anywhere, $n. I promise, this won't hurt a bit!
%s examines the blood in the bottle.
%s seems to be talking to the squirrel and the statue. He periodically points in your direction.

7228.text: None may steal the secrets of the Makers!

7267.text: Feel the fury of the sands!

7271.text: How dare you enter my sanctum!

7357.text: We will spread across this barren land!
Soon, the Scourge will rule the world!
Slay them, my brethren! For the Scourge!

7358.text: You'll never leave this place alive.
I am the hand of the Lich King!
%s begins to summon wraiths out of the freezing cold air!

7361.text: We come from below! You can never stop us!

7363.text: %s releases the flawless draenethyst sphere, allowing it to hover before him.
Success, the rift is open!! My brethren, rise and return home! The Outland awaits!
Hurry brothers! You must go now! I do not know how much longer the rift will remain open!
And now you know why I live in a crater.

7564.text: I'm going to carefully mix this - oops! ...Well, I spilled a little, but it's ready!

7572.text: Per your request, Corporal Splithoof has come, $n.

7583.text: Umi sent you, didn't she?! She told me to expect a surprise, but I never thought that this is what she meant!
Just sit tight while I get this prepared for you!

7603.text: %s is splashed by the blood and becomes irradiated!
No gnome will be left behind.
The troggs...they never stop coming.  Die trogg!  Die!
This sickness clouds my vision, but I know you must be a trogg.  Die foul invader!
A foul trogg if ever I saw one.  Die!

7604.text: What?  How dare you say that to me?!?
After all we've been through?  Well, I didn't like you anyway!!

7664.text: Let the flames of chaos engulf you!
Prepare yourselves for an eternity of anguish and torture - vengeance shall be mine...

7668.text: %s's physical form is weakened. You notice the Stone of Binding near the creature is glowing! Strike now!
Give my regards to Commander Trebor.
It was not his fault. Tell him that...
Finally, released from his cursed grasp. Father, I come...
Stone of Binding shatters, releasing the soul which it held.
