7764.text: Feralas: A History... Hmmmm... Let me examine this for a moment.
%s skims the pages of the book.
Amazing! I think I have found it, $n!

7765.text: I'm so glad yer back, Shay. Please, don't ever run off like that again! What would I tell yer parents if I lost ya?

7766.text: Wait here, $n. Spybot will make Lescovar come out as soon as possible. Be ready! Attack only after you've overheard their conversation.
That's it! That's what you were waiting for! KILL THEM!

7774.text: Don't forget to get my bell out of the chest here. And remember, if do happen to wander off, just ring it and i'll find you again.
Oh, I wandered off again.  I'm sorry.
The bell again, such a sweet sound.
I can't help it, really. This is just such a beautiful place.
Are we taking the scenic route?
Oh, what a beautiful flower over there...
These trees are quite glorious, aren't they?
Are you sure this is the right way? Maybe we should go this way instead...
Hmmm, I wonder what's over this way?
Oh, here you are, Rockbiter! I'm sorry, I know I'm not supposed to wander off.

7779.text: Good day to you both. I would speak to Lord Lescovar.
Thank you. The Light be with you both.
Milord, your guest has arrived. He awaits your presence.
I shall use the time wisely, milord. Thank you.

7780.text: Rin'ji can see the road now, $n. Rin'ji knows the way home.
Rin'ji will tell you secret now... $n should go to the Overlook Cliffs. Rin'ji hid something on island there.
You find it, you keep it! Don't tell no one that Rin'ji talked to you!

7783.text: You will need to open the Felhound Tracker Kit and read the instruction manual. Summon the beast when you are near the peninsula of cliff giants, south of here.

7800.text: My machines are the future! They'll destroy you all!
Explosions! MORE explosions! I got to have more explosions!

7804.text: Hear ye, denizens of Tanaris! Let it be known that $n is an exalted member of the Mithril Order. A blacksmith of honor, dedication, and infinite patience. Three cheers for $n!

7805.text: No one challenges the Wastewander nomads -- not even robotic chickens!  ATTACK!

7849.text: Warning! Warning! Intruder alert! Intruder alert!

7850.text: I see the exit! Hurry, hurry!
Thank you for rescuing me! Word of your deed will not go unnoticed.

7853.text: Give me a moment while I calibrate the transponder to your height and weight specifications, $n.

7879.text: I will need to focus my energies onto this knife.  By doing so, I should catch some of the stronger psychic impressions associated with it.
I... I've seen enough I think... so very draining...

7897.text: Anti-escape countermeasures activated. Self-destruct in t-minus 20 seconds....
Alarm-a-bomb unit 2600 has failed. Self-destruct override [ACTIVE]. Cooldown [ACTIVE].

7899.text: Hey!  Get away from our treasure!
We didn't hide this stuff just you could steal it!

7901.text: Hey!  Get away from our treasure!
We didn't hide this stuff just you could steal it!

7902.text: Hey!  Get away from our treasure!
We didn't hide this stuff just you could steal it!

7907.text: Take a look around, $n. Perhaps you will find something that I have missed.
%s gestures at the piles of books.

7917.text: Greetings, $c!  Welcome to the Cathedral of Light!

7918.text: Salutations!  I am a guardian of entry.  Please use the proper discs for access to Uldum.
Your discs will be returned to you once you access the pedestal.

7955.text: What?  I don't even know what you're talking about!  That's terrible!

7956.text: I'm ready when you are, $n. Lead the way!
We've done it! Meet me back by Jer'kai above the Grim Totem camp.
No! The faerie dragons aren't making it, $n! I must return to Jer'kai to make sure she hasn't been found. Elune be with you.
Die, $n. Elune will not have you harm her creatures any longer!
Death to you, $n. How dare you come within a bow's shot of me!
Oh, no! We've run out of time.

7978.text: Straight from the lush forests of Elwynn, get your fresh fruit right here.
Sink your teeth into a fresh, ripe apple.

7998.text: With your help, I can evaluate these tunnels.
Let's see if we can find out where these Troggs are coming from.... and put a stop to the invasion!
Such devastation... what a horrible mess...
It's quiet here....
...too quiet.
Look! Over there at the tunnel wall!
Trogg incursion! Defend me while I blast the hole closed!
I don't think one charge is going to cut it. Keep fending them off!
The charges are set. Get back before they blow!
Incoming blast in 10 seconds!
Incoming blast in 5 seconds. Clear the tunnel! Stay back!
FIRE IN THE HOLE!
Well done! Without your help I would have never been able to thwart that wave of troggs.
Did you hear something?
I heard something over there.
More troggs! Ward them off as I prepare the explosives!
The final charge is set. Stand back!
10 seconds to blast! Stand back!!!
5 seconds until detonation!!!!!
Superb! Because of your help, my people stand a chance of re-taking our beloved city. Three cheers to you!

8020.text: You will not defile our sacred land!

8022.text: Make no sound during the ritual.  One misstep could spell our doom...

8115.text: The muisek vessels are now ready, $n.
%s gathers the materials together and begins to work.

8127.text: The children of Sul will protect their master. Rise once more Sul'lithuz!
Lunch has arrived, my beautiful children. Tear them to pieces!

8256.text: Poor Dorius. If I ever get my hands on those Dark Irons, so help me...
I have just the spot for this horn!
I've been saving this spot for something special. I don't think it gets any more special than this, $n.

8284.text: Stop... need to catch.... my breath.
This is the place, $r: The Cauldron! Mark it on a map or do something so that you don't forget. If anything ever happened to me, my team would be stuck in that mine forever.
I've got to quit smoking! Give me a minute to catch my breath.
We're almost to safety. From here, we run. Try not to get too far behind! GO!
The gate is in sight! We're going to make it! But first, I need to take a breather.
%s points to the parchment on the ground.
Are you going to let an injured dwarf do all the work for you?
It's on! $n, meet my fists. Fists, say hello to $n.
I'm about to open a can on this $n.
Onward! And be on guard this time! I'm not going to carry anymore fights.

8337.text: The secrets of Suntara will not leave these lands.

8338.text: %s disappears in a cloud of dust.

8380.text: Stand Prepared! The naga won't wait long to press their advantage once they know we're alive.

8383.text: Don't make me go medieval on you.
Keep it up, $n, and I'll beat some manners into you.

8391.text: Your task is complete. Prepare to meet your doom.
Obsidion rise and serve your master!

8419.text: You dare interrupt our prayer? Execute them!
You will make a fitting sacrifice to Ragnaros.

8421.text: Bravo! Bravo! Good show. What? You thought I was dead?
Fools, I knew that if I played upon my brother's feeble emotions, he would send 'rescuers.'
How easy it was to manipulate you into recovering the last Suntara stone from those imbeciles of the Twilight's Hammer.
When I stumbled upon the Suntara stones at the Grimesilt Digsite, the power of Ragnaros surged through my being. It was Ragnaros that gave me a purpose.
It was the will of Ragnaros that Obsidion be built. Obsidion will destroy the Blackrock orcs of Blackrock Spire, uniting us with our bretheren in the fiery depths.
And ultimately, it was Ragnaros that named me when I was reborn as an acolyte of fire: Lathoric... Lathoric the Black.

8439.text: Use this Staff of Command on Raze when you are near Shadowsilk Poachers and he will make them rue the day they decided to poach in these lands.

8441.text: Raze follow $n! Raze SMASH poachers! SMASH SMASH SMASH! Tell Raze to SMASH by playing with stick! SMASH!
Use staff, tell Raze what do! Show Raze poacher! Raze smash!
Raze need go home now. Bye, bye, $r.
Bye, bye, tiny little $r. Raze go now.

8444.text: There'll be a new trade risin' up round your carcass, $n. We'll call it 'flesh-craftin.'

8479.text: Be patient, $n. The torch is almost complete.
%s falls to one knee. He looks exhausted.

8480.text: Glorious, indeed, Maltrake. It looks as if my plan worked perfectly. Wouldn't you say so, mortal?
%s lets loose a reptilian laugh... at least you think it's a laugh.
You would not have helped the legion of Blackrock had we just asked for your assistance, now would you?
They will live, if only to see the fruits of their labor: the destruction and chaos that will surely ensue as the legion of Blackrock invade the gorge.
I leave you now, mortals. Alive and with these trinkets. Maltrake! Present them with the trinkets!
Oh yes, the molt - do not lose it. There are those of my kin in the Burning Steppes that would craft items that only the molt of the black Dragonflight could fortify.
%s begins to flap his massive wings faster. He is preparing for flight.
The legion of Blackrock comes, dwarflings! We shall scorch the earth and set fire to the heavens. None shall survive...

8506.text: My eyes!  It burns... it burns...
Torture me no more!  Release me, mortal!  The Swamp of Sorrows... mortal... please...
Foolish mortal, I will rend your soul in two once I am released!
You are an agent of their wicked god, fool.  I will see you destroyed!
My soul is not a trinket!  Mortal, you must release me from these chains!
It hurts so much... Itharius, my old friend... Please help me...
Will the nightmare ever end?!  I cannot force myself awake!
My charge to watch the temple has failed... my corrupted soul knows no peace...

8509.text: What will we do with them, master? They are of no use to us anymore.

8516.text: All right, stay close.  These fiends will jump right out of the shadows at you if you let your guard down.
Okay, here we go.  It's going to take about five minutes to shut this thing down through the ritual.  Once I start, keep the vermin off of me or it will be the end of us all!
Three minutes left -- I can feel the energy starting to build!  Keep up the solid defense!
Just two minutes to go!  We're half way there, but don't let your guard down!
One more minute!  Hold on now, the ritual is about to take hold!
That's it -- we made it!  The ritual is set in motion, and idol fires are about to go out for good!  You truly are the heroes I thought you would be!
You'll rue the day you crossed me, $n.

8538.text: %s lets out a high pitched screech, calling for help!
8538.comment: Unseen Servant - Call for help Say

8539.text: %s lets out a high pitched screech, calling for help!
8539.comment: Eyeless Watcher - Call for help Say

8567.text: Me smell stench of the living!

8578.text: You dare! Now feel my wrath!

8579.text: It is true, $n.  The wheels of doom now turn, inevitably, toward the true return of Hakkar!
Blood and souls for Hakkar!  HAHAHAH!

8580.text: My banishment is ended! Let the blood flow!

8581.text: Who dares?! I will destroy you!
Mistress!! They seek to destroy your work!!
Ha! Now your death is ensured!

8666.text: Don't worry, I'll find a good home for ya.
Can anyone give my adorable, extra little kitty a home?
I can't believe dad won't let me keep your sister.
Kitten for sale, looking for a good home.
What does allergic mean anyway? And what does it have to do with either of my kitties?
Will someone please give my little kitten a good home?

8668.text: %s searches for a source of arcane energy.

8696.text: Thank again, $n.  Now I'll just wait here until it's safe to leave.

8856.text: Good day to you both. I would speak to Lord Lescovar.
Thank you. The Light be with you both.
Milord, your guest has arrived. He awaits your presence.
I shall use the time wisely, milord. Thank you.

8887.text: Leave this place. <The relic emits a white hot arc of flame. A memory has been gained: A lone Dark Iron dwarf is surrounded by seven corpses, kneeling before a monolith of flame.>
You will perish here. <Your mind fills with visions of chaos and destruction.>
Do not taint these ruins, mortal. <You are engulfed in a blinding flash of light. A creature composed entirely of flame is the only thing you can remember seeing.>
Help us, outsider. <The relic crumbles to dust. A vision of eight Dark Iron dwarves performing some sort of ritual fills your head.>
He cannot be defeated. <The relic burns to nothing. The memories it held are now your own. This city was destroyed by a being not of this world.>
Your existence is acknowledged. <The relic turns to dust. Your head throbs with newfound wisdom. Something evil lurks in the heart of the mountain.>
Defiler... you will be punished for this incursion. <A symbol of flame radiates from the relic before it crumbles to the earth.>

8891.text: You can't hide from us.  Prepare to burn!

8929.text: %s is visibly shaken by the death of Emperor Thaurissan.

8962.text: I know how to speak kitty, and Effsee said thank you.

9016.text: %s begins to summon a lava spawn!

9017.text: I cannot be destroyed! By the will of Ragnaros, I shall be reborn!

9021.text: Key... get the key... Gerstahn has... key.
Try and make yourself useful, $r. GET ME OUT OF HERE! The High Interrogator has the key.
HEY! HEY YOU! $R! Get me out of here!

9026.text: I will be reborn, mortals! Incendius shall raise me from these ashes!

9116.text: May this evil aura be banished from this artifact!
I can feel the presence of evil leaving...

9117.text: Now, let's see... If I am correct, then... Hmmm...
$n, that's it! I have finally figured it out!
Ahh... My experiments never seem to work out right. Maybe I should go back downstream.
%s begins to combine different colored crystals together.
I think... I think it's working!
I know it'll work this time...
This will be my best experiment yet!
I know it'll work this time... My last 13 tries were just practice!
Now, if I add the yellow ones...

9119.text: %s adds the haze to the Bloodpetal sprouts.
%s laughs as he watches the pests run off.

9298.text: Are you sure you weren't followed here? I have a very bad feeling all of a sudden...
I haven't really figured out what it is, but there's something strange about the hot springs...
%s tosses the sword into the shallow pool.
I've found that when I throw something into this water, it has improved incredibly when I retrieve it.
Well, whatever it is, it works quite well!
And I am determined to find out more... So if you need my help again, you know where I'll be.

9447.text: You carry the taint of the Scourge.  Prepare to enter the Twisting Nether.
There is no escape for you.  The Crusade shall destroy all who carry the Scourge's taint.
The Light condemns all who harbor evil.  Now you will die!
The Scarlet Crusade shall smite the wicked and drive evil from these lands!

9453.text: $n, you have disturbed me from my rest!
%s begins to cast a powerful spell.
%s transforms the items into a totem.

9460.text: You dare spill blood on neutral ground? OUT! OUT, I SAY!
We don't take kindly to miscreants, $r.
Please tell me that you didn't just do what I think you just did. Please tell me that I'm not going to have to hurt you...
As if we don't have enough problems, you go and create more!
Believe me when I tell you this: You're gonna wish you weren't born, sissy!
Your actions shame us all, $c. I hurt inside as I beat you senseless.

9467.text: %s abandons the block he was holding up in the doorway, and looks towards the bait.

9499.text: Drink up!  There's more where that came from!
Enjoy!  You won't find better ale anywhere!
Have you tried the Dark Iron Ale?  It's the best!
Try the boar!  It's my new recipe!
What are you doing over there?
Phalanx, I think you need to teach thos person a lesson.
That's it!  No more beer until this mess is sorted out!

9500.text: I'll bring it right over, baby...

9503.text: I want more ale!  Give me more ale!

9520.text: You have come to play? Then let us play!
I know the way, insect. There is no need to prod me as if I were cattle.
Surely you do not think that you will get away with this incursion. They will come for me and you shall pay for your insolence.
I doubt you will be so lucky the next time you encounter my brethren.
What do you think you accomplish from this, fool? Even now, the Blackrock armies make preparations to destroy your world.
On darkest wing they fly. Prepare to meet your end!
The worst is yet to come!
Time to make your final stand, insect.

9528.text: Here is a beacon for you, $n.  You must keep it in your possession if you are to find the corrupted items we will need.

9529.text: Here is a beacon for you, $n.  You must keep it in your possession if you are to find the corrupted items we will need.

9538.text: %s raises his massive axe over Grark.

9539.text: Grark Lorkrub, you have been charged and found guilty of treason against the Horde. How you plead is unimportant. High Executioner Nuzrak, step forward.
%s raises his hand and then lowers it.
You, soldier, report back to Kargath at once!

9543.text: No!  Get away from me!  Help!!

9545.text: Hey Nagmara!  How about a mug of Dark Iron Ale?
Mistress, you tell Plugger that I want more of his ale.  I can't get enough!
Hey Nag, how about you slice me off a piece of that...

9546.text: Oh man, I thought I was dead for sure.  Ugh... still dizzy...
I can get back to the Stronghold on my own, I think.  Now that you bought me some time, I should be able to stealth out of here.  Who ever you are... thank you.  May Elune bless you always!

9547.text: Hey Nagmara!  How about a mug of Dark Iron Ale?
Mistress, you tell Plugger that I want more of his ale.  I can't get enough!
Hey Nag, how about you slice me off a piece of that...

9554.text: Hey Nagmara!  How about a mug of Dark Iron Ale?
Mistress, you tell Plugger that I want more of his ale.  I can't get enough!
Hey Nag, how about you slice me off a piece of that...

9564.text: The zeppelin to Undercity has just arrived! All aboard for Tirisfal Glades!

9566.text: The zeppelin to Orgrimmar has just arrived! All aboard for Durotar!

9598.text: Please, help me to get through this cursed forest, $r.
The corruption of Felwood has trapped my spirit here... I may never rest...
That I must fight against my own kind deeply saddens me.
The corruption of the fel has not left any of the creatures of Felwood untouched, $n. Please, be on your guard.
I can sense it now, $n. Ashenvale lies down this path.
$n, my form has now changed! The true strength of my spirit is returning to me now... The cursed grasp of the forest is leaving me.
Thank you, $n. Now my spirit will finally be at peace.
I sense the taint of corruption upon this $n. Help me destroy it!
This creature suffers from the effects of the fel... We must end its misery.
This $n has been driven mad from the corruption!

9623.text: A-Me good. Good, A-Me. Follow... follow A-Me. Home. A-Me go home.
Good... good, A-Me. A-Me good. Home. Find home.
A-Me home! A-Me, good! Good A-Me. Home. Home. Home.
A-Me, home. A-Me go home! $n, no stop A-Me.

9816.text: %s regains its power and breaks free of its bonds!
Ha! Ha! Ha! Thank you for freeing me, fools. Now let me repay you by charring the flesh from your bones.

9818.text: %s begins to summon in a Blackhand Veteran!
%s begins to summon in a Blackhand Dreadweaver!

9876.text: Ach! Thank you so much, $n! I'm free! Finally!
You take care of yourself! I'm gettin' out o' here.

9937.text: %s jumps into the moonwell, and goes underwater...

9996.text: I'm very curious to see what this sample of water will do!
%s pours the corrupted water onto the cat.

9997.text: Ringo? Wake up! Don't worry, I'll take care of you.

9999.text: Well, I'm not sure how far I'll make it in this state... I'm feeling kind of faint...
The heat... I can't take it...
I am feeling a little better now, thank you.
How am I feeling? Quite soaked, thank you.
Spraggle! I didn't think I'd make it back!
%s faints and falls onto the ground.
If I look woozy, slap me.  If I pass out, use the canteen.  Now let's go!

10096.text: The Sons of Thaurissan shall watch you perish in the Ring of the Law!
Unleash the fury and let it be done!
But your real punishment lies ahead.
You have been sentenced to death for crimes against the Dark Iron nation!
Haha! I bet you thought you were done!

10162.text: Excellent... it would appear as if the meddlesome insects have arrived just in time to feed my legion. Welcome, mortals!
Let not even a drop of their blood remain upon the arena floor, my children. Feast on their souls!
Foolsss... Kill the one in the dress!
Your efforts will prove fruitless. None shall stand in our way!
Do not force my hand, children! I shall use your hides to line my boots.
THIS CANNOT BE!!! Rend, deal with these insects.
The Warchief shall make quick work of you, mortals. Prepare yourselves!
Your victory shall be short lived. The days of both the Alliance and Horde are coming to an end! The next time we meet shall be the last.
The mortals have fallen! The new age of the Blackrock legion is at hand!
In this world where time is your enemy, it is my greatest ally. This grand game of life that you think you play in fact plays you. To that I say...
Ah...the heroes. You are persistent, aren't you? Your ally here attempted to match his power against mine - and paid the price. Now he shall serve me...by slaughtering you.
Get up, little red wyrm...and destroy them!n

10181.text: Sighing, %s kneels down and picks up the amulet.
%s looks down at the discarded necklace.  In her sadness, the lady incants a glamour, which beckons forth Highborne spirits.  The chamber resonates with their ancient song about the Sin'dorei...

10184.text: How fortuitous. Usually, I must leave my lair in order to feed.
This meaningless exertion bores me. I'll incinerate you all from above!
It seems you'll need another lesson, mortals!

10204.text: Misha lets OUT a loud roar AS she rakes her claws AGAINST the gronn's altar.

10216.text: Fishing is real easy.  Just take a pole with a line on it, maybe put some bait on it, and cast it out in the water.  Sure enough, them fish will start biting.
I got some extras with me; if you pay me back what I paid for them, you can have one.  I got some bait too.

10220.text: %s lets loose a guttural growl as her body collapses. A horrifying howl can be heard echoing through the halls of Blackrock Spire. Something is very, very angry.

10262.text: Bijou knows where treasures are hidden.
SQUAWK!! *cough* *cough* I need to quit smoking!
Ask Kibler about the treasure! SQUAWK!
They all go to the Spire but none ever come back... just like Bijou.
Opus wants some Cuergo's Gold... with worm.
Kibler is being investigated by G.E.T.A.

10296.text: At last - one among you is worthy of my knowledge. Worry not - I have probed your thoughts, no harm will come to you.
Listen carefully, for the lord of Blackrock will surely destroy you, should you not be prepared.
%s is surrounded by a barrier of anti-magic.
I have discerned the path that you must take. Are you prepared?

10299.text: Begone, mortal. You are not worthy of my knowledge.

10300.text: Remember, I need your help to properly channel. I will ask you to aid me several times on our path, so please be ready.
This blue light... It's strange. What do you think it means?
Please, light this while I am channeling.
This is the place. Let's light it.
It is time for the final step; we must activate the altar.
I will read the words carved into the stone, and you must find a way to light it.
The altar is glowing! We have done it!
Please, priestesses, forgive us for our intrusion. We do not wish any harm here.
We only wish to know why the wildkin guard this area...
Thank you for your help, $n. I wish you well in your adventures.
I want to stay here and reflect on what we have seen. Please see Erelas and tell him what we have learned.

10304.text: Please wait while I attempt to bind the shards together so that they will be whole once again.
Yes, I was able to reseal the relic, $n.

10373.text: What the... nobody cleanses a furbolg in MY camp!  Face the wrath of Xabraxxis!

10382.text: %s collapses but the broken body rises again!

10427.text: Lets go, $n. I am ready to reach Whitereach Post.
Now this looks familiar. If we keep heading east, I think we can... Ahh! Wyvern on the attack!
Thanks a bunch... I can find my way back to Whitereach Post from here. Be sure to talk with Motega Firemane; perhaps you can keep him from sending me home.

10440.text: %s raises an undead servant back to life!
%s attempts to cast Death Pact on his servants!

10503.text: %s loosens her grasp on the journal she had been clutching.

10541.text: It's 428,000 degrees Kraklenheit... What's happening, hot stuff!?
DING! 428,000 degrees Kraklenheit, exactly! Well, approximately. Almost. Somewhere around there...
Measuring by Kraklenheit, it is 428,000 degrees! That's Krakley!
Holy Krakle! The temperature is 428,000 degrees Kraklenheit!
The temperature is 9280 degrees Kraklenheit! That's HOT!
Wow, it's 3 degrees Kraklenheit. Keep looking.
The temperature is 12 degrees Kraklenheit. How exciting.
18 degrees Kraklenheit. It's kind of cold, actually...
It's 40 degrees Kraklenheit. Can you feel the heat? No? I really couldn't either.

10556.text: Ow!  OK, I'll get back to work, $n!

10584.text: You have summoned me, fool!  Now DIE!

10600.text: Do not push me, or I will impale you on my horns!

10602.text: %s attempts to run away in fear!

10605.text: You carry the taint of the Scourge.  Prepare to enter the Twisting Nether.
There is no escape for you.  The Crusade shall destroy all who carry the Scourge's taint.
The Light condemns all who harbor evil.  Now you will die!
The Scarlet Crusade shall smite the wicked and drive evil from these lands!

10608.text: You carry the taint of the Scourge.  Prepare to enter the Twisting Nether.
There is no escape for you.  The Crusade shall destroy all who carry the Scourge's taint.
The Light condemns all who harbor evil.  Now you will die!
The Scarlet Crusade shall smite the wicked and drive evil from these lands!

10616.text: We have yet to meet our quota for the wood demand.  Now back to work with you.
Daylight is still upon us so let's see that axe of yours chopping some more wood.
We need to get this wagon filled by the end of the day.  So back to work with you.  Chop, chop!

10646.text: Be on guard... Arnak has some strange power over the Grimtotem... they will not be happy to see me escape.
Look out, the Grimtotem are upon us!
More Grimtotems are coming this way!
Finally, free at last... I must be going now, thanks for helping me escape. I can get back to Freewind Post by myself.

10665.text: What could be taking so long?
How long can it take to pick a handful of weeds?
At this rate I could have gathered them myself!
If you want something done right, do it yourself!
As if I had all eternity.
Ah, this must be him now... no?  Bah!
Maybe I should have just bought some off of Faruza?
I had to go and requisition an Abomination... an Abomination!

10667.text: Let's find out the whole story.  That's going to take some magic...
There, it is done.  The book has been enhanced...

10676.text: %s and Raider Kerr let their wolves rest a bit and drink...
%s and Raider Kerr charge into battle...

10680.text: %s summons a Blackhand Dreadweaver to his aid!

10681.text: %s summons a Blackhand Veteran to his aid!

10684.text: Highborne spirits! Be at peace! The Crystal of Zin-Malor is whole once again!
Cursed spirits! Let go of the past! The Crystal of Zin-Malor no longer binds you!
Spirits of the Highborne! You may now rest! The curse of the crystal releases you!

10717.text: %s is summoned through a temporal rift!

10776.text: Leaping leper gnomes! I've been stuck in there for months. Thanks, gang.

10803.text: %s casually points at the orc target...
%s quickly shoots the middle target dead center...
%s then takes aim at the bottles...
%s only hits the side of the box!

10804.text: %s takes aim at the bottles again...
%s shoots from the hip at the bottles...

10808.comment: Timmy the Cruel - Yell on Spawn

10812.text: Today you have unmade what took me years to create! For this you shall all die by my hand!

10813.text: You fools think you can defeat me so easily? Face the true might of the Nathrezim!
Damn you mortals! All my plans of revenge, all my hate...I will be avenged...

10926.text: Let's go play!  No, tell me a story, Daddy!  No... let's go pick flowers!  And play tea time!  I found my dollie, did I tell you?
I missed you so much, Daddy!
You'll keep the bad people away, won't you?

10936.text: I missed you too, honey.  And I'm finally home...

10937.text: Defenders of Darrowshire!  Rally!  We must prevail!

10938.text: Captain Joseph Redpath has been corrupted!  Kill him quickly!

10939.text: Redpath!  Your life ends, here and now!

10944.text: Do not lose hope, Darrowshire!  We will not fall!
Ah!  My wounds are too severe.  Defenders, fight on without me!
Davil Lightfire has succumbed to his wounds!

10945.text: Captain Redpath!  How could you forsake us!
Captain Redpath has appeared on the battlefield!  Protect him!
Davil Lightfire is defeated!  Darrowshire is lost!

10946.text: The Light burns bright in you, Davil.  I will enjoy snuffing it out!

10948.text: Darrowshire, to arms! The Scourge approach!
Horgus is slain! Take heat, defenders of Darrowshire.
The Scourge are defeated! Darrowshire is saved!
Speak with Joseph Redpath in the center of Darrowshire.

10977.text: Oh!!! Get that thing away from me!
%s runs quickly away from Umi's Mechanical yeti.
Why do you chase me, Mechanical yeti?! WHY?!
I'm jumpy as it is... and people insist on scaring me... Next time, though, I'll be ready!

10978.text: You big meanie! Who put you up to this?
It was Umi, wasn't it?! She's always playing jokes on me, and now she's got you in on it too!

10980.text: %s marches around, roaring and making a ruckus.

11016.text: I'm ready, $n. Let's find my equipment and get out of here. I think I know where it is.
Oh my! Look at this... all these candles. I'm sure they're used for some terrible ritual or dark summoning. We best make haste!
All I need now is a golden lasso.
Let's get out of here, $n. I'm ready now!
Ah! Fresh air at last! I never thought I'd see the day...
NO! What have they done to you!?
No! My friend... what's happened? This is all my fault...
I can travel faster on my own from here, $n. Meet Jessir Moonbow near Ashenvale. She should be with the druids of the Emerald Circle. She'll tell you what to do next. Thank you so much for your help!
You will not stop me from escaping here, $r!
You kept me in that cell for too long, monster!
You will pay for what you've done to Trey!

11022.text: The deeds are mine, brother! Soon you shall be out of my way for good!
HELP! ASSASSINS HAVE COME TO KILL ME!

11023.text: The fortune is mine, Alexi! Your end comes soon!
HELP! ASSASSINS HAVE COME TO KILL ME!

11056.text: The solution is ready in my cauldron.  It's just the matter of treating both the unfinished key and the scarab.
It's done $n, and I think you'll be satisfied with the results.

11057.text: The solution is ready in my cauldron.  It's just the matter of treating both the unfinished key and the scarab.
It's done $n, and I think you'll be satisfied with the results.

11058.text: Looking for these???? You'll never have em!
I'm going to wear your skin as a smoking jacket! The stogies? You'll have to pry them from my cold dead... er... RAWR!!!!

11077.text: Who dares to approach this cauldron?  Taste my dark blade!

11136.text: May Kel'Thuzad one day feel our vengeance.

11190.text: You dare spill blood on neutral ground? OUT! OUT, I SAY!
We don't take kindly to miscreants, $r.
Please tell me that you didn't just do what I think you just did. Please tell me that I'm not going to have to hurt you...
As if we don't have enough problems, you go and create more!
Believe me when I tell you this: You're gonna wish you weren't born, sissy!
Your actions shame us all, $c. I hurt inside as I beat you senseless.

11218.text: Liladris has been waiting for me at Maestra's Post, so we should make haste, $n.
This looks like the perfect place for a nap...
You don't mind if I stop here for a moment, do you?
Be on the alert! The Blackwood furbolgs are numerous in this area...
Oh, I can see Liladris from here... Tell her I'm here, won't you?

11256.text: We have heard your requests, and we agree... it is noble in intent. We will purify your waters. Go with our blessing, shaman.

11282.text: Wanna race again? Best two out of three!

11289.text: Where is the Silver Hand?  We need their help!
Fight for your families!  Don't give up!
If we fall, then Darrowshire is doomed!

11360.text: %s flees toward the safety of another tiger.

11380.text: Welcome to the great show, friends.  Step right up to die!

11382.text: I'll feed your souls to Hakkar himself!
I'm keeping my eye on you, $N!
Don't make me angry. You won't like it when I'm angry.
%s goes into a rage after seeing his raptor fall in battle!

11447.text: That will teach you to lay off the herb, $r.

11451.comment: Wildspawn Satyr - At 30% HP - Enraged Text

11486.text: Who dares disrupt the sanctity of Eldre'Thalas? Face me, cowards!

11501.text: You no challenge me, scrubs!  I'm da king now, and I stay king FOREVER!!!

11502.text: TOO SOON! YOU HAVE AWAKENED ME TOO SOON, EXECUTUS! WHAT IS THE MEANING OF THIS INTRUSION???
FOOL! YOU ALLOWED THESE INSECTS TO RUN RAMPANT THROUGH THE HALLOWED CORE? AND NOW YOU LEAD THEM TO MY VERY LAIR? YOU HAVE FAILED ME, EXECUTUS! JUSTICE SHALL BE MET, INDEED!
NOW FOR YOU, INSECTS! BOLDLY, YOU SOUGHT THE POWER OF RAGNAROS. NOW YOU SHALL SEE IT FIRSTHAND!n
COME FORTH, MY SERVANTS! DEFEND YOUR MASTER!
YOU CANNOT DEFEAT THE LIVING FLAME! COME YOU MINIONS OF FIRE! COME FORTH, YOU CREATURES OF HATE! YOUR MASTER CALLS!

11560.text: %s is drawn to the ghost magnet...

11582.text: Now this is an example of what not to summon. Look, it's frail and brittle. One good whack from a mace will send bone shards flying.
Hmmm, this one looks like something that would be better off as a windchime. Take notes class... This is NOT what you want to summon in the heat of battle.
This one is slightly better than the last. However, it still suffers from the same flimsy bone structure as the others. When you summon one of these, you are on the right path.
Note the weak binding structure of this one. Be sure to finish your incantations or this is what you will end up with.
Wow, this one is just plain useless. Let me try again.

11583.text: Well done, my minions. The mortals' courage begins to wane! Now, let's see how they contend with the true Lord of Blackrock Spire!!!
Impossible! Rise my minions!  Serve your master once more!
Worthless $n!  Your friends will join you soon enough!
This cannot be!  I am the master here!  You mortals are nothing to my kind!  Do you hear me? Nothing!
Mages too? You should be more careful when you play with magic...
Warriors, I know you can hit harder than that! Let's see it!
Druids and your silly shapeshifting. Lets see it in action!
Priests! If you're going to keep healing like that, we might as well make it a little more interesting!
Paladins... I've heard you have many lives. Show me.
Shamans, show me what your totems can do!
Warlocks, you shouldn't be playing with magic you don't understand. See what happens?
Rogues? Stop hiding and face me!
Enough! Now you vermin shall feel the force of my birthright, the fury of the earth itself.

11596.text: Ah...the wondrous sound of kodos.  I love the way they make the ground shake... inspect the beast for me.
Hey, look out with that kodo! You had better inspect that beast before I give you credit!
That kodo sure is a beauty.  Wait a minute, where are my bifocals?  Perhaps you should inspect the beast for me.

11625.text: So sorry to leave a customer but we have places to go and people to swindle. We will be back sometime later today. Good-bye!
I am looking for some bodyguards that would like to protect the Gizelton Caravan. We are stopped on the road east of Kormek's Hut, north of Kolkar Centaur Village.
Hey, you call yourself a body guard? Get to work and protect us...
Mister body guard, are you going to earn your money or what?
You're fired! <Cough...Cork clears throat.> I mean, help!
Blast those stupid centaurs! Sigh - well, it seems you kept your bargain. Up the road you shall find Smeed Scrabblescrew, he has your money.

11626.text: Time for the Gizleton Caravan to head on out! We'll be back soon but if you cannot wait, head north to Kormek's Hut. We open shop in about an hour.
This is Rigger Gizelton asking for assistance escorting my caravan past Mannoroc Coven. I'm on the road east of Shadowprey village.
Eeck! Demons appear hungry for the kodos!
What am I paying you for? The kodos are nearly dead!
Only if I were about five feet taller, then I would show these blasphemous demons a thing or two! Help!
Wow! We did it... not sure why we thought we needed the likes of you. Nevertheless, speak with Smeed Scrabblescrew; he will give you your earnings!n

11672.text: %s refuses to die while its master is endangered!

11677.text: Snivvle is here!  Snivvle claims the Coldtooth mine!

11711.text: Wait... did you hear that? Something approaches from the west!
I've run out of arrows! I'm afraid if any more come you will need to take them on by yourself my friend.
Praise Elune! I don't know if I could have survived the day without you, friend.
My leg feels much better now, the remedy must be working. If you will excuse me, I must go report to my superiors about what has transpired here.n
Please speak with Sentinel Onaeya at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale, she will see to it that you are properly rewarded for your bravery this day.

11715.text: $n, please take a look at the sample of the Vylestem vine that I took from the caverns, so that you know what to look for...

11793.text: You do not belong in these gardens.  Your body shall nourish our lovely creations!
Nothing must befoul the gardens! You must be destroyed!

11794.text: You do not belong in these gardens.  Your body shall nourish our lovely creations!
Nothing must befoul the gardens! You must be destroyed!

11801.text: Speak with me, $n - if you are willing, the Cenarion Circle would eagerly accept your generous offer of aid.  The threat posed by the Felvine of Eldre'Thalas is indeed dire.

11832.text: We will locate the origin of the Nightmare through the fragments you collected, $n. From there we will pull Eranikus through a rift in the Dream. Steel yourself, $c. We are inviting the embodiment of the Nightmare into our world.
The rift will be opened there, above Lake Elun'ara. Prepare yourself, $n. Eranikus's entry into our world will be wrought with chaos and strife.n
He will stop at nothing to get to Malfurion's physical manifestation. That must not happen... We must keep the beast occupied long enough for Tyrande to arrive.
Fiend! Face the might of Cenarius!
Who is the predictable one, beast? Surely you did not think that we would summon you on top of Malfurion? Your redemption comes, Eranikus. You will be cleansed of this madness - this corruption.n
Hurry, $n! We must find protective cover!
It will be done, Eranikus. Be well, ancient one.
Let us leave Nighthaven, hero. Seek me out at the grove.
Come, $n. The lake is just around the bend.
Stand near me, $n. I will protect you should anything go wrong.
It was shrouded in nightmares, Malfurion. What is happening in the Dream? What could cause such atrocities?
I sensed as much, Malfurion. Dark days loom ahead.
You have been gone too long, Malfurion. Peace between the children of Azeroth is tenuous at best. What of my father? Of your brother? Have you any news?n
Let us return to the grove, mortal.

11856.text: Let's go before they find out I'm free!
Thank you for helping me. I know my way back from here.

11878.text: I shall wear your entrails as a necklace.
If you run now, you may live.
The reckoning is upon you, weakling!
Is that the best you can do?
You weren't worth the energy expenditure. <Nathanos spits.>

11880.text: %s goes into a rage after seeing a friend fall in battle!

11915.text: No kill me! No kill me!

11917.text: No kill me! No kill me!

11918.text: No kill me! No kill me!

11936.text: Is someone there? Tirion my old friend, is that you? have you come to save us?
The Sarkhoff's... sometimes the Sarkhoff's visit. They are good people.

11946.text: Stormpike filth! In my keep?! Slay them all!
You seek to draw the General of the Frostwolf legion out from his fortress? PREPOSTEROUS!
Stormpike weaklings, face me in my fortress - if you dare!
Your attacks are slowed by the cold, I think!
Today, you will meet your ancestors!
If you will not leave Alterac Valley on your own, then the Frostwolves will force you out!
You cannot defeat the Frostwolf clan!
You are no match for the strength of the Horde!

11947.text: Die!  Your kind has no place in Alterac Valley!
I'll never fall for that, fool! If you want a battle, it will be on my terms and in my lair.
Now is the time to attack!  For the Horde!

11948.text: Soldiers of Stormpike, your General is under attack! I require aid! Come! Come! Slay these mangy Frostwolf dogs.
You'll never get me out of me bunker, heathens!
Why don't ya try again without yer cheap tactics, pansies! Or are you too chicken???
I will tell you this much...Alterac Valley will be ours.
Your attacks are weak!  Go practice on some rabbits and come back when you're stronger.
We will not be swayed from our mission!
It'll take more than you rabble to bring me down!
The Stormpike clan bows to no one, especially the horde!
Is that the best you can do?
Take no prisoners! Drive these heathens from our lands!

11949.text: Begone, uncouth scum!  The Alliance shall prevail in Alterac Valley!
Filthy Frostwolf cowards! If you want a fight, you'll have to come to me!
Take heart, Alliance!  Throw these villains from Alterac Valley!

11980.text: Lord Illidan, bless me with the power of the flight!
Foolish mortals. Did you think that I would not strike you down for your transgressions?
Indeed, the time has come to end this charade.

12017.text: None of your kind should be here!  You've doomed only yourselves!
Clever, mortals - but I am not so easily lured away from my sanctum!

12018.text: Reckless mortals! None may challenge the Sons of the Living flame!
Impossible! Stay your attack, mortals... I submit! I submit!
Brashly, you have come to wrest the secrets of the Living Flame! You will soon regret the recklessness of your quest.
I go now to summon the lord whose house this is. Should you seek an audience with him, your paltry lives will surely be forfeit! Nevertheless, seek out his lair, if you dare!
The runes of warding have been destroyed! Hunt down the infidels, my brethren!
You think you've won already? Perhaps you'll need another lesson in pain!
Impudent whelps! You've rushed headlong to your own deaths! See now, the master stirs!n
Behold Ragnaros - the Firelord! He who was ancient when this world was young! Bow before him, mortals! Bow before your ending!
These mortal infidels, my lord! They have invaded your sanctum and seek to steal your secrets!

12056.text: %s performs one last service for Ragnaros...

12057.text: %s forces one of his Firesworn minions to erupt!

12116.text: Who has disturbed the altar of the goddess?
Enu thora'serador. This is a sacred place.n
Look above you; thara dormil dorah...
This gem once allowed direct communication with Elune, herself.
Through the gem, Elune channeled her infinite wisdom...
Realizing that the gem needed to be protected, we turned to the goddess herself.
Soon after, we began to have visions of a creature... A creature with the feathers of an owl, but the will and might of a bear...
It was on that day that the wildkin were given to us. Fierce guardians, the goddess assigned the wildkin to protect all of her sacred places.n
But now, many years later, the wildkin have grown more feral, and without the guidance of the goddess, they are confused...n
Without a purpose, they wander... But many find their way back to the sacred areas that they once were sworn to protect.n
Wildkin are inherently magical; this power was bestowed upon them by the goddess.
Know that wherever you might find them in the world, they are protecting something of importance, as they were entrusted to do so long ago.
Please, remember what we have shown you...

12136.text: The zeppelin to Grom'gol has just arrived! All aboard for Stranglethorn!

12137.text: The zeppelin to Undercity has just arrived! All aboard for Tirisfal Glades!

We're going to have to scratch the Maraudines off our list.  Too hard to work with...
Well, I'm off to the Gelkis.  They're not as dumb as the Maraudines, but they're more reasonable.

12319.text: You've interfered with our plans for the last time, foolish $c!

12321.text: You've interfered with our plans for the last time, foolish $c!

I'm Augustus, and my prices are INSANE!

Ah, $gpriest:priestess;, you came along just in time. I appreciate it.
Argh, the pain. Will it ever leave me?

Fools! These eggs are more precious than you know!
No - not another one! I'll have your heads for this atrocity!
If I fall into the abyss, I'll take all of you mortals with me!

12557.text: Intruders have breached the hatchery! Sound the alarm! Protect the eggs at all costs!n

12717.text: Are you sure that you are ready? If we do not have a group of your allies to aid us, we will surely fail.
This will be a tough fight, $n. Follow me closely!
This is the brazier, $n. Put it out. Vorsha is a beast, worthy of praise from no one!
Now we must wait. It won't be long before the naga realize what we have done.
Perhaps we will get a moment to rest. But I will not give up until we have faced off against Vorsha!
You have my deepest gratitude. I thank you.
I am going to patrol the area for a while longer and ensure that things are truly safe.
Please return to Zoram'gar and report our success to the Warsong Runner.

12807.text: Look at her down there!  Just who does she think she is?

12818.text: Thank you for freeing me.  Speak with my sister in Splintertree.  I... I must find a place to rest...

12858.text: Prepare yourselves.  Silverwing is just around the bend.
Go report that the outpost is taken.  We will remain here.
Steady, people.  We'll raid soon enough.
With luck, we'll gain some good scars today.
These woods make my tusks itch...
They say Duriel is a fierce night elf.  It'll be a good fight!
We'll be notching our axes after this.
Stay calm, people.  We don't want to give away our position.

12860.text: Who dares attack the Silverwing Outpost?!?

12918.text: You are a little gnat to the Foulweald!  Die!
No!  You cannot be stronger than the Foulweald!  No!!

12997.text: Into the box me pretties! Thas it. One by one ye go.
Overflowin' with rats! Help a pirate out, matey!
Do yer part in keepin' the Deeprun Tram clean!

I beg you, mortals - FLEE! Flee before I lose all sense of control! The black fire rages within my heart! I MUST- release it!
FLAME! DEATH! DESTRUCTION! Cower, mortals before the wrath of Lord...NO - I MUST fight this! Alexstrasza help me, I MUST fight it!
Nefarius' hate has made me stronger than ever before! You should have fled while you could, mortals! The fury of Blackrock courses through my veins! n
Forgive me, $n! Your death only adds to my failure!

13257.text: Seasoned units are entering the battle!
Veteran units are entering the battle!

13716.text: You wish to learn of the stone? Follow me.
For so long I have drifted in my cursed form. You have freed me... Your hard work shall be repaid.
Please do as I instruct you, $n.
Read this tome I have placed before you, and speak the words aloud.
%s begins to channel his energy, focusing on the stone.
Together, the two parts shall become one, once again.
My scepter will once again become whole!
Perhaps we can attempt this later. Please speak to me again if you wish to do so.

My family was wiped out by the Scourge! MONSTER!

14325.text: No one get past me and threaten da king!  Ungh, take it!!
%s begins to retaliate all attacks against him!

Hey, who Fengus callin' a gnoll lover?!  Take da prisoners to da king; you smart to bring them with their weapons and show da king that they a threat.  I'll go see if Fengus talk smack when I give him da beatdown!  HAR!
OK Fengus, where you at?!  You come call me a gnoll lover while I give you da hammer upside da head!

14354.text: If you want the key, you'll have to catch me!
Chase me if you dare! I run without a care!
Why would you ever want to harm me!? Come. Friends we can be!
Say hello to my little friends!

14368.text: I very much doubt that he will have anything to say, stranger...

I personally didn't mind him. It was the Prince who took exception to a high elf in his domain. Alas, I am not one to question the Prince. In his defense, he did not incinerate Master Winthalus immediately.

We most definitely do not need anymore attention drawn to us, stranger. Return to those that sent you in search of the lost master and tell them that nothing could be found. When this is done - and I will know when it is so - return and I shall reveal the secrets of the deceased.

People of Orgrimmar, bow down before the might of $n and $g his:her; allies for they have laid a blow against the Black Dragonflight that is sure to stir the Aspects from their malaise! This defeat shall surely be felt by the father of the Black Flight: Deathwing reels in pain and anguish this day!
Be lifted by $n's accomplishment! Revel in $g his:her; rallying cry!

Ah, and the fool who freed me shall be among the first to quell my immense hunger.
My power is discombobulatingly devastating! It is ludicrous that these mortals even attempt to enter my realm!n

Silence, servant! Vengeance will be mine! Death to Stormwind! Death by chicken!
This is it, Impsy. I can feel it! This is the big one!
Brace yourself for the glorious impact, Impsy!
Kick me out, will they!? I'll show those uptight cone heads in Stormwind the true power of Niby! BEHOLD!

Ack! Help! Crazed gnome trying to kill me!

14497.text: It's so sad for you poor children.
Now children stop that!  I mean it!
All will be well children.  The Light shall see to that!
I believe you children are our future...

14498.text: You are mine now, children.  You will grow up to be a strong part of the Horde!

14507.text: Let the coils of hate unfurl!

14509.text: Shirvallah, fill me with your RAGE!
Hakkar binds me no more!  Peace at last!

14510.text: Draw me to your web mistress Shadra. Unleash your venom!
Shadra, make of me your avatar!
Bless you, mortals, for this release...Hakkar controls me no longer!

14515.text: Bethekk, your priestess calls upon your might!
At last, I am free of the Soulflayer!

14516.text: ENOUGH - this ends now!  You fools will be added to my bone collection!

14517.text: Lord Hir'eek, grant me wings of vengeance!
I command you to rain fire down upon these invaders!
Finally...death!  Curse you, Hakkar!  Curse you!
%s begins to cast a Great Heal!

FOR YOUR EFFRONTERY TO THE LICH KING!

15183.text: I will do my best to translate and describe what I see.

It is history... A history of Silithus... of Ahn'Qiraj... of Titans and Old Gods... I read from the prophecy of C'Thun as written by the Qiraji Prophet Skeram. A prophecy that portends a cataclysm...n

In the time before time, when the world was still in its infancy, a battle between a Titan and a being of unimaginable evil and power raged on this very soil. The prophecy is unclear about whether or not the Titan was vanquished in this battle but it illustrates that a Titan fell. An Old God had also fallen - or so it was thought.n
For millennia this being lay dormant beneath the world - biding its time. From its prison it waited for the exact moment at which to strike back at those that would see it harmed.n

The land of eternal starlight, Kalimdor, was a nurturing mother to all of its creatures. The magic of the Well of Eternity permeated the land and empowered the multitude of flora and fauna that would make the world their home. From this magical ether were born the silithid. It was through the silithid that the brooding Old God would reach and attempt to sunder the world that it once held in its unmerciful grasp. n

The Old God would create avatars from the silithid in its own image. These avatars were to be known as Qiraji. Sentient and with purpose, the Qiraji would name their creator: C'Thun was born... For many thousands of years the Qiraji worked feverishly to build a force capable of laying waste to the world that would betray their god. The great fortress city of Ahn'Qiraj was created to house their growing armies and prepare for the coming of C'Thun.n
This can't be right. An Old God could never be allowed to enter this world. The results would be... Oh dear!
%s regains her composure.
There is more.

The moment that C'Thun had so patiently waited for had finally arrived. His children had spent thousands of years building an army capable of exacting revenge upon the whole of Kalimdor and now the prize was within their grasp.n
The Titans had long since vacated this world. Only the night elves that once inhabited this area were here to defend. Oh my! The next passage is fascinating!n

A mighty Qiraji known as General Rajaxx would command the initial incursion into Silithus. Only one would stand in his way: A night elf known as Staghelm. They refer to him as Khar'sis or 'hand of the earth' in the native Qiraji tongue.n

Staghelm and his armies were clearly overwhelmed as the endless flow of Rajaxx's troops poured into Silithus. It would seem as if Staghelm, however, was more than just a nuisance to the Qiraji. Under Staghelm, the whole of the night elf armies had come together to defend Kalimdor, greatly slowing the Qiraji forces.n

Unfortunately, the night elf defense was untenable and Rajaxx knew that they could not hold out much longer. Their tenacity, however, was causing great frustration to Rajaxx and causing even more frustration to his king. Wait, kings? Incredible...n
Vek'nilash and Vek'lor, known as the Twin Emperors of Ahn'Qiraj, watched the war from the sanctuary of their temple. The clever brothers devised a plan to demoralize and divide Staghelm's forces.

Valstann Staghelm served as the right hand of Fandral. A proud and noble warrior, his dedication and adoration for his father unyielding... and the Twin Emperors sensed this as weakness. A weakness that could be exploited.n

The Qiraji forces were commanded to fall back and hide the bulk of their numbers beneath the sands of the desert. A small attack was ordered upon Southwind Village while the front lines of Staghelm's army were kept occupied.

Valstann, eager to please his father, convinced Fandral to allow him to take a small battalion to the defense of Southwind. Surely with the tide of battle turning their way, no harm could come to his beloved child. The trap was missed. Valstann was captured by the hiding Qiraji and Southwind Village obliterated. Rajaxx himself would take the captive Valstann to the front lines of the battle where - in front of Staghelm and the night elf forces - he would brutally execute the young night elf.n
The war continued but the will of the great leader was sapped. The whole of Silithus was soon engulfed by the silithid and their Qiraji hosts.
Poor man, this explains so much.

The night elf army was pushed back through Un'Goro, to the borders of the Tanaris desert. Something in Un'Goro prevented the Qiraji from being able to take the land. I do not quite understand this word but I believe it to mean 'God Lands.' It is stated that they could not 'take the God Lands.' n
Fascinating, this coincides with theories of Un'Goro being the home of the Titans when they inhabited Kalimdor. Perhaps Aman'thul himself watched over 'The God Lands.'

Oh, I've gone and made a mess...

15688.text: Your blood will anoint my circle!
The great one will be pleased.
My life is yours, oh great one...
Ah, you're just in time. The rituals are about to begin!
Please accept this humble offering, oh great one...
Let this sacrifice serve as testament to my fealty.
Come, you dwellers in the dark! Rally to my call!
Gather, my pets... there is plenty for all!

15690.text: Madness has brought you here to me. I shall be your undoing!
Simple fools! Time is the fire in which you'll burn!
I see the subtlety of conception is beyond primitives such as you.
Who knows what secrets hide in the dark.
The cerestial forces are mine to manipulate.
How can you hope to stand against such overwhelming power?
Surely you did not think you could win.
Your greed, your foolishness has brought you to this end.
You are but a plaything. Unfit even to amuse.
All realities, all dimensions are open to me!
You face not Malchezaar alone, but the legions I command!
I refuse to concede defeat! I am a prince of the Eredar! I... am...

15691.text: The Menagerie is for guests only.
Gallery rules will be strictly enforced.
This Curator is equipped for gallery protection.
Failure to comply will result in offensive action.

15692.text: Ye'll be feasting on me blade this Winter Veil!  Yeargh!
No scallywag $c is taking our Winter Veil plunder!  Get 'em!
These land lubbers are here for the reindeer!  Give 'em the shank!
It's a rescue attempt!  Let no one escape!
Let me give you my regards for Greatfather Winter, scum...
It's a rescue attempt!  Slay them all!
The only thing Metzen is going to be doing this Winter Veil is roasting on a spit!

15745.text: Presents for everyone! Father Winter's put gifts under the tree for all.

15746.text: Presents for everyone! Father Winter's put gifts under the tree for all.

15928.text: You are too late!! I... must... obey!!

15936.text: The races of the world will perish. It is only a matter of time.
I see endless suffering. I see torment. I see rage. I see everything...
Hungry worms will feast on your rotting flesh.
%s teleports and begins to channel a spell!

15945.text: You can't do this to me!  We had a deal!

15951.text: Good riddance... now none shall be able to repeat my mistakes!

15952.text: %s spins her web into a cocoon!

15953.text: Your old lives, your mortal desires mean nothing... you are acolytes of the master now, and you will serve the cause without question! The greatest glory is to die in the master's service!
Slay them in the master's name!

15954.text: Rise, my soldiers! Rise and fight once more!
I will serve the master... in death!

15956.text: Yes, run! It makes the blood pump faster!
I hear little hearts beating. Yes... beating faster now... soon the beating will stop.
Where to go? What to do? So many choices that all end in pain, end in death.
Which one shall I eat first? So difficult to choose. They all smell so delicious...
Closer now. Tasty morsels. I've been too long without food, without blood to drink.
Shhh... it will all be over soon.
Anub'Rekhan begins to unleash an insect swarm!

15989.text: Sapphiron lifts off into the air!

15990.text: Your forces are nearly marshaled to strike back against your enemies, my liege.
It is good that you serve me so faithfully. Soon, all will serve the Lich King and in the end, you shall be rewarded...so long as you do not falter.
Yes, master. The time of their ultimate demise draws close.... What is this?
Your security measures have failed! See to this interruption immediately!
As you command, master!
No!!! A curse upon you, interlopers! The armies of the Lich King will hunt you down. You will not escape your fate...
Pray for mercy!
Scream your dying breath!
The end is upon you!
The dark void awaits you!
%s cackles maniacally.n
Agghhhh! Do... not... rejoice! Your victory is a hollow one, for I shall return with powers beyond your imagining!
Your soul is bound to me, now!
There will be no escape!
I will freeze the blood in your veins!
Master, I require aid!
Kel'Thuzad strikes!
Minions, servants, soldiers of the cold dark! Obey the call of Kel'Thuzad!
Your petty magics are no challenge to the might of the Scourge!
Enough! I grow tired of these distractions!
Fools, you have spread your powers too thin. Be free, my minions!
Who dares violate the sanctity of my domain? Be warned, all who trespass here are doomed.
Fools! You think yourselves triumphant? You have only taken one step closer to the abyss!
I grow tired of these games. Proceed, and I will banish your souls to oblivion!
You have no idea what horrors lie ahead. You have seen nothing! The frozen heart of Naxxramas awaits you!
Come, heroes... By the will of the Lich King, you shall be destroyed.

16011.text: An aura of necrotic energy blocks all healing!
The aura fades away, allowing healing once more!
The aura's power begins to wane!

16028.text: Kel'thuzad make Patchwerk his avatar of war!

16031.text: You did it... you've slain Baron Rivendare!  The Argent Dawn shall hear of your valiant deeds!

16059.text: I'm going to kick yer ugly head in!
You want a fight?  A fight you'll get!
I crush weaklings like you every day!  Bring it on!

16060.text: Foolishly you have sought your own demise.
Brazenly you have disregarded powers beyond your understanding.
You have fought hard to invade the realm of the harvester.
Now there is only one way out- to walk the lonely path of the damned.
I have waited long enough. Now you face the harvester of souls.

16061.text: The time for practice is over! Show me what you have learned!
Sweep the leg... Do you have a problem with that?

16063.text: Do not continue! Turn back while there's still time!
I have no choice but to obey!
It is... as it should be.
Invaders, cease this foolish venture at once! Turn away while you still can!
Perhaps they will come to their senses... and run away as fast as they can.

16064.text: C'mon an' fight ye wee ninny!
I'm gonna' enjoy killin' these slack-jawed daffodils!
I like my meat extra crispy!
What a bloody waste this is!
To arms, ye roustabouts! We've got company!
I've heard about enough a' yer snivelin'! Shut yer flytrap before I shut it for ye'!

16065.text: The first kill goes to me! Anyone care to wager?
Come, Zeliek, do not drive them out. Not before we've had our fun!
I do hope they stay alive long enough for me to... introduce myself.

16113.text: You've really outdone yourself this time, Mrs. Chambers. Not a spot of mold to be found!

16114.text: Your message did reach us, Commander, but by no means is our involvement here sanctioned by the Grand Crusader.
The heathens will be forced to react. Orcs, bull-men...
Whatever. The revolting, unkempt Horde filth...
Too little, too late. The dam has broken. We are a bump in the road at best.
And might I add, that dress is lovely! You must tell me where you got it from.

16115.text: Your leader takes residence at the doorstep to Naxxramas. Do you think he does not feel the pressure?n
%s lowers the sound of his voice to a whisper.
Even demons are capable of fear...

Scourge activity in the Plaguelands has increased ten-fold. We are receiving reports of Scourge attacks from as far away as Kalimdor! Now how do you suppose this has happened? How have the wretched undead done that which was previously thought impossible? Is nowhere safe?
You lack tact, Commander. This is not surprising. However, you are right in that the Horde will be forced to act. But not just the Horde. They already come - heroes from across the world.
So why are you here? What are we to do if there is no hope?
So this is what you have come for? To try and claim that which is the reason for the Dawn's existence and the Crusade's downfall? You open old wounds with your words, Commander!

The Ashbringer is dead and there will never be another like him. The lesser Mograine is a far cry from the man his father was. You know this, Commander! It was, after all, your own leadership that was responsible for the death of the Scarlet Highlord Mograine.

It was your leadership that manipulated a grieving child to try and recover the sword. A child that has grown into a man with nothing but vengeance and hatred in his heart! And for what? You are no closer to the sword now than you were five years ago.n

Yet you think that recovering Ashbringer will somehow turn the tide of battle? Let me let you in on a little secret, Commander: The power of the Ashbringer came from the man who would wield it... I was there, Commander. I watched him burn legions of undead in righteous fire before he would even unsheathe the blade. Alas, your grasp on history is ... lacking.

Now be silent and note where you are, lest I inform Lord Fordring and his knights that you are no longer here on amicable terms. I am certain he would take great pleasure in seeing to your 'atonement.'

16116.text: Oh, quite succulent. Many thanks, Mrs. Chambers.

16118.text: You think you can summon us? We are the ones that summon, not you! We bash you good for this and suck the marrow from your bones!
First Kormok crush your bones!  Then Kormok burn your soul!
You so little and puny... you no make good servants for Kormok!
We am free! Thank you little, puny ones.

16128.text: We received Brann's message, and we have begun preparations.
Citizens of Dalaran! Raise your eyes to the skies and observe!
Today our world's destruction has been averted in defiance of our very makers!
Algalon the Observer, herald of the titans, has been defeated by our brave comrades in the depths of the titan city of Ulduar.
Algalon was sent here to judge the fate of our world.
He found a planet whose races had deviated from the titans' blueprints. A planet where not everything had gone according to plan.
Cold logic deemed our world not worth saving. Cold logic, however, does not account for the power of free will. It's up to each of us to prove this is a world worth saving.
That our lives... our lives are worth living.

16134.text: Watch, druid. The earth still breathes. It yearns to be cleansed.

16135.text: That is wonderous, Rimblat! Even this foul, sundered earth is not beyond healing.

16144.text: As you say, my dear, as you say.
Hmm, what was that? I'm sorry my dear, I must have been daydreaming.
Oh, most definitely, Elisara. But please, can you show the least bit of patience?
Is that so? How very interesting. My dear, why don't you run along and powder your nose? I have much to think about.

16147.text: I was just thinking... we really ought to take a trip south one of these nights, maybe have an evening picnic overlooking the fighting at the border? What do you think, milord? Wouldn't that just be so exciting?
Milord, with much of the sin'dorei nobility regrettably crushed, does that mean that you are likely to receive an elevation soon?  I'm so excited for you!
Milord, do you think that we can join the party soon? I'm so bored in here.
Oh, my lordship, I do so hope that you've arranged for more of that excellent wine from Silvermoon City. I dare say drinking it makes me feel almost as forward as a common woman!
I'm so tired. We really shouldn't have stayed up so late last night,,, well this morning. But it was fun! You do throw the best soirees milord.

Lord Saltheril, my dear, did you notice that supplies for the party are a little low? We really should send for one of those couriers from Fairbreeze Village to deliver more of whatever is needed. I especially like those little hors d'oeuvres wrapped in the smoked bacon. What are those called?
Salthy, do you think we're letting too many 'undesirables' into the party?  I do worry about what our friends might think of all of this.
You promised to take me out for a night on the town!  Are we just going to stand around here again tonight?

16152.text: Another trophy to add to my collection!
Amateurs! Do not think you can best me! I kill for a living.
Weapons are merely a convenience for a warrior of my skill!
Always knew... someday I would become... the hunted.

16196.text: You're not going anywhere just yet, handsome.  Not until you regain your strength.

16204.text: Why doesn't Kaendris move against Dar'Khan yet?  What is it we're waiting for?

16206.text: Th... thank you.  I thought I was going to die.

16208.text: Thanks, I should've never left Silverpine Forest.

16213.text: %s peers inside the tower and then clenches his jaw.

16217.text: This isn't Silvermoon City! Where are we? Oh, I was confused there for a moment.

I tell you now, when we get back to Farstrider Enclave there will be a full accounting of your actions, Ranger Valanna! You alone were responsible for our losses and I'm certain that the captain will see it my way.
I'm sure to receive a commendation upon our return. We may have suffered a few losses, but overall I think we did quite nicely, don't you, Valanna?
Did I not yell at them? Pull back! Pull back and regroup with suppressing fire!!
They should have listened to me.  Then I'd receive all of the accolades that are my due!

16219.text: You have got to be the most incompetent officer I have ever met!
Remind me once again why it is that I don't just leave?
With all due respect, sir, stick it!

16220.text: %s nods in relief to Ranger Lilatha and her escort.
Lilatha, get someone to look at those injuries. Thank you for bringing her back safely.

16222.text: Glory to the Sun K-- ah... Silvermoon!
Our lives are yours, Blood Knight.
Even the Light is no match for the indomitable will of our people.

16231.text: %s nods her head yes at what her advisor has to say.
%s disagrees with whatever it is that Valwyn has whispered to her.
%s seems nonplussed by whatever it is that her advisor has whispered in her ear.

Executor, your direct assault approach will cost us more lives than I am comfortable with. A more nuanced strategy is called for; one that involves us reclaiming the surrounding territory, starting with the villages so as to cut off all points of reinforcement to Deatholme.

I hear what you are saying, Mavren. Nevertheless, the final decision is mine. I appreciate your assistance, but the majority of the lives on the line are blood elf. I will not have those lives carelessly thrown away!
How long until Forsaken reinforcements arrive? Our position here is tenuous. Your Lady promised us more soldiers. We must be able to concentrate solely on Deatholme and the Scourge!

Mavren, I don't want excuses, I want results! The Farstriders aren't available and we've received all that we're going to get from Silvermoon for now. I cannot ignore the Shadowpine trolls and Zul'Aman... they're arrayed across our eastern border!
No, I was right to begin with. Deatholme must come last. We must secure all of the Ghostlands first. I will not commit the forces here to a battle against Dar'khan with enemies to our flank and rear!
Disagree with me all you like, High Executor. I will weigh your counsel, and then we will take the steps to free all of Quel'Thalas as I deem necessary. We shall continue this discussion anon.

16240.text: Calm yourself, Idonis.  Brash actions will get us nowhere!  Take a break, tap into some mana crystals.  You'll feel better.
He's got his reasons, Idonis.  He thinks the Farstriders have uncovered something.
We must remain focused on our work.  Once the sanctum starts producing at full capacity, Silvermoon will be forced to send help.  Functioning arcane sanctums are in short supply.

16251.text: %s opens his mouth as if to add something, and then apparently thinks the better of it.
%s looks over at Advisor Valwyn with a smirk on his face.
%s grins at the High Executor's words.
%s appears bored with the whole discussion.
%s fidgets with his armor, clearly uncomfortable at the tone of the discussion.
%s looks like he'd rather be anywhere else but here.
%s turns to Advisor Valwyn and winks lasciviously in her direction.

16252.text: With all due respect, milady, you have not fought the Scourge as I have. The Lady appointed me to assist you in defeating Dar'khan because of that, and you would do well to consider what I have to say.

I strongly disagree. Dar'khan is not going to get reinforcements because he'll be bottlenecked. Deatholme has only one way in and out. Your traitor was a fool to corner himself there, and I intend to exploit that weakness!

This is war, Dame Auriferous, and in any war lives will be lost! The only areas that we need to secure are the two ziggurats. We will turtle in and take the Tower of the Damned and its master by brute force. Then you will have your Quel'Thalas.

And if your Farstriders were here to reinforce us, I might agree. But, they are busying themselves instead with the Shadowpine trolls on your eastern border. The longer we wait for them, the stronger the Scourge will become.

I believe that you're making my argument for me, but yes it would be nice if we had more reinforcements. I would counter that it would be faster to pull the Farstriders from their senseless skirmishing with the trolls.

Dame Auriferous, we are the reinforcements. It may come to pass that The Lady will send more men in time. Better that you convince Silvermoon City to muster all of its forces and put them at our disposal here.

You are correct; we must concentrate on the Scourge. Ignore the trolls and the villages, and focus our attentions on Deatholme! With Dar'khan defeated you will find that the rest of the Scourge 'body' will fall quickly, lacking their 'head'.
Forsaken reinforcements? Undercity is stretched thin with the Scourge on all sides. No, this will be a matter largely dealt with by the blood elves. We Forsaken are here as backup and advisors.

Again I strongly disagree with your view of the strategic situation. Your plan will spread our forces too thin. It will leave us with only a small force to assault Deatholme. I cannot in good conscience execute such a strategy.
Spread throughout the Ghostlands, our forces will be of little use in an assault on Deatholme. No, milady, I am here to kill Dar'khan and that is what I intend to do!

We've been over this before. Only a focused assault upon Deatholme will meet with success. These other targets are distractions that we can ill afford. I suggest that you inform your Captain Helios that he is to leave off his campaign against the Shadowpine trolls and focus solely on the Scourge.

Perhaps we should let the matter rest for the time being until your chef has prepared your meal? You look a bit piqued if you don't mind my saying. We can resume our discussion when you are feeling more yourself.

16256.text: Ok, you had the fish platter, Commander. Enjoy!
Father, you had the bowl of fruit? Right?
And for the ladies, roast baby boar. Enjoy!
Please let me know if you need anything else!

16263.text: Why do we ally with filthy stinking trolls?  The only good troll is a dead troll.
Does anyone need supplies to hunt down the trolls?  Any troll will do.

16287.text: That could have gone better. $n, come here, please. I have something I need you to take care of for me.

16289.text: %s whispers something in the Dame's ear.
%s looks appalled at the Executor's tone!
%s tries to busy herself with other matters.
%s glares daggers in the direction of High Executor Mavren and Deathstalker Maltendis.
%s lifts her nose and sniffs in response to the High Executor's reply.
%s shakes her head in disbelief at what she is hearing out of the Forsaken's mouth.
%s blanches as much of the blood drains from her face.
%s reddens furiously at what she is hearing in response to her lady's question.
%s concentrates on the wall opposite her, clearly ignoring the looks of the Executor and his assistant.
%s looks disgusted at the deathstalker's flirtations.

16295.text: $n, let's use the antechamber to the right.
I can see the light at the end of the tunnel!
There's Farstrider Enclave now, $c. Not far to go... look out!  Troll ambush!!
Thank you for saving my life and bringing me back to safety, $n!
Captain Helios, I've been rescued from the Amani Catacombs. Reporting for duty, sir!
Hey!  Could you come over and get me out of this cage?
Get me out of here and I guarantee there'll be a reward in it for you!
Quick, kill all of these trolls and then let me out of this thing!
If you let me out I promise that you won't regret it!
If you don't mind hurrying it up?  I think they're getting ready to sacrifice me!

16329.text: Mortal fools!  The ghouls of Deatholme will feast on your remains!

16364.text: %s releases the last of its energies into the nearby runestone, successfully reactivating it.

16406.text: We do not wish to be disturbed!

16408.text: The fates have turned against me!
No, not now! Not like this!
Hey! Where do you think you are going, sneaking around like that?
Excuse me, are you trying to sneak by without an invitation?

16409.text: It's not my time, not yet!
All good things must come to an end.
Leave us alone! Let us be!

16410.text: We do not wish to be disturbed!

16411.text: I'll chop you into minced meat!
I'll gut you like a fish!
I'll carve the meat from your bones!
I have served to the last....
This isn't the end; it can't be!

16412.text: I'll chop you into minced meat!
I'll gut you like a fish!
I'll carve the meat from your bones!
I have served to the last....
This isn't the end; it can't be!

16414.text: That was a 200 year old Pupellyverbos Port!
That was wasted on the likes of you!
How dare you disturb the master's dinner!
How dare you spill the master's wine!
Meddling fools! You will pay with your lives!
You'll never make it out alive....

16441.text: A Guardian of Icecrown enters the fight!

16457.text: Your behavior will not be tolerated.
Impure thoughts lead to profane actions.
Death comes. Will your conscience be clear?

16459.text: So I said, "Yeah, but that'll cost you extra."
He asked if the imp could join in--can you believe it? Actually, it wasn't half bad....
They fall asleep after. Me, I fall asleep during....
Come here, pretty. You have what I need!
It was fun while it lasted....
Just when things were getting interesting.
We could have had so much fun!
Come any closer, and I'll scream.
I want to show you a different side of me....
I want you to be with me... forever and ever.
Shhh... I have a little secret I've been keeping.n
Enough foreplay. Let's get down to business.

16460.text: He asked if the imp could join in--can you believe it? Actually, it wasn't half bad....
So I said, "Yeah, but that'll cost you extra."
They fall asleep after. Me, I fall asleep during....

He asked if the imp could join in--can you believe it? Actually, it wasn't half bad....
