16464.text: %s cackles maniacally as he combines the two mixtures in his hands.
Drat!  This bloodthistle extract doesn't seem to want to combine properly with my poison.  I'll not be deterred - those trolls will be dealt with!  Perhaps a different mixture?

16468.text: Yes, I think I remember now....
What are you doing? Be off!

16470.text: It's all... coming back to me....
Your insolence will not be tolerated!

16471.text: The show is for guests only!
You should not have come here!
You'll be joining the other guests now....

16472.text: Am I released from my duties?
At last, my work is done.

16473.text: I will not be upstaged by amateurs!
It's so cold, so dark.... I'm not overacting, am I?
Make sure my name is spelled correctly on the tombst--

16481.text: You will find no reward here, only death!

16482.text: You will find no reward here, only death!

16483.text: The last thing I remember is the ship falling and us getting into the pods.  I'll go see how I can help.  Thank you!
Where am I?  Who are you?  Oh no!  What happened to the ship?
$C, you saved me!  I owe you a debt that I can never repay.  I'll go see if I can help the others.
Ugh... what is this place?  Is that all that's left of the ship over there?
Everything hurts. Please, make it stop...
Ughhh... I hurt.  Can you help me?
I don't know if I can make it. Please help me...

16485.text: The same fate awaits all who would steal from the master.
Death is far too merciful for your kind.
This... changes nothing. Eternal damnation awaits you!n

16502.text: Oh no!  I'm losing this one!

16514.text: Tedon, go ahead and try the neutralizing agent on the mutated creature.

16518.text: The %s doesn't look like it minds the crystal's effects.
The %s didn't like what just happened.

16521.text: I hope you've made your peace.
We won't allow you to leave this valley!
What a pity you survived the crash just to die here.
None of you are to leave this valley alive.

16522.text: You'll not take me alive, scum!

16524.text: Please, no more! My son... he's gone mad!
Who are you? What do you want? Stay away from me!
I'll show you: this beaten dog still has some teeth!
Back to the cold dark with you!
Yes, yes my son is quite powerful... but I have powers of my own!
I am not some simple jester! I am Nielas Aran!
Surely you wouldn't deny an old man a replenishing drink? No, no, I thought not.
I'm not finished yet! No, I have a few more tricks up my sleeve...
I want this nightmare to be over!
You've wasted enough of my time... let these games be finished!
At last the nightmare is over...
Where did you get that? Did HE send you?

16534.text: The %s didn't like what just happened.
The %s doesn't look like it minds the crystal's effects.

16544.text: You will succeed only in damning yourselves!

16550.text: By the seven Ata'mal crystals!  Others have survived the crash!  Zhanaa, is that you?  It is so good to see you again!
And who do we have here?  No doubt th... crzzzk ...ade this communication possible?  I give you greetings fro... psshzzzk... Azure Watch.
Judging by your signal, we put you... ust southeast of the larger part of the island we crashed onto.  Cross the Crystalbrook River to ge... kshhhhk zzzt. Sorry, there's a lot of stat...

16551.text: Yes, Zhanaa, it's me!  Your signal is weak.
Zhanaa!  Gah, I have to get this thing fixed!

16573.text: A Crypt Guard joins the fight!
Corpse Scarabs appear from a Crypt Guard's corpse!

16577.text: Brothers and sisters, I have been to the promised land. I have tasted in the sublime energy. I have felt bliss - bliss so engrossing and all encompassing that I was left wondering if I had stumbled upon the dreams of gods.
In paradise, you merely reach out and take from the Nether.

From the very air! Tendrils of arcane energy light up the obsidian sky as plumes of raw magic rise up from fissures in the land. Kneel and drink from the fissure as you do from a stream or well. Pluck a tendril from the heavens as if it were an apple hanging from a branch.

16578.text: Tell us more, Martik. What is it? What does it feel like?

16580.text: I say we fire it. Cut the rope.
You cut the rope. You have the knife.
You know, I think we can hit Honor Hold from here.
If General Krakork found out, he'd eat us alive. Don't.
Ah! We can tell him Hagash stumbled into it and fired it accidentally!

16584.text: I've seen gnomes work harder than you, peon! Little girl gnomes - with pig tails! MOVE IT, MOVE IT, MOVE IT!

16585.text: Yer slop is ready. Come n' get it...
And if I hear that you palookas complained to Nazgrel again, it'll be one of ya's that I serve up next time...

16589.text: So there we were - me and the battalion, doing a routine recon down the bone road. We'd sent the scout up ahead to look around in case anything dangerous come up.
Sure enough, scout came runnin' back, talkin' bout some orcs down the path. They hadn't seen us yet so we figured we'd go get acquainted.
Big red suckers! Bigger than any orc I'd ever seen. Muscles out to here, tusks out to here...
I dunno, grunt. I just - don't - know...
But that's not the worst of it. Before I could pull us back, a group of 'em spotted us and attacked.
Lost some of my best soldiers that day...

16590.text: If my stomach wasn't threatening to dislodge itself from my body and leave me for the refuse that we give to the prisoners, I might be insulted by this... this food.
Do I detect a hint of cinnamon? Or is that nutmeg? Whatever it is, one thing's for sure - nobody cooks a donkey like you, Cookie.
But how, chief? I thought the curse was lifted...n

16769.text: Knowing there isn't enough time, the %s doesn't even try to run.
Kill them before they get away!
I will have your energy and then your life!

16781.text: The Horde fires will never be extinguished!
I'd like to see the Alliance try to steal our flame.
The Horde have tried to steal our flames.  I hope we return the favor.
The Alliance fires burn strong and true!
Midsummer Fire Festival is a great time to celebrate the summer!
I love the firework show at the end of Midsummer Firefestival.

16790.text: Thank you, $n.  It looks like they're going to get along just fine.

16793.text: You're such a good friend, Twinkle.  You'd never leave me, would you?
It's just you and me, Twinkle.  Daddy's not going to be coming home.
Did you find something fun to chase around, Twinkle?  I bet you did!

16794.text: But where could I ever find a suitable test subject?
Drink this, you blue brute!  Disobey me and I promise you a slow, painful death!
Hmmm... looks like I'm going to need a new test subject.

16795.text: I pity you, Forsaken.  Your soul is devoid of light.

16807.text: You wish to fight us all at once? This should be amusing!n
Come on, show me a real fight!
Thank you for saving me the trouble. Now it's my turn to have some fun!n
You can have that one, I no longer need him!
Yes, beat him mercilessly! His skull is as thick as an ogre's!n
Don't waste your time on that one, he's weak!
You want him? Very well, take him!
One pitiful wretch down. Go on, take another one!
I was going to kill him anyway!
I had more fun torturing the peons!

16808.text: Ours is the TRUE Horde! The only Horde!
I'll carve the meat from your bones!
I am called Bladefist for a reason. As you will see.
The Alliance dares to intrude this far into my fortress?  Bring out the Honor Hold prisoners and call for the executioner!  They'll pay with their lives for this trespass!
Thrall's false Horde dares to intrude this far into my fortress?  Bring out the Thrallmar prisoners and call for the executioner!  They'll pay with their lives for this trespass!
Cowards! You'll never draw me into the shadows!

16812.text: Splendid. I'm going to get the audience ready. Break a leg!
Good evening ladies and gentlemen, welcome to this evening's presentation!
Tonight, things are not what they seem... for tonight your eyes may not be trusted!
Take for instance this quiet elderly woman waiting for a visit from her granddaughter... surely there is nothing to fear from this sweet, gray-haired old lady!
But don't let me pull the wool over your eyes! See for yourself what lies beneath those covers! And now... on with the show!
Welcome ladies and gentlemen, to this evening's presentation!
Tonight we plumb the depths of the human soul as we join a lost, lonely girl trying desperately--with the help of her loyal companions--to find her way home!
But she is pursued... by a wicked, malevolent crone!
Will she survive? Will she prevail? Only time will tell. And now... on with the show!
Welcome ladies and gentlemen, to this evening's presentation!
Tonight... we explore a tale of forbidden love!
But beware, for not all love stories end happily, as you may find out. Sometimes, love pricks like a thorn!
But don't take it from me; see for yourself what tragedy lies ahead when the paths of star crossed lovers meet! And now... on with the show!

16819.text: Welcome to Honor Hold, $n.  It's good to have you.
The feast of corruption is no more! Magtheridon has fallen to the battle prowess of $n and $g his:her; allies! Witness the might of the Alliance! A pit lord commander is destroyed!n
16819.comment: Force Commander Danath Trollbane to Player

16819.text: Hear me brothers and sisters-in-arms! The time of our enemies is at an end! We must strike at the fel orcs that remain! Exterminate them like the vermin that they are! Carry with you the favor of the Sons of Lothar!n
16819.comment: Force Commander Danath Trollbane to Player

16833.text: No!  Not... Sedai!  The orcs must pay!
The orcs hate us, Obadei!  They've killed many of us before!  They deserve death and worse.

16834.text: What have you done, Makuru?!  These are not our ways!
I understand how you feel Makuru.  Sedai was my brother after all.  Yet we can't disgrace his memory by going against his very ideals.

16847.text: You've found a cure!  We will crush our enemies!
You've restored my health!  I'm in your debt, $n.

16871.text: Protect the Warchief at all costs!

16873.text: Protect the Warchief at all costs!

16876.text: %s becomes unstable and begins to disintegrate!
Protect the Warchief at all costs!

16907.text: Protect the Warchief at all costs!

16915.text: I'll get you working yet, you bucket of junk.
What?!  You don't think I can do it?  I'll show you...once I get my parts, that is.
It moved!  I swear, I saw it move!
Oh yeah, it's real funny isn't it?

16916.text: Please!  I must feed on something soon... A mana crystal.... a shard... anything!  The pain is unbearable!

16923.text: I might just have to go hunting for that Wretched beast now that there's a bounty on his head.

16924.text: Tell us!  Where does your leader hide?
You're not getting anything until you speak, scum!

16925.text: Protect the Warchief at all costs!

16938.text: Put me out of this misery!
Forgive me... I have no choice.
I will do as you ask, demon.  At least for now.

16980.text: Intruders have breached the inner sanctum. Hasten the destruction of the green dragon! Leave only bones and sinew for the reanimation!
16980.comment: The Lich King - Valithria Dreamwalker - SAY_LICH_KING_INTRO

16980.text: Soon we will eradicate the Alliance and Horde. Then the rest of Azeroth will fall before the might of my army.
Invaders... here?! DESTROY them, Kel'Thuzad! Naxxramas must not fall!
Very well. Warriors of the frozen wastes, rise up! I command you to fight, kill and die for your master! Let none survive!
You will have your challenge, Fordring.
The souls of your fallen champions will be mine, Fordring.
16980.comment: The Lich King SAY SOULS WILL BE MINE

16993.text: Thank you for agreeing to help. Now, let's get out of here, $n!
Allow me a moment to rest. The journey taxes what little strength I have.
Falcon Watch, at last! Now, where's my... Oh no! My pack, it's missing! Where has -
You won't keep me from getting to Falcon Watch!

17000.text: Fools!  You seek to abjure my father's presence?  Death awaits you, mortals!

17008.text: Be silent! The shattering is soon to come!
Bear witness to the undeniable power of our dark master!
With his gift, I shall raze this land and reform it!
Watch! See the ground shatter before us! Watch as the energy flows! It will feed our armies...
We will never be without power! I have secured our future! Bask in my glory!

17015.text: You've had enough time to recover from your wounds, Gal'ressa. The time has come for you to return to the road.
You'll do no such thing. We simply haven't the room to keep you here. Now, kindly be on your way.
Very well then, have it your way. When we turn others away, you will be responsible for their suffering. Think about that.
Another pilgrim has arrived! Bring water quickly, or we may lose her!

17023.text: Gul'dan speaks the truth! We should return at once to tell our brothers of the news! Retreat back through the portal!

17046.text: %s rubs the sleep from her eyes.
I'm not going on alone, Taleris, and that's final. I'm going to wait here for the next group of pilgrims and set out with them when they depart.
By the Sunwell, you've a thick skull! You'll not bully me into leaving, Taleris. Now, begone from my sight!

17058.text: Do not stop!  I promise you a thousand deaths if you even think about putting down that pick!
Dig faster, wretch!  Do not force me to show you the true meaning of pain!
Faster, scum!  The Master won't be pleased if we don't find the Ata'mal crystal he's after.
You dare interfere with the Master's endeavors?  You will pay, foolish mortal!
Slay these intruders, filthy Dreghood!  I promise you neverending pain if you disobey me!
Go, you little wretches!  Show these fools that our Master is not to be trifled with!
Do not even think of fleeing, Broken wretches!  I promise you a fate worse than death if you don't slay these intruders!

17071.text: This is great news!  Your efforts have indeed saved us, $n!

17073.text: <Sobbing> I hate graveyards.  So many dead.  And my sweet Luhanaa....
Be at peace, my sweet, sweet, Luhanaa.
I'll never forget you, my love.
If I ever find the ones responsible for the crash...!
We should never have come along.
You'll always be here, with me.
%s bows his head and sighs, clearly exhausted.
%s breaks down into huge, wracking sobs.
%s stares in silence at the grave marker before him.

17076.text: Thank you for allowing me to speak, A'dal. I know many of your allies despise me and my knights for our treatment of M'uru.
When he was given to us by 'Prince' Kael'thas, we believed his power would help us lead our people into a new age.
I've come to realize our path was a false one. We were betrayed by the man we called our prince. In his lust for power, he sent the felblood to attack us, and to spirit M'uru away to the Sunwell.
I... I don't understand. You -- and M'uru -- knew all along that this would occur?
I see it clearly now. I renounce my loyalties to House Sunstrider and its false prince.
I pledge the blades of my Blood Knights to the defeat of Kil'jaeden and the restoration of Silvermoon.n
We will fight beside you, A'dal.

17077.text: %s lifts its head into the air, as if listening for something.
%s lets out a howl that rings across the mountains to the north and motions for you to follow.

17085.text: Avruu's magic... it still controls me.  You must fight me, mortal.  It's the only way to break the spell!
Avruu's magic is broken!  I'm free once again!

17093.text: %s removes the reagents from the crate and mixes portions of each in a flask.
I've endured much hardship to complete my research and with your help, $n, I've finally done it. Here's to a brighter future!
I feel... lightheaded... What's... happening to me?
No, this can't be! This tonic... it was supposed to reverse my addiction, not hasten my descent into the ranks of the Wretched!
All those years of research... and for nothing! Perhaps they were right, perhaps this is something we must learn to live with.

17099.text: Uther Lightbringer brought only darkness to Quel'Thalas.  Let us see if we can bring some darkness to his tomb!
At last I will have my revenge!

17109.text: Hahaha!  That fool will never find out what I'm up to!  Or, if he does, it'll be too late for the draenei!
These orcs are fools!  So much power nearby just waiting to be taken, and all they do is sit on their hands and watch while others plunder the riches!
I cannot wait to see the results of this latest batch!
Avuun dares to oppose me?!  I will crush him!  When I am done with the draenei, they'll wish that they were Lost Ones!
Oh, would you please stop checking your nails and spanking yourself, for one moment?  Really, no one cares!
Are you hungry?  I'm hungry.  I just can't stand the thought of cured ham steak from Thultash again.  If only we could get some of that succulent roasted quail!
You have something to say to my face?
I need some fresh air, not that there's any to be had in this swamp!  I'm going out for a bit.  Tidy up a bit while I'm gone, would you?

17117.text: Whe... Where am I? What... What is this place?
BY THE LIGHT OF ELUNE! Eredar! Cursed demons, what have you done to me? I have not come alone, we will fight you as we have in the past! I...

17119.text: I think I can make it to Brackenwall on my own. They've got the cargo at the top of the tower. Be careful!

17123.text: Welcome, kind spirit.  What has brought you to us?

17127.text: Magtoor, thank you for allowing me to stay here with you.  I'm sure that there is much that we can learn from each other.  And I'm eager to learn all that I can of the Lost Ones to the east.
Why do you traffic with the Horde?  Their foul ways are beneath you.
I must find a way to put an end to the evil that Cersei Dusksinger is committing against our lost brothers and sisters!

Magtoor, I have faith that there is a way to bring the Lost Ones back from the brink.  By studying them, I will find a way to cure the fel energies that have consumed them.  And in so doing, I will be able to reverse the damage to the Broken as well.

17207.text: Who challenges Naias? Puny $r, you are little better than those mindless trolls I have played against each other like so many pieces on a game board!

17214.text: Now to apply the ointment to her wounds.
It appears that the ointment is ineffective. Such a pity...
Man'ari... But how... We are not eredar! She must know! If there are others like her, we must find them and explain...

17215.text: There may still be a solution. Come here, $n. I will explain what I need.
Wake up little creature. Wake up from your slumber... You are safe now.

17220.text: %s looks over at Temper as if reluctant to speak.
Thank you, shaman.  I am reborn and will burn brighter than ever before!

17225.text: An ancient being awakens in the distance...
What fools! I shall bring a quick end to your suffering!
Miserable vermin. I shall exterminate you from the air!
Enough! I shall land and crush you myself!
Insects! Let me show you my strength up close!

17226.text: Ok, let's go.  I know just the perfect spot!
I can't wait to try this wine!
What... is happening... to me?  Get this cat away from me!
Viera Sunwhisper scurries away, attempting to flee from Twinkle.

17228.text: How can I be expected to get any work done with that thing spreading its heresy?
%s sighs disgustedly as he turns back to his work.
Turning to face Tuluun, the %s sneers contemptuously.
We do not need your kind here.

17230.text: Twinkle looks at Viera Sunwhisper with very hungry eyes.

17233.text: Thank you for coming here in remembrance of me.  Your efforts in recovering that symbol, while unnecessary, are certainly touching to an old man's heart.
Please, rise my friend.  Keep the Blessing as a symbol of the strength of the Light and how heroes long gone might once again rise in each of us to inspire.

Thank you my friend for making this possible.  This is a day that I shall never forget!  I think I will stay a while.  Please return to High Priestess MacDonnell at the camp.  I know that she'll be keenly interested to know of what has transpired here.
Why do you do this?  Did I somehow wrong you in life?
Ah, I see it now in your mind.  This is the work of one of my former students... Mehlar Dawnblade.  It is sad to know that his heart has turned so dark.
Return to him.  Return to Mehlar and tell him that I forgive him and that I understand why he believes what he does.
I can only hope that he will see the Light and instead turn his energies to restoring once-beautiful Quel'Thalas.

17238.text: This area is known to be full of foul Scourge.  You may want to take a moment to prepare any defenses at your disposal.
It must be the purity of the Mark of the Lightbringer that is drawing forth the Scourge to us.  We must proceed with caution lest we be overwhelmed!
We are beset upon again!  Defend yourself!
This land truly needs to be cleansed by the Light!  Let us continue on to the tomb.  It isn't far now.

Thank you my friend for making this possible.  This is a day that I shall never forget!  I think I will stay a while.  Please return to High Priestess MacDonnell at the camp.  I know that she'll be keenly interested to know of what has transpired here.

17240.text: Hey, Cookie! What's for dinner tonight? And don't say chicken!
I hate you so much, Cookie.

17241.text: Adamant, could you please take a look at this tablet and try to decipher the runes?
Thank you, Adamant. I think I know just the person for the job.

17242.text: Of course! Anything for you, darling!
Alright, let me take a look at that tablet.
%s slowly reads the tablet, mouthing the words in their native tongue.

Well, you aren't going to like what I have to tell you, young missy. This tablet is a naga communication. Their leader, Warlord Sriss'tiz, has ordered his naga to take the rest of the island by force.
And it looks like he's got reinforcements comin' from Nazjatar!
We've got to do something about this!

17243.text: Yes Master, all goes along as planned.
%s holds the shell up to his ear.
What's the big idea? You nearly blew my cover, idiot! I told you to put the compass and navigation maps somewhere safe - not out in the open for any fool to discover.
The Master has gone to great lengths to secure information about the whereabouts of the Exodar. You could have blown the entire operation, including the cover of our spy on the inside.
Relax? Do you know what Kael'thas does to those that fail him, Geezle? Eternal suffering and pain... Do NOT screw this up, fool.
Our Bloodmyst scouts have located our contact. The fool, Velen, will soon leave himself open and defenseless -- long enough for us to strike! Now get out of my sight before I vaporize you...

17246.text: Yarr, Admiral. Let me think about it... Arrr... It be comin' into focus.
It looks like it be succulent pork ribs basted with its own delectable juices and a side o' Captain Sander's Secret Sauce - fer dippin'.n
And fer dessert we be havin' cheesecake, flown in fresh from Stormwind on the wings o' angels...

17257.text: Wretched, meddling insects! Release me, and perhaps I will grant you a merciful death!
Vermin! Leeches! Take my blood and choke on it!
Illidan is an arrogant fool! I will crush him and reclaim Outland as my own!
Away, you mindless parasites! My blood is my own!
How long do you believe your pathetic sorcery can hold me?
My blood will be the end of you!
Did you think me weak? Soft? Who is the weak one now?
I will not be taken so easily! Let the walls of this prison tremble... and fall!
The Legion will consume you all!
%s is nearly free of his bonds!

17268.text: I can barely hear you... <static> aking up!

17282.text: We're never going to fire one of these, are we?
Do we even have ammunition for these?
What, exactly, are we ever going to fire these at?
I wonder how far this would launch that white cat...

17306.text: Do you smell that?  Fresh meat has somehow breached our citadel.  Be wary of any intruders.

17307.text: You have faced many challenges.... Pity they were all in vain! Soon your people will kneel to MY lord!

17308.text: Achor she-ki!  Feast, my pet!  Eat your fill!
Your insolence will be your death!

17312.text: Our house is this way, through the thicket.
My poor family. Everything has been destroyed.
You can thank $n for getting me back here safely, father.

17318.text: What's the big idea, Spark? Why'd you call for this meeting?
Relax, Spark! I have it all under control. We'll strip mine the Exodar right out from under 'em - making both you and I very, very rich in the process.
Yes, sir. It won't happen again...

17359.text: What have you done to my life's work?!  DIE!!!
It is YOU who are wrong!  I will deal with you two after I have slain this meddlesome shaman!

17375.text: [Furbolg] The Stillpine furbolgs will not soon forget your bravery!
[Furbolg] Those remaining at Stillpine Hold will welcome you as a hero!

17377.text: Who dares interrupt--What is this; what have you done? You'll ruin everything!
Your friends will soon be joining you!

17379.text: %s points to the totem of Coo.

17381.text: My work must not be interrupted!
Perhaps I can find a use for you...
Anger...hate... These are tools I can use.
Let's see what I can make of you!

17391.text: %s motions for you to follow him.
[Furbolg] Coo xip fly... Jump ilos river. Find Tikti.

17392.text: [Furbolg] Far you mixik tak come. Gaze upon the kitch'kal river. Follow. Ilog to Yor.
[Furbolg] Go... Search yitix'kil bottom river. South!

17393.text: [Furbolg] Come, $n. Let us leave the water together, purified.
[Furbolg] We go now, together. We will seek Vark.

17404.text: The cycle of bloodshed is unending... Is there nothing I can do?

17410.text: [Furbolg] Bear witness to the savage acts of our adversaries, $n. They steal our young... our weak... Imprisoned here, they are left to the devices of the Bristlelimb. Set them free, Promised One!

17414.text: %s begins to arm the Proximity Bomb!

17417.text: Do not return, draenei scum.  Next time we won't spare your life, unarmed or not!

17424.text: In the process of translating this, I believe I've learned more about the drunken exploits of a certain 'Andrew Clementine' than about the journal's author.
But, no matter. Mister Clementine's... err, 'contribution' notwithstanding, this seems to be the journal of a man named Nolkai. The entries toward the end describe a brutal battle.
Take a look at this passage...

17426.text: No... you're not Morae, but I sense that you have met. When you see her, tell her that I survived the crash, only to be done in by the infiltrators.
Let her know... my last thought was of her...

17433.text: These pictographs tell a story. This figure at the beginning, almost looks like one of the creatures we encountered at Azure Watch...
No, this can't be... It says this creature willingly became a servant of the Legion. He transforms into a satyr and receives the Legion's "blessing."
We must defeat these satyr, $n. We will not suffer the Legion's presence in these lands.

17445.text: Stillpine raiders, the time to strike is at hand! Charge!

17455.text: Intruders!  Hold them off until I can release the warhounds!
You're too late, now feel the wrath of my warhounds!

17509.text: Read the tome of divinity I have given you, $n.  When you have learned from the book, speak with me again.

17521.text: The better to own you with!
Run away little girl, run away!

17528.text: Fools! Weaklings! Tzerak has no need of your assistance!

17533.text: Wilt thou provoke me? Then have at thee, boy!
Thou smilest... upon the stroke that... murders me.
Thou detestable maw, thou womb of death; I enforce thy rotten jaws to open!
How well my comfort is revived by this!

17534.text: What devil art thou, that dost torment me thus?
Romulo, I come! Oh... this do I drink to thee!
O happy dagger! This is thy sheath; there rust, and let me die!
Come, gentle night; and give me back my Romulo!

17535.text: Oh at last, at last I can go home!
Don't let them hurt us Tito! Oh, you won't, will you?
Oh Tito, we simply must find a way home! The old wizard could be our only hope! Strawman, Roar, Tinhead, will you - wait... oh golly, look we have visitors!

17537.text: Is there no one left to test me?
You are nothing! I answer a higher call....
The dark lord laughs at you!
My lord will be... the end of you all!

17542.text: %s stares at you in sheer wonderment.

17543.text: Now what should I do with you? I simply can't make up my mind.
Don't let them make... a mattress outta' me.
I guess I'm not a failure after all!

17546.text: I'm not afraid a' you! Do you wanna' fight? Huh, do ya'? C'mon! I'll fight ya' with both paws behind my back!
You didn't have to go and do that!
Go ahead and take forty winks.

17547.text: I could really use a heart. Say, can I have yours?
Back to being an old rust bucket.
Guess I'm not so rusty after all.

17551.text: Please tell Guvan that I'll be fine, thanks to you.

17587.text: Help! I think this creature might be too tough for me to handle alone.
Can anyone hear me? I need help! This creature is going to kill me!
I can't hold it off any longer! Tell the exarch that I gave it my best.
How could you think yourself a match for the draenei champion!
Kill as many infected nightstalkers as I can find... This should be easy.
I'm supposed to be hunting infected nightstalkers... This should be easy.
Where in the nether are these damnable lashers??
Hrm, azure snapdragons? Where do they come up with these names? Daedal has gone mad!
These stags look nothing like talbuks.
I wonder what that little purple creature at the village is... It's certainly beautiful.

17591.text: Your money or your life! Actually, just your life will do...
Your death will make a fitting tribute to the King!

17612.text: Who dares wield magic in my presence?

17651.text: You've got my attention, dragon.  You'll find I'm not as easily scared as the villagers below.
You dare challenge me at my own dwelling?  Your arrogance is astounding, even for a dragon!
I do not know what you speak of, dragon... but  I will not be bullied by this display of insolence.  I'll leave Karazhan when it suits me!
%s begins to cast a spell of great power, weaving his own essence into the magic.
He should not have angered me.  I must go... recover my strength now...

17652.text: Your dabbling in the arcane has gone too far, Medivh.  You've attracted the attention of powers beyond your understanding.  You must leave Karazhan at once!
A dark power seeks to use you, Medivh!  If you stay, dire days will follow.  You must hurry, we don't have much time!
You leave me no alternative.  I will stop you by force if you won't listen to reason!
What have you done, wizard?  This cannot be!  I'm burning from... within!

17653.text: You fools! He'll kill us all!

17658.text: All hail $N, savior of Azuremyst and Bloodmyst. Hero of the Hand of Argus, champion of the draenei people!

17663.text: If only I could get back to the mushroom thicket. I have not seen such a mature cluster in my lifetime!

17664.text: You will never take me alive!

17678.text: Petulant children, pray to your gods for you are about to meet them!

17681.text: By the forehead signet of Velen, I am saved!
I knew Cornelius wouldn't leave us behind!

17682.text: Thank you for saving me, $N! My father will be delighted!

17703.text: Don't you people ever check the mail?
How am I expected to deliver all of these messages?
I need to be re-assigned. This job is pushing me over the edge...
He thinks he's so damned important. Always pushing me around... I'll show him. I'll show all of them!
One of these days I'm going to bust out the crystalline doomhammer and go positively orc on this town. Then they'll be sorry...

17711.text: Do not proceed. You will be eliminated.

17715.text: Who dares defile the statue of our beloved?

17767.text: The Legion's final conquest has begun! Once again the subjugation of this world is within our grasp. Let none survive!
Ashes to ashes, dust to dust!
Succumb to the icy chill... of death.
It will be much colder in your grave.
You have won this battle, but not... the... war.

17768.text: This is... Silvermoon? My head... Next time Bloodvalor needs a volunteer, I'll point him in a different direction. Paragon of Blood Knight virtue, indeed!
Don't get me wrong, $n. I very much appreciate the resurrection, but I think this is the last time I'll perform this particular duty. Maybe a goblet or two of wine will help with this headache.

17772.text: I'm in jeopardy! Help me if you can!
Don't give up! We must prevail!
Hold them back as long as possible!
We have won valuable time. Now we must pull back.
%s begins channelling a massive teleport spell.

17796.text: You're in for a world o' hurt!

17797.text: To the depths of oblivion with you!
Our matron will be... the end of you.

17798.text: You deem yourselves worthy simply because you bested my guards? Our work here will not be compromised!
I despise all of your kind!
%s begins to channel from the nearby distiller...

17807.text: Let the trial begin! Bloodwrath, attack!
Show this upstart how a real Blood Knight fights, Swiftblade!
Show $n the meaning of pain, Sunstriker!
Well done, $n! You have passed the second trial!

17808.text: You are defenders of a doomed world! Flee here, and perhaps you will prolong your pathetic lives!
The swarm is eager to feed.
Pity, no time for a slow death!

17824.text: Treacherous whelp! Sironas will destroy you and your people!

17826.text: Beast! Obey me! Kill them at once!

17831.text: $n, let's go see if this plan will work.  Come along, Buddy!
Ok, let's see about using those mushrooms you brought back to grow the bog lords a new food supply.
Oh Buddy, you big baby!  Look, it's working.  It's really working!!  Now all I need to do is grow more of these mushrooms here and the bog lords will likely leave the sporelings alone!
Oh, thank you, $n!  You've made it possible to save both the sporelings from the bog lords, and the bog lords from our wrath.

17839.text: The sands of time shall be scattered to the winds!
History is about to be rewritten!
You are running out of time!
You will never defeat us all!

17841.text: It's just like the structure you described at Umbrafen Lake.  Does this mean the naga are pumping water out of all the lakes in Zangarmarsh?
The naga are even pumping the water out of their own lake!  What purpose could that possibly serve?
There!  Those pipes all appear to be connected to that structure.  It can't possibly fit all the water they've been stealing.  Where are they keeping it?
What we saw explains what happened in the Dead Mire.  There was a lake here once.  If we don't stop the naga, all of the marsh will soon look like this!

17842.text: Abandon all hope! The Legion has returned to finish what was begun so many years ago. This time, there will be no escape!
Just a taste... of what awaits you.
No one is going to save you.

17843.text: I want all of your trackers out in search of the criminal, Matis the Cruel. I have given trusted agents of the Hand flare guns. Should you or one of your trackers see the flare, it means that an agent has found Matis and needs assistance. And remember, tracker, Matis is to be brought back to me alive.

17848.text: You there, fetch water quickly! Get these flames out before they spread to the rest of the keep! Hurry, damn you!
I know what you're up to, and I mean to put an end to it, permanently!

17852.text: I will lay down for no one!
Bring the fight to me and pay with your lives!
Hold them back! Do not falter!
Make ready for another wave! LOK-TAR OGAR!
Do not give an inch of ground!
It is over! Withdraw! We have failed....
We have played our part, and done well at that. It is up to the others now.

17853.text: We've got you now, Matis the Cruel!
Return to Kuros. I will bring him to Blood Watch.

17855.text: Please tell me that you didn't just do what I think you just did. Please tell me that I'm not going to have to hurt you...
As if we don't have enough problems, you go and create more!
You dare spill blood on neutral ground? OUT! OUT, I SAY!
We don't take kindly to miscreants, $r.
Believe me when I tell you this: You're gonna wish you weren't born, sissy!
Your actions shame us all, $c. I hurt inside as I beat you senseless.

17862.text: Thrall! You didn't really think you would escape, did you?  You and your allies shall answer to Blackmoore... after I've had my fun.
You're a slave! That's all you'll ever be!
I don't know what Blackmoore sees in you. For my money you're just another ignorant savage!
Did you really think you would leave here alive?

17875.text: I am at your service, my lord.
It will be done, my lord.
Brothers and sisters, tonight we hunt! A blood elf known as Matis must be brought to justice! The first to find him gets one week's vacation aboard the Exodar!
Onward! The wilds of Bloodmyst await!

17876.text: Very well then. Let's go!
As long as we're going with a new plan, I may as well pick up a weapon and some armor.
A rider approaches.
I'll never be chained again!
Very well. Tarren Mill lies just west of here. Since time is of the essence...
Let's ride!
Taretha must be in the inn. Let's go.
Taretha! What foul magic is this?
Who or what was that?
No!
Goodbye, Taretha. I will never forget your kindness.
Things are looking grim....
I'll fight... to the last!
Taretha....
A good day... to die.
I have earned my freedom!
This day is long overdue! Out of my way!
I am a slave no longer!
Blackmoore has much to answer for!
You have forced my hand!
It should not have come to this!
I did not ask for this!
I am truly in your debt, strangers.
Thank you, strangers. You have given me hope.
I will not waste this chance. I will seek out my destiny.

17877.text: Fhwoor go now, $n.  Get ark, come back.
%s lifts the Ark of Ssslith with ease.
%s places the Ark of Ssslith on the ground.

17879.text: Why do you aid the Magus? Just think of how many lives could be saved if the portal is never opened, if the resulting wars could be erased....
You have outstayed your welcome, Keeper. Be gone!
If you will not cease this foolish quest, then you will die!
I told you it was a fool's quest!

17880.text: Why do you persist? Surely you can see the futility of it all. It is not too late! You may still leave with your lives...
Keeper! The sands of time have run out for you.
So be it... you have been warned.
You should have left when you had the chance.

17881.text: The time has come to shatter this clockwork universe forever! Let us no longer be slaves of the hourglass! I warn you: those who do not embrace this greater path shall become victims of its passing!
Your time is up, slave of the past.
Let us see what fate has in store....
One less obstacle in our way!
We will triumph. It is only a matter... of time.

17888.text: Cry for mercy! Your meaningless lives will soon be forfeit!
Your death will be a painful one.

17892.text: You will not stand in our way!

17893.text: Hey!  Over here!  Yeah, over here... I'm in this cage!!!
Uh oh!  It would appear that all of the noise you've been making has attracted some unwanted attention!

17899.text: A pleasure... to serve the master.

17918.text: There is no time to waste!
We must use this time wisely!
One less threat to the timeways!
Carry on! Victory at all costs!
Continue the fight! Do not falter!

17919.text: Let these monsters taste cold steel!

17933.text: This world is not for you!

17949.text: Remulos, old friend. It is good to see you once more. I knew that the message would find its way to you - one way or another.

I fear for the worst, old friend. Within the Dream we fight a new foe, born of an ancient evil. Ysera's noble brood has fallen victim to the old whisperings. It seems as if the Nightmare has broken through the realm and seeks a new host on Azeroth.
Aye, Remulos. Prepare the mortal races.

Cenarius fights at my side. Illidan sits atop his throne in the Outland - brooding. I am afraid that the loss to Arthas proved to be his breaking point. Madness has embraced him, Remulos. He replays the events in his mind a thousand times per day, but in his mind, he is the victor and Arthas is utterly defeated. He is too far gone, old friend. I fear that the time may soon come that our bond is tested and it will not be as it was at the Well in Zin-Azshari.
Remulos, I am being drawn back... Tyrande... send her my love... Tell her I am safe. Tell her... Tell her I will return... Farewell...

17955.text: The %s takes a piece of the mushroom tree and holds it to its 'nose'.  Seemingly satisfied, it eats it!
The %s uproots the rest of the mushroom tree and makes off with it.

17957.text: Intrudersss with the prisssoner!  Kill them!!!

17959.text: Too soon! You are slacking off too soon!
Wake up! Now get up and back to work!
Hurry up with it already! The longer you take, the more of a hurtin' I'm putting on you!
What is this?! Didn't mommy and daddy teach you anything?!
This is terrible..... my arms grow tired from beating on you lazy peons!

17968.text: All of your efforts have been in vain, for the draining of the World Tree has already begun!  Soon the heart of your world will beat no more!
Your soul will languish for eternity.
I am the coming of the end!
At last it is here! Mourn and lament the passing of all you have ever known, and all that would have been! Hach min corai!

17969.text: Is the way clear?  Let's get out while we can, $n.
Looks like we won't get away so easily.  Get ready!
Let's keep moving.  We're not safe here!
We're almost to the refuge!  Let's go.
I can see my fellow druids from here.  Thank you, $n.  I'm sure Ysiel will reward you for your actions!

17975.text: What are you doing?  These specimens are very delicate!
Your life cycle is now concluded.

17976.text: Step forward.  I will see that you are properly welcomed!
You are no longer dealing with some underling!
Guards, rally!  Cut these invaders down!
I have not yet... begun to...

17977.text: You must die! But wait: this does not-- No, no... you must die!
What am I doing? Why do I...
Maybe this is not-- No, we fight! Come to my aid!
So... confused. Do not... belong here.

17978.text: What aggravation is this? You will die!
You seek a prize, eh? How about death?
I hate to say I told you so...
17978.comment: Thorngrin the Tender - Player Death Say
Thorngrin the Tender - Cast Sacrifice Say
Thorngrin the Tender - Cast Hellfire Say
Thorngrin the Tender - Cast Hellfire Say
Thorngrin the Tender - On Death Say
Thorngrin the Tender - On Enrage Say

17978.text: Welcome my brothers! Bask in the glory of my power!

17982.text: There's no turning back now, $n. Stay close and watch my back.
There it is! Do you see where the large red crystal is jutting out from the Vector Coil? That's where I need to plant the first set of explosives.
It won't be much longer, $n. Just keep them off me while I work.
That'll do it! Quickly, take cover!
Don't get too excited, hero, that was the easy part. The challenge lies ahead! Let's go.
What in the Nether is that?!?!
Blessed Light! She's siphoning energy right out of the Vector Coil!
Cover me, we have to do this quickly. Once I blow the support on this side, it will disrupt the energy beams and she'll break out! I doubt very much that she'll be happy to see us.
I've almost got it! Just a little more time...
Take cover and be ready for the fight of your life, $n!
I... I can't believe it's over. You did it! You've destroyed the blood elves and their leader!
Get back to Blood Watch. I'll see you there...

17993.text: Get out of here, there are too many of them! Escape while you can!

18063.text: We are honored by your presence, son of Durotan. The Greatmother awaits you at the hospice.
As you wish, Thrall, son of Durotan.
For my entire life I have thought my bloodline cursed. I have lived beneath the shadow of my father's greatest failure.
I hated him for what he had done. I hated him for the burden he left me. But now...

You have shown me truths that I would have never known. You and your allies have gifted me with something that cannot bear a price: Redemption. Thrall, redeemer of the Mag'har, you honor me as none ever have...
On this day, a great burden has been lifted from my chest. My heart swells with pride. And for the first time, I can proudly proclaim who I am. I can finally unleash the fury in my heart.
I am Garrosh Hellscream, son of Grom, chieftain of the Mag'har! Let the battle call of Hellscream give you courage and strength! Be lifted by my rallying cry.

18069.text: Dat was poop! Mogor could put up much better fight den dat!
Mogor not impressed! Skra'gath wuz made of da air and shadow! Soft like da squishy orcies!
Now you face da true champion! I give you chance to run away little one. Run away now before Mogor decim... destyor... Run away before Mogor KILL!
No more chances! Now you pay da ogre!
No more nice ogre! You hurt Mogor!!
WUT!? UNPOSSIBLE!! You fight Mogor now! Mogor destroy!

18075.text: So predictable. I knew you would come. And I see you've brought the mighty Hellscream.
His blood is mine, as is your whole misbegotten race.
The boy believed you could be saved, but he didn't know what burns within your soul when in your heart, you know we are the same.n

18076.text: Thrall... The blood haze has lifted.
Grom's eyes go dim as the blood curse is lifted.
The demon's fire has burnt out in my veins. I have... freed myself.n

18096.text: Thrall! Come outside and face your fate!
Taretha's life hangs in the balance. Surely you care for her. Surely you wish to save her...

Ah, there you are. I had hoped to accomplish this with a bit of subtlety, but I suppose direct confrontation was inevitable. Your future, Thrall, must not come to pass and so... you and your troublesome friends must die!
Enough, I will erase your very existence!
Thrall will remain a slave. Taretha will die. You have failed.
Struggle as much as you like...
No! The master will... not be... pleased.

18098.text: %s examines the information on the wanted poster.

18103.text: Obey the laws of Silvermoon. Failure to do so will result in termination.
Remain strong. Kael'thas will - error - Lor'themar will lead you to power and glory!
Do not disturb the serenity of the city. Peace must be upheld.

18141.text: I have been expecting you, young one. Come closer - my eyes are not as sharp as they once were.n
Yes, you move like my son. You have his broad shoulders - ahh, and your mother's fierce eyes.n
There is no doubt - you are the heir of Durotan... my grandson. Draka told me she was with child before she and your father left our world, but I never dared dream that they would survive...n
Thrall? You've been a slave only to the past, grandson! But no more! When last I saw him, Durotan told me the name he would give his unborn son... He was... so proud...
Go'el. You are Go'el, son of Durotan - rightful chieftain of the Frostwolves. This day, grandson - you are the great joy of my heart.n
I see that you hold the Doomhammer. Have all of our greatest heroes fallen, grandson?n
What of Grommash? What of Hellscream?n

Blessed spirits! For twenty years, all we knew was that Grom was the first to drink from the cursed chalice and bring damnation down upon our people... It is the only truth his son, Garrosh has ever known.n
Grandson, will you... Will you tell Garrosh what you have told me about his father?

18146.text: %s inclines his head slightly to the pair of guardians in greeting.
%s arches a sculpted brow at the guards, a disapproving scowl on his face.
%s surveys the small ranger practice ground with a condescending smirk.

18166.text: Do not burden A'dal with mundane questions, $r.  This being's will is all that keeps our enemies from crushing this city.
Show our guest around Shattrath, will you?  Keep an eye out for pickpockets in the Lower City.

18168.text: Woe to each and every one of you, my pretties!
It will all be over soon!
How could you? What a cruel, cruel world...

18174.text: Lady Liadrin is bound to find a way. She must.
Is... it true, what I've heard?  That it was the Sun King himself?
Still, the Blood Knights will endure through this loss. We have no other choice... we must find another source.
Who do they think they are?
I know what you mean... they whisper about us when they think we can't hear them. They'll get theirs.
Jealous, that's what they are. They're afraid to dedicate themselves to true power.
They simply fear what they cannot begin to understand.

18175.text: Matters are so uncertain now that the chamber below is empty...
It's gone. I can't believe it's gone. Who would have thought we'd be betrayed like this?
Our neighbors are positively laughable. Have you seen the way they turn up their noses at us?
The rangers certainly have a high opinion of themselves.
I'm quickly tiring of the haughty attitude I receive from those grubby bowslingers outside.

18180.text: Uh oh, those stags don't look pleased with us!
Look out, Fitz, they're coming right for us!

18187.text: If your people are as strong as you purport, I'm sure you'll find your stride again.
%s taps a finger on her chin, lost in thought.
I suppose we'll see the measure of your dedication in due time.
I don't suppose Lor'themar Theron is available for an audience yet?
I'll accept that answer for the time being, Kelemar, but my patience is not exactly boundless.
Remind me, ambassador... what precisely will your people be contributing to our efforts?
You should be used to those looks, Tatai. Do you remember the reason you were drafted into this job?
I'm no happier about being your babysitter than you are about being watched. Just remember... it could have been worse.
Well, no one asked you, Tatai.

18188.text: Bah! If I ever be in charge'a dis place, da first t'ing I be doin' is stoppin' alla dat. Ja be markin' my words.
Dis place be huge. Why ja be needin' all dis space?
Why be all dese t'ings floatin' an' movin' by demselves?
Dis place be too bright fa my tastes.
What help be ja givin' de Horde, anyway?
Just what I be t'inkin'. More delays.
Ja be keepin' away from me.
I be gettin' tired'a dis. Dese elves, dey be treatin' me like I stole somet'in'.
Dis be a big waste, if ja be askin' me.
T'ink ja be contributin' less glarin' in dis troll's direction?
%s sighs in resignation and falls silent.

18189.text: This city is very... expansive, but it seems to be lacking something. I can't put my finger on what...
It seems that a great deal of your power is used for... and I hope you'll pardon the term... frivolous things. Isn't that, well, wasteful?
There's an ethereal beauty about this place... but for all the trees and plant life, it's still so... unnatural.
As you say, ambassador. We can wait.
Tell us, Ambassador Kelemar... how do the blood elves plan to aid us, exactly?
Dela Runetotem's brow furrows, but she remains silent.
My condolences. These past years have been hard on us all.
I don't know. It still seems like such a waste.

18190.text: You're not the only victims of the Scourge. Our lady Sylvanas sympathizes with your plight.
Your choice of decor is intriguing, Kelemar. Tell me - why the arcane frippery?
An understandable expenditure, as I see it. Show everyone, enemies and allies alike, that you're not afraid to use your power.
Such marvelous sights. I regret being unable to see it when I was younger.
I thought we were going to speak with the regent lord. I'm beginning to question whether or not he exists at all at this point.
Troll, if you can't keep a civil tongue in your head, I'll be happy to remove it for you.

18191.text: This is merely part of what Silvermoon once was. Much of the city was lost after Arthas swept through our lands.
We lost many of our kin in the war... so yes, the city is not perhaps as lively as it once was. We will endure, however.
It is not simply a beautification measure, but also a morale booster. It demonstrates to our people that we have a great deal of power at our fingertips, and with it... we can do nearly anything.
Think about it carefully, my friends. If we can afford to spend our magic on simple aesthetic enhancements, clearly we hold a vast reservoir of power at our beck and call.
This must be somewhat different from the environment to which you're accustomed. It is a visible demonstration of the power we hold, nothing more. We're mindful of our resources.
Yes, well... luckily for us all, the troll will not be in a position of power within our fair city anytime soon.
The regent lord is a very busy man. I'm sure you understand.
He is unable to see you just yet, but do not trouble yourselves over it. I'm certain he will find a way to fit you into his busy schedule.
In due course. There is no rush, after all - our hospitality is extended to you indefinitely. Even the troll.
Exercise caution during your stay. Some close-minded individuals may still cling to old alliances long since dissolved...
Thank you for making the journey here. I hope you will find Silvermoon to your liking.
Behold the wonders of our fair city.
Our people are strong. We bring you a mastery over arcane magics that you have previously lacked - ah, no offense intended, of course.
Surely you see the advantage in our relationship. The powers we command are immense. With our aid, your enemies could well be decimated.
I realize we have had somewhat differing loyalties in the past, but put your suspicions aside. Our considerable power has been pledged to your leaders in good faith.
I'm afraid your ancestry is the cause, troll. Decades of fighting with your green-skinned brethren have hardened their hearts against your kind.
Keep your chin up. Perhaps with time, our people will see you as the ally you are, rather than the enemy you appear to be.

18202.text: Where do you think you're going? Kill them all!

18206.text: How can you just leave me here?

18209.text: More of them coming! Watch out!
Up ahead is the road to Telaar. We will split up when we reach the fork as they will surely send more Murkblood after us. Hopefully one of us makes it back to Telaar alive.

18210.text: More of them coming! Watch out!
It is best that we split up now, in case they send more after us. Hopefully one of us will make it back to Garrosh. Farewell, stranger.

18211.text: Don't let them escape! Kill the strong one first!

18218.text: Uh... sure thing, Gankly.  Just...<cough>... wait right there.  <Cough>  Guys?
Oh good, I was beginning to worry.
Shifting, %s moans from the pain of his thorn scratch.
%s looks at his friends and then grunts painfully.
%s winces when he touches the tender area around his scratch.
%s begins to whistle a tune, but then stops abruptly and moans.

18230.text: The magister's going to kill me...
No, no, no! Come back here!
Argh. They told me those crystals would work properly!
When I catch you, I'm going to disenchant your components, so help me...
You stay out of the regent lord's way! I mean it!

18248.text: Grunting, %s turns away from the wanted poster, returning to his warm spot by the fire.
%s begins to read the wanted poster.

18262.text: I give up! Please don't kill me!

18265.text: Nothing surprising there.  Come back with some real news, will you?

18292.text: I wanna be just like the pitfighter!
Will he win? Can he win?

18294.text: Hi, Harold.  I have your skins!

18296.text: I wanna be just like the pitfighter!

18297.text: I'll be taking those skins, tiny.
%s rifles through Kristen's stuff and grabs her bundle of skins.
Here are my skins, Harold.  Now give me the reward!

18303.text: My brothers and sisters. Listen to me. We must speak of the survival of our people. We have narrowly survived one calamity, but I fear the next shall destroy us.

Can you not see what is happening? Open your eyes. It is laid bare for all to see. What is this new alliance? Why have we betrayed our allies of old, only to take up with the enemies of all that live?
You speak of her as friend? You are a fool. This "Dark Lady" is not Sylvanas.
Blood? And these orcs, these fair weather friends? They will aid us?
The magisters are the traitors! They have sealed our doom.
We have not struggled so hard to survive, only to bring about the true destruction.
If we speak as one, we cannot be ignored!
We will repay the betrayal of the Alliance! We shall never forget, and never forgive!

18309.text: What have the netherwinds brought us?
If you hear the whisper, you're dying...

18311.text: What have the netherwinds brought us?
If you hear the whisper, you're dying...

18312.text: What have the netherwinds brought us?
If you hear the whisper, you're dying...

18313.text: What have the netherwinds brought us?
If you hear the whisper, you're dying...

18314.text: What have the netherwinds brought us?
If you hear the whisper, you're dying...

18315.text: What have the netherwinds brought us?
If you hear the whisper, you're dying...

18317.text: What have the netherwinds brought us?
If you hear the whisper, you're dying...

18331.text: What have the netherwinds brought us?
If you hear the whisper, you're dying...

18337.text: That should take care of that. Summon me if you have further need of my services.

18340.text: I will show you not to cross us again!
Warlord Kalithresh will hear of this insolence!
I'll make you pay for that!

18341.text: I will feed... on your soul.

18344.text: What is this? You must forgive me, but I was not expecting company. As you can see, we are somewhat preoccupied right now. But no matter. As I am a gracious host, I will tend to you... personally.
We have not been properly introduced.
I've longed for a good adventure!
I have such fascinating things to show you.

18351.text: You taste good with maybe a little salt and pepper.

18369.text: Thanks, $r! I'm sure my dad will reward you greatly! Bye!

18371.comment: Shirrak the Dead Watcher - Emote Focus

18373.text: Stare into the darkness of your soul.
Rise, my fallen brothers! Take form and fight!
You will pay with your life!
There is no turning back now!
These walls will be your tomb!

18384.text: Wolf spirit of the forest, hear me!
Long ago, you were a companion to my people. We gave ourselves to evil and you were forgotten.
But we have returned, spirit! We have returned to honor you again. Favor us with your presence once more.
May our bond with you never be broken again, spirit.
We have done it! Thrall would be proud.

18385.text: I never thought it would turn out to be mana oil! There's going to be plenty of demand for that, minus Grek, of course!

18401.text: Closer... Come closer... See what the void brings!

18402.text: Piece by piece I will tear this challenger apart... PIECE BY PIECE!

18407.text: Damn those ogres. Damn them to the Nether. Won't someone save us from these savages! This is the fifth kidnapping in as many days.
That's the best reward we're going to be able to offer. Hopefully someone accepts the mission.

18408.text: New posting going up! Adventurers and heroes, gather round the bulletin board!
That should get Telaar the assistance it needs!

18417.text: The information you seek... I cannot give you that freely.  You will have to prove that your enemies are the same as mine.
This book would give me unlimited power over my enemies... I would become... unstoppable!
No... you must take this from me, $n!  I feel its dark power swaying my will already!  Use it to destroy Varedis.

18424.text: Go on, get out of here!  Save yourself!
BOOM!
Stop looking at me!
They broke us all.
Can't... control... form.
Meow.
Roar!
Blinding white light, and then silence!
Too close to the truth, too close to the truth!
Who are you to stare at me and pass judgment?!
Do I know you?  If you're interested in joining the Cenarion Expedition step right in.
Careful who you talk to.  The teromoths have ears.
Not all dinner guests are gracious.  Mind your manners!
It knows all, it sees all!
No need to wait outside in the rain.  Come in... you're welcome with us in here.
You won't get my clothes!  Die!
Filthy vermin.  Submit or perish!
You as well, Flutter?  We used to be such good friends.  I will miss you.
Oops, my bad.  Sometimes I can't control my moonfire.
The vicious teromoths and I are just fine in here on our own, thank you.

18428.text: Help! Help! They're going to eat me!
One day, a hero will rise and lift the orcs up to their former glory.
The ogres have the keys! Kill the ogres and get me out of here!
My children will be made orphans!
Thank you, $r! Your service to the Mag'har will not be forgotten.

18440.text: Your daddy pay Warmaul and maybe we no eat you.
Ha-ha! Just kidding. We eat you for shure anyway!
BAM! Look at dat gristle sizzle!
And dis is da recipe for da bestest Broken chowder!
Da salt goes into da pot...
Den you put da pepper in da pot...
Now we gonna kick it up a notch wit da secret ingra... ingor... inrag... da secret sauce!
And last, we put in da Corki!

18445.text: Thanks, $n! How many times have you saved my life now? Three? That makes us blood in my book!

18447.text: The threat be over! $n be savin' us all!

18459.text: Rejoice, my friends! $n has saved us from the looming shadow that threatened our very lives!

18471.text: Get in the Ring of Blood, $n. The fight is about to start!
The battle is about to begin! $n versus the ferocious clefthoof, Brokentoe!
The battle is about to begin! The unmerciful Murkblood twins versus $n!
Unbelievable! $n has defeated the Murkblood twins!
Hailing from the mountains of Blade's Edge comes Rokdar the Sundered Lord! $n is in for the fight of $g his:her; life.
From parts unknown: Skra'gath! Can $n possibly survive the onslaught of void energies?

This is the moment we've all been waiting for! The Warmaul champion is about to make his first showing at the Ring of Blood in weeks! Will $n go down in defeat as easily as the champion's other opponents? We shall see...

Patience, general. The Light embraces all who enter Shattrath in good faith.
You are welcome in Shattrath, Lady Liadrin. We have long awaited your arrival.
Both our peoples have suffered greatly at the hands of Kael'thas and his agents, Lady Liadrin. Your people were not the authors of their own fate, but they will die if they do not change.
M'uru accepted his role in this long ago, knowing full well what would happen to him. Will you accept your own?
It wasn't I who foretold it, but Velen of the Draenei:
Led astray into the night, armed with sword of broken Light.
Broken, then betrayed by one, standing there bestride the sun.
At darkest hour, redemption comes, in knightly lady sworn to blood.
The Shattered Sun Offensive will surely benefit from the addition of your knights, Lady Liadrin.
The battle for the Sunwell is but the first step on your new path, Lady Liadrin. Shattrath is open to you and all who follow you.

18482.text: What is the meaning of this?!

Could it really be? The son of Durotan?
Has he come to lead us?
I have never felt such strength radiate from an orc. Is he... mortal...
For the first time, I feel safe. I do not know you, stranger, but I know that I would lay down my life for you if only you asked.
Son of Durotan... Grandson of Garad and Geyah... Bow your heads for a Warchief is among us...
I am unworthy, son of Durotan. We are all unworthy...

I can assure you that we will not fail, my master.  I am personally overseeing every aspect of the construction, and I hold the final codes, myself.  Within a day's time, I will have the bomb detonated on those nearby pests.

Invaders, you dangle upon the precipice of oblivion! The Burning Legion comes and with it comes your end.n

They revel in causing anguish and pain - and their murderous interrogations are the stuff of nightmares.
Conscripted from the mo'arg race, these warriors serve as the Legion's rank and file soldiers.
They are fearless and unwaveringly loyal to their master's godlike will.
Powerful and deliberate, these winged aberrations are renowned across the cosmos for their brutality.
The Doomguard are utterly devoted to their Pit Lord masters and revel in the destruction of worlds.
Cunning and precise, the Wrathguard often protect the Legion's eredar masters.
Their skill in battle should never be underestimated.
Devout and exceedingly charismatic, these priestesses live only to evangelize the power of Sargeras' dread vision.
They are the driving heart of the Burning Crusade.
The Nathrezim are merciless villains who feed upon the energies of mortal creatures.
They utilize terror and subterfuge - often turning brother against brother as whole worlds fall before their dark influence.
The cunning, powerful eredar warlocks were once our noble kinsmen.
Yet they fell to the lure of Sargeras' evil - and now they have become our most stalwart enemies.
These colossal destroyers serve as the Legion's military commanders.
They are as cruel as they are powerful - and revel in the destruction of all that exists.
These stunted mo'arg are very clever, and are often employed as helpers for their larger brethren.
Mischievous by nature, they are fond of employing their own hastily-constructed technologies.
Brutish though they seem, these iron-stitched horrors are exceedingly brilliant engineers and forge-smiths.
Their black iron constructs have sown death across a thousand worlds.

The rocks are here when we first enter this world, and they will remain long after we pass.
Stand... there is more to discuss.
Stop here a moment, my children, and close your eyes. Can you feel the air currents?

The spirits of the air can be found even here, underground. They dislike being surrounded, constricted by the earth... their precious freedom is limited here.
They are flighty, these spirits, and easily distracted... but they will share their secrets with those who know how to listen.
%s smiles to himself as he watches the students fidget in their concentration.

The strength of fire lies in change. Its strength is considerable, but ever-shifting... unpredictable.
This is extended to the spirits themselves. They are often quick to anger; it is important that you learn to listen without falling prey to their tempers.
That is enough for now. Come.
The water here is peaceful, is it not? Listening to the trickle from the ceiling can aid you in finding its true voice...
The water spirits are perhaps the most outspoken. They are generous and understanding. Indeed, if you are having trouble hearing the voices, it is with water that you should begin.
Close your eyes, my children, and listen to the water within these halls.

18966.text: Soldiers of Azeroth, you now fight against the vile Burning Crusade.  And the hopes and prayers of all Light-loving people march with you.  In the company of our brave allies and brothers-in-arms you will hold your ground and break this demonic charge.  You will stem the destructive tyranny that rages across so many worlds.
With each passing moment, I see the people of Azeroth prove again the reasons we have come.  It is with solemn pride that I fight with you, and if I die this day, then I die among friends.

The demons should be in no doubt that we are their nemesis and, though they wish our destruction, it is we who will bring about their ruin.  Kazzak and his forces will be diminished and defeated by this coalition.  And to do this, we must throw at them our bodies and hearts, for they seek no less than the obliteration of this world.
Fight on, good people of Azeroth. And take heart! Your brethren rush to this hellish portal and will soon throw themselves at these demons as you have so bravely done. May the Light keep you!

These fiends will fail!  For Azeroth!
If it is our fate to die this day, then we will not go easy!  Mark me, these demons will fall like wheat!
Though your sinews tire and your blood flows from cuts and wounds to this sodden ground, you fight for the spirits of your world.  No evil force can stand against us!
My brethren, my comrades-in-arms!  I must go to seek the forces of the Horde and direct them here!  Keep your spirits strong, brave hunters!  Do not fall to the portal-spawned fiends!
