Greatfather Winter is only a wyvern's ride away to Orgrimmar.

19177.text: During the Lunar Festival, we should take time to seek out our elders and consider their wisdom.
Have you seen the fireworks? This is the best time of year to buy them.
We should go to Moonglade to see the druids' great festival of the moon.
The druids of Nighthaven are holding a great celebration in Moonglade for the Lunar Festival.
Next year, I'm dressing up as either a corsair or an assassin.
What do you think of the mask?
Boo-hoo! I'm a poor little gnome, and I don't have a capital ci... oh, wait.
Someone should make a candy with a chewy gnome center.
We should go trick or treating later.
I think I've eaten too much candy...
I hope I have a chance to visit with Greatfather Winter before Winter Veil is over.
Greatfather Winter will leave presents for everyone under the tree in Orgrimmar. I wonder what he'll bring me this year.
The goblins of Smokywood Pastures always have such wonderful treats for sale this time of year.

19178.text: Have you seen the fireworks? This is the best time of year to buy them.
During the Lunar Festival, we should take time to seek out our elders and consider their wisdom.
The druids of Nighthaven are holding a great celebration in Moonglade for the Lunar Festival.
During the Lunar Festival, we should take time to seek out our elders and consider their wisdom.
Legend says that the great beast Omen sleeps in the waters of Lake Elune'ara in Moonglade, only to appear once a year. But that's just a legend.
Legend says that the great beast Omen sleeps in the waters of Lake Elune'ara in Moonglade, only to appear once a year. But that's just a legend.
We should go trick or treating later.
We should attend the next burning of the Wickerman.
For the Alliance!
Happy Hallow's End!
I think I've eaten too much candy...
I think I've eaten too much candy...
Winter Veil just isn't the same now, but going through the motions still makes me feel something.
Greatfather Winter will leave presents for everyone under the tree in Orgrimmar. I wonder what he'll bring me this year.
Where are all those wonderful winter hats coming from?
I hope I have a chance to visit with Greatfather Winter before Winter Veil is over.
Winter Veil just isn't the same now, but going through the motions still makes me feel something.
I hope I have a chance to visit with Greatfather Winter before Winter Veil is over.
Where are all those wonderful winter hats coming from?
Winter Veil just isn't the same now, but going through the motions still makes me feel something.
The goblins of Smokywood Pastures always have such wonderful treats for sale this time of year.
Greatfather Winter will leave presents for everyone under the tree in Orgrimmar. I wonder what he'll bring me this year.

19191.text: What insolence! What arrogance! To believe you could defeat me on my own doorstep!
Fool! You are a child playing in a world beyond your comprehension. Speak no more!
Your weapons are nothing to me! Relent!
You have confidence in your skills? Think carefully as the answer may surprise you.

19196.text: I feel that war is fast approaching.  The fruit vendor has enlisted the help of an ogre.  I shall have to enlist help as well.
FRUIT VENDOR!!! Your cart is still in our way!  We will give you one more hour to move it from our area.  Do not test our patience anymore!

19216.text: Friends, it is my great pleasure to welcome you to the temple today.
A'dal has been most generous in his revelations to me, a humble servant of the Light.
In accordance with my divine calling, I must share these revealed truths to all who would hear.
It has been made known to me that inside each of us, the Light resides...
...that it is a gift, given freely to all naturally born beings.
It manifests itself as a feeling, small at first and easily ignored, that confirms truths and subtly prods one to do good.
Simple kindnesses, charitable deeds, service to those in need. These are all fruits of the Light.
It rewards those who heed its promptings with blessings, both seen and unseen.
Personal reservoirs of hope and faith are strengthened, and one's capacity for greater light increases.
Over the course of time, through obedience to the Light's guidance, one becomes more sensitive to its voice, and its power.
Great is the healing and blessing power of the Light's most diligent followers.
Sadly, there are those who wander through mortality in defiance of the Light.
From these the Light withdraws, until only darkness remains.
Where there is no light, despair, loathing and rage thrive.
We are born into a perilous age, where the forces of darkness are determined to bring about our destruction.
These are the times to find yourselves in unison with the Light.
Hear my words, and let the Light inside of you confirm the truth of them.
Embrace the light that is in you, my friends! Deny yourself all darkness...
We must endure these trying times faithfully, and one day we will find ourselves victorious.

19217.text: Oh, another show already? Very well then...
%s sighs audibly and glances at Sagan.
I shall transform my familiar, Sagan, into something truly wondrous!
Thank you for watching, everyone! If you'd be so kind as to bring your non-irradiated currency to tomorrow's performance, I'd appreciate it.

19218.text: If my division is correct... you should be quite dead.
You hear a faint unlocking sound...

19219.text: You should split while you can.
Go ahead, gimme your best shot.  I can take it!
Think you can hurt me, huh?  Think I'm afraid a' you?
Can't say I didn't warn you....

19220.text: We are on a strict timetable. You will not interfere!
I'm looking for a team player...
Time to supplement my work force.

19221.text: Don't value your life very much, do you?
Think you can take the heat?

19223.text: I could have sworn I had more apples.  Grok!
What is that poor orc yelling about? Someone should see what is going on.

19227.text: Hey! Hey, $r! I be havin' just the thing for ya. Ya ever see a tikbalang? Frightenin' creatures. Prone to stealin' ya away. What ya need is one of my tikbalang wards. Guaranteed to ward away all tikbalangs!
Look over here, $c! I got somethin' for ya. Just what ya need. It's soap, right... and it's on a rope! No offense, $G man:honey;, but yer a little ripe, know what I'm sayin'?
Ya look lovesick. Special someone be gettin' ya down, eh? No worries, no worries. Ya get this medallion from me, ya wear it when ya see 'em, and they be all over ya, $G man:sweetheart;!

Dangerous out there, innit? Know what ya need? Protection. I can help ya defy death itself! Ya wear this madstone 'round yer neck, see, and then ya be able to come back if ya find yerself in the spirit world! Just a quick jaunt to yer corpse and up ya come, fresh and new!

Amazing amulets! Incredible curios! The newfangled jewelcrafters be havin' nothin' on the tried and true mystical methods of ol' Griftah! Improve yerself through these magical talismans for a bargain price!
C'mere, $r. Ya don't want to be riskin' yerself in a dungeon, do ya? Filthy work, and for what? Some worthless trinket? Nah, what ya need be one of my amulets. Guaranteed to work!

Ya look tired, $c. I be havin' somethin' for ya. These amulets, they can help ya leap obstacles and swim through the rivers like ya be born to it. They energize the food ya be eatin', makin' yer wounds close before yer eyes!

19228.text: Hey all!  So how long until the jokes spawn?
I just flew in from Ironforge and, Boy!, are my mount's wings tired!
Hey folks, go easy on me... it's my first time.
Thanks for coming out to see me!  I hope you are ready for a good time, because I am.
Whoa!  Is all that applause for me?  Thanks for coming out!
What a good looking crowd. The dwarven women even shaved.
Are you ready to laugh!
I never met a tauren I didn't like...
To eat!!
Last week I was in Goldshire. Have you been there?
That town's so small, I asked a kid to draw me a map. He drew it on the back of a Defias wanted poster...
to scale!!
Impersonation time!!  I call this, "The Silly Tauren."
The comedian clears his throat.
The comedian impersonates a tauren.
Here's a good one, why do watermelons have water in them?
Because they are planted in the spring!
What's the deal with women?  I mean they are always like...
The comedian impersonates a human female.
And then gnomes are even worse!  They are always saying stuff like...
The comedian impersonates a gnome.
What time is it when an elekk sits on your fence?
Time to get a new fence!!
If I knew it was going to be like this, I'd have worn my Greater Boots of Laughter.
Apparently my reputation with you people is hostile.
Wow!  The laughs don't drop very often here, do they?
Can I get a buff? I'm dying up here.
Come on!  These jokes are epic!
Hey! Hey! Hey! It's Raliq the drunk... His momma's so fat she didn't just make the front cover of Ogre Today...
She made the back cover too!
The gnomes used to be a nice respectful people...
The other day I saw one walking down the street shouting, "Once you go gnome, you never go home!"
I love blood elf women.  Especially when they say stuff like this...
The comedian impersonates a blood elf.
So the blood elves think they're just one step away from ruling the world...
Twelve steps is more like it!
One last impersonation.  It's tough, but let's see if you can guess who it is...
The comedian impersonates an orc.
Now that the show's done, can someone run me through Scarlet Monestary?
Thank you! Don't forget to tip your waiters! Good night folks.
Well, it's time to take these comedic muscles elsewhere. Have a good night all!
Is it over already?  You've been great folks.  Walk safely and have a good night.
Thank you everyone!  And keep clapping, there is a fly in here and one of you are bound to get it!  Good night!
How many kobolds does it take to change a lantern wick?
You no take candle!
Goldshire's inn advertises a lakeside view...
I saw a murloc swim by my window.
Have you ever noticed that all those cute, orc kids look the same?
It's too bad they don't stay cute.  There must be some rite of passage in the Barrens called, "Climb ugly tree and fall out."
I've heard that gnomes can grant wishes...
Well I wish they'd go away!
Look who's here, it's Raliq the drunk... His momma's so fat dragons won't eat her...
They don't know where to store the leftovers!
My wife and I were happy for 23 years...
And then we met!
What do you call a broken boomerang?
A stick!
So this gnome tells a tauren that he's been to Molten Core.
The tauren says, "That's a load of bull."
How desperate do you have to be for allies that you recruit your livestock?
I own a dog, but I'm not giving him a sword.
Used to be you couldn't trust a goblin...
Who am I kiddin'? If you trade with goblins you'd better have iron plating in your coinpurse.
Is it just me, or is the Horde about the ugliest enemy we could find?
Just so you guys don't feel left out, all I said was how attractive the blood elves are.  It loses something in the translation.

19255.text: Yea, we got problems. I think that's crystal clear. The question is, what are we gonna do about it?
Get used to it, girls. We're out here for the rest of our miserable lives as far as I'm concerned. Welcome to Hellfire Peninsula, your new home.

How many more of you grunts do I need to send back to mommy and daddy in a body bag before you grow a brain and realize that runnin' head first into a Legion kill squad is suicide? And don't nod your thick skulls at me as if you know what I'm talkin' about!
I'm not gonna lie to you, soldiers. We're getting our butts kicked out there! Now which one of you is orc enough to do something about it?
The warchief's put a price on Arazzius's head! As of right now, that no-good piece of demon refuse is enemy number one.

19257.text: INCOMING! Do not let them through! Focus fire! NOW, NOW, NOW!

19270.text: If you are ready to laugh, head over to the World's End Tavern!
TAUREN CHIEFTAINS! Playing LIVE, in the WORLD'S END TAVERN! Be there, at the top of the hour! Banished from Shattrath? SNEAK BACK IN!
Are you ready to rock? Then head over to the World's End Tavern! The Tauren Chieftains start their show at the top of the hour.
Who? The Tauren Chieftains! What? A live performance! Where? The World's End Tavern! When? The top of the hour! BE THERE!
Now, in Shattrath City: The Tauren Chieftains! Playing in the World's End Tavern at the top of the hour!

19271.text: Thank you all for coming tonight.  Now put your hands together to welcome Shattrath's best, Perry Gatner!
Perry Gatner! What an act!  The cantina is open all night long, so please, stay and enjoy yourselves!

19273.text: Speak with Wing Commander Brack, $n.  He'll outfit you with one of our armored wyvern destroyers.  And, good luck!

19283.text: Hey, $G man:lady;? Got some money?  I got five kids to feed!

19294.text: I have an idea.  Let's plant this shard in the ground and see what happens.
The evil emanating from the crystal shard has lured one of the colossi.  Put it down quick!

19308.text: This war - and don't mistake this for anything but a war - is not going to win itself. If we do not fight, scratch, claw, and kick for every speck of land on this shattered world, all will be lost.
How many more soldiers need to die before we start paying attention out there?
Do you think that demons will play fair? These beasts are more savage than orcs and more cunning than the undead. Do not attempt to engage Legion by normal standards of war.
I regret to inform you all that we sent home another ten soldiers today - in body bags.

19316.text: Tear it down, soldiers! We're shippin' this thing back to Stormwind!
We're gonna melt this hunk of junk down and make weapons with the ingots! Let's see how the Legion likes a taste of fel reaver served up Alliance style!
Well done, soldiers! We weren't about to let the filthy animals of the Horde show us up!
Let them throw another one of these overgrown tin cans at us! We'll show them what the Alliance is made of!

19346.text: Anchorite Nindumen, I have a request to make of you.
We've just sent another inexperienced squad into Nagrand. Might you offer a prayer for them?

19354.text: Work these Broken wretches to the bones, Illidari!  If there's anything of value in this forsaken place we shall find it!
Do not allow these wretches a moment of rest!  If there's an Ata'mal crystal here then we shall find it!
Keep a close eye on this Broken scum!  Far too many have escaped from us!
We will find what the Master is looking for!  Failure is not an option!

19362.text: If I see any lazy peons here, I'll load them into a catapult and launch them off to the Black Temple!
Any time any of you peons want to take a break, the graveyard is right over there.

19378.text: Of course, my friend. How can I be of service to you?
A noble request. It would be an honor, Erothem.
My friends, please join me in humble supplication to the Light.
Light that we embrace, we beseech thee...
Into our struggle against the darkness we have sent our children.
Please bless and protect them, and grant them success over those who seek to do us harm...
Continue to bless this, our ancient home, we beg.
Bless us with tolerance for our elven visitors.
By the naaru, may it be so.

19380.text: Hurry up with that axe, you! I want it sharp enough to cut the wind!
If you're no good at fixing, we'll see if you're good for eating. Now WORK!

19389.text: %s lets out a massive roar, calling for aid!

19392.text: WE'RE UNDER ATTACK! RUN FOR COVER!
INFERNAL RAIN ON THE RISE! TAKE COVER!

19394.text: Nae, that's fer wimps. Hit me with yer hammer!

19395.text: %s blinks, a perplexed expression crossing his face.
I'm... not sure that's a good idea, 'Moke. Ye might get hurt...

19412.text: A cool breeze caresses your face. Gentle, melodic humming resonates throughout the chamber.n

19422.text: Protect the Warchief at all costs!

19424.text: Protect the Warchief at all costs!

19447.text: Light, lead the fallen from untruth to truth, from darkness to Light and from death to immortality.
Light be with you now and forever.
The priest kneels in silent prayer.

19456.text: Haven't you done enough harm?  Must you also disturb my slumber?
What good does this violence serve?  What is done is done.  I have failed my people.

19466.text: Hold your tongue, knave!  Do not dare use that tone with a priestess of the Light!
Even you must admit that your information from defectors is outdated and unreliable.  Let us make calculated attacks on these manaforges and gather what information we can.

19467.text: With all due respect, A'dal sent us here to investigate Kael's activities, not mount a full-scaled attack.
The magistrix will be happy to know  I'm  fluent in Thalassian.  Your courtesy is not lost on me.
Back to the topic...  we should focus our attention on these manaforges.  We need to learn what the enemy is doing with them and why.

19468.text: Look, sweetheart.  No one's talking about storming Tempest Keep ourselves, but when we see a target of opportunity we have to take it.
...and just look at where that got us!
Finally some talk of action from the big guy!

19469.text: We've told you all there is to know!  Do you forget that many of us used to be trusted followers of Kael'thas?

19475.text: It's coming along, Wafflefry. Haven't you got a product demonstration to do or something?

19477.text: The taskmaster's dead!  Quick, Dreghoods!  Run!
This is our chance!  Run for it!

19481.text: I can't thank you enough for your help, $n. At long last, I will be free of this tower and Kael's damnable magic!
No! How could the ritual fail?
The curse remains intact. We'll have to find another way.

19493.text: I told you only to summon me if that stupid elf returned! What's this? No matter, you won't detain me long.

19516.text: Alert! You are marked for extermination.

19523.text: If you nice me let you live.
You stay here.  Me go kill someone else!

19524.text: Why don't you let me do the talking?
No, we will NOT let you live.
You're always hungry.  That's why we so fat!
I'm tired.  You kill next one!
That's because I do all the hard work!

19527.text: %s absorbs the fire energy of the attack.
%s absorbs the arcane energy of the attack.
%s absorbs the frost energy of the attack.
%s absorbs the holy energy of the attack.
%s absorbs the nature energy of the attack.
%s absorbs the shadow energy of the attack.

19533.text: A tradesman, perhaps? You need look no further than I for supplies. My prices are quite fair, friend. These items were difficult to acquire, but what does the source matter, eh? You'll have what you need.

19534.text: The creatures of this place are strong, wayfarer. You'll need ample ammunition if you hope to survive. You're in luck - I am well-stocked with fine arrows, bullets, and throwing weapons. The price is reasonable, considering circumstances.

19535.text: Ahh, another powerful traveler. The nether can be dangerous; you'll want the most potent spells at your disposal. I carry the finest reagents, common and exotic. Come, buy - you won't be sorry!

19541.text: Good thing that we're surrounded by neighbors with excess machine parts.
Maybe I should gather up some other agents and head out there after this shift?
Hmm, arcane annihilators are pretty tough.  I wonder if Papa Wheeler knows what he's asking for?
Last time someone went out to try to collect the bounty on Netherock, all we got back was a compressed layer of foolhardy adventurer!
Netherock?!  That thing'll squish you flat with one step of its massive foot!  No thanks!

19543.text: I don't know what I was thinking, going out without my sword. I would've put it on if I'd seen it here...

19544.text: I can't possibly go out without my cloak. I hope it's in here...
There it is! I could've sworn it wasn't here last time I checked...

19545.text: Phew! There's my lucky hat. I've been looking for it everywhere.

19546.text: I can't sleep without a good bedtime story. Now I'm certain to rest well.

19554.text: You only hasten the inevitable. In time, all will be devoured!

19556.text: War drums echo in the distance.
At long last, I am home...
Hellscream! Blessed ancestors! He is the mirrored reflection of Grom, Drek'Thar.
I am sorry that I did not come sooner, young Hellscream. There is so much that I have to tell you about your father, but first you must tell me where I may find the Greatmother.
I thank you, Garrosh. We have much to discuss when I return from my visit with the Greatmother.
They... did not, Greatmother. They were killed shortly after I was born. I never knew them. I was raised as a slave. To this day, I carry the name of Thrall.n

I have dreamed of this moment all my life, Greatmother. 'Till now, all I've had were Orgrim's stories about my parents and their adventures on Draenor. He was my greatest teacher and dearest friend. He died a hero... They all died as heroes - and for all of them, a song of honor remains.n
He died our greatest hero. It was Grom who freed us all... I was by his side when he struck down Mannoroth and ended the curse forever.

Tell him? Greatmother, that boy's father died so that all of us could live free of the blood curse. I will tell him nothing. I will show him! Show him and any that would doubt Hellscream's resolve exactly what Grom Hellscream did for all orcs!
Please excuse me, Greatmother. I will return soon.
Garrosh, son of Hellscream, your father lived and died as our greatest hero. Honor me by allowing me to show you what your father sacrificed so that we could live free of the demon's grasp.
Spirits give me strength! Take from my soul these old wounds and expose them for all to see! Let this child know his father! Let these people know their savior!
%s places a hand on Garrosh's shoulder.
You need not thank me, Garrosh. Your father was a brother to me. I would do anything for you and the Mag'har. I must now return to the Greatmother.
I have returned, Greatmother. Garrosh has found his heart and his fury.

19561.text: I'm blind, you stupid sow-spawn, not deaf. Don't even think about it.

19569.text: I hope those blood elves across the way don't think that I'm spying on them!
If I were smart, I'd be selling this research for a seat on the rocket ship.  I have a feeling we're going to need to get out of here soon!
If this is right, we don't have long!  Oh well.
This is the last time that I buy second-hand equipment from an ethereal!

19578.text: Alright, Mk. I, that should just about do it.  Let's just flip your switch here...
Oh no!  Will I ever get you working?!
Mark II, get your metallic behind back here this instant!
Be careful in there and come back in one piece!
You're back!  Were you able to get all of the machines?

19579.text: Phew! There's my lucky hat. I've been looking for it everywhere.

19580.text: I can't possibly go out without my cloak. I hope it's in here...
There it is! I could've sworn it wasn't here last time I checked...

19589.text: All systems on-line.  Prepare yourself, we leave shortly.

19606.text: Someone come read this wanted poster to Grek.  Grek can't read!
This oil no good for Grek! What Grek look like to you, some weakling in robes?

19610.text: A skunk! Eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeew! Don't touch me!
Let me outta here! Guys... guys?
Oh man, he got you good!
Remember how you're always telling us to chill?
That was the best trick ever! Ok, boys, let's go get a drink.
My eyebrows! You singed my eyebrows!

19616.text: %s howls in response to Malukaz's call.

19622.text: Energy. Power. My people are addicted to it... a dependence made manifest after the Sunwell was destroyed. Welcome to the future. A pity you are too late to stop it. No one can stop me now! Selama ashal'anore!
Capernian will see to it that your stay here is a short one.
Well done, you have proven worthy to test your skills against my master engineer, Telonicus.
Let us see how your nerves hold up against the Darkener, Thaladred!
You have persevered against some of my best advisors... but none can withstand the might of the Blood Hammer. Behold, Lord Sanguinar!
As you see, I have many weapons in my arsenal....
Perhaps I underestimated you. It would be unfair to make you fight all four advisors at once, but... fair treatment was never shown to my people. I'm just returning the favor.
Alas, sometimes one must take matters into one's own hands. Balamore shanal!
Let us see how you fare when your world is turned upside down.
Having trouble staying grounded?
By the power of the sun!
Anar'anel belore!
Obey me!
Bow to my will!
You will not prevail!
You gambled. And lost.
This was child's play.
I have not come this far to be stopped! The future I have planned will not be jeopardized! Now you will taste true power!!
For... Quel'...Thalas!
%s begins to cast Pyroblast!

19635.text: I love the smell of nether in the morning.

19647.text: No, old friend. You've freed us all...

19664.text: Nothing like a tankard full to wash down one of my magnificent muffins.
Yea, that hit the spot.  Muffins for sale!  Get your fresh muffins right here!
I've got muffins right over here.  Come on over!
Yea, yea, I'm the muffin man.  You know why?  Because I sell muffins, that's why!

19666.text: Bravo! Bravo! Good show... I couldn't convince you to work for me, could I? No, I suppose the needless slaughter of my employees might negatively impact your employment application.
Your plan was a good one, Sha'heen, and you would have gotten away with it if not for one thing...
Never underestimate the other ethereal's greed!

19667.text: Hail, Gezhe!  Seventeen more orders have been placed in the Hara'samid Sector.  The markets of heavy veldarite have all but collapsed, as you predicted.
Heraazi exports are on the rise, sir.  We've already bribed the appropriate taxation officers and contraband will begin to arrive within days.

19671.text: %s checks to make sure his body is intact.
You made it! Well done, $r. Now if you'll excuse me, I have to get the rest of our crew inside.
Let's not waste any time! Take anything that isn't nailed down to the floor and teleport directly to Stormspire! Chop chop!
This should't take very long. Just watch my back as I empty these nether collectors.
Fantastic! Let's move on, shall we?
Looking at these energy levels, Shaffar was set to make a killing!
Hrm, now where is the next collector?
Ah, there it is. Follow me, fleshling.
There can't be too many more of these collectors. Just keep me safe as I do my job.

What do we have here? I thought you said the area was secure? This is now the third attack? If we make it out of here, I will definitely be deducting this from your reward. Now don't just stand there, destroy them so I can get to that collector.
We're close to the exit. I'll let you rest for about thirty seconds, but then we're out of here.
Ok break time is OVER. Let's go!
Oh really? And what might that be?
He was right, you know. I'll have to take that tag-line for my own... It's not like he'll have a use for it anymore!

19672.text: It is if I'm not the one that's going to be sent in to test it... Otherwise, no.
What does that mean anyway? Ready? Can it ever be ready?
I'm giving her all that I've got, captain. I don't think she can take much more of this!
I can't bang on this device any faster, captain! My wrapping is already beginning to unravel!
Why don't you pick up a hammer and start banging on these structures instead of asking us if it's done every 5 minutes?
I've had just about enough of your incessant whining, captain. What are you even a captain of? I mean, the nerve!

19673.text: I don't get paid enough for this nonsense.
This is gonna leave a mark...
If I make it through, I expect a pay raise.
%s runs his hands across his body to make sure everything is intact.
I made it! I made it!

19674.text: I don't give a damn what Shaffar's ethereals have placed over the entrance to the Mana-Tombs. You will work until those wards are removed and the Consortium can move in safely and take what's rightfully ours!

I don't pay you engineers exorbitant amounts of gold so that I can hear the words "no" or "can't" exit your wrappings. Bring that barrier down or you'll find yourselves working the energy reclamation line on X-17.
I'm close to the edge, Morphalius. Another screw up and it'll be you running through that portal for Kaftiz's tests.

19676.text: Is that damned thing safe to go through yet?
Is it done yet? What is taking so damned long?
You know, we could easily replace you with goblins. Is that what you want???
I can't believe you imbeciles went to school for this! Does anybody here know what they're doing?
Alright, it looks safe. Get in there, engineer!
Oh well, back to the drawing board.
I didn't like him much anyway. Too much talk, not enough "do."
Damnit. How are we ever going to get through their security measures?

19685.text: Follow me, stranger.  This won't take long.
Shattrath was once the draenei capital of this world. Its name means "dwelling of light."
When the Burning Legion turned the orcs against the draenei, the fiercest battle was fought here. The draenei fought tooth and nail, but in the end the city fell.
The city was left in ruins and darkness... until the Sha'tar arrived.
Let us go into the Lower City.  I will warn you that as one of the only safe havens in Outland, Shattrath has attracted droves of refugees from all wars, current and past.
The Sha'tar, or "born from light" are the naaru that came to Outland to fight the demons of the Burning Legion.
They were drawn to the ruins of Shattrath City where a small remnant of the draenei priesthood conducted its rites inside a ruined temple on this very spot.n

The priesthood, known as the Aldor, quickly regained its strength as word spread that the naaru had returned and reconstruction soon began.  The ruined temple is now used as an infirmary for injured refugees.

It wouldn't be long, however, before the city came under attack once again.  This time, the attack came from Illidan's armies. A large regiment of blood elves had been sent by Illidan's ally, Kael'thas Sunstrider, to lay waste to the city.
As the regiment of blood elves crossed this very bridge, the Aldor's exarchs and vindicators lined up to defend the Terrace of Light.  But then the unexpected happened.n
The blood elves laid down their weapons in front of the city's defenders; their leader, a blood elf elder known as Voren'thal, stormed into the Terrace of Light and demanded to speak to A'dal.

As the naaru approached him, Voren'thal kneeled before him and uttered the following words: "I've seen you in a vision, naaru. My race's only hope for survival lies with you. My followers and I are here to serve you."

The defection of Voren'thal and his followers was the largest loss ever incurred by Kael's forces. And these weren't just any blood elves.  Many of the best and brightest amongst Kael's scholars and magisters had been swayed by Voren'thal's influence.n
The naaru accepted the defectors, who would be known as the Scryers; their dwelling lies in the platform above.  Only those initiated with the Scryers are allowed there.
The Aldor are followers of the Light and forgiveness and redemption are values they understand. However, they found hard to forget the deeds of the blood elves while under Kael's command.
Many of the priesthood had been slain by the same magisters who now vowed to serve the naaru.  They were not happy to share the city with their former enemies.
The Aldor's most holy temple and its surrounding dwellings lie on the terrace above.  As a holy site, only the initiated are welcome inside.n
The attacks against Shattrath continued, but the city did not fall, as you can see. On the contrary, the naaru known as Xi'ri led a successful incursion into Shadowmoon Valley - Illidan's doorstep.
There he continues to wage war on Illidan with the assistance of the Aldor and the Scryers.  The two factions have not given up on their old feuds, though.

Such is their animosity that they vie for the honor of being sent to assist the naaru there. Each day, that decision is made here by A'dal.  The armies gather here to receive A'dal's blessing before heading to Shadowmoon.

Khadgar should be ready to see you again.  Just remember that to serve the Sha'tar you will most likely have to ally with the Aldor or the Scryers. And seeking the favor of one group will cause the others' dislike.n
Good luck stranger, and welcome to Shattrath City.

20129.text: Greetings, $n. I will guide you through the cavern. Please try and keep up.

We do not know if the Caverns of Time have always been accessible to mortals. Truly, it is impossible to tell as the Timeless One is in perpetual motion, changing our timeways as he sees fit. What you see now may very well not exist tomorrow. You may wake up yesterday and have no memory of this place.n
It is strange, I know... Most mortals cannot actually comprehend what they see here, as often, what they see is not anchored within their own perception of reality.n
There are only two truths to be found here: First, that time is chaotic, always in flux, and completely malleable and second, perception does not dictate reality.

As custodians of time, we watch over and care for Nozdormu's realm. The master is away at the moment, which means that attempts are being made to dramatically alter time. The master never meddles in the affairs of mortals but instead corrects the alterations made to time by others. He is reactionary in this regard.n

For normal maintenance of time, the Keepers of Time are sufficient caretakers. We are able to deal with most ordinary disturbances. I speak of little things, such as rogue mages changing something in the past to elevate their status or wealth in the present.n

These tunnels that you see are called timeways. They are infinite in number. The ones that currently exist in your reality are what the master has deemed as 'trouble spots.'  These trouble spots may differ completely in theme but they always share a cause. That is, their existence is a result of the same temporal disturbance. Remember that should you venture inside one...n

This timeway is in great disarray! We have agents inside right now attempting to restore order. What little information I have indicates that Thrall's freedom is in jeopardy. A malevolent organization known as the Infinite Dragonflight is trying to prevent his escape. I fear without outside assistance, all will be lost.n

We have very little information on this timeway. Sa'at has been dispatched and is currently inside. The data we have gathered from his correspondence is that the Infinite Dragonflight are once again attempting to alter time. Could it be that the opening of the Dark Portal is being targeted for sabotage? Let us hope not...n
This timeway collapsed and reformed. The result was Stratholme of yore. What could possibly be happening inside?

The timeways are currently ranked in order from least catastrophic to most catastrophic. Note that they are all classified as catastrophic, meaning that any single one of these timeways collapsing would mean that your world would end. We only classify them in such a way so that the heroes and adventurers that are sent here know which timeway best suits their abilities.n

All we know of this timeway is that it leads to Mount Hyjal. The Infinite Dragonflight have gone to great lengths to prevent our involvement. We know next to nothing, mortal. Soridormi is currently attempting to break through the timeway's defenses but has thus far been unsuccessful. You might be our only hope of breaking through and resolving the conflict.n
Our time is at an end, $n. I would wish you luck, if such a thing existed.n

I have had this object in my possession for 10 years. Since Blackrock Spire...
I wrested it free from the remains of an orc lieutenant - a dark caster... It is from their homeworld.
Do not get too close. I laid a hand upon it once... Only once and never again. The memories of that day still linger.
I surmise that this object is the living embodiment of shadows... darkness... It is a manifestation. It is a void.

Let me ask you this, brothers and sisters: Can good exist without evil? Can there be light without dark?
And if that answer is no, then could it be possible that because this artifact exists, its polar opposite must also exist?

BY THE LIGHT! Could it be? Could this be it?
I must know... I will know...
I... It... It is beautiful. What I felt when I touched it... The Light coursed through me and I through it... It healed my spirit.
Let us never again speak of this day. Our enemies are many. They need not know we hold such artifacts.

I have seen it... From this blessed crystal we will forge a weapon. This weapon will hold inside it a piece of each of us... And when it is used against undead, it shall cast them down. And in its wake, it will leave only ashes...

Why would I call on you?

Knew this was... the only way out.

I suggest a new strategy: you draw their attacks while I gather reinforcements.

20904.text: I knew the prince would be angry, but I... I have not been myself. I had to let them out! The great one speaks to me, you see. Wait--outsiders. Kael'thas did not send you! Good... I'll just tell the prince you released the prisoners!
The naaru kept some of the most dangerous beings in existence here in these cells. Let me introduce you to another....
Yes, yes... another! Your will is mine!
Behold, yet another terrifying creature of incomprehensible power!
What is this? A lowly gnome? I will do better, oh great one.
Anarchy! Bedlam! Oh, you are so wise! Yes, I see it now, of course!
One final cell remains. Yes, O great one, right away!
Welcome, O great one. I am your humble servant.

20912.text: It is a small matter to control the mind of the weak... for I bear allegiance to powers untouched by time, unmoved by fate. No force on this world or beyond harbors the strength to bend our knee... not even the mighty Legion!
Bear witness to the agent of your demise!
The chaos I have sown here is but a taste....
You will do my bidding, weakling.
Your will is no longer your own.
I will show you horrors undreamed of.
We span the universe, as countless as the stars!
I am merely one of... infinite multitudes.

20913.text: It's working! Ghabar will be pleased to hear the news.

20926.text: You hear a loud rumble of metal grinding on stone...

20977.text: Where in Bonzo's Brass Buttons am I? And who are-- yaaghh, that's one mother of a headache!
"Lowly"? I don't care who you are, friend: no one refers to the mighty Millhouse Manastorm as "lowly"!
I have no idea what goes on here, but I will gladly join your fight against this impudent imbecile!
I just need to get some things ready first. You guys go ahead and get started. I need to summon up some water....
Fantastic! Next, some protective spells. Yeah, now we're cookin'!
And of course I'll need some mana. You guys are gonna love this; just wait....
Aaalllriiiight!! Who ordered up an extra large can of whoop-ass?
I didn't even break a sweat on that one!
You guys feel free to jump in anytime.
I'm gonna light you up, sweet cheeks!
Heal me! For the love of all that's holy, heal me! I'm dying!!
You'll be hearing from my lawyer!
Who's bad? Who's bad? That's right: we bad!

21024.text: Stand back, $n. The spirits may lash out.
We wish to help you, spirit. We seek your wisdom.
You are right, spirit. It was my people that did this to you. Allow us to make it right.
Please tell us this: Who or what is Cyrukh?
The... The fire lord? An elemental lord was unearthed? Of course... Gul'dan you were a damned fool!
Do not doubt my comrades and I, spirit. Tell us how to conjure the fire lord. My allies will destroy him.
We will find these words. We will summon your master and we will destroy him.
Now to recover the lost words!
I hear what you hear, brother. Look behind you...
21024.comment: Earthmender Torlok to Cyrukh the Firelord

21027.text: I sense the tortured spirits, $n. They are this way. Come quickly!
Grant me protection, $n. I must break through their foul magic!
The naga of Coilskar are exceptionally cruel to their prisoners. It is a miracle that I survived inside that watery prison for as long as I did. Earthmother be praised.
Lady Vashj must answer for these atrocities. She must be brought to justice!
The tumultuous nature of the great waterways of Azeroth and Draenor are a direct result of tormented water spirits.
Now we must find the exit.
It shouldn't be much further, $n. The exit is just up ahead.
Thank you, $n. Please return to my brethren at the Altar of Damnation, near the Hand of Gul'dan, and tell them that Wilda is safe. May the Earthmother watch over you...

21049.text: You have damned us all... We are lost.
Do not do this, Gul'dan! The elements will never forgive us!
Think of our younglings, Gul'dan! You will destroy us all!
We will take from the land if it refuses to give!
Tear the land asunder, Gul'dan! Sever the tie!
They have abandoned us! Do not forget!

21057.text: Who dares to interrupt my operation?

21066.text: %s whispers softly in reverent tones under her breath.

21104.text: The sands of time shall be scattered to the winds!
History is about to be rewritten!
You are running out of time!
You will never defeat us all!

21114.text: This is going to hurt in the morning.

21118.text: Where's our back up?  I want them here now!
Last push boys!  Let 'em have it!
Nice work soldiers!  This is the last of them!
This is the last of them.  Don't get sloppy!
We can handle it from here.  Roughriders you are dismissed.
Come on you apes. You want to live forever?
21118.comment: Razak Ironsides - Ravager invasion event random combat text

21118.text: Warm it up and give 'em everything you've got.
21118.comment: Razak Ironsides - Ravager invasion event random combat text

21118.text: I only have one rule. Everyone fights. No one quits.

21129.text: Fool! Cyrukh the fire lord! When the tie was severed, Cyrukh awoke. It is the tears of Cyrukh that fill this land with molten rock.
Yes... Yes... the words. The words of damnation. The words spoken by the dark one. Your master.
Talk. More talk... Now release us, mortal.

21130.text: What is it that you hope to gain from this?
He is insane now. Driven mad during the shattering. There is no rest for the elements.

21131.text: Wisdom? It was your people that caused the insufferable wrath of Cyrukh.
Yes, a way. Destroy Cyrukh. Destroy an elemental lord.

21132.text: Why should we help you? The world is ruined. Destroyed.

21133.text: Ah, this was from Private Denning.  I remember when he fell...
This one was from Corporal Stonewell... he died protecting a field hospital...
Ah, yes... Private Guarding.  He always was quick to laugh... until a Bleeding Hollow Raid tore out his throat!
This insignia is from Sergeant Rantack, once my superior.  You'd never find a tougher soldier than old Rantack...
%s faces the Bleeding Hollow fort of Zeth'Gor...
Damn you!  Damn all of you bleeding fel orcs!  May your souls rot in the belly of whatever Dark Power that fuels you!

21134.text: A deep, bone chilling voice echoes from the %s...
How dare you trifle with my playthings, $n!
The orcs in my citadel will drink your blood and devour you!

21136.text: You will not stand in our way!

21139.text: You will not stand in our way!

21140.text: The sands of time shall be scattered to the winds!
History is about to be rewritten!
You are running out of time!
You will never defeat us all!

21148.text: The sands of time shall be scattered to the winds!
History is about to be rewritten!
You are running out of time!
You will never defeat us all!

21151.text: ACK!  That's the worst thing I've ever tasted!  I wouldn't let my ram drink that!

21174.text: Wretched, meddling insects! Release me, and perhaps I will grant you a merciful death!
Vermin! Leeches! Take my blood and choke on it!
Illidan is an arrogant fool! I will crush him and reclaim Outland as my own!
Away, you mindless parasites! My blood is my own!
How long do you believe your pathetic sorcery can hold me?
My blood will be the end of you!

21181.text: Those that dare play with fire will be incinerated!
Little creature made of flesh, your wish is granted! Death comes for you!

21188.text: It's time to celebrate, I think...
%s places a keg on the ground.
Listen up, you lot! Our worries are over! FREE BOOZE FOR EVERYONE!

21193.text: Learning to read is a thirsty business. A toast, eh?

21212.text: Water... is life. It has become a rare commodity here in Outland; a commodity that we alone shall control. We are the Highborne, and the time has come at last for us to retake our rightful place in the world!
I'll split you from stem to stern!
I spit on you, surface filth!
I did not wish to lower myself by engaging your kind, but you leave me little choice...
The time is now! Leave none standing!
You may want to take cover.
Lord Illidan, I... I am... sorry.

21213.text: Flood of the deep, take you!
%s sends his enemies to their watery graves!
The violent earthquake has alerted nearby Murlocs!

21214.text: Your overconfidence will be your undoing! Guards, lend me your strength!
Go on, kill them! I'll be the better for it!
I am more powerful than ever!

21215.text: Be gone, trifling elf.  I am in control now!
No... no! What have you done? I am the master! Do you hear me? I am... aaggh! Can't... contain him.
You cannot kill me, fools! I'll be back, I'll....

21216.text: I cannot allow you to interfere!
They have forced me to this....
I will purge you from this place!
You are no better than they!
You... are the disease... not I...

21238.text: Me mad. You get smash in face!

21257.text: Thank you, $n.  Now, to perform the test...
$n, I have confirmed that this blood is from the Bonechewer clan of orcs, tainted with demonic power.  I'm afraid, however, that my current equipment can delve no deeper into this mystery...

21277.text: Hi.  Thanks for the help.  But please don't open the cage.
Yes, the ogres are so stupid that they forgot to lock my cage.  But that's exactly how I like it, so please don't open it again.
No.  Don't open the cage.  One of them might notice!
Please leave the cage door closed.  Thanks.
Psst, $r, up here near the entrance.  I'm in the cage.  Hurry!

21279.text: Please excuse me while I begin my tests...
If my blood hadn't clotted long ago, it would be boiling with rage right now...

21291.text: Where is the Cipher of Damnation? I know a third of it is in this village.
No... Of course not. What was I thinking? Why would you have a third of the Cipher of Damnation?
I feel so stupid. Maybe I should unchain you and set you free?
DO I HONESTLY LOOK THAT STUPID TO YOU, NAGA? NOW YOU FEEL PAIN!
GET UP YOU ROTTEN PIECE OF TRASH! GET UP BEFORE I END YOU!

21293.text: Hide! Hide before they see you! Back up!
The time to strike is at hand. Terminate Icarius.
You have it. Do not lose it again!

21295.text: Whhaaat... are you sssspeaking of, ssssoft-sskin?
The naga do nottt... have thissss... cipherrr...
Do not beat the Coilsssskaarrr commander anymore, orc! I will tell you! The cipherrr... It is hidden in one of the chests at Coilssskarrr Point... The naga there hold the keysss...

21315.text: The skies will darken and all will go quiet. Only then will you know the sweet serenity of death...
Your world is at an end.

21318.text: I... I have died... I was in so much pain... engulfed in darkness... Can you see me, $r?

21319.text: Puny $r cannot lift spear.  Gor lift spear!
Hah!  The Thunderspike is mine.  Die!

21326.text: The %s appears very grateful to be free of the koi-koi spirit's influence.

21332.text: It is dying! The second part of the Cipher of Damnation is ours. I...
21332.comment: Spirit Hunter to Veneratus the Many

21332.text: I am fading... Return to Ar'tor... Ret... rn... to...
21332.comment: Spirit Hunter to Veneratus the Many

21350.text: %s lets out a massive roar, calling for aid!

21397.text: How fortuitous. I believe this calls for some wine.
A fine vintage in celebration of our salvation!

21400.text: We're saved? We're really saved?! YAHOO!

21409.text: Zarath you must return to the Black Temple at once! I... I seem to have misplaced Lord Illidan's orders. Quickly!
Zarath, I am perfectly capable of making it up this road to Eclipse Point. If we do not deliver the missive, Lord Illidan will have both of our heads! You are dismissed!
Ah, sweet, sweet bloodthistle... Probably left behind by one of those filthy addicts at Eclipse Point.
Their loss is most definitely my gain...
%s puts the bundle of bloodthistle in his robe.
Ah, damn it all! Clever trap. Too bad you'll never live to tell the tale...

21410.text: My lord, surely you do not expect me to leave you unattended. Lord Illidan would have my head if anything were to happen to you.

21411.text: %s cracks the rotten egg open and - to the horror and dismay of all around him - begins to drink from its putrid core.
21411.comment: Tobias the Filth Gorger to Player

21411.text: That was life-changing... Excuse me for one minute.
21411.comment: Tobias the Filth Gorger to Player

21411.text: %s lets loose the most foul belch ever heard or smelled.
21411.comment: Tobias the Filth Gorger to Player
Tobias the Filth Gorger to Player

21469.text: Good, $n, you are under the spell's influence. I must analyze it quickly, then we can talk.

21496.text: Cansis, hold still. I'm going to try to use this crystal.

21502.text: Doom Lord Kazzak will be pleased. You are to increase the pace of your attacks. Destroy the orcish and dwarven strongholds with all haste.
Don't worry about that. I've increased production at the Deathforge. You'll have all the infernals you need to carry out your orders. Don't fail, Jovaan.
Crate? I didn't send you a crate, Jovaan. Don't you have more important things to worry about? Go see to them!

21504.text: Indeed, it is not a request.
Duro will be reinforced!  Ultris was a complete disaster.  I will NOT have that mistake repeated!

We've had too many setbacks along the way: Hellfire Citadel, Fallen Sky Ridge, Firewing Point...  Prince Kael'thas will tolerate no further delays.  I will tolerate nothing other than complete success!
I am returning to Tempest Keep.  See to it that I do not have reason to return!

For the time being, yes.  However, allow my presence to be a motivator.  Prince Kael'thas was displeased with the failure of the crystal experiment on Fallen Sky Ridge.  This is one of the reasons for why we chose the Cenarion druids as the testing grounds for the bomb.

I need not tell you what will happen should the mana bomb down in the courtyard fail to be used on its target soon?  Since moving into the forest, they've become increasingly annoying to our operations: here, at Tuurem and to the south at the Bonechewer Ruins.
I think that we should teach a lesson to both the Horde and the Alliance.  One that they will not soon forget!
See to it that you do, Sharth, or I will personally see to your slow torture and death.
I believe I may recognize them.  Deal with this quickly, Sharth.  Then take the mana bomb and destroy their town!
And just what do you think you are doing?  You dare to interfere with my master's experiment?
Do you like what we've done here?  Perhaps we will drop these crystals from the sky all over Outland.

I grow bored with your attempt to heal the land and quell the energies summoning and driving the colossi mad.  Goliathon, King of the Colossi, Prince Kael'thas and I demand that you defend the crystal!
Rise, young Voldoun.  Do not worry yourself with pleasantries.  I come at the behest of our master, Prince Kael'thas.  He bids me to check on the progress of the mana bomb.

21506.text: Illidan's lapdogs!  You will pay for my imprisonment with your lives!

21514.text: Who dares defile the altar of Gorgrom the Dragon-Eater?
I will crush it and flay it and eat its meat and crack its bones one by one when I am done.

21633.text: Warbringer, that will require the use of all the hold's infernals. It may leave us vulnerable to a counterattack.
It shall be as you say, warbringer. One last question, if I may...

21661.text: You will not escape us so easily!

21685.text: You do not fight alone, $n! Together, we will banish this spawn of hellfire!
We leave, then, Torlok. I have only one request...
The Torn-heart men give their weapons to Earthmender Torlok.
Give these to the heroes that made this possible.
We will set the elements free of your grasp by force!
We will fight when you are ready.
What say the elements, Torlok? I hear only silence.
They are redeemed! Then we have won?

21690.text: WARNING!  WARNING!  AWAY HOSTILE BEINGS!  DO NOT HEAD UP THE RIDGE TO TOSHLEY'S STATION!

21692.text: If you ever do that again, I will break your neck.

21697.text: Why do you aid the Magus? Just think of how many lives could be saved if the portal is never opened, if the resulting wars could be erased....
You have outstayed your welcome, Keeper. Be gone!
If you will not cease this foolish quest, then you will die!
I told you it was a fool's quest!

21698.text: Why do you persist? Surely you can see the futility of it all. It is not too late! You may still leave with your lives...
Keeper! The sands of time have run out for you.
So be it... you have been warned.
You should have left when you had the chance.

21699.text: Release me immediately or face my wrath!
If we truly desire the same thing, Akama, then release me!  If Illidan is to die, it shall be by my hand!
Curse you, Akama!  I am not a pawn in your game... my will is my own.  When I unleash my wrath upon Illidan it will have nothing to do with your foolish scheme!

21700.text: Have no fear, $r.  Just play along.
A mere nuisance, I assure you!  Tell the Master his prisoner will not escape while Akama and his Deathsworn watch over her.
Forgive my harsh methods, but the Betrayer cannot learn of the truth.  My secret must be kept at all costs!
In due time, Maiev.  I've spent years preparing to make my move - I can't afford to put my plans in peril by tipping my hand too soon.
The Heart of Fury... I witnessed its power long ago, when Velen wielded it.  I feel the same power coursing through it right now!
With this crystal's powers, my Deathsworn and I... we'd be unstoppable!  We could destroy Illidan!  We could... replace him as lords of Outland!
But that is not part of the vision I was granted... that is not... how my people will be freed.
Please, $n.  You must take the Heart of Fury somewhere safe... you must take it to A'dal!
Olum... old friend.  It is good to see that you are safe.
Illidan will become suspicious... that much is for certain.  We will deal with it as we always do.
You cannot... be serious, Olum.  Your sacrifice has already been too great.
It appears your mind is set then.  We will guide you to the spirit world with as much kindness as we can.
Farewell, dear friend. We shall meet you in the next world when our duties in this one are fulfilled.
Master!  We've found the traitor who escaped Vashj!  His body lies in front of me... lifeless!

But, sire!  You have misjudged my actions... I do have knowledge of someone close to you who plans to betray you.  It is that dog, Kael'thas!  He has allied with Kil'jaeden and intends to replace you as Lord of Outland!
It will be done, my lord!

21739.text: Farewell, mortals... The earthmender knows what fire feels...
It is now as it should be, shaman. You have done well.

21740.text: Yes... Well enough for the elements that are here, but the cipher is known to another... The spirits of fire are in turmoil... If this force is not stopped, the world where these mortals came from will cease.

21767.text: What $r dare harm those of my flock?

21768.text: Mortals, here?  What is the meaning of this, pathetic Broken!
You'd do well not to toy with me, Akama.  Illidan has given me specific orders to keep a close watch on the Warden.  If I find out you're hiding anything from me, I will crush you with my own hands!

21769.text: What is it that you want from me, shaman?
Do you not have eyes? Did you not see the demons on our very doorstep? I do not have the soldiers to spare!
Pray to your gods, shaman. Perhaps they will come to your aid. The Horde, however, cannot...

21771.text: Wit a reward like dis, how could they refuse, mon?

21773.text: I don't get it! Are ya blind? Can ya not see the demons bangin' on our door? Who am I gonna send out to talk to your shaman friends? Point 'em out!

21788.text: We will never dissipate, mortal... Our fate is tied to Gorefiend...
Pray that the chilling embrace of Teron Gorefiend does not reach out for you...
It is you who have invaded our home. Gorefiend will avenge us!
Gorefiend will have your head, interloper!
We are bound here... eternally. It is the will of Gorefiend.

21789.text: I've rigged a few control consoles down the slope. Get to one quickly and take control of the fel reaver! You'll only have a limited amount of time.

21790.text: I've rigged a few control consoles down the slope. Get to one quickly and take control of the fel reaver! You'll only have a limited amount of time.

21795.text: We will never dissipate, mortal... Our fate is tied to Gorefiend...
Pray that the chilling embrace of Teron Gorefiend does not reach out for you...
It is you who have invaded our home. Gorefiend will avenge us!
Gorefiend will have your head, interloper!
We are bound here... eternally. It is the will of Gorefiend.

21797.text: Your body is mine! Our fates are forever intertwined.

21838.text: Who calls me to this world?  The stars are not yet aligned... my powers fail me!  You will pay for this!
Show me what you're made of, $n!
Kwa! You cannot kill me, I am immortal!
%s becomes enraged as his shield shatters.

21861.text: From the darkest night shall rise again the raven, shall take flight in the shadows, shall reveal the nature of its kind. Prepare yourself for its coming, for the faithful shall be elevated to take flight with the raven, the rest be forgotten to walk upon the ground, clipped wings and shame.
21861.comment: The Voice of the Raven God - The First Prophecy

21861.text: Steel your minds and guard your thoughts. The dark wings will cloud and consume the minds of the weak, a flock of thralls whose feet may never leave the ground.
21861.comment: The Voice of the Raven God - The Second Prophecy

21861.text: The Old blood will flow once again with the coming of the raven, the return of the darkness in the skies. Scarlet night, and the rise of the old.
21861.comment: The Voice of the Raven God - The Third Prophecy

21861.text: The raven was struck down once for flying too high, unready. The eons have prepared the Dark Watcher for its ascent, to draw the dark cloak across the horizon.
21861.comment: The Voice of the Raven God - The Fourth Prophecy

21867.text: Death incarnate has been released upon the world once more! Teron Gorefiend has returned...

21872.text: Waste no time, fool! Use our power to kill those that stand in our way! Destroy Karsius before you are subdued!

21875.text: At last I am liberated. It has been too long since I have tasted true freedom!

21877.text: Your pathetic attempt to escape will be short lived, Gorefiend. Let the $g boy:girl; go and submit! Even with your armor and weapons, you cannot defeat the ancients!
21877.comment: Karsius the Ancient Watcher to Player
Karsius the Ancient Watcher to Player

21925.text: Feel my wrath, $r scum!  You will not get away with this!

21983.text: Yes, he's the second-in-command of the wyrmcult at the Blackwing Coven to the west.

22007.text: Samia, do you know who Kolphis Darkscale is?

22012.text: Lend us the strength of the giants of Shadowmoon, Corok. The master is a just ruler. He will be sure to take care of those that assisted in subduing the dissidents of this world.
Then you become enemies of my lord, Illidan. Enemies of Illidan are destroyed. Are your giants able to withstand an attack from the forces of Eclipse Point?
No... I did not think so...

22016.text: We shall not fail you Sir!

22018.text: Straighten up! I will not have soldiers in my unit looking so undisciplined before Val'zareq.
You will do nothing to dishonor me before Val'zareq.  Is that clear?
You are doing well. Keep it up!

22062.text: It is very kind of you to donate your organs!
Be proud, your brain will be put to good use in one of my abominations.

22083.text: What is the meaning of this, Mor'ghor?
Blathering idiot. You incomprehensibly incompetent buffoon...n
This... whole... operation... HAS BEEN COMPROMISED!
I expect to see this insect's carcass in pieces in my lair within the hour. Fail and you will suffer a fate so much worse than death.

22127.text: It's a good thing I was able to make duplicates of the Felsworn Gas Mask.

22160.text: Me mad. You get smash in face!
Puny $r... you were a... horrible $g king : queen;.
22160.comment: Bloodmaul Taskmaster on death Quest 11000 complete
Bloodmaul Taskmaster on death Quest 11000 complete
Bloodmaul Taskmaster on death Quest 11000 complete

22160.text: $G King : Queen; think... there really is... an Ogri'la?
22160.comment: Bloodmaul Taskmaster on death Quest 11000 complete

22160.text: Me honored... $g king : queen; kill me.
22160.comment: Bloodmaul Taskmaster on death Quest 11000 complete
Bloodmaul Taskmaster on death Quest 11000 complete

22181.text: The %s appears ready to be wrangled.

22252.text: Your bones will break under my boot, $r!
Long live the Dragonmaw! Die you worthless $r!
It put the mutton in the stomach!
Hey... me not feel so good.
You is bad orc... baaad... or... argh!

22273.text: Die, interloper!  Your puny device cannot pierce the dark magics of Hellfire Citadel!

22293.text: %s begins to sputter as its engine malfunctions.

22304.text: Get to work on those crystals!
Move it!  These crystals aren't going to collect themselves.
These crystals will work.  Get them!
At least you didn't screw this batch up.
I can't believe you've actually done something right for once.
You've ruined this batch!  Why must I work with you worthless Gan'arg.

22314.text: I think those weird bird guys were going to eat us.  Gross!
Yay!  We love you!  You saved us!

22315.text: Deathforge Mine will detonate in 3 seconds!

22339.text: The %s flies up through the trees, free of Terokk's corruption.

22357.text: What do you hope to accomplish from this, insect?
I WILL CRUSH YOU LIKE A GNAT!
You are making me angry, mortal!
I will break you in two! Relent, fool!
Flee now while you still have your life!
You will regret this, mortal! Reth'hedron will return... I will have my vengeance!

22366.text: Thank you for allowing me to visit, $n.  You have a very colorful soul, but it's a little brighter than I prefer... or I might have stayed longer!

22373.text: More Minions of Terokk are coming!
The invaders persist! Hold them off!
An Avatar of Terokk!! To arms!
The Avatar of Terokk has been defeated! Death to Terokk! Death to Skettis!

22374.text: Who dares slay one of my Kargath's commanders?  You will pay for this... in flesh!

22377.text: Let us leave this place.  I've had enough of these madmen!
I can find my way from here.  My friend Mekeda will reward you for your kind actions.

22378.text: Speak, filthy refugee!  What was your caravan doing in the Bone Wastes?

22381.text: Incompetent fools!  Auchindoun should've been ours... look at yourselves scrambling like rats!

22384.text: Puny $r... you were a... horrible $g king : queen;.
22384.comment: Bloodmaul Soothsayer on death Quest 11000 complete
Bloodmaul Soothsayer on death Quest 11000 complete

22384.text: $G King : Queen; think... there really is... an Ogri'la?

22424.text: %s squawks and heads toward Veil Shalas. Hurry and follow!
%s pauses briefly before the tree and then heads inside.
%s seems to be looking for something. He wants you to follow.
%s flies to the platform below! You'd better jump if you want to keep up. Hurry!
Free at last from that horrible curse! Thank you! Please send word to Rilak the Redeemed that I am okay. My mission lies in Skettis. Terokk must be defeated!

22431.text: It is time.  The rite of exorcism will now commence...
Prepare yourself.  Do not allow the ritual to be interrupted or we may lose our patient...
Back, foul beings of darkness!  You have no power here!
The Light is my guide... it is my sustenance!
The power of Light compels you!  Back to your pit!
Be cleansed with Light, human!  Let not the demonic corruption overwhelm you.
Back!  I cast you back... corrupter of faith!  Author of pain!  Do not return, or suffer the same fate as you did here today!

22432.text: Keep away. The fool is mine.
Ah!  Cease the incantations, Anchorite!  Cease, or I will show you such pain that your pathetic people have never imagined!
This is fruitless, draenei!  You and your little helper cannot wrest control of this pathetic human.  He is mine!
I see your ancestors, Anchorite!  They writhe and scream in the darkness... they are with us!
I will tear your soul into morsels and slow roast them over demon fire!

22448.text: I am Rexxar, son of the Mok'Nathal, champion of the Horde.
And their torment at your hands is at an end. By my name, I shall put an end to your life.
I could not have achieved this victory without you. We will speak back at Thunderlord Stronghold.

22452.text: You have brought me back too soon! I am weak yet... What is this! Who... It matters not! DIE!

22458.text: Aright, listen up! Form a circle around me and move out!
Aright, $r, just keep us safe from harm while we work. We'll pay you when we return.
The dig site is just north of here.
I think there's somethin' buried here, beneath the sand!
By Brann's brittle bananas! What is it!? It... It looks like a drum.
Have ye gone mad? You expect me to leave behind a drum without first beatin' on it? Not this son of Ironforge! No sir!
Shut yer yaps! I'm gonna bang on this drum and that's that!
IN YOUR FACE! I told you there was somethin' here!
Don't just stand there! Help $g him:her; out!
You've been a tremendous help, $r! Let's get out of here before more of those things show up! I'll let Dwarfowitz know you did the job asked of ya' admirably.

22459.text: Praise the naaru, I'm saved. I will try to make it clear on my own.
I'm hurt, but I can still run. Thank you, stranger.
I'm too weak to fight with you.  Please find my friends.

22464.text: This discovery will surely rock the foundation of modern archaeology.
Yea, great. Can we leave now? This desert is giving me hives.
This reminds me of that one time where you made us search Silithus for evidence of sand gnomes.
Or that time when you told us that you'd discovered the cure for the plague of the 20th century. What is that even? 20th century?

I don't think it can top the one time where he told us that he'd heard that Arthas's "cousin's" skeleton was frozen beneath a glacier in Winterspring. I'll never forgive you for that one, Letoll. I mean honestly... Arthas's cousin?

I dunno. It can't possibly beat the time he tried to convince us that we're all actually a figment of some being's imagination and that they only use us for their own personal amusement. That went over well during dinner with the family.
Say, do you guys hear that?

22465.text: Have you seen my mommy and daddy?
Antelarion, is it safe to play in the forest yet?
I think I came from Eng-land, do you know where that is?
Antelarion says I fell off a big bird, as I fell he caught me... He is so pretty!

22473.text: It's only right that you know the name of the one who will take your life.
Baron Sablemane. It will be on your lips as you gasp your dying breath.
We will speak again, but away from here.
