22820.text: Akama, my friend!  Have you been informed?  I was found out by Vashj's followers.  Our secret is in peril!
Illidan is looking for me.  I am not safe here... none of us are.

Illidan will find me and when he does... he will pry the Ashtongue secret from me - such is the power of the Betrayer!  No... there is only one way.  My usefulness to the cause has come to an end. I must venture into the spirit world!
My decision is final.  I will not be dissuaded.  I have devoted my life to our plan.  To jeopardize it now would betray all who have died for the cause long before me.
I thank you, Akama.  You honor me by allowing me this moment, surrounded by my brothers.  Farewell, friend.  Guide our people well.

22832.text: There are few left in the world who can prepare the Ward of Waking, $N. We are fortunate that I am among them.
%s kneels, filling the vial with water from the moonwell.
%s combines the herbs with the moonwell water to create the Ward of Waking.
The potion is finished. I can only hope Clintar forgives us for interrupting his sojourn in the Emerald Dream.

22834.text: %s snaps up to a kneeling position, but seems as though he's somewhere else.
What are you doing in Ysera's realm, interloper? Leave us, I say! Your kind are not welcome here!
%s gets to his feet, beginning to recognize his surroundings.
You -- you're not one of them! Let's get out of sight before they find us! Hurry!
They're following me, $r! Quickly, tell me why you're here before we're discovered! If they catch up to me, it will mean my death and yours!

22862.text: I've a message for your master, scum!
Pathetic worm... your master's days are over!
Your end is at hand, Illidari!

22864.text: Onward, Scryers!  Show Illidan's lackeys the temper of our steel!

22865.text: You disappoint me, Akama.  I wanted to question the treacherous worm myself!  I'm beginning to question your allegiance, Broken.

I do not sense lies in your voice, Akama.  That Kael'thas would betray me does not come as a big surprise - I'm not as oblivious as some would think. That one of your own was involved with him puts your loyalties into question.

Send your Ashtongue into Tempest Keep and slay his most prized possession, the phoenix known as Al'ar.  I must know that you're not on his side.  Do not think of betraying me, Broken.  We both know who owns your soul!

22871.text: I was the first you know. For me the wheel of death has spun many times. So much time has passed... I have a lot of catching up to do.
You will show the proper respect!

22887.text: You will die in the name of Lady Vashj!
My patience has run out! Die! Die!

22898.text: Supremus punches the ground in anger!
The ground begins to crack open!

22900.text: Commander... I am not long for this world... Taken to a holding pen... hundreds... thousands... beings from other worlds... Imprisoned... Imprisoned by Ethereum. Many of them our allies. Must... Must save the others... It... It's not too late...

22910.text: Argh!  I will shred your soul and grind it to dust!

22911.text: Now me grow bigger and crush you!

22916.text: Lurosa, I am entrusting the Relics of Aviana to $n, who will take them to Morthis Whisperwing. I must return completely to the Emerald Dream now. Do not let $n fail!

22917.text: Come, my minions. Deal with this traitor as he deserves!
Who shall be next to taste my blades?
I will not be touched by rabble such as you!
Stare into the eyes of the Betrayer!
Behold the power... of the demon within!
You've wasted too much time, mortals. Now you shall fall.
Feel the hatred of ten thousand years!
Akama. Your duplicity is hardly surprising. I should have slaughtered you and your malformed brethren long ago.
Boldly said. But I remain... unconvinced.
Is this it, mortals? Is this all the fury you can muster?
Maiev... How is it even possible?
Feel the hatred of ten thousand years!
You have won... Maiev. But the huntress... is nothing without the hunt. You... are nothing... without me.

22924.text: It would've taken years to find the Book of the Raven without you, young sparrowhawk. Return to your home in Nagrand with our gratitude.
This is it! This is really it -- the Book of the Raven!

There's something else here, too. After a description of a bloody battle and the downfall of the raven, there's a prophecy. Anzu will haunt the dreams of his enemies, twisting them to effect a return to this world...

It's all here... how the raven's followers captured and subdued the spirits of rivals, trapping them forever within stone statues! The tablet even mentions the raven god's name -- Anzu. I'd thought it was lost to history!
The tablet has the confirmation we need, just as I thought. Now, we have to use this information to draw out and defeat this Anzu before he can do any more damage to the Emerald Dream!

Since the sparrowhawks have proven such a success in hunting down the raven stones, Watcher Elaira has trained another one to relay my voice at a great distance. He can help us communicate as you investigate the bird spirits revealed in the tablet!

22928.text: I... I am free! Ethereum were planning on torturing me until I gave in to their requests. I fear that, had you not come along, I would have surely given in to their torment.

Know this, $r. Within Shaffar's chambers at the end of these tombs rests a creature of unimaginable power. It is held in check by the power of the stasis chamber. You must return to Ameer before you venture further if you wish to destroy it!

22940.text: Grok need help!  Why no one help?
If no one help, Grok smash!
Grok get angry if puny ones not go to Blade's Edge and talk to Mog'dorg!
Bladespire clan not fight fair.  Have gronn to help dem.  You go to Blade's Edge Mountains.  Talk to Mog'dorg the Wizened.  Kill gronn.
Mog'dorg the Wizened tell Grok go to city, get help for Bloodmaul.  Grok go.

22941.text: All hail, $n, the new $G King : Queen; of the ogres!!!

22947.text: So much for a happy ending.

22948.text: Drink your blood. Eat your flesh.
I'll rip the meat from your bones!

22949.text: I have better things to do...

22950.text: Common... such a crude language. Bandal!

22952.text: You wish to kill me? You first!
You're not cut out for this.

22972.text: %s looks at you for a moment, then motions for you to follow.
%s surveys the ground for buried raven stones.
%s doesn't seem to have had any luck finding raven stones nearby.

22981.text: Come closer, young one. There's nothing to fear from me or $n.
I'm going to train you to help $n with a very important task. After that, I promise you'll be free to return home.
You will hear the call when you are needed. Fly east, to Skettis, and wait there for $N's signal.

22982.text: $n, do you feel the need -- the need for speed?
$n, how's your mount holding up?  Pretty rough up there these days?
Heh, the skies aren't so friendly with $n flying them!
$n, terror of the skies, how are you doing?
Well, if it isn't our resident $g flyboy : flygirl;, $n.  How's it going, ace?

22984.text: You hear a loud rumble of metal grinding on stone...
22984.comment: Black Temple Trigger - when High Warlord Naj'entus dies - Emote

22984.text: The door to The Den of Mortal Delights has opened.
22984.comment: Black Temple Trigger - when Lower Temple Defeated - Emote

22987.text: %s cowers in fear as it realizies what the ogre has in mind.

22989.text: I've waited for this moment for years.  Illidan and his lapdogs will be destroyed!

22990.text: Now is the time, Maiev!  Unleash your wrath!
Slay all who see us!  Word must not get back to Illidan.
Akama has no master.  Not anymore.
Our plans are in danger already.  It appears Maiev's decided to do things her own way.
%s's attention shifts to a crack along the temple's southern wall.
We must carry on with or without Maiev.  Inside!  Quickly!

22992.text: Fool! The essence of the hawk will never be yours!
The time of the Raven is nigh, but yours will end here!

22993.text: You dare to disturb the loyal followers of the Raven?
You will die for your hubris, $c!

22994.text: The falcon is vanquished, doomed never to rise again! Your quest is futile!
The raven will return to us as foretold in the prophecy and you are powerless to stop it!

23002.text: You, there! Hand over that moonstone and nobody gets hurt!
All right, you win! I surrender! Just don't hurt me!
%s takes the Southfury moonstone and escapes into the river. Follow her!

23035.text: Pain will be the price for your insolence! You cannot stop me from claiming the Emerald Dream as my own!
Awaken, my children and assist your master!
Yes... cast your precious little spells, ak-a-ak!
Your magics shall be your undoing... ak-a-ak...
Your powers... ak-ak... turn against you...
Your spells... ke-kaw... are weak magics... easy to turn against you...

23038.text: The elixir... give it to me, Severin!
I see them now... assassins from Skettis!
The arakkoa can send all the assassins they have... they will meet the same fate as these!
Is this... blood in my lungs?  If I don't die to an assassin's blade, it'll be my old injuries that get me.
Do not... bring Terokk into our world, $n...  That would be... madness...
You're one of our bravest, $n.  All of the Skyguard is in your debt.

23042.text: Rest now, Adaris.  You need to recover your strength.
Rest now, friend.  You need your strength.

23054.text: Your monkeys failed to finish the job, naaru. Beaten but alive... The same mistake was not made when we took command of your vessel.
All for what? Trinkets? You are too late. The preparations have already begun. Soon the master will make his return.
And there is nothing you or that fool, Illidan, can do to stop me! You have both served me in your own right - unwittingly.
Lay down your arms and succumb to the might of Kil'jaeden!

23061.text: I know you by your stench, little $n.  Here, in my perch, is where your bones shall finally rest.
I tire of interruptions from the insignificant.  Your time has come, $n!
The Skyguard shall pay for your temerity, $n!
I believe that I shall feast upon both $r and ogre flesh tonight.
Little $r, you will now come to appreciate my wrath!
You have dared to defile my perch and must now be cleansed in fire!
What's this?!  $n and $g his : her; friends come to play?

23083.text: %s goes into a rage after seeing its master fall in battle!

23089.text: This door is all that stands between us and the Betrayer.  Stand aside, friends.
I thank you for your aid, brothers.  Our people will be redeemed!
Be wary, friends. The Betrayer meditates in the court just beyond.
We've come to end your reign, Illidan. My people, and all of Outland, shall be free!
The time has come! The moment is at hand!
I will deal with these mongrels! Strike now, friends! Strike at the Betrayer!
The Light will bless these dismal halls once again.... I swear it.
Let us finish what we've started.  I will lead you to Illidan's abode once you've recovered your strength.

23093.text: So my blood was not a sufficient payment, eh? Fine, let us recover your arcane essence. After this, I owe Balthas nothing.
%s places a fetish at the ritual pile.
The process is arduous. We must first summon forth acolytes of the elements. You must then destroy these acolytes so that my minions can make preparations.
Prepare yourself! The acolyte of water is soon to come...
Now we call forth the arcane acolyte.

23100.text: I require your life essence to maintain my existence in this realm.

23104.text: The bogblossom explodes, spraying pollen wildly.

23139.text: Warriors of Dragonmaw, gather 'round! One among you has attained the rank of highlord! Bow your heads in reverence! Show your respect and allegiance to Highlord $n!
Lord Illidan will be here shortly.
Lord Illidan, this is the Dragonmaw that I, and others, have told you about. He will lead us to victory!
But... My lord, I do not understand. $n... He is the orc that has...
It will be done, my lord.
So you thought to make a fool of Mor'ghor, eh? Before you are delivered to Lord Illidan, you will feel pain that you could not know to exist. I will take pleasure in exacting my own vengeance.
I will not drag this out any further than it needs, Lady Sinestra. You have bent my ear, now tell me what it is that you want from Dragonmaw.
Ye... Yes, yes... Of course. We need only the crystals and ore from this place. There is... We will need mounts.

23141.text: You will not harm the $g boy:girl;, Mor'ghor! Quickly, $n, climb on my back!

23146.text: Who... Who is you?? What you want?
Yes... Yes we move now... Please no hurt us...

23152.text: Pitiful wretches. You dared to assault Illidan's temple? Very well, I shall make it your death bed!
You've sealed your fate, Akama.  The Master will learn of your betrayal!

23153.text: Find what I am looking for and you may have a treat.
I am beginning to suspect you are worthless.  Do not disappoint me further.
Yes, that's it.  These will do nicely.
You've found nothing?  Very well.  Over there next.

23162.text: Furious winds envelop Vakkiz as he writhes menacingly towards you.
%s's flesh shatters in an unearthly rage!

23163.text: %s bares her fangs and hisses menacingly at those around her.

23191.text: Broken of the Ashtongue tribe, your leader speaks!
The Betrayer no longer holds sway over us.  His dark magic over the Ashtongue soul has been destroyed!
Come out from the shadows!  I've returned to lead you against our true enemy!  Shed your chains and raise your weapons against your Illidari masters!
I will not last much longer!

23197.text: Their fury pales before mine, Illidan. We have some unsettled business between us.
My long hunt is finally over. Today, Justice will be done!
There shall be no prison for you this time!
It is finished. You are beaten.
He's right. I feel nothing... I am... nothing.

23208.text: Maybe one day $n will teach us a few of $g his : her; tricks?

23224.text: Yes, unless I have anything to do with it.
I see that happening sometime between tomorrow and the next decade. Definitely.
Looks good for you...and bad for me.
I've consulted my fellow imps, and we think YES, except for that one imp.
The outlook is positive, but I'm still negative.
It pains me to say this, but "Yes".
When dwarves fly! They do? Then yes!
Sure, but you're not going to like it.
Be quiet 'bout what you hear and see around here, $r.
Unfortunately... yes.
I can't see why not, although, I can't see a lot of things right now.
I would bet your soul on it.
Yes, but if anyone asks... It wasn't me who told you.
Didn't you already ask that once? Yes already!
Please... Is Kil'jaeden red?
Yeah, sure. You just keep thinking that.
I suppose.
Definitely.
Jump three times and dance for ten minutes and it will definitely happen!
Word on the peninsula is YES!
Oh, that one's for sure.
Yes, but not in the way you imagine.
Yes, yes, a thousand times, yes already!
Yes, now stop pestering me!
The answer will be a yes if you let me out of here.
It's as sure as the warts on my backside!
The answer is yes in here, I don't see why it would be any different out there.
Three words - "ab - so - lutely"!
Yes, but I hoped I would never have to answer that.
Ask me again later - I'm trying to scratch my nose and it's hard to concentrate.
Why should I answer that?  Do you tell fortunes when people shake YOU?
Yes, it will rain.  That's not what you asked?  Too bad!
I'm sorry, I can only speak Demonic.
Yes!  I mean no!  I mean... which answer gets me out of here?
Yes, No, Maybe so.
It won't matter, you'll be dead by tomorrow.
You should be asking "Is that rogue behind me going to kill me?"
It's times like these that I wish I had a longer cooldown.
%s shrugs. Who knows?
It's like my mother always said: [Demonic] "Razxx khaj jhashxx xashjx."
%s is ignoring you.
Why me?  Why not a goblin, or a gnome...
What happens in the twisting nether, stays in the twisting nether.
Avoid taking unnecessary gambles. Your lucky numbers are two, two and half, and eleven-teen.
Wouldn't you like to know?
Oh, oh, oh!  I can see this one clearly...  Nah, lost it.
This was NOT in my contract!
XRA RAHKI MAZIZRA!
Are you making fun of me?
What kind of imp do you think I am?
Say please.
Want to trade places?
Do you ask this question to everything that's trapped in a ball?
Hey! You try arranging furniture with some jerk shaking your house!
I can make that happen. Just sign below the dotted line...
Reply hazy and slightly damp. Dry thoroughly and try again.
Concentrate (on releasing me from this infernal prison) and try again later.
Please insert 25 silver pieces and try again.
Are you my pal, Danny?
You remember the time you tried to drill that hole in your head?
Oh that's right, don't make any effort to make your own fortune!
Two words - imp-possible!
You need Arcane Intellect, because that answer is obvious!  NO!
Not on your life!
I don't have to be a fortune-telling imp to know the answer to that one - NO!
The odds are 32.33 (repeating of course) percent chance of success.
When Blackrock freezes over!
Hahahaha, you're kidding right?
Inconceivable!
My sources say "no". Before the torture, that is.
That's about as likely as me getting out of this ball.
You picked the wrong time to shake me today, buddy!  Prepare for disappointment.
Not unless you're some kind of super-person.  And don't kid yourself, you're not.
That's about as likely as me getting a date with a succubus.
My fortune telling powers are immeasurable - your chances are though: NO CHANCE
NO - and don't try shaking me again for a better answer!
Yes is my answer...
...NOT!
I'm gonna have to give this one the big N-O.
The outlook is very bad - for YOU that is!  Haha, take it!
Survey says: BZZZT!

23257.text: Look who's here.  It's $n, our top gun.
$n, terror of the skies, how are you doing?
$G Mister : Lady; $n, what an unexpected pleasure, $g sir : ma'am;.
Heh, the skies aren't so friendly with $n flying them!
$n, you and I should race sometime.
$n, how's your mount holding up?  Pretty rough up there these days?
Well one thing's for sure, $n's not a nugget any more!
The list of Skyguard members is long and distinguished.  $n tops that list.

23261.text: I know you by your stench, little $n.  Here, in my perch, is where your bones shall finally rest.
I tire of interruptions from the insignificant.  Your time has come, $n!
The Skyguard shall pay for your temerity, $n!
I believe that I shall feast upon both $r and ogre flesh tonight.
Little $r, you will now come to appreciate my wrath!
You have dared to defile my perch and must now be cleansed in fire!
What's this?!  $n and $g his : her; friends come to play?

I thought you would see it my way...
Overlord Mor'ghor, I presume... A pleasure to finally make your acquaintance.
You have no doubt heard about Nefarian's failures on Azeroth... While he has fallen, the experiments continue. My master... He continues the work that his progeny began.
You were once a chief lieutenant, Mor'ghor. Your work in Grim Batol is not easily forgotten.
Now... We need the eggs that you recover. The Netherwing eggs. They are, after all, a product of the master. We will pay whatever price that you ask.
The master will be most pleased with this news. The Black Dragonflight will provide you all that you ask. You will be allowed to ride upon the backs of our drakes as needed.
I thank you for your graciousness, Mor'ghor. I must now take my leave.

23306.text: You over there!  I must speak with you!

23311.text: AYAYA! One day me have dat booterang...
HEY! No more booterang! Me sorry! Me work!
OOF! Booterang hurted me! Me tink work better den booterang!
OWWWW! Ok, ok, me go back to work!
WHY IT PUT DA BOOTERANG ON DA SKIN?? WHY??

23334.text: Maybe one day $n will teach us a few of $g his : her; tricks?

I don't think yer hearin' me. Nether rays just aren't made for --

I be losin' me patience! Go on: make dem wish dey was never born!
You call on da beast, you gonna get more dan you bargain for!
You had your chance; now it be too late!
I... be waitin' on da udda side....
What could be better than servin' da bear spirit for eternity? Come closer now. Bring your souls to me!
I smell you, strangers. Don't be delayin' your fate. Come to me now. I make your sacrifice quick.

23682.text: It is over, your search is done. Let fate choose now, the righteous one.
Here's my body, fit and pure!  Now, your blackened souls I'll cure!
Harken, cur!  Tis you I spurn!  Now feel... the burn!
Soldiers arise, stand and fight! Bring victory at last to this fallen knight!
This end have I reached before.  What new adventure lies in store?
Your body lies beaten, battered and broken! Let my curse be your own, fate has spoken!

HEY YOU!  DRINK OGRE BREWS!  MAKE YOU BIG AND STRONG!
YOU TRY DA' BEST, NOW TRY DA' REST!  OGRE BREW!!

Matron!  Is that bad man going to eat us?
If my dad were alive, he would put out the fires!
If my mom were alive, she would put out the fires!

23720.text: Thank you! There's no telling what those brutes would've done to me.

23728.text: I look across this base and all I see is fear... Are you gonna be scared when the Lich King's armies are sittin' pretty in Stormwind? Ironforge? NO! You're not. And do you know why? Because you'll be dead, that's why.

So when you're feeling that tinglin' sensation at the base of your spine and you're 'bout ready to wet your pants, embrace it. Let it enrage you. That fear is the only thing that's gonna keep you breathin'.
Am I clear? Do you understand what I'm sayin'? I don't wanna have to send any more coffins or letters home.

23732.text: That hit the shpot! Gimmie anudder one, Coot! *hic*
You're shayin' you wan... you wan... *hic* you wan' me to dansh on dis bar? *hic*

23734.text: That should slow the infection down a little.
I can only hope the treatment will work.
I just don't have the medical supplies I need to properly treat all of you.
Oh my, let me change those bandages!
Don't worry, soldier. Yazmina is going to take care of you.

23768.text: James? James... No, you're not James, but I know who you are...
You're the one who tracked down the brutes who did this to us.
I tried so hard to tell Jim... to tell anyone... who was behind this, but I couldn't find a way...
Thank you for helping us and for helping Jim. If you see him, tell him little Jimmy and I love him and that we're waiting for him.
I don't know when we'll see Daddy again, Jimmy, but I know he loves you and he misses you very much.

23769.text: Mommy, when will we see Daddy again?

23775.text: So eager you are, for my blood to spill. Yet to vanquish me, 'tis my head you must kill!

23778.text: Keep them split from their main force!
Keep firing!  Cut off their reinforcements!

23780.text: Archers at the ready!  Hold your fire!
What fool dares to enter her majesty's dominion unannounced?
Is that all you've come to say?
Send these scumbags back to hell!  Fire at will!

23782.text: Reports from the test on the enemy fleet have come in, sir!
Well... the good news is we forced the reinforcements to turn back.
The plague was not quite... fatal.  However, reports of harmful effects include nausea, loss of equilibrium and severe stomach pain.

23784.text: You couldn't have come at a better time!  Let's get out of here.
Yes, let us leave... but not before we leave our Alliance hosts something to remember us by!
They have limited supplies in this camp.  It would be a real shame if something were to happen to them.
That'll teach you to mess with an apothecary, you motherless Alliance dogs!
Let's high-tail it out of here.
We're in your debt, friend.  Speak to Lysander at Vengeance Landing; he will arrange a suitable reward for you.

23786.text: Me crush puny friend of dragons!

23789.text: Pitiful mortal, Onyxia answers to no one!

23837.text: There is a noise from behind you!

23843.text: I brought you a housewarming gift, Jarl.
Go on, open it. I think you'll like it.
Jarl, you haven't been yourself ever since I arrived. What's going on?
I came out here to visit you, Jarl! And I find you living in an empty cabin in the middle of nowhere, babbling about frogs? You're hopeless!

23861.text: The darkness... the corruption... they came too quickly for anyone to know...
It is too late for us, living one. Take yourself and your friend away from here before you both are... claimed...
Go away, whoever you are! Witch Hill is mine... mine!
The darkness will consume all... all the living...
The manor... someone else... will soon be consumed...
Why have you come here, outsider? You will only find pain! Our fate will be yours...
It is too late for Jarl... its hold is too strong...

Dere be no hidin' from da eagle!
Let me introduce you to me new bruddas: fang and claw!

Fire kill you just as quick!
You too slow! Me too strong!
Lot more going to fall like you.
Mebbe me fall... but da Amani empire... never going to die.

%s absorbs the essence of the eagle spirit!

Are we going to hide in our mountain and let those swill-peddlers have their little shindig without us?!
DAMN RIGHT! We'll show 'em why you don't cross the Dark Iron dwarves!

Your entrails will make a fine necklace.

23991.text: There will be no everlasting life for you!
Your race is a disease upon the world!
I will take pleasure in gutting you!
I will feed you to the dogs!
Your entrails will make a fine necklace.

23995.text: I thought we talked about this, Brogg. You can't stay in this building. Sure, it can house you, but there's no room for anyone else!
Yes, we said you can stay here, but this building is our headquarters! All of our manuals and blueprints are stored here!
I'm inclined to say they made ogres too big! I can see I'm not going to convince you to move now, but don't think this is permanent!

24014.text: You too will serve the Lich King.
There's always room for one more.
Your life for the Lich King!
So eager to die are we?
Hello, little one. Come to play?
I have so many wonders to show you.
There's always room for one more.

24015.text: Your remains will be fed TO the sharks of Daggercap!
The sacrifices NOW bring themselves TO us? Have you NO sense!?
You dare challenge Winterskorn?! I will impale you ON your own puny flag!

24016.text: Drive this scum from the Vrykul homeland!

24018.text: Foolish child, you will not stop what I have set in motion! Now, meet your doom!

24023.text: Give me your souls that I might slay the enemy!
You will not stop my work here!  My husband-king will awaken!
The ritual proceeds too slowly. More sacrifices are needed!
Soon, my love. Soon you will waken and all of Azeroth will know fear!
Awaken, Ymiron, the time of your continued reign is nigh.
Double your efforts! King Ymiron will awaken and then he will ascend!
Sleep no longer, my love. With the might of the Lich King behind you, the world will tremble.
Why is this ritual taking so long? Your master promised that your assistance would speed the process!

24027.text: Hold positions!  Keep vrykul men back!
Don't let vrykul come through!  Kill all!
Some things Gorth has to do himself!
Gorth no care if he die!  Gorth get put back together!

24029.text: Did you really think that by facing me, you have any hope of saving your friends?

24035.text: Please, let me out of here!
The key... you have to find the key!
I think I saw a key on one of those vrykul.
I don't want to be taken down into the catacombs!
I don't want to be sacrificed!
They're performing unholy rites down in the catacombs, and I'm about to be the sacrifice!
Is there no hero to rescue me?
I think I saw a key on one of those Gjalerbron vrykul up top.
Thank you.  I will not forget this!
Avenge my friends who have already been sacrificed!
You have to put a stop to this madness before it's too late!
The vrykul are evil and must be destroyed!

24038.text: $n, my child, come here, I have something to ask of you.

24041.text: Ah, but it is you who intrudes on our master's territory.  He could wipe you out in an instant for that transgression alone!  Arthas does not have much love or patience for his escaped slaves.
But... he has learned of your victory over Stormwind's North Fleet and thinks you have potential.  Potential to see reason and abandon Sylvanas' childish rebellion.
Arthas is prepared to offer you power beyond your imagination.  The puny army you lead here would pale in comparison to the phalanxes at your command if you returned to the Scourge's embrace.

Behold the Vrykul!   A race that has perfected war and destruction to the point of an art form.  Already they've cast their lot with the Lich King!  Their dwellings surround you and their numbers are easily five times yours.
The choice is yours, Anselm.  Return to the Lich King's army and fight alongside them or remain loyal to your so-called queen and suffer their wrath as they drive you from their homelands!
Listen to your men's dying breaths as I drink in their souls!
This will not be the last you hear of me.  I will return to spit on your corpse after Utgarde's armies have descended upon you!

24042.text: $N's concoction is ruined.  A new one must be created from scratch.
The failed concoction spills on the floor and appears to come to life!

24052.text: We don't shoe no mules here. 'Sides, it's strictly expedition business right now.
Not my problem! If yer so antsy to get yerself a house built, do it 'ere in the fort and quit yer whinin'!
Now, if you'd be so kind as to get your ass away from my forge...

24068.text: Ingvar! Your pathetic failure will serve as a warning to all... you are damned! Arise and carry out the master's will!
24068.comment: Annhylde the Caller to Ingvar the Plunderer

24077.text: %s screams in agony as the harpoon is removed.
Not... no... Our people... Wyrmskull... some live...
My injuries are too great. I won't make it... Our citizenry held in cages... ritual...
I'm done for... too much blood lost... Forget about me, tell Keller... People still alive inside...
My family must know... I... for them... always for them...
They left us here impaled as a warning to the others... Several still alive... prisoners of...
Don't let my death go unavenged, stranger... give... them... hell...

24086.text: You have my thanks, hero. If you don't mind, I'd like to stay by your side and exact a little vengeance upon my captors!
Many thanks! Allow me to repay you by killing a few dozen of these beasts!
Thanks, friend. Looking for another to join your group?
I will help you out before I head back to Valgarde. It's the least I could do.

24088.text: You have my thanks, hero. If you don't mind, I'd like to stay by your side and exact a little vengeance upon my captors!
Many thanks! Allow me to repay you by killing a few dozen of these beasts!
Thanks, friend. Looking for another to join your group?
I will help you out before I head back to Valgarde. It's the least I could do.

24089.text: You have my thanks, hero. If you don't mind, I'd like to stay by your side and exact a little vengeance upon my captors!
Many thanks! Allow me to repay you by killing a few dozen of these beasts!
Thanks, friend. Looking for another to join your group?
I will help you out before I head back to Valgarde. It's the least I could do.

24090.text: You have my thanks, hero. If you don't mind, I'd like to stay by your side and exact a little vengeance upon my captors!
Many thanks! Allow me to repay you by killing a few dozen of these beasts!
Thanks, friend. Looking for another to join your group?
I will help you out before I head back to Valgarde. It's the least I could do.

24118.text: We find you unworthy of ascension, Halfdan. Let your soul know oblivion!

24120.text: It was awful... I dreamt I was fighting against my friends.

24123.text: These are all excellent. It's going to be hard to choose just one.
I think I've found the one I'll use. Now I have to begin the task of carving it. I don't think it's going to be easy. I don't even know what a female yeti's mating call sounds like!
I've got most of the basic carving done, but it needs to be tested before I can continue. Are you willing to help me with that, $n?

24126.text: Excellent.  What's the lowdown?  Do we have a bodycount?
Well, spit it out!  What's the bad news?
We are the Royal Apothecary Society!  Inducing belly aches is not part of our job description!
Am I surrounded by amateurs?  I want a full analysis of the new strain by tomorrow morning!  Get on it, Ravien!
We were making progress with our plague in Undercity.  All of a sudden our strains keep failing!
The last ten strains from Undercity... all of them worthless!
I cannot work under these conditions!  We need a viable strain!

24131.text: Hey, Gil, you give my offer any more thought? I'll have plenty of skins and preserved meat to trade for those heavy yeti furs or down your men are working with.
I'll be lookin' forward to it. Guess I'll get to preserving this meat, then. A good quartermaster won't turn down a reliable supply of rations.
Why not? Just think how much better it'll look with the hatchlings to either side --
What? I'm just sayin' that's how we do things in Grizzly Hills.

24139.text: Much as I'd like to do business with you, Jethan, all this stuff is the property of the Alliance expeditionary forces.
Maybe after everything dies down, you and I can make a deal with some of the surplus. I'm sure the troops will give your people plenty of business as they head into the Grizzly Hills.
Y'hear that, Jethan? You're not getting that Steelfeather trophy now that we know she's a mother.

24151.text: What did you do with the people of this village!?
What do you want with me?
Release me, cowards! I'll show you what a dwarf is made of!

24152.text: There's absolutely nothing out of the ordinary about it.
You! Not a word to Grick about this! Do you hear me?

24156.text: The hound appears to pick up a scent from the north and prepares to sprint to its source.
Upon reaching its destination the hound becomes startled by noise up ahead and appears ready to flee.

24161.text: Enemies of the Winterskorn, you will be torn limb from limb!

24162.text: Gunnar, son of Thorvard, has arrived!  Prepare to meet your demise!

24168.text: AGH! Not again with the sprayin'!
The dwarf coughs, sputters, and shivers in the cage.
A low, despairing moan escapes the caged dwarf.
%s shakes the bars of the cage weakly.
%s slumps against the cage bars dejectedly.

24173.text: Are YOU the one who interrupted my dinner? Well, are you?
You're too ugly and scrawny to be a female yeti! And now you're making me mad...

24178.text: %s smells the meat, awakens from his slumber, and roars in anger!
24178.comment: Shatterhorn on aggro line and roar at same time

24191.text: Lord Fordring, you mustn't reveal yourself!
The path of freedom has always been beset with tragedy, sire. We could not risk losing you. The Crusade could not have survived such a blow.

24199.text: %s loses all self control and begins to attack friend and foe alike!

24200.text: Dalronn! See if you can muster the nerve to join my attack!
Pfagh! What sort of necromancer lets death stop him? I knew you were worthless!

24201.text: By all means, don't assess the situation, you halfwit! Just jump into the fray!
Skarvald, you incompetent slug! Return and make yourself useful!

24206.text: A %s appears to defend its dinner.

24211.text: I must return. Good hunting to you.
Blessings of the spirits of the land and air upon you.
You saved me from certain death. I owe you.
We should never have traveled through the Rivenwood. Everyone knows this!
Strange ghosts walk the land. Be careful!
They took us one by one. I'm sure there are other survivors.
I owe you a life debt, stranger.

24216.text: Take me! I am ready to die!
We battle for the glory of Ymiron! We die in the name of the Lich King!
May you die in the Lich King's favor!

24232.text: The boy's death and, in fact, the deaths of all of the knights involved in the redemption of the blade could have been avoided.
Their passing weighs heavily upon my soul.
It should have been me that carried the blade to Northrend. The burden was mine to bear.n
But you are right, Irulon. The price of our freedom will undoubtedly cost thousands more of their lives.
Do you hear me, Arthas? The Argent Crusade comes for you! Your kingdom shall crumble beneath the weight of justice! By the Light!

24238.text: No one speaks of my mother in that manner!
Drive the invaders out!  For Queen Angerboda!
Fight without fear and the Val'kyr will reward you!

24239.text: Da shadow gonna fall on you....
Ya don' kill me yet... ya don' get anudda chance!
Dis a nightmare ya don' wake up from!
Your will belong ta me now!
It not gonna make no difference.
You gonna die worse dan him.
Dis not... da end for me!

24248.text: Shamanism has brought you here... Its scent permeates the air. *The Lich King laughs* I was once a shaman.
No, minion. This one is not ready.
Do you feel it, mortal? Death seeps through me, enveloping all that I touch. With just a snap of my finger your soul will languish in damnation for all eternity.
But... It is not yet your time to serve the Lich King. Yes, a greater destiny awaits you. Power... You must become more powerful before you are to serve me.
Now watch, val'kyr. Observe as I apply pressure. Can you see that it is not yet ripe? Watch as it pops and falls lifeless to the floor.
Persistence or stupidity? It matters not. Let this be a lesson learned, mortal!

24249.text: I sacrifice this human in the name of our dark master!
Take me, val'kyr! I am ready to be judged!

24250.text: The interlopers will be stopped, my lord.
One among us will ascend on this day.
My life for the Dread King!
I should be in Utgarde Keep, battling at Ingvar's side! Instead I am charged to guard little maggots like you.
Why we don't just kill you is beyond my understanding.
Ingvar has plans for you, little one.
Your time in the Ring of Judgment comes soon, maggot.

24251.text: Steady your hand, you fool!  Those are rare components you're spilling on the floor!

24252.text: The foot bone's connected to the... hip bone!  The hip bone's connected to this... other bone!  Hmmmhmmmmhmmm...
It's hard work putting these things together!

24271.text: I've never seen one of you around here.
Stop!! Stop!!! Scrap metal moves itself now?
Right... my bad. Now where was I?
You're right, of course. Carry on.
Work must continue. Double your efforts.
Reinforcements en route. Function must be unabated.
Do you bring word from the creator?

24283.text: Right, that should do it. I think ...hic.

24284.text: The vrykul clutches at his throat as he begins to gag and thrash about.

24314.text: So then we too are cursed?
The gods have forsaken us! We must dispose of it before Ymiron is notified!
Then what are we to do, wife? The others cannot find out. Should they learn of this aberration, we will all be executed.

24315.text: NO! You cannot! I beg of you! It is our child!
I... I will hide it. I will hide it until I find it a home, far away from here...

24316.text: A rune on %s begins to glow brightly!

24321.text: Vrykul, your king implores you to listen!
Even now, in our darkest hour, they mock us!
Where are the titans in our time of greatest need? Our women birth abberations - disfigured runts unable to even stand on their own! Weak and ugly... Useless...
Ymiron has toiled. Long have I sat upon my throne and thought hard of our plight. There is only one answer... one reason...
For who but the titans themselves could bestow such a curse? What could have such power?
And the answer is nothing... For it is the titans that have cursed us!
On this day all Vrykul will shed their old beliefs! We denounce our old gods! All Vrykul will pledge their allegiance to Ymiron! Ymiron will protect our noble race!

And now my first decree upon the Vrykul! All malformed infants born of Vrykul mother and father are to be destroyed upon birth! Our blood must remain pure always! Those found in violation of Ymiron's decree will be taken to Gjalerbron for execution!

24322.text: Show them mercy, my king! They are of our flesh and blood!
All hail our glorious king, Ymiron!
Show the abberations no mercy, Ymiron!
They weaken us! Our strength is dilluted by their very existence! Destroy them all!

24323.text: The king is going to speak!

24327.text: Shall we prepare it for you, my lord?

24328.text: They keep their tools in boxes that look like this. Look for them near the pavilions.
I'm only going to carve the runes I think will give you command over a giant.
I'm omitting the runes for "north" and "west" because I'm not sure how they impact the giant. I'm also including a rune to limit how long you can control it.
There we go, the Rune of Command... hopefully. Not nearly as vicious as its Iron Dwarf cousin, but functional.

24358.text: Suit yourself. At least three of you must assist me if we're to get inside. Follow me....
According to my calculations, if enough of us bang the gong at once the seal on these doors will break and we can enter.

24362.text: They keep their tools in boxes that look like this. Look for them near the pavilions.
I'm only going to carve the runes I think will give you command over a giant.
I'm omitting the runes for "north" and "west" because I'm not sure how they impact the giant. I'm also including a rune to limit how long you can control it.
There we go, the Rune of Command... hopefully. Not nearly as vicious as its Iron Dwarf cousin, but functional.

24371.text: I have fallen! Fear not, brethren! Let nothing keep you from the Stoneforge!

24375.text: I've researched this site extensively and I won't allow any dim-witted treasure hunters to swoop in and steal what belongs in a museum. I'll lead this charge.
In fact, it would be best if you just stay here. You'd only get in my way....

24381.text: Arise from the earth, my brothers!
Our iron masters have a mission for us!
Follow me into the mountains to carry out the plan of the masters!

24397.text: Greetings, kind stranger, and thank you for your selfless act.
These heathens have robbed me of my belongings, but I can offer you this charm I took from my captors.

24398.text: Yeouch! Watch where you throw that stuff!

24403.text: I fear I have nothing but this old chest I discovered here. You're welcome to it.
I hope you find its contents... useful.

24404.text: Oooh! It's about time someone rescued me....
I suppose I should be grateful. Please, take this. I want nothing to remind me of this place.
I took it from one of these trolls as I was captured. Maybe you can find a way to use it against them.
I've had quite enough of this place. Goodbye.

24405.text: Say, I found this charm just before they caught me. Maybe it'll do you some good here....
I hope it helps. These vile beasts simply must be stopped!

24406.text: Woohoo! I'm saved! I thank you, $n.
Oh, my. What IS that smell - oh wait, heh, whoops! Guess my senses will take a little time to get readjusted.
My apologies, friends. Here, now. This should help to cover the expenses involved in my rescue.

24407.text: Well, now. What a pleasant turn of events.
It's most fortunate for you that you rescued me, and not one of these other poor sots.
Please accept this payment, as well as my gratitude, for your trouble.

24408.text: Oh, can it be? I... I'm free of that hideous curse?
Words cannot express my gratitude, $n. Thank you for your kindness.
As you can see, I have but little after these savages got hold of me, but you're welcome to what I have. Come, have a look.
I must go now, before I get myself caught again. If you need anything, I won't be far.

24409.text: Mmmm, flies! Even better now that I can taste them.
Nice to be back among the unliving, thanks to you.
Perhaps I am able to offer something of interest to you? Come, see if there's anything you like.
I must be off now, $n. See you around.

24445.text: Thank you for rescuing me. I simply hate being a yucky frog!
I'm really not supposed to talk to strangers, but you've been so nice to me. Here's a special something I found just before I was kidnapped.
I should go now. Be careful!

24448.text: Do you have any idea how neat it is to hop that far?
Oh well, I was starting to miss my pals anyway - they're not gunna believe this! Oh, here - you can have this, I found it playin' hide and seek.
Let's see if I can still make that sound....

24453.text: Hrmmph. Thanks all the same, but I didn't need any help.
I was working on a cantrip that would counteract my predicament and I was very close to finding a <CROOAAK>... Oh my!
Well, I suppose I do owe you a little something - here, take one of these. I've got lots.
You may want to consider leaving this place. I think being transformed into a frog is one of the better things that can happen to one here.

24455.text: Oh! Back to my beautiful self? How lovely! I thought I would be a frog forever.
It was just terrible. I was all slimy, and I kept licking my eyes!
Thank goodness you came along when you did. Please, take one of these troll boxes to remember me by.
I never want to see this nasty pond again. Thank you, $n. I'll never forget you!

24458.text: I've been saving this just for you, big boy!

24480.text: Now that's what I call froggy-style!
This won't take long, did it?
I promise not to give you warts...
There's just never enough Mojo to go around...
Listen, $n, I know of a little swamp not too far from here....
Feelin' a little froggy, are ya?

24525.text: Ku into me carver, ye ugly croaker!  Ku and show me who dares cross me brethren!
Dis a rankin' set, mon, no scurvy dog gonna kass-kass me buckos an' walk aweh!
Watch nah, ye bogfiddler!  I an' I gunna show ye 'ow a jig meant fe be jigged to!
Yah, me bredren!  Galang now and pass us a grog, just dead men yahso.

24528.text: How much'll it cost me to get my mules shod?
You don't understand! If I'm not ready to go soon, all the good homesteading land will be taken!

24531.text: Yes, darling. You realize you'll be eating dire ram mutton for dinner until the crops are planted...
I'd rather listen to his braying than yours, dear.

24532.text: And I don't want our land to have any of those horrible wolves, or giants, or ugly rams!
I'd sooner butcher that mule of yours! Why did you bring that beast in here, anyway?
Remember, honey, we need to get a plot of land with a nice hot spring.

24534.text: Welcome to Fort Wildervar, brave homesteaders! There's a whole continent out there just waiting to be claimed!
True, Northrend is a hard land, but our people are strong, hardy, and equal to the task!
We will win this land with the sword, and break it with the plow! You are the men and women who will be remembered for taming the wild continent!
But, you will not be alone out there. My men and I have prepared pack mules carrying the supplies you'll need most.
Axes, picks, seed, nails, food, blankets, water... it's all there, waiting for you. I think you'll find my prices quite reasonable, too.
There are more than enough to go around. Should you need other goods, don't hesitate to ask!
Now, my loyal custo... err, friends, go forth and conquer this land for our people!

24537.text: I don't know much about art... but I know what I like!

24539.text: Do not test me, scurvy dog!  I'm trained in the way of the Blood Knights!
I'll pay!  I'll pay!  Eeeek!  Please don't hurt me!

24560.text: Lackeys be damned! I'll finish you myself!
I call that a good start.
I could have sworn there were more of you...
Not really much of a "group" anymore, is it?
One is such a lonely number.

24639.text: Keep quiet, will you?  If anyone catches on, we're both dead.
All right, fellas!  Who ordered the spiced rum?  Was it you, Jackie boy?
It's ok, sweetheart.  This one's on the house.

24642.text: Nothin' finer than enjoying a fine beverage and the company of some fine buckos... hic!
...that scurvy dog had two peg legs, a hook for a left hand, two glass eyes and a wooden nose!
Nothin' finer than enjoying a fine beverage and the company of some fine buckos... hic!
Whatcha lookin' at, ye bilge rat?  Har, har.... just kiddin' with ye, mate!
Nothin' finer than enjoying a fine beverage and the company of some fine buckos... hic!
...that scurvy dog had two peg legs, a hook for a left hand, two glass eyes and a wooden nose!
I 'eard Terry fenced one of 'em pictures for a thousand gold.  Maybe I can get in some of that artwork dealin' too!
I 'eard Terry fenced one of 'em pictures for a thousand gold.  Maybe I can get in some of that artwork dealin' too!
Kiss the gunner's daughter?  Why I haven't ever met the lass...
Whatcha lookin' at, ye bilge rat?  Har, har.... just kiddin' with ye, mate!
Grab a seat and 'ave a drink, mate!  Grab me one while yer at it!
Grab a seat and 'ave a drink, mate!  Grab me one while yer at it!
Nothin' finer than enjoying a fine beverage and the company of some fine buckos... hic!
...that scurvy dog had two peg legs, a hook for a left hand, two glass eyes and a wooden nose!
Kiss the gunner's daughter?  Why I haven't ever met the lass...
Whatcha lookin' at, ye bilge rat?  Har, har.... just kiddin' with ye, mate!
"Yaaaaaaaaaarrr... it's driving me insane!"  Wait... that's not quite how it goes...
I 'eard Terry fenced one of 'em pictures for a thousand gold.  Maybe I can get in some of that artwork dealin' too!
I 'eard Terry fenced one of 'em pictures for a thousand gold.  Maybe I can get in some of that artwork dealin' too!
...so he says "Of course I'm not seeing double!  I've only got one eye!"
Grab a seat and 'ave a drink, mate!  Grab me one while yer at it!
...so he says "Of course I'm not seeing double!  I've only got one eye!"
"Yaaaaaaaaaarrr... it's driving me insane!"  Wait... that's not quite how it goes...
"Yaaaaaaaaaarrr... it's driving me insane!"  Wait... that's not quite how it goes...
What ...hic?!
That's it... no more grog for me!

24664.text: Don't look so smug! I know what you're thinking, but Tempest Keep was merely a setback. Did you honestly believe I would trust the future to some blind, half-night elf mongrel?
Oh no, he was merely an instrument, a stepping stone to a much larger plan! It has all led to this... and this time you will not interfere!
I'll turn your world... upside... down.

24664.comment: Kael'thas Sunstrider to Kael'thas Sunstrider - Gravity lapse Intro 2
Kael'thas Sunstrider to Kael'thas Sunstrider - Power Feedback

24664.text: My demise accomplishes nothing! The master will have you! You will drown in your own blood! The world shall burn! Aaaghh!

24669.text: Interference with the wakening ritual causes the vrykul to die.
The vrykul dies from being awakened improperly.
The incorrect application of the awakening rod causes the dormant vrykul to expire.

24703.text: The Scourge has us surrounded. We can hold the village for awhile, but if we can't defeat them, they will overrun us.
The time has come to act. We must decide how to deal with the Scourge before it consumes us.
I won't sacrifice my warriors for romantic notions of glorious death on the battlefield. What use is fighting for survival if no one survives?
There will be a time for battle, Durm. But first, we must find a way to even the odds. What would you have me do, Aeire?
What is your honor worth, Durm? Your life? Mine? The life of blind old Greatfather Mahan, who raised you from childhood?

Honor is meaningless to a dead man. A warrior may throw himself into battle for honor's sake, but a chieftain is responsible for far more. We will follow Sage Aeire's plan and continue to defend our village.
Aeire, $n has brought your hides. Please, take them before they make me ill.

24706.text: The choice is clear. We must attack. I know the odds are against us, but Taunka do not go quietly to the slaughter.
I'll die with my axes in my hands and drenched in the blood of our foes!

24709.text: The ancestors knew a way to confound an enemy's senses. We could use this knowledge to discover the Scourge's weakness or strike at their commanders. Without their leaders, the Scourge would fall before our warriors.
I'll take those. We can't have the mighty chieftain cowering in fear of a few hides.

24710.text: Right!  Let's try this so-called dire brew...
By Bronzebeard's beard!  What a drink!
$n, this beer... well, it might be the best of Brewfest!
It is a shame Coren's Dire Brew can't quench more thirsting throats!  It's blasphemy, I know, but  I envy those Dark Iron dwarves!
Ho there, and welcome to Brewfest!
Hello, friend! Welcome to the Brewfest Grounds!
Hail, good $c! Welcome to Ironforge's annual Brewfest celebration!

24711.text: Well time's money, and time's wasting!  Let's have that drink...
Wow!  This really greases the steamplugs!
If I were an honest goblin, I'd say this was the best beer of the festival...
Too bad Coren's dead.  If I could buy that brew from him and resell it -- watered down and rebottled under my own label, of course -- I'd be rich!
Hey there, and welcome to Brewfest. Come in and have a drink or three!
What's up, friend? Welcome to the Brewfest Grounds! Now go buy some drinks!
Hey hey, it's another $c! Welcome to my annual Brewfest celebration... now go feast and drink some!

24713.text: Curse that frog!  Yes, I joined the Southsea crew - you want to make something of it, mate?  I'll cut you down here and now!

24717.text: WHOA, WHOA, WHOA! Hold everything, fellas!
Oh dear lords of stone and steel, what... I repeat... WHAT are ya gonna do with that?
The dwarves all burst out in laughter.

24718.text: Man, that will never work. The iron dwarves are never gonna fall for that hunk o' junk!
What do you think you're doing, man? Lebronski does NOT appreciate you dragging your loose metal parts all over his rug.
Far out, man. This bucket of bolts might make it after all...

24719.text: I'm cryin' here! Please, make the funny stop!

24720.text: If only our pappy were alive to see this!

24723.text: No... more, I must have more!!
%s begins to channel from the nearby Fel Crystal. Destroy it!

24730.text: With the power of the horn, I bind you to its wielder's will!

24734.text: Hmm... well, just be careful, he might be sweet on you. I don't trust that sister of his either...
Alright, Becca, just leave them in the garden next to the bush. Watch out for wolves!

24735.text: Ah, thank you! I'll be sure to go get them soon.
Nah, I can handle it. Thanks.
That William is so funny. His face always turns bright red.
I'd better ask before I go herbing this time. I don't want to get attacked by another wolf.
I am sure a noble soldier of the Alliance has better things on his mind. Oh! Elenna found some herbs so I'm going to go pick them up.

24736.text: Oh, these apples are utterly delicious!
My brother simply must try these.

24737.text: What? Why do you want me to do it?
Hi, uh, Becanna, I mean... uh, Elenna found some herbs! Can you go pick them up?
Thanks! If you uh, need any help, just come pick me up... I mean, come get me and I'll help!
%s turns slightly red and walks away.
Thanks, but I'm not very hungry right now.

24738.text: William, I saw a fresh growth of herbs out on the ridge. Go ask Becanna to pick them up.
Come on, Goodie, lets go scout the area.

24739.text: ... and have I told you about the time when I ventured deep into the heart of Blackrock Mountain?
..with a mighty blow, I slew a Murloc, freeing the orb from his cold, slimy hands!
... not to forget that time I ventured deep within the forests of Zul'Aman.
... the burning sands of Silithus scorched my face as we battled wave after wave of Silithid.
... the city was burned, a scorched ruin of what it once was. The armies of the undead rose where the people had once lived.
... did I tell you about the time that I explored the far reaches of Dire Maul?
That was when I slew the Orc with a great slash and took away these spaulders.
I found a mighty axe there, freshly forged upon the fire.
There, I crafted this breastplate with my own hands, toiling for hours upon the forge.
There, deep within the pockets of a Troll was the beautiful gem, which I sold for a handsome price!

24742.text: Yarrrrrrr!  Ye'll never get me spyglass, bilgesucker!
Yarrrrrrr!  Ye'll never get me spyglass, bilgesucker!
Is this how you repay your master, you fleabag?  Arrrrrgghh!!
Is this how you repay your master, you fleabag?  Arrrrrgghh!!

24784.text: There we go, $n! This fat'll do the trick fer sure! And now for some real swabbin'!

24786.text: A Lion Seal has become alerted to your presence and begins bellowing a warning!

24788.text: Sure thing, love.  Put it on Harry's tab, will ya?  He owes me a drink!
Free rum?  Why... that's me favorite kind!
Sweet Neptulon!  That was... one drink... too many!

24790.text: Yarrrr!  If it's me treasure yer lookin' for... yer gonna have to fight for it!

24797.text: The reef cow and her new bull find true love.
24797.comment: Reef Cow to Attracted Reef Bull

24807.text: You're out of your element, Lebronski! Uncalled for! Those iron dwarves won't know what hit 'em! Now why don't you get back to uncovering the mystery of the gigantic turd on your rug and leave the real scientists to their work!

24823.text: Model U-9207 Iron Rune Construct does not appreciate your tone of voice. Commencing total annihilation of your rug, Lebronski.

24825.text: Alert! Alert! Construct senses that enemies have breeched our defenses. Increase pace.
Construct class carrier reporting for duty. Primary function: Overseeing.
There is nothing to see here. Proceed with your mandated duties.
To interfere with construct's function results in termination. Move along.
Construct must not be questioned by iron dwarf servant. Commence deconstruction.
Construct is not authorized to communicate with lesser beings. Being must double their efforts.
Did you lose your wallet? Construct has found wallet with overabundance of currency.

24833.text: Thank you, Mr. Kowalski! You may return to your post to oversee docking!
Well done, all. Please bring us safely to our next port.

24835.text: Bring us into port, please, Mr. Mehran.
Captain Stash! We'll be arriving shortly, sir!

24838.text: Land ho, Mr. Kowalski! Port is in sight, sir!

24844.text: Be still, mortals, and hearken to my words.

24847.text: The sound of thunder roars throughout the cavern.
The work of your brothers in the Storm Peaks has reached a frenzied pace. Soon, Father will be freed.
Your brothers to the north have subjugated the stone behemoths and set them on the path to Ulduar. Soon, the remaining defenses of the Pantheon will be neutralized.
The three fissures opened by the mortals of this region must be silenced. The earth hears and sees what we do and will continue to interfere with our efforts if the way is not closed.
Bury this place! Your master demands it!

24850.text: Aggh!! No longer will I be a slave to Malygos! Challenge me and you will be destroyed!
I am forever in your debt. Once we have triumphed over Kil'jaeden, this entire world will be in your debt as well.
Sathrovarr drives Kalecgos into a crazed rage!

24874.text: Your offering has come too late, little one. Can you feel the mist closing in upon you? The Kvaldir return...
From sundered ground the sacrament was stolen. The Shield of Aesirites is lost. Unrest will be eternal.

24875.text: My brothers have awoken. Your efforts are wasted...n
The anguish of ten-thousand years awaits any foolish enough to don the Ancient Armor of the Kvaldir. Beware the mist and fog, mortals; for with them comes your end.n

24876.text: From the mist and fog the Kvaldir approach. Flee while you still breathe the air of the living...
The Staff of Storm's Fury pilfered. A curse upon this land! The storms will never cease!n

24877.text: Look to the seas, as your doom comes with the swell of tides.n
The Frozen Heart of Isuldof will consume this land until it is returned. Woe unto those that hold the heart as the curse of frozen blood besets them...n

24882.text: Puny lizard! Death is the only answer you'll find here!
That was fun, but I still await a true challenge!
Ah, more lambs to the slaughter!
So much for a real challenge. Die!
Agghh! Well done! Now this gets... interesting...

24891.text: I need... your help! Cannot... resist him much longer!
Agghh!! Help me before I lose my mind!
Hurry! There is not much of me left!
There is no time to waste!

24892.text: There will be no reprieve! My work here is nearly finished!
Haven't you heard? I always win!
I'm never on the... losing... side!

24895.text: Hold, friends! There is information to be had before this devil meets his fate!
Where is Anveena, demon? What has become of Kalec?
You will tell me where they are!
Speak! I grow weary of asking!
Malygos, my lord... I did my... best.

24900.text: Its power courses through me! I AM A GOD!
The fury of the Vrykul will consume you!
ARE YOU CHALLENGING ME? I HAVE THE STRENGTH OF TEN MEN!

24910.text: It may'ave won in life, but it won't be winnin' in the afterlife! FIRE!
Fire! Fire for the booty, me hearties!
Fire! Fire, ya yella sea dogs!

24911.text: Yo-ho-ho, and a bottle of gnomish spirits!
Yo-ho-ho, and a bottle of gnomish spirits!

24960.text: Mine! You shall not take this place!

24966.text: Get away, this place is ours!

24972.text: Core overload detected. System malfunction detected...

24981.text: Deployment successful.  Trespassers will be neutralized.

24992.text: Sorlof's booty falls to the floor.

25032.text: $n, it's very good to see you again!
Everyone look, it's $n!
Dawnblade, demons and naga beware, $n is back.
$G Milord : Milady;, $n, we are fortunate to have you here with us.
The Shattered Sun Offensive is lucky to have $n on our side.
If it weren't for $n, we'd all be long dead.
$n, thank you again for helping us. We couldn't have achieved any of this without you.
$Three cheers for $n!
It's an honor to serve with you, $n.
If I were one of those Dawnblade blood elves, I'd be swimming away from the island now that $n is here.
How many wretched do you think $n has put out of their misery?
Snap to attention, $n, one of our finest, is here!
Welcome back, $n.
There's our $g hero : heroine; right there! How are you doing, $n?
I guarantee that without $n, this whole offensive would have been a failure.
No matter what, your efforts will always be exalted here, $n!
Lay waste to the demons on the Dead Scar lately, $n?
$n, one of these days I want to buy you a drink.
$n, you have no idea what a relief it is to see you!
What a coincidence... we were just talking about you, $n!
Who needs sentries? $n is here!
Hey, $n, try to leave some of the glory for us, would ya?
Do not fight the enemy unprepared, $n.  I can provide you with very powerful items... provided you have proven yourself to us.
I don't even want to think about what'll happen here if $n ever decides not to come back.

25038.text: Glory to Kil'jaeden! Death to all who oppose!
I am stronger than ever before!
No more hesitation! Your fates are written!
Madrigosa deserved a far better fate. You did what had to be done, but this battle is far from over!

25132.text: Shattered Sun scum!  Fire at will!

25144.text: Dragonhawk incoming from the west!  Shoot that $c down!
Keep your eye on the demons.  We're not concerned with killing Scourge today.

25162.text: Attention!
Alright, quiet down. We have a lot to do and very little time to do it in, people.
I've stood with some of you draenei before at Skettis, and others in Shadowmoon Valley. But now we're on Azeroth, and the situation looks grim.
First though, you sin'dorei listen up. I run a tight ship... this isn't going to be like what you're used to with the Scryers. Pull your weight, or get back on the boat!
Now that that's out of the way, welcome to the Isle of Quel'Danas. The Sunwell's on the plateau to the south, and Prince Kael'thas is holed up in the Magisters' Terrace to the east.
We're here as support for the so-called 'adventurers' that the brass has called in. We'll help them hold the key points on the island, and keep the heat off so that they can do their jobs.
If none of you ladies have any questions, you can get further instructions and assignments from your squad leaders. That's it. Good luck!
Attention!
Welcome to the Sunwell. Despite the mild temperatures and scenic vistas, you're not on vacation, ladies and gentlemen!
The current situation looks like this: we're holding what we can while those with more experience and better equipment are moving against Prince Kael'thas.
I know, we thought he was dead too, but that's not the case. He's trying to use the Sunwell to bring the master of the Burning Legion, Kil'Jaeden, into this world.
Let me assure you people that if he's successful, this world will suffer far worse than Outland ever did! So, let's make sure that doesn't come to pass.
Warriors will be deployed to hold key positions, while you marksmen will be assigned to keep the enemy fliers at bay.
I'm awaiting orders on your specific assignments. In the meantime, stay here and be ready to move at a moment's notice!
Attention!
Hello to you new recruits. I'm Drill Sergeant Bahduum. For the next few days, you're going to receive orientation.
The Isle of Quel'Danas has been overrun by the forces of Prince Kael'thas Sunstrider. Intel had him pegged as deceased. Intel was wrong.
Up on the plateau, he and his demon friends are trying to reignite the Sunwell and open a rift to bring their head-honcho, Kil'Jaeden, back into the world.
Our job is to clear out as much of his fodder as we can, while supporting the specialists that the powers-that-be are having brought in.
Needless to say, a lot of us won't be going home. But if you remember your training and keep your wits about you, you'll greatly increase your chances.
That's all I have to say for now. Stay focused, boys and girls.

25165.text: Shadow to the aid of fire!
Alythess! Your fire burns within me!
Time is a luxury you no longer possess!

25166.text: Fire to the aid of shadow!
Your luck has run its course!

25167.text: Why do you suffer the presence of this despicable Lady Liadrin? She and her followers distort the Light and make a mockery of all we stand for!

25197.text: There, $n, now you will be able to speak with, and understand, the Winterfin murlocs.

25208.text: Together we will fight our way out of here. Are you ready?
This is far enough. I can make it on my own from here.
Thank you for rescuing me, $r. Please tell the king that I am back.
If only there were someone nearby who would help me escape.
You can't hold me against my will! You've all been brainwashed!
Living in these caverns and following that mad lobstrok, Clacker, is unnatural! Let me free!

25209.text: What tiny morsel comes this way? Not one of the murloc I think.
It's been a long time since last I tasted $r.
What's this? You're not one of the Winterfin!
Did 'King Mrgl-Mrgl' send you? I know what he truly is!
You're not one of mine. King Mrgl-Mrgl must have sent you to talk terms of surrender. Come closer so that I might see you better.

25210.text: I am the Keymaster. Are you the Gatekeeper?

25211.text: Psst... $r, over here! Next to the dead whale.

Civilian Recruit to Generic Quest Trigger - LAB
Civilian Recruit to Generic Quest Trigger - LAB
Civilian Recruit to Generic Quest Trigger - LAB
Civilian Recruit to Generic Quest Trigger - LAB
Civilian Recruit to Generic Quest Trigger - LAB
Civilian Recruit to Generic Quest Trigger - LAB

25222.text: What did you do before you came to Northrend, then?
25222.comment: Recruitment Officer Carven to Generic Quest Trigger - LAB
Recruitment Officer Carven to Generic Quest Trigger - LAB

25222.text: Yes, then.  What is your trade?
25222.comment: Recruitment Officer Carven to Generic Quest Trigger - LAB

25222.text: Your previous line of work, recruit?
25222.comment: Recruitment Officer Carven to Generic Quest Trigger - LAB
Recruitment Officer Carven to Generic Quest Trigger - LAB

25222.text: Yes, you're well seasoned in your field of work.  Report to the civilian liaison at once, we need more like you!
25222.comment: Recruitment Officer Carven to Generic Quest Trigger - LAB

25222.text: I thought we had enough in your line of work, but it looks like we have some openings.  Report to the civilian liaison.
25222.comment: Recruitment Officer Carven to Generic Quest Trigger - LAB

25222.text: I do have some openings in your line of work.  Report to the civilian liaison.
25222.comment: Recruitment Officer Carven to Generic Quest Trigger - LAB

25222.text: Yeah.  We could use some more of you.  Report to the civilian liaison for work assignment.
25222.comment: Recruitment Officer Carven to Generic Quest Trigger - LAB

25222.text: Not anymore!  Here's your sword.  Report to the barracks for duty!
25222.comment: Recruitment Officer Carven to Generic Quest Trigger - LAB

25222.text: Afraid not, friend.  Here's your sword and shield.  Report to the barracks for duty.
25222.comment: Recruitment Officer Carven to Generic Quest Trigger - LAB

25222.text: You're breaking my heart - I've quotas to fill, you know?  Can you wield a sword?  Off to the barracks.
25222.comment: Recruitment Officer Carven to Generic Quest Trigger - LAB

25222.text: With a sword arm like that?  I'm afraid we need you in the front lines, my friend.  Report to the barracks.
25222.comment: Recruitment Officer Carven to Generic Quest Trigger - LAB

25222.text: Looks like we have room for one more... no, my mistake.  That's a seven not a one.  Hope you're good with a sword - report to the barracks.
25222.comment: Recruitment Officer Carven to Generic Quest Trigger - LAB
Recruitment Officer Carven to Generic Quest Trigger - LAB
Recruitment Officer Carven to Generic Quest Trigger - LAB
Recruitment Officer Carven to Generic Quest Trigger - LAB

25237.text: Shipping lanes... supplies... You bore me to death! We need nothing more than the warrior spirit of the Horde, Saurfang! Now that we are firmly entrenched in this frozen wasteland, nothing shall stop us!
Propose? I will show you what I propose!
There... Now we now have a shipping lane.
Do not speak to me of consequences, old one.
But surely you cannot think that those children were born into innocence? They would have grown up and taken arms against us!
How have you managed to survive for so long, Saurfang? Not fallen victim to your own memories?

25242.text: $g Sir:Ma'am;, my life for the Horde!
It is an honor to serve along your side, $g sir:ma'am;.
With your strength and determination, we cannot fail!

25243.text: $g Sir:Ma'am;, my life for the Horde!
It is an honor to serve along your side, $g sir:ma'am;.
With your strength and determination, we cannot fail!

25244.text: Captain... Nerub'ar flyers! Hundreds of 'em! Coming... Coming from the south! Over our defenses!

25245.text: You lads know the drill.  No alcohol to servicemen on duty.  You want the general to kill me himself?
All right, all right... but you didn't get these from me!

25248.text: I suppose this is it, then?  I won't go down quietly!

25250.text: Ugh!  My head won't stop spinning...
Your offer will be carefully considered, harbinger.  In the meantime we will make use of your delegation in an advisory role.

25251.text: I thought... I thought you were... dead.
Don't leave me again!  You want to fight for your country, but they don't even want you!  They sent you here to die!
I know that look in your eye... I'm not going to be able to talk you out of this.  If you die on me again...

25256.text: We are surrounded... Our enemies press in from all sides, young Hellscream.
The Scourge descends like locust from the north.
The Alliance holds the only secure shipping lane in this region, and even that is at risk of being lost to those dreaded mists.
Our only viable port for resupply is held by the Forsaken on the other side of this blasted continent!
Anything our zeppelins cannot haul must be brought in by ship and travel the length of Northrend to reach us.
Siege engines, ammunition, heavy armor... How do you propose to shatter the walls of Icecrown without those?
So the prodigal son has spoken!
Your father's blood runs strong in you, Hellscream. Impatient as always... Impatient and reckless.
You rush headlong into all-out war without a thought of the consequences.
I drank of the same blood your father did, Garrosh. Mannoroth's cursed venom pumped through my veins as well.
I drove my weapons into the bodies and minds of my enemies.
And while Grom died a glorious death - freeing us all from the blood curse - he could not wipe away the terrible memory of our past.
His act could not erase the horrors we committed.
%s pauses.
The winter after the curse was lifted, hundreds of veteran orcs like me were lost to despair.
Our minds were finally free, yes... Free to relive all of the unthinkable acts that we had performed under the Legions' influence.
%s nods.
I think it was the sounds of the draenei children that unnerved most of them... You never forget...

Have you ever been to Jaggedswine Farm? When the swine are of age for the slaughter... It's that sound. The sound of the swine being killed... It resonates the loudest. Those are hard times for us older veterans.
%s shakes his head.
I am not speaking solely of the children of our enemies...
%s pauses.
I won't let you take us down that dark path again, young Hellscream. I'll kill you myself before that day comes...
I don't eat pork...
%s spits.

25258.text: One last drink before we head to the front?
Barkeep!  Bring out your strongest ale.  We're off to the front.
You'll surely make an exception for us, eh?  We might not come back.
I guess that's it then.  Off we go.

25261.text: That was the worst beer I've ever had.

25270.text: Huh? Where me at? Dis don't look good! Me run now!
Mister Mortuus gonna be so mad! Me go home now.
Why it keep telling me to put da lotion in da basket? Me no like da lotion!

25274.text: Those weapons ain't gonna build themselves! Faster!
You call that a hammer strike? What kind of amateurs am I workin' with here?
You keep that garbage up and I'll ship you back to your momma in a box with a note strapped to your chest that reads: FAILURE.
And WHAT are our soldiers supposed to do with that shoddy piece of junk?
You're an embarassment to this entire operation! Pack up your stuff and get out!

25285.text: Give the word, general.  I will have two regiments at your disposal in a month's time.
Very well, general.  Should you change your mind, my people will be more than willing to provide military assistance.

25294.text: The %s directs the blinding swarm directly in front of it.

25301.text: Our troops, general, consist mostly of villagers and peasants.  Good men, but not quite rid of the prejudices and superstitions of their upbringing.  They're not ready to fight alongside our more exotic allies.

25315.text: The expendable have perished. So be it! Now I shall succeed where Sargeras could not! I will bleed this wretched world and secure my place as the true master of the Burning Legion! The end has come! Let the unravelling of this world commence!
I will not be denied! This world shall fall!
Do not harbor false hope! You cannot win!
Aggghh! The powers of the Sunwell... turn... against me! What have you done? What have you done???
Kil'jaeden begins to channel dark energy.

25317.text: What's the matter, $c?  Think you're too good to stand in line with the rest of us?
This is harder than it looks.
I think I'm starting to get the hang of this.
You aren't going to let me sleep are you?
Are you going to be doing this for much longer?
Could you try to be a little quieter?
I just don't want to let anyone down.
I need to do something to keep myself busy.

25318.text: Thank you, $r. I shall not forget your kindness.
Thank you, $r. Without your help I would have become one of them!

25319.text: Strike now heroes, while he is weakened! Vanquish the Deceiver!
I will channel my powers into the orbs! Be ready!
I have empowered another orb! Use it quickly!
Another orb is ready! Make haste!
I have channeled all I can! The power is in your hands!
Anveena, you must awaken! This world needs you!
You must let go! You must become what you were always meant to be! The time is now Anveena!
Anveena I love you! Focus on my voice! Come back for me now! Only you can cleanse the Sunwell!
Yes Anveena! Let fate embrace you now!
Goodbye Anveena, my love. Few will remember your name, yet this day you changed the course of destiny. What was once corrupt, is now pure. Heroes, do not let her sacrifice be in vain.
You are not alone! The blue dragonflight shall help you vanquish the Deceiver!

25320.text: Thank you, $r. I shall not forget your kindness.
Thank you, $r. Without your help I would have become one of them!

25321.text: Thank you for freeing me! May the tides always favor you.
You have my gratitude, $c. I thought I'd never be free.
Do not allow Kaskala to forget what has happened here.

25322.text: Thank you, $c. May the winds and seas always deliver you safely.
The people of Kaskala are in your debt, $c.
May the ancestors always aid you, $c, as you have aided me.

25326.text: You peons work harder or I will come over there and beat you!
This outpost is not ready! What would happen if Malygos and the blue dragonflight decided to strike?
Work faster! We must push into Sholazar Basin before the Alliance!
You peons are falling behind. Half rations until you pick up the pace!
This is the most pathetic bunch of peons I've ever seen! Where's my booterang?
I swear that if you do not work faster I'm going to feed you to my worg!
Have you grunts no pride? You will have this outpost ready for the reinforcements from Warsong Hold or your worthless corpses will fill the graveyard!
Time for a five-minute break. Haha, just kidding! What do you think this is, the Alliance?!

25335.text: $n is going to join us on our assault. Let us bring peace to my ancestors!
An ambush. Return them to their rest!
Regain your strength. The place where Steeljaw was felled is just ahead.
There's the dog's banner and there's his corpse. What's that? He's upon us!
You fought well. Now go north to your orc outpost and inform Overlord Bor'gorok of our success!

25339.text: Oh no... they've shackled his spirit!

25372.text: Enemies spotted! Attack while I try to activate a Protector!

25379.text: Try to not lose this one, $n. It is important that we at least try and keep up appearances with the Alliance.
Look at 'em, Ug. You know what those are?
No, blood of my blood, they are soldiers of the Alliance. Our sworn enemies.
They are here because they do not wish to defend their homes... their families...
They have given up and surrendered - willingly - to us.
Ug'thor, they are afraid to die.
That's right, Ug. Victory or death!
[In Broken Common] Hear boy, cowards? Boy die! Boy die for freedom!

25380.text: And remember, $n, the bloodspore powder can be used to weaken all magnataur in Gammoth.

25381.text: How positively awful! You were totally incapacitated? Weak? Hot flashes?

25396.text: You should not have come here!
You'll be joining the other guests now....

25414.text: My axe is yours, hero! Together we will destroy these insects!
I must return to Warsong Hold. Battle hard, hero!
I must return to Warsong Hold, hero. May you swim in the blood of our enemies and feast upon their sorrow!

25416.text: I will turn your bones to ash!
There is no escape from my rise!
Tell Imperean that I will consider a cessation of hostilities. But first, Churn must stop his watery intrusions upon my rise!
I grow bored with you. Begone!

25418.text: I... submit. As long as Simmer agrees to stop boiling my pool, I agree to an armistice.
Now, remove yourself from my presence. You would be wise not to come within sight of me again.
I will crush you under the weight of my waves!
You dare come into my pool?!
Your death will not be pleasant!
Your corpse will feed my fish.

25420.text: By the fury of the Sunwell, I am released!
Vengeance shall be mine! For Quel'thalas! For the sin'dorei!
Farewell, friend. I must return to Warsong Hold.
Until we meet again, hero. Duty calls!

25421.text: Rescued! You have my thanks and my aid, friend.
