We will battle together to rid this quarry of the Scourge!
Spirits watch over you, friend. I must make my return to Warsong Hold.
Ancestors be with you, hero. Farewell!

25426.text: No, popo. They look kind of like the pigs. Are they pigs?
But popo, what are they afraid of? Why are they here?
%s puffs out his chest and stands on his tip-toes.

25446.text: Marksmen! Front and center! Scourge attack incoming!
The Nerub'ar have been punished for their transgression!
Let the forces of the Lich King gaze upon the carcass of this wretch and know that the Horde will not relent!
Gather, soldiers! Gather and take your trophies from the carapace of the enemy!
We'll be ready for 'em... You did a good job in warning us.

25453.text: I will take great pleasure in tearing the forces of the Horde apart... limb from limb and piece by piece...

25465.text: You only delay the inevitable! The dread citadel rises in the east as the armies of the dead march from the heart of Icecrown!

25475.text: What am I supposed to do without tools, Gorge!
Can't fix somethin' as complicated as a tank without the proper equipment, buddy!
Have you heard anything from Warsong? We gonna be gettin' some supplies soon?
I wanna go home... Take off this uniform and leave the Horde!

25478.text: Pathetic fool! A servant of Malygos would sooner die than aid an enemy....
Aargh! Do your worst, $c! I'll tell you NOTHING!
Aahhhh! Release me! I am of no use to you. I swear it!
Stop! I beg you, please stop. Please....
Alright! I am beaten. Your precious archmage is held in a prison, elevated and sealed. Even if you manage to reach her, Salrand herself holds the key. Your mission is folly!
Enough! I've told you all that I know. Your continued abuse is senseless!
Noooo! This torture is inhumane! You have what you want... why don't you just kill me?
I've given you the information, $r! You're wasting your time....
What more can you possibly want, $r?
How can you possibly bring me lower?
What more can you take away from me?
You've got a darkness in you, $r.
You aren't even asking me questions...
Are you trying to meet the real me?
You have shown me the face of true evil, $n.

25496.text: The subjugation of these people has only just begun... so much time for fun and games.

25504.text: Thank you for doing this, $r. I... I think I know how to get back to my father. Please don't let the bad things hurt me.
I can feel my father's aura. He's definitely this way... come on, $n.
I see a break in the mist up ahead. We're getting closer!
The mist is death... senseless, without compassion.
Everyone is dead... Everyone and everything...
How will we overcome the mist?
I thought for sure that I would die like all the others!
What was that! Did you see that?
Have you heard of the taunka? They are supposedly related to tauren in some way. Can you imagine such a thing?

25507.text: Local proximity threat detected. Exiting energy conservation mode.
Unit is now operational and attacking targets.

25510.text: The Serpent's Maw is engulfed in tuskarr fire!

25511.text: The Kur Drakkar is engulfed in tuskarr fire!

25512.text: Bor's Hammer is engulfed in tuskarr fire!

25513.text: Bor's Anvil is engulfed in tuskarr fire!

25514.text: Frozen and destroyed. This is all your fleshy corpse is good for.
You are not welcome here. Die!
Your presence unbalances the land. You must be removed!

25521.text: Send in the next pair of prisoners, let them fight to see who lives!
You may have survived for our amusement, but now, you shall die at our hands!

25522.text: I shall draw your soul into the mist!
I will heave your carcass into the ocean myself!
You're not even fit to be fed to Leviroth.
You've strayed too far from your comfortable soil, $r.

25584.text: What is the meaning of this disturbance?!
25584.comment: Inquisitor Salrand to Beryl Point InvisMan

25584.text: Who dares interrupt my work!? Show yourself, coward!
25584.comment: Inquisitor Salrand to Beryl Point InvisMan

25584.text: I've destroyed the key! Your cherished archmage belongs to Malygos!

25589.text: Um, hello? Is there anyone out there?
Hey, you! Yes, you! I can hear you! Get over here and get me outa here!
I'm beginning to think that they all forgot about me!
A gnome tries to make some friends, and then BAMM... the next thing you know, he's in shackles!
I'm right here. I know you can hear me. Ya think you could let me out of these chains?
I'll make you a deal: if you get me out of here alive, you'll get a reward larger than you can imagine!
Hey! Over here in Magmothregar's pit!
What? You think I want to be Magmothregar's next appetizer? Get me outa here!
Right then, no time to waste. Let's get outa here!
Here we go.
I think it's up this way to the left.  Let's go!
Ah, fresh air! I can get myself back to the airstrip from here. Be sure to tell Fizzcrank I'm back and safe. Thanks so much, $n!
Filthy creature!
I came here to talk, but you mindless things tried to kill me instead!
You won't put me in chains again!
I AM NOT AN APPETIZER!
The only good vermen is a dead vermen!
Enough fighting! Let's finish this and get outa here!
Hey! I'm walking here!
I can't believe my own people forgot about me. Die!

25602.text: Now, $n, let us release their souls and hear what they have to say.

25608.text: All my plans have led to this!
Stay on task, do not waste time!
Fail me and suffer for eternity!
Drain the girl! Drain her power until there is nothing but a vacant shell!

25610.text: Don't let them turn me into one of those aberrations!
Should I ever escape this prison...
Freedom at last! I must return to Warsong Hold at once!
I am forever indebted to you, friend.

25618.text: Is this it? Is this all the mighty Horde could muster?
I've never understood your type. The hero...
Why won't you just let go? Why do you fight the inevitable?
The Lich King cannot be stopped. Accept it.
This world is coming to an end. Let. It. Burn.
Take $g him:her; away and prepare $g him:her; for reanimation.
You? A lone orc? Against me and...
I will reanimate them all as servants of the Lich King! Bring them here...

25629.text: Foolish elemental slave! You and your master will pay for your meddling!
Feebleminded tinkerer, do you really think your pathetic creation can stop me?

25639.text: Your wounds are severe, but you will live.
Rest now, you have fought well today.

25678.comment: Part of the Doctor Razorgin on aggro lines
Part of the Doctor Razorgin on aggro lines
Part of the Doctor Razorgin on aggro lines
Part of the Doctor Razorgin on aggro lines
Part of the Doctor Razorgin ooc lines

25678.text: It's no good... you need more work first.
25678.comment: Part of the Doctor Razorgin ooc lines
Part of the Doctor Razorgin ooc lines

25697.text: Ahune, your strength grows no more!
Your frozen reign will not come to pass!

25729.text: This is it, $n. The start of the end of the world. And you're here to see it off...
I... I can't believe it... Saurfang... I... I am honored... honored to have fought along side you, sir.
You should return to Warsong Hold now, friend. Hellscream will surely want to hear of what just happened here... of Saurfang...

25751.text: I'll rip your shriveled heart out with my bare hands before any harm comes to $n, necromancer.
This world that you seek to destroy is our home.
We will fight you with every fiber of our being - until we are nothing more than dust and debris. We will fight until the end.
A fool who is about to end you, necrolord. There will be nothing left of you for the Lich King to reanimate!
%s's eyes glow red for a brief moment.
Is that the best you can do?
You'll make no mention of me. Either of you!

25753.text: Attention all units, $r inside the perimeter.
You have been detected. You will be assimilated or eliminated.
Warning! Warning! Intruder alert! Intruder alert!

25758.text: Incoming $r flier! Shoot $g him : her; down!

25759.text: Thank you, $r. I will take this miserable cur from you now.

25773.text: I'm flesh and blood again! Thank you, $c!
Thank you so much! I thought I'd never wake up from that nightmare!
Oh no, not the transmatter... it'll probably malfunction!
Where am I? Who are you? What's that strange feeling?
Mechazod is insane! You have to stop him before it's too late!
It was horrible! They've all been changed!
He called it the Curse of the Flesh. Mechazod is deranged!

25783.text: I'm flesh and blood again. That's all that matters!

25784.text: I thank you, friend of Dalaran.
We mustn't tarry here... stay close - I'll take us somewhere safe.

25801.text: Your impetuousness will be your end!
You dare challenge Nedar, lord of the tundra!?

25802.text: You challenge Kaw, destroyer of mammoths!? Then face me and feel my thunder!

25804.text: You seek to deafen me? Pathetic... Wait... What's that sound?

25806.text: I'm sure ol' Hemet can do something with your bones!
Just fifty more hooves and I'll have the new gun!
No way! Rhino head helmet for the low, low price of thirty rhino heads? I'll take two at those prices!
I wonder what Nesingwary will give me for your hide!
Nesingwary is going to go broke if he keeps this up! Lane probably has no idea what he's doing!

25807.text: Are you crazy? You're about to blow us sky high! I'll take care of this wreck once everything else is finished.

25808.text: Do you think us fools! You're covered in animal blood!
Calf killer! Murderer! You will pay for this!

25809.text: Do you think us fools! You're covered in animal blood!
Calf killer! Murderer! You will pay for this!

25810.text: Do you think us fools! You're covered in animal blood!
Calf killer! Murderer! You will pay for this!

25811.text: Do you think us fools! You're covered in animal blood!
Calf killer! Murderer! You will pay for this!

25812.text: Do you think us fools! You're covered in animal blood!
Calf killer! Murderer! You will pay for this!

25814.text: We are Mechagnome... resistance is futile.
You are cursed and we are the cure.
The flesh is weak. We will make you better, stronger... faster.
We can decurse you, we have the technology.
The Gearmaster has plans for your weak flesh.
Today, the Borean Tundra. Tomorrow, the world!
Come be perfect with us, $g brother : sister;.

25819.text: Do you think us fools! You're covered in animal blood!
Calf killer! Murderer! You will pay for this!

25827.text: You don't know who you're messing with, $c!  Death beckons!

25828.text: Finally!  This charade is over... Arthas give me strength!

25832.text: I am the herald of Mechazod. You will be decursed!

25833.text: Your meddling is at an end. Mechazod will relieve your curse once I am done with you.

25834.text: You were looking for me, child? Why do you come to kill me, $n? I only wish to help.
Now that I have been reassembled, we can return to a time of perfection... the time of the Titans!
But, I can see it in your eyes, hear it in your pulse rate. You would destroy me despite my offer of immortality!
Very well. It saddens me that it has come to this. I look upon all of you as if you were my children. I will slay you if I must!

25835.text: It's a miracle! The beast skinned itself!
This is the last one that I need for the set of Nesingwary steak knives!

25836.text: Clam skin dress shirt here I come!
The clam has given up the goods!

25838.text: Do you think us fools! You're covered in animal blood!
Calf killer! Murderer! You will pay for this!

25849.text: It's really going to work this time... right?
It works, Dorain! Look! It actually works...
I give up! So much for goblin ingenuity!

25863.text: You are not allowed to interfere!

25885.text: Hey, harbinger, how's that research coming along? There might be an Ultra-Kinetic Waffle Iron in it for you if you're prompt with the results!
Be the first on your block to own the incredible Electrostatic Maculation Blaster!
Derived from cutting edge Shattered Sun Offensive military technology, it blasts away stubborn stains with ease!
Wine stains, grass stains, even pet stains are no match for the Electrostatic Maculation Blaster!
Don't wait! Order now and receive my Ultra-Kinetic Waffle Iron at no additional charge!

25949.text: These stones should be the last of them. Our coordination with Neptulon's forces will be impeccable.
And your own preparations? Will the Frost Lord have a path to the portal?

The ritual in Coilfang will bring Ahune through once he is fully prepared, and the resulting clash between Firelord and Frostlord will rend the foundations of this world. Our ultimate goals are in reach at last....

25951.text: Yess. The Tidehunter will be pleased at this development. The Firelord's hold will weaken.
Skar'this has informed us well. We have worked our way into the slave pens and await your cryomancerss.

25979.text: I'm sure ol' Hemet can do something with your bones!
Just fifty more hooves and I'll have the new gun!
No way! Rhino head helmet for the low, low price of thirty rhino heads? I'll take two at those prices!
I wonder what Nesingwary will give me for your hide!
Nesingwary is going to go broke if he keeps this up! Lane probably has no idea what he's doing!

25983.text: Fezzix, I think we've solved your little engine problem.

25986.text: The Ore Cart squeaks against the rails as it is released.

26045.text: You will not master me, puny $r!

26046.text: I serve only the master now.
But I'm... lost. I cannot find my way back.
The nightmare is over! The spell is broken! Goodbye Kalec, my love!

26076.text: What is the meaning of this?! I have not yet finished my feast!

26097.text: Thank you for saving us. We accidentally uncovered the pieces of Gearmaster Mechazod and reassembled him.
In return, he 'de-cursed' us, saying that we were being 'fixed' by returning us to the state of being mechanical constructs.
He claims that all creations of the Titans fall prey to what he calls, 'The Curse of Flesh'. He says that the original gnomes were once mechagnomes.
He's quite insane! Someone must put a stop to his madness before it's too late for everyone!

26117.text: Yes, this one should advance my studies nicely....
Keristrasza! I wish that circumstances allowed for a more fitting welcome. Fate has been kind to return you to us.
Malygos - in the open? I hadn't dared hope for an opportunity such as this. I'll assemble our bretheren at once!
Of course, my lady. Until we meet again...

26165.text: Death will be only the beginning of your torture.

26167.text: The smoke in the distance... It is Wartook. He is trying to tell us something...
%s expertly identifies the messages hidden within the smoke signals.
Icemist... Not Icemist... NO!!! Come quickly, hero! Follow me!

26170.text: What have you done to my sister, you motherless elf scum!?
I would sooner slit my own throat.  You will pay for what you did to your own men, Arthas... for what you did to me!  I swear it.
I cannot return home with you just yet, Leryssa.  I am not quite done with the Scourge.
You might be right, sister.  My obligations to my land and King have been fulfilled.  But there is something that I still owe to myself.
Do not worry, Leryssa.  I will come back to you when I am done.  Nothing in the world will stop me from coming home to the only family that I have left.
Speak, Lich!  Undeath won't save you from what I'll put you through!

26171.text: Please... all our orders come from Naxxanar... me and my men are kept in the dark!
Mercy!  You were once with us!  Do you not remember?
I beg you, death knight!  Keep your minion away from me!  I'll do anything!

26178.text: You will not stop the Frost Lord from entering this world, mortal. The Tidehunter's might will crush that of Ragnaros once and for all, leaving your land a frozen paradise!

26179.text: Victory or death! For the Horde!

26184.text: Victory or death! For the Horde!

26185.text: You worship death, little man?  Death is here!
Master... you want... I kill puny priest?  Make painful, yes?
Yes, weakling... beg Lurid for life!
Lurid could get used... to working with you.
It's about time!  Lurid was getting bored.
This not... end well for you!

26189.text: The ziggurat's lost!  Flee to the temple!

26203.text: Your progress in this region has been impressive, blood prince.  I am pleased.
Now this is a surprise, Thassarian.  I hadn't heard from Mograine or the other death knights for months.  You've come to rejoin the Scourge, I take it?
Do not fail me, San'layn.  Return to Icecrown with this fool's head or do not bother to return.

26204.text: You will not stop the Frost Lord from entering this world, mortal. The Tidehunter's might will crush that of Ragnaros once and for all, leaving your land a frozen paradise!

26206.text: Raelorasz, it is good to see you again.
Fate, it seems, has been more than kind. A blow has been dealt to Malygos. When he learns of it, I am confident he will leave the safety of the Nexus.
Prepare them well, Raelorasz. Malygos' power is like nothing they've seen. We will likely only delay his plans with this diversion.

26214.text: You will not stop the Frost Lord from entering this world, mortal. The Tidehunter's might will crush that of Ragnaros once and for all, leaving your land a frozen paradise!

26215.text: You will not stop the Frost Lord from entering this world, mortal. The Tidehunter's might will crush that of Ragnaros once and for all, leaving your land a frozen paradise!

26216.text: You will not stop the Frost Lord from entering this world, mortal. The Tidehunter's might will crush that of Ragnaros once and for all, leaving your land a frozen paradise!

26218.text: The spirits have listened!  Can you feel it, $n?

26237.text: Stay close to me, $n. I could not bear for any harm to come to you.
Come, Lord of Magic, and recover your precious consort....
Come, $n. Let us see the fruits of our efforts.
Hurry, $n! Flee! Live to finish what we've begun here....

26287.text: Thel'zan's phylactery drops to the ground beneath Icestorm.

26293.text: The Hulking Jormungar falters for a moment, opening its mouth wide.

26310.text: Keristrasza! You've bested my consort... and now YOU shall take her place!

26334.text: Constructs, defend the capital at all costs!
To battle, my children! Show the enemy no mercy!
Crush the children of stone, my iron brethren!

26349.text: You're too late! The accord has been negotiated. Only the details remain. Small details... like you!

26379.text: Welcome to the Horde, High Chief. Lok'tar ogar!

26401.text: Thank you again, $n, for this delectable incense.
So good!  So packed with energy!
It has everything a growing scorchling needs!
I can feel the power SURGING within me!
Now!  Finally!  Our plans can take effect!
KNEEL, LITTLE MORTAL!  KNEEL BEFORE THE MIGHT OF THE HERALD OF RAGNAROS!
YOU WILL ALL PERISH IN FLAMES!

26406.text: The EMP disrupts Iron Thane Furyhammer's shield!
%s recovers from the EMP and restores Iron Thane Furyhammer's shield.

26417.text: Children of iron, lend me your blades!
Iron masters, aid me in this battle!
The enemy grows stronger! Aid me!
We will destroy you, puny creature!

26420.text: Ah, yes. Loken is well known to me.
It is he who commands the sons of iron in their war against us.
From his hiding place, he oversees their preparations for war with the goal of exterminating the stone giants!

26421.text: The %s is angered by your request and attacks!
Breaking off a piece of its bark, the %s hands it to you before departing.

26437.text: Amidst the tragedy and chaos, this place stands defiantly against the Scourge! It is good to be Horde.

26450.text: The fallen of Pal'ea will not rest, son.  Find the naga priestess!

26484.text: He's out to get me, too! I'd be careful around here if I was you, traveler. You never know which tree he's hiding behind!
That's not something Limpy Joe would ask! But yeah, I know Loken.
By the Light, you killed Limpy Joe and took the meat! How did you know where to find us?
Well, if you've come to kill me, too, can you at least wait until I've fed Griselda? Poor girl hasn't eaten in days.
Here, girl. I've got one last meal for you before Limpy Joe's killer does us in!
How could you kill poor, defenseless old Joe? And why did you bring the meat back?
You're an enigma, that's what you are... And let me tell you, enigmas and I don't get along....
I think you'd best leave before Griselda decides she's in the mood for dessert.
They'll never find us here, will they? We won't let them get us like they got Limpy Joe and Flannel McGee!
No, we escaped from those monsters! They're nothing like us, Griselda.
We're hunters, you and I. No wolfmen here, no ma'am.
Keep an eye out for them, girl! Don't let them get us!

26497.text: I'm sorry, Arthas. I can't watch you do this.

26499.text: Glad you could make it, Uther.
As if I could forget. Listen, Uther, there's something about the plague you should know...
Oh, no. We're too late. These people have all been infected! They may look fine now, but it's just a matter of time before they turn into the undead!
This entire city must be purged.
Damn it, Uther! As your future king, I order you to purge this city!
Then I must consider this an act of treason.
Have I? Lord Uther, by my right of succession and the sovereignty of my crown, I hereby relieve you of your command and suspend your paladins from service.
It's done! Those of you who have the will to save this land, follow me! The rest of you... get out of my sight!
Jaina?
Take position here, and I will lead a small force inside Stratholme to begin the culling. We must contain and purge the infected for the sake of all of Lordaeron!
Everyone looks ready. Remember, these people are all infected with the plague and will die soon. We must purge Stratholme to protect the remainder of Lordaeron from the Scourge. Let's go.
I can only help you with a clean death.
That was just the beginning.
I won't allow it, Mal'Ganis! Better that these people die by my hand than serve as your slaves in death!

Mal'Ganis will send out some of his Scourge minions to interfere with us. Those of you with the strongest steel and magic shall go forth and destroy them. I will lead the rest of my forces in purging Stratholme of the infected.
Champions, meet me at the Town Hall at once. We must take the fight to Mal'Ganis.
Follow me, I know the way through.
Yes, I'm glad I could get to you before the plague.
What is this sorcery?
Mal'Ganis appears to have more than Scourge in his arsenal. We should make haste.
More vile sorcery! Be ready for anything!
Let's move on.
Watch your backs: they have us surrounded in this hall.
One less obstacle to deal with.
Mal'Ganis is not making this easy.
They're very persistent.
What else can he put in my way?
I do what I must for Lordaeron, and neither your words nor your actions will stop me.
The quickest path to Mal'Ganis lies behind that bookshelf ahead.
This will only take a moment.
I'm relieved this secret passage still works.
Let's move through here as quickly as possible. If the undead don't kill us, the fires might.
Rest a moment and clear your lungs, but we must move again soon.
That's enough; we must move again. Mal'Ganis awaits.
At last some good luck. Market Row has not caught fire yet. Mal'Ganis is supposed to be in Crusaders' Square, which is just ahead. Tell me when you're ready to move forward.
Justice will be done.
We're going to finish this right now, Mal'Ganis. Just you... and me.
I'll hunt you to the ends of the earth if I have to! Do you hear me? To the ends of the earth!
You performed well this day. Anything that Mal'Ganis has left behind is yours. Take it as your reward. I must now begin plans for an expedition to Northrend.
I can't afford to spare you.
All officers should check in with me when their squads are ready. We'll enter Stratholme on my order.

26500.text: I'll be waitin' for ya, mon.

26520.text: Thank you again, $n, for this delectable incense.
So good!  So packed with energy!
It has everything a growing scorchling needs!
I can feel the power SURGING within me!
Now!  Finally!  Our plans can take effect!
KNEEL, LITTLE MORTAL!  KNEEL BEFORE THE MIGHT OF THE HERALD OF RAGNAROS!
YOU WILL ALL PERISH IN FLAMES!

26527.text: Oh, no! Adventurers, something awful has happened! A colleague of mine has been captured by the Infinite Dragonflight, and they're doing something horrible to him!$B$BKeeping Arthas is still your highest priority, but if you act fast you could help save a Guardian of Time!
Adventurers, you must hurry! The Guardian of Time cannot last for much longer!
I can barely sense the Guardian of Time! His timeline is fading quickly!

26528.text: Watch your tone with me, boy. You may be the prince, but I'm still your superior as a paladin!
How can you even consider that? There's got to be some other way.
You are not my king yet, boy! Nor would I obey that command even if you were!
Treason? Have you lost your mind, Arthas?
You've just crossed a terrible threshold, Arthas.

26530.text: You are too late, champion of Lordaeron. The dead shall have their day.
Don't worry; I'll make good use of you!
You only advance... the master's plan...
Such strength... it must be mine!
Say hello to some friends of mine.
Come, citizens of Stratholme! Meet your "saviors."

26531.text: %s is entranced by the sun's reflection on Zeh'gehn's knife.
%s croaks eagerly while directing its gaze to the docked ship.

26532.text: Prince Arthas Menethil, on this day, a powerful darkness has taken hold of your soul. The death you are destined to visit upon others will this day be your own.
We'll see about that, young prince.
There is no future for you.
This is the hour of our greatest triumph!

26533.text: Yes, this is the beginning. I've been waiting for you, young prince. I am Mal'Ganis.
As you can see, your people are now mine. I will now turn this city household by household, until the flame of life has been snuffed out... forever.
This will be a fine test, Prince Arthas.
The Dark Lord is displeased with your interference.
It is Prince Arthas I want, not you!
My Onslaught will wash over the Lich King's forces!
Your death is in vain, tiny mortal.
Your time has come to an end.
Gah! I spent too much time in that weak little shell.
Kirel narak! I am Mal'Ganis. I AM ETERNAL!
ENOUGH! I waste my time here. I must gather my strength on the homeworld.
You'll never defeat the Lich King without my forces. I'll have my revenge... on him AND you!

Your journey has just begun, young prince. Gather your forces and meet me in the arctic land of Northrend. It is there that we shall settle the score between us. It is there that your true destiny will unfold.

26537.text: The zeppelin to Warsong Hold has just arrived! All aboard for Borean Tundra!

26538.text: The zeppelin to Orgrimmar has just arrived! All aboard for Durotar!

26539.text: The zeppelin to Vengeance Landing has just arrived! All aboard for Howling Fjord!

26540.text: The zeppelin to Undercity has just arrived! All aboard for Tirisfal Glades!

26564.text: Faster! Faster! These armaments must be delivered to the Kor'kron Vanguard TODAY!
I will happily replace you all with goblins! Do not fail me!
Overlord Agmar demands more of us! We must not disappoint!
Don't make me jump off of this crate! I will beat your head in, orc.

26568.text: Don't be shy, elfy. Don't you feel dis burnin' love formin' between us?
Lookie what Zebu'tan got for you! Roses for da rose!
Hey pretty lady, Zebu'tan got two rugs over here! Why don't you come on over and keep he warm, eh?
Dis troll tink you got a crush on he! Come on over!

26569.text: Not if you were the last troll on Azeroth!
I've got a man! Now take a hike!

26588.text: Um... I think one of those wolves is back...
Oh, no! Look, it's another wolf, and it's a biiiiiiig one!
He's gonna eat Mr. Floppy! You gotta help Mr. Floppy! You just gotta!
There's a big meanie attacking Mr. Floppy! Help!
Let's get out of here before more wolves find us!
Don't go toward the light, Mr. Floppy!
Mr. Floppy, you're ok! Thank you so much for saving Mr. Floppy!
I think I see the camp! We're almost home, Mr. Floppy! Let's go!
The Ravenous Worg chomps down on Mr. Floppy
Are you ready, Mr. Floppy? Stay close to me and watch out for those wolves!
Thank you for helping me to get back to the camp. Go tell Walter that I'm safe now!

26593.text: Perfect.  As long as you don't go hacking and slashing your way through, they'll never know the difference.

26604.text: That's it! Far as I got... Whatd'ya think?

26605.text: You have made a fatal mistake, mortal... There isss no essscape...

26608.text: Give in, Taunka! Your will cannot hold out against the Scourge!
Your freedom will be short lived, Icemist!
Insolent mortal! You will be consumed!
Anub'et'kan is defeated! Take a fragment of his husk as proof of your victory!

26626.text: Don't be so quick to escape! I have a parting gift....
Rise my warriors and fight for your new liege!
Please enjoy their company, the Lich King sends his regards!

26630.text: Mo' guts! Mo' blood! Mo' food!
Me gonna carve you and eat you!

26631.text: The chill you feel is the herald of your doom!
Such is the fate of all who oppose the Lich King!
Bolster my defenses! Hurry, curse you!
Surely you can see the futility of it all!
Just give up and die already!

26632.text: Tharon'ja sees all! The work of mortals shall not end the eternal dynasty!
Tharon'ja has a use for your mortal shell!
No! A taste... all too brief!
Im... impossible! Tharon'ja is eternal! Tharon'ja... is....

26635.text: Help mon! There's too many of dem!

26648.text: Little $n, why do you call me forth? Are you working with the trolls of this land? Have you come to kill me and take my power as your own?
I sense uncertainty in you, and I do not trust it whether you are with them, or not. If you wish my augury for the Kalu'ak, you will have to prove yourself first.
I will lay a mild compulsion upon you. Jump into the depths before me so that you put yourself into my element and thereby display your submission.
Though you are compelled, the choice, and the last step before you leap, are yours. You have twenty more seconds to decide.
I'm rather curious as to what will happen, should you ignore this and NOT jump into the water.
Well done, $n. Your display of respect is duly noted. Now, I have information for you that you must convey to the Kalu'ak.
Simply put, you must tell the tuskarr that they cannot run. If they do so, their spirits will be destroyed by the evil rising within Northrend.
Tell the mystic that his people are to stand and fight alongside the Horde and Alliance against the forces of Malygos and the Lich King.
Now swim back with the knowledge I have granted you. Do what you can for them, $r.
Very well, $n, you have failed to act. The prophecy is not yours to learn. Do not call upon me again until you have found your backbone!

26649.text: Pssst... Over here, by the mailbox. Come quickly and make sure you aren't followed.

26653.text: Betrayers! The day of reckoning comes and with it comes your end! See then if your Lich King saves you from the ancient one's judgement! Now you die!

26654.text: Pray to whatever gods you believe in that I am never freed!
What have they done to my people...
You will face the full fury of the ancestors for what you have done, monster!
Rebirth comes, my brothers... Rise... Rise and fight once more.
Come down and face me, insect!
Then I will force you down! Wind grant me flight!

26660.text: About time!  Get that lumber and get moving.  The horde won't be up there fighting forever, there's money to be made!

26661.text: The control components are working perfectly this time!
Who to test the bomb on?  The Harpies?  Ha ha... wait... what's that?
NO!  My machine... my bombs!  THAT'S IT!  Those Harpies are going DOWN!
Talk to Narf.  Lets take care of those bird-brains once and for all.

26666.text: Stay your blade, Chieftain. He may yet have value to us.
Remember the dwarven journal that was discovered? Well, this dwarf could be exactly what we need to track down Brann Bronzebeard and capture him.
You will if you wish to keep your head attached to your shoulders.

26668.text: The sensation is... beyond my imagining. I am yours to command, my king.
I will be happy to slaughter them in your name! Come, enemies of the Scourge! I will show you the might of the Lich King!
You were a fool to challenge the power of the Lich King!
Your will is done, my king!
Nooo! I did not come this far... to...

26676.text: A fine meal you will make...
Anub'arak may have uses for your carcass...

26687.text: What this place? I will destroy you!
You die! That what master wants.

26693.text: What mongrels dare intrude here? Look alive, my brothers!  A feast for the one that brings me their heads!
Not so brash now, are you?
I'll mount your skull from the highest tower!n
Skadi the Ruthless is within range of the harpoon launchers!
ARGH! You call that... an attack? I'll...  show... aghhhh...
Skadi the Ruthless is within range of the harpoon launchers!
You motherless knaves! Your corpses will make fine morsels for my new drake!
Go now! Leave nothing but ash in your wake!
Cleanse our sacred halls with flame!

26723.text: Preserve? Why? There's no truth in it. No no no... only in the taking! I see that now!
Now we've come to the truth!
Finish it! Finish it! Kill me, or I swear by the Dragonqueen you'll never see daylight again!

26731.text: You know what they say about curiosity....
There's plenty of me to go around.
I'll give you more than you can handle!

26762.text: Keep them away from the focus!

26763.text: %s shields himself and diverts his power to the rifts!

26786.text: No one will keep us from our destiny!
You are a fool to fight Kurun's hopeless battle!
You will pay for your interference!
Your life is forfeit, ally of stone!

26796.text: What? Where in the-- don't just stand around lads; kill somebody!

26798.text: What is this? Mok-thorin ka! Kill them!
Our task is not yet done!

26810.text: %s reads from the scroll as the other Taunka gather around him.
Lok'tar ogar! Victory or death - it is these words that bind me to the Horde! For they are the most sacred and fundamental of truths to any warrior of the Horde.
I give my flesh and blood freely to the Warchief. I am the instrument of my Warchief's desire. I am a weapon of my Warchief's command!
From this moment until the end of days I live and die - For the Horde!n
For my Taunka brothers and sisters! FOR THE HORDE!n

26811.text: You take my heart, now I take yours!
Why ya wanna mess wit me innards, mon?
Dat me liver you be squeezin, mon!
Come back here with me guts, $r!

26812.text: You take my heart, now I take yours!
Why ya wanna mess wit me innards, mon?
Dat me liver you be squeezin, mon!
Come back here with me guts, $r!

26814.text: Alright, kid. Stay behind me and you'll be fine.
Their ceremonial chamber, where I was to be sacrificed...
Time to put an end to all this!
Just as well, I've had enough of this place.
Listen, kid. I can handle this thing. You just watch my back!

26815.text: Ya shouldn'a taken the boat north, mon!

26817.text: I'll blast those gnomish wannabes back to the scrap heap!
What? You're sending me back there?!

26860.text: I've never seen you so eager to cause harm to someone, sister.  Such a pleasant development... very well, go!
That spineless troll has failed me for the last time.  Anthis!  Break his legs!

26861.text: You invade my home and then dare to challenge me?  I will tear the hearts from your chests and offer them as gifts to the death god! Rualg nja gaborr!
Your death is only the beginning.
There is a reason I am king!n
Bjorn of the Black Storm! Honor me now with your presence!
Haldor of the Rocky Cliffs! Grant me your strength!
Ranulf of the Screaming Abyss!  Snuff these maggots with darkest night!
Tor of the Brutal Siege, bestow your might upon me!

26890.text: You are not welcome in our home.  Leave and go find some other land to pillage!

26893.text: Skadi the Ruthless is within range of the harpoon launchers!

26902.text: How dare you summon me without an offering!

26917.text: Mortal champions have long used these weapons to combat evil. I see no reason to keep the swords from them in this battle.
If I was in my dragon form, there wouldn't be any room for anyone else, little one.

26919.text: Dey be stronger then I expect mon, attack dem!
26919.comment: Drak'aguul - Between 0-30% Health - Call For Help

26919.text: Wait for me orders, I handle dis myself!
26919.comment: Drak'aguul - On Aggro - Order soldiers to wait

26920.text: Fool! You'll never get away with this!
You dare to defy the sons of iron?
What do you think you're doing?

26921.text: Fool! You'll never get away with this!
You dare to defy the sons of iron?
What do you think you're doing?

26922.text: Fool! You'll never get away with this!
You dare to defy the sons of iron?
What do you think you're doing?

26923.text: Fool! You'll never get away with this!
You dare to defy the sons of iron?
What do you think you're doing?

26935.text: I'm old enough to shoot beasts like you right between the eyes... at twice this distance.
Don't you dare talk about my father, monster.  He was twice the man you'll ever be.
I'd rather be dead than be one of you!  You think you're still human?  You're... animals!
Surprise, you scum!  You're going to tell me where my sister is or I'll put a bucketful of truesilver bullets through your wife's heart.
There is one last thing.  I need to know where Arugal is.
Don't worry, sister... no one can hurt you now.

26966.text: The boy believed he could essssscape... Neither of you shall make it out alive.
Kill ussss all... More will come for him...
Relent! This ssssoul iss not worth sssaving...
You have made a grave misssstake...

26971.text: You won't get away with this, you know?  You're just a kid.
Your father was weak, Sasha... he didn't have the guts to do what had to be done.
We'll all end up serving the Lich King, kid.  Better this way than becoming a rotten corpse.
Stop!  Do not shoot!  Do not hurt Tatjana!
The brat's held prisoner in the wolf den on the other side of the mountain.  She was to be taken to Arugal.  Are we free to go now?
Nothing you can do can compare to what Arugal can do to us!  I will tear you apart myself!

27002.text: I'll consume your flesh and pick my teeth with your bones!
You're no magnataur!  Where... did you... find... such strength?

27003.text: I know why you've come - one of those foolish Magnataur on the plains meddled and managed to get the dragons involved.  Do you enjoy serving them like a dog?
You seek their leader... little thing, you wage war against the clans of Grom'thar the Thunderbringer himself.  Don't be so eager to rush to your death.
Hah!  So be it.  Blow the horn of a magnataur leader at the ring of torches south of the Blue Dragonshrine.  Make peace with your gods... Grom'thar will come.

27006.text: You dare invade Magnataur lands?  Bonesunder gladly smash you and take your limbs as payment!
Bonesunder begins to cast Crack Bone!

27010.text: All these folks are keeping me busy.  Take this horse over to your stables.
27010.comment: Celidh Aletracker to Jimmy the Stable Boy

27054.text: %s beams, unaware that she is teasing him, answering in his thickly-accented Common.
Well! You see, was gift from Grandmother Oluba. She hand-weave from finest silk on Draenor! Am quite proud of, yes.

27055.text: %s huffs with annoyance, glaring briefly at Sentinel Sweetspring before turning away with her nose in the air.

27056.text: %s grins at Sentinel Amberline across the camp, waggling her long eyebrows suggestively.
Pssst. Naohain. Why does Modoru still wear those ridiculous robes? He looks like some interdimensional bumpkin who stumbled out of Ammen Vale not six hours past.
Say, Modoru. Where did you get those... ah... "wonderful" robes of yours, hmmm?
Oh. Oh... I see. How nice!

27061.text: Xink's Shredder ready and available for woodland destruction.
Xink's Shredder security features activated.  Returning to base.

27102.text: Let me take care of it, sister.
What were you thinking, provoking her like that?
I used good judgment when you showed none.  I don't want to see you lead us into ruin, Krenna!
You... half-idiot!  You really did it this time.  I'm going to have to make it look like your leg's broken.
Now don't move if you ever want to walk again!

27113.text: Thank you for rescuing me, but the others are still held on the tiers above!

27114.text: Thank goodness! I was worried they were going to press me into service in their war against the stone giants!

27115.text: These irons are crazy! They keep talking about serving their 'master Loken' but from what I can tell, only a few receive orders from him.

27119.text: %s snickers, nuzzling into Sentinel Sweetspring's ankles.

27163.text: Keep 'em off me for about 15 seconds and this thing is as good as dead.
When I'm done with this plague wagon it'll look like a goblin built it! Keep me safe!
Keep the bad guys off me!
That oughta do it! Just a few more seconds now.

27166.text: Do ye want ta live forever?

27169.text: Do ye want ta live forever?

27199.text: Ahhh! What be happenin' to me, mon?
How dare you summon me without an offering!

27202.text: I've heard whisperings of intruders.  Be wary.
I sense the taint of this land in you, footman.  Report to the Bishop before the start of your next shift.
Your protection is strong, child.  Continue your work.
You require the Bishop's blessing.  Go to him soon.
Remain on the pure path.  The Light will protect you.
The Grand Admiral himself has come to see to our dedication.  If I see you slacking on your post again, I will gut you myself.
HELP! HELP! THIS $g MAN : WOMAN; HAS STOLEN MY IMAGE!
A member of the priesthood whom I've never seen before.

27203.text: In the name of the Light!

27209.text: Ow! I'll tell you NOTHING, filthy $r!
Wait... WAIT! What is it that you want to know?! I know you're the $c named $n.
OW...NO! We know that you've been stealing our armor and weapons and horses!
We know... that you don't... know why we're immune... to your so-called blight. Grand Admiral Westwind somehow gave the high abbot that prayer. I beg you... no more... please?!
AHHHHHHHHH! Please... we know... that you... have a spy... disguised as... one of us! There... that's all that I know. Please... mercy... STOP!
I TOLD YOU... I don't know... anything... else!
They all... begged... for their... lives!
You won't get... anything else... out of me!

27210.text: Now I'll show you the REAL power of the Onslaught!

27212.text: Destiny will not wait. Your craftsmen must increase their production of the war golems before the stone giant leader and his army reach Ulduar.
Tell your rune-smiths to continue converting what stone giants you can. Those that will not submit must be destroyed.
If the stone giants interfere with our work at Ulduar, I will hold you and your thane responsible. Mortals must not be allowed to come to the aid of the giants.
Return to your duties, overseer. Be certain to impress upon your workers the urgency of their tasks.

27221.text: You are among the Taunka of Camp Oneqwah, dwarf.
If you agree to help us against our mutual enemy, you will come to no harm here.
Think about it, prospector, but make up your mind swiftly. We must act soon.
I'll admit, dwarf, I was pleasantly surprised to see your plan succeed.
We can't just let you return to your companions and we can't take you with us...
He will live so long as he proves useful. I'd be careful if I was you, dwarf.

27227.text: Wait a minute here! You promised to spare me if I helped you. I held up my end o' the bargain!
By the Light, Brann's alive? I'd never help you capture him!

27234.text: You are being misled! The Onslaught is all lies! The Scourge and the Forsaken are not our enemies! Wake up!

27235.text: Renounce the Scarlet Onslaught! Don't listen to the lies of the high general and the grand admiral any longer!

27236.text: Abbendis is nothing but a harlot and Grand Admiral Westwind is selling her cheap like he sold us out!

27237.text: High General Abbendis personally told me that it was a mistake to come north and that we're doomed! I urge you all to lay down your weapons and leave before it's too late!

27238.text: My beautiful mill. You! You'll die for this!

27245.text: Boys, go see who's doing that.

27246.text: It is good that you have come my child.  The Light's protection has worn thin on you.
It is done.  Serve the Light well.
How dare you interrupt our righteous work?!

27248.text: Apparently you flubbed this batch of blight. What do you have to say for yourself?
Sorry? SORRY?! Here's sorry for you!
Oops. I guess it IS working! That's odd.
I'm gonna need a cleanup and a new assistant over here!

27250.text: But... I followed your instructions precisely! Sorry?

27299.text: I think I've got it this time..
Do you think that will get some answers?
True, our enemies would show us no mercy.
True, but how far should we push?  At what point are we no better than our enemies?

27300.text: You need more bite.  Do not show our enemies any mercy.
The more pain we can inflict, the quicker we can get our answers.

27315.text: Are you sure you know how to fly this thing? Feels a little wobbly.
I don't mean to sound ungrateful, but could you fly a little closer to the ground? I hate heights!
I picked a bad day to stop drinking!
I'm gettin' a little woozy... Oooooof...
You are my guardian angel! Like a white knight you flew in from the heavens and lifted me from the pit of damnation!
How can I ever repay you for this, friend?
Kindness is not lost with this one, Urik. Thank you, hero!
My shop's doors will always be open to you, friend.
Safe at last! Thank you, stranger!
We made it! We actually made it!

27316.text: Stand back, $n, the beast might lash out and harm you.
GODFREY! Hear me, fiend! Hear me, for I am the Light, here to deliver you from evil!
Good. I have your attention, then, Godfrey?
We can do this in one of two ways, Godfrey. First, I will simply ask you to tell me what the unholy markings etched upon the pages of this tome mean. What say you?
I say a prayer for you now, lost soul. May the Light take you gracefully.
LET THE LIGHT IN, GODFREY GOODARD!
May the power of Light compel you!
I thought you would see the Light, Godfrey... Now speak quickly, fiend. What does it say?

RUBBISH! Godfrey do you take me for a fool? Do not spew your Scourge propaganda at a man of the Light, heathen! Speak now or I will have the peasants craft a holy water bath and dip you into it like a dog with fleas!
What? There is a mausoleum beneath the old village? What fools we are to not have noticed! We will find and strike down your master now, Godfrey. We will end this nightmare.
You let us worry about how we kill the monster, Godfrey.

Return to Halford with the information that the good mayor was kind enough to submit, $n. I will finish here and squeeze whatever else this wretch might know about Thel'zan. Now, I will show Godfrey the rarely seen "option three."
Let's you and I have a chat about some things, Godfrey.

27328.text: Stay behind me, $r.  I will do my best to protect you.
My freedom means nothing if we fail to save Ursoc.  Make haste, $n.
I will watch over you and your allies, $r.
Ursoc, brother of Ursol and guardian of the furbolg tribes... show yourself!

27336.text: Are you sure you know how to fly this thing? Feels a little wobbly.
I don't mean to sound ungrateful, but could you fly a little closer to the ground? I hate heights!
I picked a bad day to stop drinking!
I'm gettin' a little woozy... Oooooof...
You are my guardian angel! Like a white knight you flew in from the heavens and lifted me from the pit of damnation!
How can I ever repay you for this, friend?
Kindness is not lost with this one, Urik. Thank you, hero!
My shop's doors will always be open to you, friend.
Safe at last! Thank you, stranger!
We made it! We actually made it!

27349.text: The %s moans but seems otherwise unaffected by the blight.

27355.text: No... NO! What have you done?! So many ancient wyrms wasted... what magic could do this?
27355.comment: Rothin the Decaying <Cult of the Damned>

27355.text: Foolish errand $G boy:girl;... you will die for interrupting my work!
27355.comment: Rothin the Decaying <Cult of the Damned>

27355.text: This is not the end... death only... strengthens...
27355.comment: Rothin the Decaying <Cult of the Damned>

27359.text: Good of you to come, champion! The beast almost had me!

27364.text: Hey Celidh!  Do you have any pets you want me to take over to the stable?
If I were king, I'd have a horse like you.  I'd make sure you didn't get lost, and I bet you'd make sure I never got lost.
We'd be best friends.  I bet me and Anduin would also be best friends, too.  Friends are important.
I'll take you to some other horses.  You probably miss being around other horses.  They can be your friend too.

27373.text: I thank you all.  The druids of old were wise to tear down Vordrassil, for its roots seep deep into the dwelling of an ancient evil.
You know their kind as old gods.  Beware Yogg-Saron, the beast with a thousand maws.  His evil extends beyond Vordrassil's roots.

27376.text: What do you mean my time has come?! I'll kill you where you stand!

27378.text: You can't possibly mean to.... I'll write you up for this, $c!
27378.comment: Senior Scrivener Barriga before going hostile

27378.text: If you'd be so kind, please let me out of here!

27379.text: No! I beg you! Please don't kill me!
Can someone let me out of here? I need to get back to Venomspite and finish my shift.

27381.text: What is the meaning of this?! Stop! I'll double whatever they're paying you!
I just arrived in Venomspite. How could I have possibly wronged you?

27383.text: I was... once like you. Mortal. Soft. Only flesh and bone. WEAK AND TIMID!
Our lord, Arthas, saw in me the frailty of man.
"Serve me in life and I will promise to rend the weakness from your soul. To erase it from existence!" To be chosen... blessed by the Lich King in such a way.
So serve him I did... Were it not for me the glorious dread citadel of Naxxramas may never have returned to Northrend.
But enough talk... You have fought hard and come from the distant reaches of this world to face the Duskbringer. I shall not disappoint...n
Just as our lord saved me, so too shall I save you!n
THIS WILL BE THE LAST TIME YOU UTTER THAT NAME, PALADIN! Breathe your dying breath!
Rise, my minions! Your master commands it!

27389.text: By all means, don't assess the situation, you halfwit! Just jump into the fray!
Skarvald, you incompetent slug! Return and make yourself useful!

27390.text: Dalronn! See if you can muster the nerve to join my attack!
Pfagh! What sort of necromancer lets death stop him? I knew you were worthless!

27406.text: I don't know. Better kill them both to be on the safe side!

27411.text: Answer me!  Were you bloody bitten?
You don't even know, do you?  The trappers?  They're not human... we have to get out of here!  Come, quick!
Take Ducal's horse, he's one of them now!
There's lamp oil in the back - make use of it.  The fiends hate fire!

27430.text: The Destructive Ward gains in power.
The Destructive Ward is fully charged!

27432.text: Me got stuck in sticky bug rope.
Me no like rock place full of bugs.
Me no like new cold place.
It time for work! Zug zug!

27439.text: I know a place nearby where we can speak in private, my child. Follow me.
Did you think that I could not see through your flimsy disguise, $N?
There is much that you do not understand, $R. The Master sees all.
He told me that you would come for me. I won't die by your hand, though. I have seen what you have done to my compatriots.
No. I will leave this world in a manner of my own choosing. And I will return, the grand admiral's will permitting!

27447.text: They are... too strong! Underestimated their... fortitude.

Intruders, your victory will be short-lived. I am Commander Varos Cloudstrider. My drakes control the skies and protect this conduit. I will see to it personally that the Oculus does not fall into your hands!

27455.text: Captain, why are the guards not at their posts?
Uther had my troops recalled? Damn it! If my warriors abandon me, I'll never defeat Mal'Ganis. The ships must be burned before the men reach the shore!n
Burned down to their frames! No one goes home until our job here is done!n
Spare me, Muradin. You weren't there to see what Mal'Ganis did to my homeland.n
I would gladly bear any curse to save my homeland.n
Damn the men! Nothing shall prevent me from having my revenge, old friend. Not even you.n
Now, I call out to the spirits of this place. I will give anything or pay any price, if only you will help me save my people.n

27463.text: Whoa - I nearly died there. Thank you, $r!

27476.text: I apologize, emissary, but the prince is away on an errand. What brings you to this desolate place?n
27476.comment: Valonforth 0  - Q: The Truth Shall Set Us Free

27476.text: We're to just pick up and leave?
27476.comment: Valonforth 1  - Q: The Truth Shall Set Us Free

27476.text: To hell with the undead! We'll cut our way through the woods, men!n
27476.comment: Valonforth 2  - Q: The Truth Shall Set Us Free

27476.text: Well, milord, your father had our troops recalled at Lord Uther's request.n
27476.comment: Valonforth 3 - Q: The Truth Shall Set Us Free

27480.text: Isn't that a bit much, lad?n
You lied to your men and betrayed the mercenaries who fought for you. What's happening to you, Arthas? Is vengeance all that's important to you?n

Hold, lad. There's an inscription on the dais. It's a warning. It says, "Whomsoever takes up this blade shall wield power eternal. Just as the blade rends flesh, so must power scar the spirit." Oh, I should've known. The blade is cursed! Let's get the hell out of here!n
Leave it be, Arthas. Forget this business and lead your men home.n
O' my head... Wh... Where am I?n

27482.text: I'd nearly given up. You've given me new life!
Bless you, friend. I nearly expired....
Without your help, I surely would have died....

27492.text: By royal edict, you men are to return to Lordaeron immediately. Lord Uther has convinced the king to recall this expedition.n
27492.comment: Alliance Emissary 0 - Q: The Truth Shall Set Us Free

27492.text: That's correct. My men report that the roads from here to the shore are held by the undead. You'll need to find an alternate route back to your ships.n
27492.comment: Alliance Emissary 1 - Q: The Truth Shall Set Us Free

27570.text: I didn't sign up for this!

27577.text: What can you do to me that Kel'Thuzad has not? That the Lich King will not?
The book is your salvation, yes... but nothing will you know! NOTHING I SAY! NOTHING!
No more LIGHT! NO MORE! I BEG YOU!
It tells of the coming apocalypse. How this world will burn and be reborn from death.
NOOOO!!! I tell you! I tell you everything!

Humans... Beneath the earth of Wintergarde Village you built a mausoleum! Why do you think Naxxramas attacked that spot? Thel'zan hides deep in your own crypt and sends a thousand-thousand corpses at you! Perish you will...
How? Humans truly are stupid, yes? Thel'zan the Duskbringer! Thel'zan the Lich! He who is born of human flesh and bone, sacrificed all for power, protected by the Lich King!
You cannot stop Thel'zan! He bears the dark gift, bestowed upon him by the Lich King himself!

27588.text: Without you we'd be lost. Thanks for the ride!
For the Alliance and Lord Fordragon!
HOO-WAH! The cavalry has arrived!
Great driving, soldier! Not a scratch on us!
I think I see one of their plague wagons!
Did I ever tell you soldiers about the time I destroyed the Thandol Span? Yep, weren't no dark irons destroyed that bridge! Was me!
It doesn't make any sense. Why don't they just fly Naxxramas over Wintergarde Keep and blow it up? I mean, that's what I would do if I were Kel'Thuzad.
I wonder if we'll ever solve the mystery of the strange ore. There's gotta be some use for it!
Hey, do any of you know McGoyver over at Valgarde? He's my uncle. You know what his title is? Pro. Yea, just "Pro." I want to be a pro too.

Something straight up stinks in here! It's definitely not me. Gnomes smell like butter and sunshine. Not like those dwarves that smell like they were born from a trogg's armpit! None of you are dwarves, are you?
I used to know a dwarf that claimed gnomes evolved from beneath the earth. That we all started out as sand gnomes. What a load of nonsense! Sand gnomes? PUH-LEASE!
I've never seen destruction like this...
Keep the chatter down, people. We need to stay alert!
The smell of death covers every inch of this place.
Driver, I hear you single handedly airlifted our villagers out of this hell-hole. Is that true?
So does anyone know anything about Thel'zan? Who is he? How did he come to leading the Scourge armies on the ground?
Look at this mess... The Scourge will pay for this!
Where are all the corpses? What have they done to our people?
I hope I'm alive to see Arthas get what's coming to him.
Reporting for duty, sir!

27619.text: Rise, Arugal!  The power of the Lich King commands you!

27624.text: Yes... he shall suit our needs perfectly.  Have him sent to Solstice Village when you're ready.  Arthas will not be pleased if we fall behind schedule.

27629.text: Shall we destabilize the shrine first or disable the enemy?
We've been expecting you, $n. Now we have the upper hand.
I can't believe the blues would attack us. Let's give some of it back!
I am ready. Let's defend the temple!
Your reputation precedes you, $n. This should be interesting.
I never thought that I'd be riding into battle with a $r on my back.
Another blue down. We make a great team!
With you and I working together, this battle will be over in no time.
I've never seen anything like this before. I'm glad that you're here.
I'm glad you saw that one!
Just hang on. We'll get through this.
We should get out of here. I need to renew!

27646.text: You won't eat me, will you?
Sister!  The mean men were going to take me to Badmoon Isle.  They wanted to turn me into one of them.
That's what I said!  Badmoon!  Sasha... don't ever leave me again!  First they took papa, then they took you... I don't want to be alone with them!

27654.text: The prisoners shall not go free! The word of Malygos is law!
It is too late to run!

27655.text: What do we have here... those that would defy the Spell-Weaver? Those without foresight or understanding. How can I make you see? Malygos is saving the world from itself! Bah! You are hardly worth my time!
Clearly my pets failed. Perhaps another demonstration is in order.
Still you fight. Still you cling to misguided principles. If you survive, you'll find me in the center ring.
%s begins to cast Empowered Arcane Explosion!
A taste... just a small taste... of the Spell-Weaver's power!
So much unstable energy... but worth the risk to destroy you!
Everything I have done... has been for Azeroth....
Now do you see? Do you?!

27656.text: Simpletons! You cannot comprehend the forces you have set in motion. The ley line conduit will not be disrupted! Your defeat shall be absolute!
You brash interlopers are out of your element! I will ground you!
Such insolence... such arrogance... must be PUNISHED!
BACK to the earth with you!
Savor this small victory, foolish little creatures. You and your dragon allies have won this battle, but we will win... the Nexus War.
We command the arcane! It shall not be used against us!
It is trivial to extinguish your fire!
No magic of nature will help you now!

27658.text: Thank you for freeing us, mortals.  Beware, the blue flight is alerted to your presence.  Even now, Malygos sends Varos Cloudstrider and his ring guardians to defend the Oculus.  You will need our help to stand a chance.

27683.text: I've lived here and kept this shrine with the blessing of the Alexstrasza for longer than I can remember.  In its darkest hour, I've failed... I fell at the feet of that damned death knight...  Bloodbane.
Dahlia spits on the ground at the thought of the name.
The Lich King is stretching his hand far now... fearlessly treading on the most sacred lands of all of the flights.  He intends to force us to action.
My time is done... I offered myself to Alexstrasza in life, but I have nothing left to offer in death.  She will need a new keeper for her shrine.
And thank you... thank you for freeing me from the shackles of the damned.  You are a hero... I know you will go on to great deeds.
The Remnant of Dahlia Suntouch fades away...

27692.text: Welcome Friend.  Keep your head down and hold on tight!
Use Leeching Poison to damage enemies and keep me healed.  Touch the Nightmare is very powerful, but it hurts me, so only use it when I have a lot of health!
Now that I am at my full power I can perform Dream Funnel.  You can use it to heal other drakes, but it drains my health, so make sure you're using Leeching Poison too!
I'm badly injured!  I can't take much more of this!

$3486W Centrifuge Constructs remain.  We must find and destroy them to disable Varos Cloudstrider's protective shield.  The constructs should be about halfway up The Oculus, on the Band of Acceleration.
One Centrifuge Construct remains.  We must find and destroy it to disable Varos Cloudstrider's protective shield.  The construct should be about halfway up The Oculus, on the Band of Acceleration.

The shield is down; Varos is vulnerable!  Defeating him should disperse the Azure Ring Guardians and allow us access to the upper bands.  Varos is on a floating platform about halfway up The Oculus, on the Band of Acceleration.

Mage-Lord Urom is our next target.  He should be hiding on one of the floating platforms on the Band of Transmutation, near the top of The Oculus.  Be warned, Urom is a powerful conjurer; he may not be alone.

Ley-Guardian Eregos is all that now stands between us and control of The Oculus.  He's flying above the Band of Alignment, at the very top of The Oculus.  Eregos is incredibly powerful; stay on my back when we engage him and leave the fighting to me.
We've wrested control of The Oculus from the forces of Malygos.  You're not getting any lighter, little one.  My wings itch for the open sky.

27705.text: Ah, I love the smell of Stonard! It smells like... like... orc sweat. And rot. Still, combined, the effect can be quite pleasant! It's an acquired scent.
While visitors complain about the exceptionally humid air, I find it helps my complexion! Dry skin is unflattering.
It is a shame, a dreadful shame, that my brethren cannot see what benefits come from truly steeping oneself in a culture.

Here I am, in a rough-hewn stone tower squatting on marshy, muddy ground while clouds of midges fly unchecked through the open doorways, standing amongst hunched, greenskin figures of dubious hygiene and coarse manners. I've never been happier.

Before I was stationed out here, I'd only heard about the rejuvenating effects a mudbath can have on skin. When I first tripped over a tree root, I was exposed to the full benefits! Amazing what nature can do, even without a bit of magic to help it along.

To this day, I ponder why I, myself, was chosen for this particular station. I can only imagine my superior felt I was uniquely suited to the task and would quickly become accustomed to the quaint culture of the Horde found herein, but I heard a truly mean-spirited rumor that it may be because I talk too much.
You need to learn to appreciate your surroundings, Cersei!

27713.text: Is this the end? If we stop this bastard now, is victory assured at the Wrathgate?
Let it be known that it has been an honor and a privilege fighting alongside all of you.
Death comes for us all eventually, but sometimes it comes a little faster than anticipated. Today we call that blind heroics... Tomorrow someone may call it stupidity.
Come on... Let's get this over with!
It looks like a gateway to hell!
I'm getting a little worried. Where is this hero that is supposed to lead us into battle?
If I don't make it back to Wintergarde, let my family know that I did my best and that I love them...

27719.text: Ladies and gentlemen!  Well... let's just say you don't want to miss this one!

27726.text: I used good judgment when you showed none.  I don't want to see you lead us into ruin, Krenna!
It doesn't have to end this way, you know?
Why... why sister?  Why did it have to come to this?

27727.text: You went behind my back.  You neglected my orders.  You will pay the price.
Enough talk.  By the time I'm through with you, not even the worgs are going to want to go near your corpse.

27755.text: Welcome Friend.  Keep your head down and hold on tight!
Use Shock Lance to damage enemies.  If we get in trouble, Stop Time to freeze all enemies in place, then hit them with Shock Lance for massive damage!
Now that I am at my full power I can perform Temporal Rift.  You can use it to make enemies take extra damage and to get Shock Charges.  Save up Shock Charges and then Shock Lance for huge damage!
I'm badly injured!  I can't take much more of this!

$3486W Centrifuge Constructs remain.  We must find and destroy them to disable Varos Cloudstrider's protective shield.  The constructs should be about halfway up The Oculus, on the Band of Acceleration.
One Centrifuge Construct remains.  We must find and destroy it to disable Varos Cloudstrider's protective shield.  The construct should be about halfway up The Oculus, on the Band of Acceleration.

The shield is down; Varos is vulnerable!  Defeating him should disperse the Azure Ring Guardians and allow us access to the upper bands.  Varos is on a floating platform about halfway up The Oculus, on the Band of Acceleration.

Mage-Lord Urom is our next target.  He should be hiding on one of the floating platforms on the Band of Transmutation, near the top of The Oculus.  Be warned, Urom is a powerful conjurer; he may not be alone.

Ley-Guardian Eregos is all that now stands between us and control of The Oculus.  He's flying above the Band of Alignment, at the very top of The Oculus.  Eregos is incredibly powerful; stay on my back when we engage him and leave the fighting to me.
We've wrested control of The Oculus from the forces of Malygos.  You're not getting any lighter, little one.  My wings itch for the open sky.

27756.text: Welcome Friend.  Keep your head down and hold on tight!
Use Searing Wrath to damage enemies and Evasive Maneuvers if I start taking damage.  Remember I need to build up Evasive Charges by taking damage to perform Evasive Maneuvers!
Now that I am at my full power I can perform Martyr.  You can use it to protect other drakes, but I will take lots of damage, so make sure you're using Evasive Maneuvers too!
I'm badly injured!  I can't take much more of this!

$3486W Centrifuge Constructs remain.  We must find and destroy them to disable Varos Cloudstrider's protective shield.  The constructs should be about halfway up The Oculus, on the Band of Acceleration.
One Centrifuge Construct remains.  We must find and destroy it to disable Varos Cloudstrider's protective shield.  The construct should be about halfway up The Oculus, on the Band of Acceleration.

The shield is down; Varos is vulnerable!  Defeating him should disperse the Azure Ring Guardians and allow us access to the upper bands.  Varos is on a floating platform about halfway up The Oculus, on the Band of Acceleration.

Mage-Lord Urom is our next target.  He should be hiding on one of the floating platforms on the Band of Transmutation, near the top of The Oculus.  Be warned, Urom is a powerful conjurer; he may not be alone.

Ley-Guardian Eregos is all that now stands between us and control of The Oculus.  He's flying above the Band of Alignment, at the very top of The Oculus.  Eregos is incredibly powerful; stay on my back when we engage him and leave the fighting to me.
We've wrested control of The Oculus from the forces of Malygos.  You're not getting any lighter, little one.  My wings itch for the open sky.

27784.text: Next, I shall speak of the most powerful entities within the pinnacle of Naxxramas. Truly, these are two of the greatest threats to all of Northrend.
27784.comment: Commander Eligor Dawnbringer - Pinnacle of Naxxramas

27784.text: Next, I shall speak of the death knight wing of Naxxramas. Within its corrupted halls, the echo of battle rings day and night, as our finest warriors are corrupted and twisted into the Scourge's greatest warriors.
27784.comment: Commander Eligor Dawnbringer - Death knight wing of Naxxramas

27784.text: Next, I shall speak of the blighted abomination wing of Naxxramas. There, the Scourge develop the strongest and most hideous aberrations of their armies.
27784.comment: Commander Eligor Dawnbringer - Blighted abomination wing of Naxxramas

27784.text: Next, I shall speak of the accursed spider wing of Naxxramas. It is there the Scourge breed even more poisonous and dangerous versions of their kin.
27784.comment: Commander Eligor Dawnbringer - Accursed spider wing of Naxxramas

27784.text: Next, I shall speak of the dread plague wing of Naxxramas, where the Scourge seek to improve upon the deadly blight which they spread across Lordaeron.
27784.comment: Commander Eligor Dawnbringer - Dread plague wing of Naxxramas

27784.text: I shall leave this image on display for your perusal. Study your opponents' strengths, for a creature's strength can also be its weakness.
27784.comment: Commander Eligor Dawnbringer - End of talk

27784.text: Sapphiron. Once a noble blue dragon within the mountains of Northrend, Sapphiron was slain by Arthas during his campaign through the frozen north. Resurrected to serve him, Sapphiron guards Kel'thuzad's lair eternally, awaiting those who would dare tresspass upon his master.

The lich, Kel'Thuzad. He serves the Lich King without question, a necromancer of great prowess in life, turned into a master of necromancy after his death. It is said he is the most loyal of the Lich King's subjects.

Kel'thuzad has survived trials that would have long since shattered the souls of even the greatest of the Brotherhood. He readily gave his life at Arthas's hand, later to be brought back - reborn in the power of the Sunwell.

In the Plaguelands, Kel'thuzad was again defeated by the agents of the Argent Dawn. However, his phylactery was delivered to a false agent of the Brotherhood. We have yet to discover who stole his phylactery or why.

Pay attention. This is Instructor Razuvious, Kel'Thuzad's appointed trainer of all death knights. It is said that his own technique is so potent, only a disciple of his could possibly withstand his might.

Gothik, the Harvester. A master of necromancy and conjuration, Gothik is said to be able to beckon forth legions of the undead at a moment's notice. It is with his guidance that even the weakest of Death Knights can raise the dead.
The most powerful death knights within Naxxramas are the four horsemen. They represent the pinnacle of Kel'Thuzad's guard. The first, Thane Korth'azz, holds the power of flame.
The next, Lady Blaumeux, calls forth the power of shadows, drawing the souls of the living into the voracious embrace.
Sir Zeliek, a paladin in life, so strong in his faith, that even in undeath, the power of the light still heeds his call, smiting his foes in battle.

The final death knight, Lord Mograine, was the finest warrior that the death knights had ever seen. However, after the events in Azeroth, he vanished without a trace. It is yet to be seen who Kel'Thuzad has appointed in his place.

Behold, Patchwerk. When word of his existence first reached the ears of the Brotherhood, none believed the tales of an abomination with such immense speed and strength. Fewer still believed it when he fell the first time...

Grobbulus, the first of what was to be an army of flesh giants. It carried the plague slime of Naxxramas within its body, injecting the living ooze into the bodies of its foe. The recipient of this foul injection would usually flee to his allies, bringing them down with him.

Gluth, the foul plague-dog of Naxxramas, was said to have an appetite so voracious that even the living were not enough to satisfy his hunger. Feugen was said to feed him an army of zombies daily, recycling the remains of undead too weak to use in combat.
Thaddius, built from the flesh of women and children, it is said that their souls are fused together - eternally bound within that foul prison of flesh.

Anub'Rekhan, one of the finest Spider Lords of Azjol'Nerub, was brought under the control of the Scourge when he and his former commander, Anub'arak, were finally defeated by Lich King many years ago. It is said that he was the most loyal of Anub'arak's commanders.
The Grand Widow Faerlina, a botanist in life, breeder and caretaker of arachnids in death, she overseers the spider wing, developing the most potent of poisons for the Lich King.

Maexxna, born deep within the mountains of Northrend many ages ago, she was captured within the dread citadel Naxxramas, where she gives birth to her brood, feeding them the corpses of all who dare venture too deeply into Naxxramas.

Behold, Noth the Plaguebringer. Responsible for the creation of the process that distills the souls of the living and places them within the cold cage of undeath, Noth was observed to be refining this process even now.
Observe, Heigan the Unclean. The mastermind behind the plague cauldrons that turned the wilderness of Azeroth into the Plaguelands.
It is said that Heigan has rigged the very walls and floors of Naxxramas itself with a vast array of traps, which he can trigger at will.
Loatheb. The hideous result of fusing the living plague of the Plaguelands with the bog beasts of Azeroth, Loatheb is said to control the power of healing itself.

27788.text: I was almost ghoul bait! Thanks for the rescue!
It's a good thing you came along, ally! We were done for!
Thanks for the cover fire! It's a MADHOUSE down there!
Wow, I thought I was a goner! Thanks, friend!

27842.text: Bat gizzards again for the gnomes tonight...
What do they expect, making the bats come in at that angle? Broken necks and gamey bat stew, that's what they get.
'We like the trees, Fenrick. They provide cover.' They won't let me chop them down, either.
I wonder how many reinforcements need to suffer injury before they allow us to chop down these idiotic trees. They're costing us a fortune in bats. Maybe I'll rig a harness or two...

27843.text: I'll flush her out, $N! You just be ready for her when she comes in!

27851.text: The walls of Frostmourne Cavern shudder and shake.

27857.text: Steel yourselves, soldiers. $n has provided us with the final piece of this puzzle. The dread lich, Thel'zan, will soon come out of hiding, only to be rendered powerless against us!
It is this phylactery - Thel'zan's phylactery - that is the key to victory!

27858.text: Honor, courage, compassion and justice! These were once the virtues you fought for as a cleric of the Argent Dawn, Thel'zan.
You dedicated your whole life to fighting the Scourge. You saw what they did to our beloved Lordaeron. The Lich King took everything from you!
So how, then, did Father Inigo Montoy, bastion of virtue for the Argent Dawn, become the embodiment of that which he hated most?
Now, be free and join the battle! Let us end this together!
You have saved Wintergarde! With Thel'zan's filth washed away, the 7th Legion will easily clean up the remaining Scourge. When you are done here, report to Angrathar!

27876.text: What are you talking about, Sergeant!
You have to believe me, I'm innocent!

27877.text: Mr. Perelli, have you seen any suspicious activity by men wearing dark robes in the last few weeks?
Mr. Perelli, have you seen any signs of the undead? Any information you can provide would be appreciated by Prince Arthas.
Mr. Perelli, I know you travel around quite a bit hawking your goods. Surely you've heard rumors or information about the Scourge?
Do you plan on leaving the area soon if we have further questions?
Mr. Perelli, have these goods been under your supervision at all times?
You wouldn't happen to have any canned turtle soup from Hillsbrad, would you?
Mr. Perelli, if you happen across any signs of Scourge activity or shady dealings in your travels, let the nearest Lordaeron soldier know.
You don't mind me checking out your merchandise for signs of tampering, do you?
Wait, what is this? You've been holding out on me, Perelli!
I'm confiscating this suspicious grain, Perelli. We were looking for signs of tampered food, and it would be in your best interest to stay put while Prince Arthas checks this out.
We'll see about that, Perelli. We'll see about that.

27884.text: Oh hello, Jena. Of course you can borrow some grain. Help yourself.

27885.text: Let's see, we had chicken last night.
I've got plenty of cured bacon, but he had some for breakfast.
I need to make something healthy for him, he's still not recovered from that illness from last week.
Strawberries! Oh wait, they're not in season.
Ah, I'll make him some fresh bread! I need to get some flour from Martha!
Martha, I'm out of flour for bread. You wouldn't happen to have any grain from that recent shipment, would you?
Thanks, Martha! I owe you one.
Martha, something's wrong with this grain! Some of the Prince's soldiers were looking for this. I'm going to go look for one.

27887.text: Here ya go, friend! Icehammer is right inside that vrykul building! Give 'em hell!

27891.text: Looks like a storm's coming in, Scruffy...
This is no good, Scruffy. Stay here and guard the house, I need to go find a soldier.

27899.text: Hey there, $n, don't be alarmed. It's me... you... from the future.  I'm here to help.
Heads up... here they come. I'll help as much as I can. Let's just keep them off of the hourglass!
I can't believe that I used to wear that.
Look at you fight; no wonder I turned to drinking.
What? Am I here alone. We both have a stake in this, you know!
No matter what, you can't die, because that would mean that I would cease to exist, right? But, I was here before when I was you. I'm so confused!
Wow, I'd forgotten how inexperienced I used to be.
Sorry, but Chromie said that I couldn't reveal anything about your future to you. She said that if I did, I would cease to exist.
Wish I could remember how many of the Infinite Dragonflight were going to try to stop you. This fight was so long ago.
Listen. I'm not supposed to tell you this, but there's going to be this party that you're invited to. Whatever you do, DO NOT DRINK THE PUNCH!

27903.text: Ok, enough work for now. Time for refreshments and a little conversation in the inn.
Can't be me, I took a bath 3 days ago!
Oh, close call. It's just the grain here.
Wait a second. Grain isn't supposed to smell like THAT! I better go find a guard.

27907.text: I'm going to lose my on time bonus because of this!
I wasn't even supposed to be here today!
Well, guess I should load everything back into the cart.
Oh, come on! My cart broke, my horse lost a shoe, and now the cargo goes bad!
I guess I'll go find the authorities. If I'm lucky they'll tell me it's the plague and that we're all going to die.

27913.text: All soldiers of Lordaeron should immediately report to the entrance of Stratholme, and await further orders from Prince Arthas.
Scourge forces have been spotted near the King's Square fountain!
Scourge forces have been spotted near the Market Row Gate!
Scourge forces have been spotted near the Festival Lane Gate!
Scourge forces have been spotted near the Elder's Square Gate!
Scourge forces have been spotted near the Town Hall!

27914.text: I have arrived. Shall we set to work, then?

27915.text: Good work with the crates! Come talk to me in front of Stratholme for your next assignment!
Come over here time traveller, we need to talk!

27923.text: Hang on to your hat, $n! To Scalawag we go!
YAAARRRRR! Here we be, matey! Scalawag Point!
