27928.text: You can leave my sight, squire, before I slay you. Again.
Get away from me, Edwards, lest I behead you.

27933.text: Enjoy the ride! It's a one way trip!

27951.text: Kill them Abbendis! Do not fail me!
The grand admiral studies you a moment through narrowed eyes.
I will see you in Icecrown, weakling... if you live that long!

27975.text: You shouldn't have come... now you will die!
Why must it be this way?
I hope you all rot! I never... wanted... this.
So much lost time... that you'll never get back!

27978.text: Soft, vulnerable shells. Brief fragile lives. You cannot escape the curse of flesh!
Flesh is no match for iron!
Armies of iron will smother the world!
Loken will not rest... until the forge is retaken! You change... nothing!

27986.text: It's got my vote! That'll put hair on your chest like nothing else will.
What a fight you missed, Dorian! It was one for the ages!
There we were, riding into battle at full speed on the back of Stampy...
Well, lad, you can start by readin' The Green Hills of Stranglethorn. Then, maybe you can join me on one of my safaris. What do you say?

27987.text: Over here, to the southeast. I see they got you, too...

27990.text: You're too late, $n. Another visitor from Dalaran came asking after information about the same prismatic dragon blades.
From your description, I'm certain that the book I loaned our visitor could allow you to easily identify the weapon.
I'm afraid you'll have to ask the -- Well, perhaps Kalecgos can help.
$n may have found the remains of a prismatic blade, Kalecgos. Will you offer your help to our visitor?
You believe our allies will not be able to control the power of the swords?
Please, mortal, speak with Arcanist Tybalin in Dalaran. He may be able to negotiate with the Sunreavers for access to the book.
Please, mortal, seek out Magister Hathorel in Dalaran. He might be able to negotiate with the Silver Covenant for access to the book.
Rest assured, Kekek, she is the queen of the dragons. We often take the forms of smaller beings when we work with them.

27996.text: Across this vast expanse rest the bones of my ancestors. Their spirits have ascended to the Chamber of the Aspects.
Galakrond was the progenitor of dragonkind. It was from Galakrond that the Titans shaped the five Aspects.
It truly is a shame that the blue dragonflight has chosen such a heartless, cold path. It pains me greatly to do battle with Malygos's children.
The queen and her council have been speaking lately of a disaster at Ulduar. Something has happened in Storm Peaks!
Today is a good day, friend. Long has it been since I have left Wyrmrest Temple, free to fly across the great Dragonblight.
What the Scourge has done here will reverberate throughout our world. The aberrations must be stopped!
You must remember that I have yet to mature into an elder wyrm. I must eat to renew my strength!
I have been called back to Wyrmrest, ally. Farewell!

28006.text: Faster, dogs! We mustn't relent in our assault against the interlopers!
Soon, the bones of Galakrond will rise from their eternal slumber and wreak havoc upon this world!
Hear me, minions! Hear your lord, Antiok! Double your efforts or pay the consequences of failure!
The Lich King demands more frost wyrms be sent to Angrathar! Meet his demands or face my wrath!
Attackers are upon us! Let none through to this ancient grave!
You think you've won, mortal? Face the unbridled power of Antiok!
The Scythe of Antiok drops to the ground!

28012.text: The trickster Mage-Lord Urom protects the third ring.  He will appear alone and defenseless, but do not be fooled by appearances!  Urom is a powerful conjurer who commands a menagerie of Phantasmal creatures.  Seek him out above.
Your greatest challenge lies ahead.  Ley-Guardian Eregos is a Blue dragon of immense power. You will find him flying above the uppermost ring.

28016.text: Ahh,  Back in Drak'Tharon at last!
Drakuru casts his gaze down on Drak'Tharon Keep.
For your efforts, you be gettin' da greatest of rewards....
Be still, friend, and behold da truth of things!
With da help of these mortals, dis region been cleansed of all who oppose us.
Forgive my deception, mon. It all been for your own good.
Ya needed ta prove yer worthiness....
I be needin' worthy underlings in Zul'Drak, mon. Ones ready to wield real power.
You see for yourself now. Da Lich King be generous to dem who obey.
Follow dis path, mon, and soon you be tastin' immortality!

28030.text: There is no escape. There is only my wrath!
Beg for your life. Plead. It will do you no good!
Burn in the fires of my fury!
You killed me and now I will kill you... over and over!

28033.text: Finally, we have the parts to repair the Spirit of Gnomeregan.
Let's see, just a tweak here and an adjustment there...
And there she is, the Spirit of Gnomeregan!
You can use her, but I don't want to hear any complaints about saw blades in your seat. I had to fix 'er with what we could find.

28041.text: Careful here, $c. These trolls killed their own snake god!
Watch your back. These Drakkari are a nasty lot.
These Drakkari are just bad news. We need to leave and head to Justice Keep!
I wonder where we're headed to. And who's going to deal with these guys?
Right. I'd better get back to the sergeant then.

28047.text: I'm always up for something of Grimbooze's.
Well, so far, it tastes like something my wife would drink...
Now, there's the kick I've come to expect from Grimbooze's drinks! I like it!

28054.text: Ouch! That's it, I quit the target business!
My ear! You grazed my ear!

28068.text: The mojo of Sseratus is ours. Now all will be crushed under the might of the Drakkari!
They dare attack us? The fools! Do they not know we are now all-powerful?!
Kill these invaders who dare to defile our altar!
Finish them and then we will move south to kill their brethren!
With the power of the wild gods burning in our veins, none, not even the Lich King, can stand in our way!
I see you, insect! Come closer.
I will destroy the Argent Crusade! I will crush the Scourge!

28070.text: Now that's earnin' your supper!
Press on; that's the way!
Keep it up now. Plenty of death-dealing for everyone!
I'm all kinds of busted up... might not... make it.
Not yet... not ye--
I'm doin' everything I can!
Light preserve ye!
I hope this is all worth it!
Time to get some answers! Let's get this show on the road!
Don't worry! Ol' Brann's got yer back! Keep that metal monstrosity busy, and I'll see if I can't sweet talk this machine into helping ye!
This is a wee bit trickier than before... Oh, bloody--incomin'!
What in the name o' Madoran did THAT do? Oh! Wait: I just about got it...
Ha, that did it! Help's a-comin'! Take this, ya glowin' iron brute!
Take a moment and relish this with me. Soon... all will be revealed. Okay then, let's do this!
Now keep an eye out! I'll have this licked in two shakes of a--
Oh, that doesn't sound good. We might have a complication or two...
Ah, you want to play hardball, eh? That's just my game!
Couple more minutes and I'll--
Heightened? What's the good news?
So that was the problem? Now I'm makin' progress...
Hang on! Nobody's gonna' be sanitized as long as I have a say in it!
Ha! The old magic fingers finally won through! Now let's get down to--
Purge? No no no no no.. where did I-- Aha, this should do the trick...
Query? What do you think I'm here for, tea and biscuits? Spill the beans already!
Tell me how the dwarves came to be, and start at the beginning!
Right, right... I know the earthen were made from stone to shape the deep regions o' the world. But what about the anomalies? Matrix non-stabilizin' and what-not?
Necrowhatinthe-- Speak bloody Common, will ye?
Old Gods, huh? So they zapped the earthen with this Curse of Flesh... and then what?
If they killed the Old Gods, Azeroth would've been destroyed...
What protectors?
Aesir and Vanir... Okay, so the Forge o' Wills started makin' new earthen... but what happened to the old ones?
Hold everything! The Aesir and Vanir went to war? Why?

This "Loken" sounds like a nasty character. Glad we don't have to worry about the likes o' him anymore. So... if I'm understandin' ye right, the original earthen eventually woke up from this stasis, and by that time the destabili-whatever had turned 'em into proper dwarves. Or at least... dwarf ancestors.
Well, now... that's a lot to digest. I'm gonna need some time to take all this in. Thank ye.
Loken?! That's downright bothersome... We might've neutralized the iron dwarves, but I'd lay odds there's another machine somewhere else churnin' out a whole mess o' these iron vrykul!
I'll use the forge to make batches o' earthen to stand guard... But our greatest challenge still remains: find and stop Loken!
I think it's time to see what's behind the door near the entrance. I'm going to sneak over there, nice and quiet. Meet me at the door and I'll get us in.

28077.text: Dumb big-tongue lover! You not friend of Frenzyheart no more. Frenzyheart will get you good.

28090.text: We'll cleanse this place! Arthas beware!
You're right! We can do this!
You're right! What was I thinking? Bring on the Scourge!

28095.text: No! You steal kill! Now you owe Gekgek!
Dumb! Don't shoot at it! Gekgek want trophy in one piece!
No let it get away! We got it this time.
Careful! No let it scratch you like last time.
Ahh! It's coming right for us!

28103.text: Urgreth begins to emanate a powerful dark energy!

28105.text: My treasure! You no steal from Tartek, dumb big-tongue traitor thing.
Tartek and nasty dragon going to kill you! You so dumb.

28113.text: Please take... my shinies. All done...
We not do anything... to them... I no understand.
Use my shinies... make weather good again... make undead things go away.
We gave shinies to shrine... we not greedy... why this happen?
I do something bad? I sorry....
Maybe you make weather better too?
You save us! Yay for you!
The mosswalker victim groans in pain.

28115.text: You feel a massive jolt of energy as your body binds with that of Soo-holu.

28116.text: You feel rage rise within you as your body binds with Kartak.

28118.text: I will add your watery innards to my own.

28120.text: Maybe more shiny bugs! We like bugs!
Treasure for Lafoo! Treasure for shrine!
That weird. Someone took our bugs. You have maybe?
One day maybe you can be Soo-dryskin. Like?
You have pie? Someone gave us pie year ago. Really yummy.
Never met Great Ones. Nope, just met their shrines.
Home good, but not stay long! More adventures!

28121.text: Shiny things! Shiny things! Not as shiny as my crystal, but still shiny!
More treasures! Treasures of all kinds! Yay treasures!
Can never have too many shiny crystals! Nope!
We are fast digger! Really fast! See... all done! That was fast, huh?
You like that? Bet not! Bet not cause you dead! Hahah!
Vic...tor...ious! Dun nun nun dun da da!
Killing Spree!
Mistcaller really good at controlling weather with shrine. They know just which crystals to use! Really good!
Ever trip over own feet? We have. Kind of hurt. No do it, not fun. Nope.
Want us to help with something? What we help with? We good at helping.
Hello! You're pretty strong and nice and stuff. I like you. Lets stay friends, okay?
Misty. Very misty. Seem sort of misty to you? Maybe not so much.
Lets go jump off tree! Fun fun!
Chase the hatchlings! Chase the hatchlings! So fast!
Great Ones keep home safe because they like Oracles I think! They know we good and nice.
Home home home... place of the shinies!
We know you have dragon thing! We not scared! We going to get you and dragon thing!
Teach you to steal our treasures! Our treasures are... ours, okay?!
Time to hide puppy-men! We coming for you... better get in your hill things!
Tartek no match for you! You got the skills. Yeah!

28122.text: What the heck are shiny rabbits doing here anyway?
Here I am, digging up some useless bauble from the ground at the will of someone I just recently met... does that seem right to you?
Hey... maybe we'll find some more useless bugs.
Yay... more dirt.
I can't believe... they're all... dead.
Another falls to our onslaught.
There some reason why we're still here? I'd love to hear it.
Yeah, let's go now.
I'm done here.
Going to go take a nap? I apologize in advance for accidentally stepping on your face while you sleep.
Planning to sit on your butt some more, or are we going to go do something that's actually useful?
I'm the most intelligent, strongest, most cultured gorloc here, yet Soo-say calls all the shots... does that seem right to you?
Soo-say didn't look into anything when the mosswalkers mentioned strange weather, now they're all dead... does that seem right to you?
I know I talk down to them, but I never want to see any of my people die.
It's good to see some of the mosswalker were more resilient than I thought.
It's hard to believe any of them survived this.
There are more that might still be alive! We need to keep moving.
Where are they dragging those bodies? What are they doing to them?
This fight's all yours!
It's a small comfort to see that they haven't brought any back in undeath.

28136.text: Thank you, friend. Were it not for your aid I would be no more.
<sigh>... This is the end of me.

28142.text: <sigh>... Well, I suppose it could be worse.
<sigh>... This is the end of me.

28148.text: I am in your debt, friend. Thank you for my life.

28160.text: I'll send you on my flying machine. Keep your eyes peeled for clues about what might've happened to Hemet!

28167.text: Prince Arthas, may the light be praised! Many people in the town have begun to fall seriously ill, can you help us?

28175.text: Never heard of it. Looks like pure evil.
Let's see how it holds up to the might of my axe!
What the? My reaper didn't even scratch it! That's the toughest ore I've ever seen!

28176.text: Let us see if it is truly impervious.

28177.text: By the Goddess. It's as if Nature can't touch it!

28178.text: Fine. Just remember though, the power of the Holy Light isn't something to be invoked casually, brother.

28179.text: The Lich King reacted swiftly to the breach. Faster than I anticipated.
What would you have me do, Darion?
Choose your words wisely, death knight. You stand amidst the company of the devoted.
We will do this with honor, Darion. We will not sink to the levels of the Scourge to be victorious. To do so would make us no better than the monster that we fight to destroy!

28189.text: My liege, the infiltration and control of the Alliance power structure by our cultists is well underway.
The power you've bestowed upon me has granted me great mental influence over human minds.  I bear these offerings as proof of my progress.
Allow me to take care of the intruders, lord.  I will feed their entrails to the maggots.

28205.text: Hmmm, I think it's time for...
We're nearly there. Find me some...
Coming along nicely, but still needs...
Before it thickens, we must add...
Before it boils over, I need...
You're too late. I must start again from the beginning....

28210.text: Let's wrap it up, Miz. They'll be here in a second.

28213.text: The %s screams with rage and rushes to the aid of her babies.

28214.text: Home! You better have brought back meat for Goregek, slave.
Goregek get some sleep. Go bring foodstuffs back, slave thing.
Goregek go get drink. You sit in corner til Goregek ready.
Goregek hungry. Go get on fire spit, slave thing. Tell Goregek when you well roasted.
Gorgek gonna catch chicken good!
You wait until Goregek ready.
You wait, slave thing. Goregek eating.
Goregek best hunter... ever.
Hah! Goregek's kill!
Next time, maybe Goregek let you try.
I stabbed it in the face! Goregek so good.
Squeal! Squeal! So good!
Frenzyheart the strongest!
That how it done, slave thing. Maybe you figure out how someday.
Why Goregek even bring you. You useless.
Elder maybe says other stuff, but you always be slave thing to Goregek.
Pitch was weakling anyway... why else you think Goregek not bother with him?
You just get yourself beat up! Hah! You so dumb, slave thing.
Careful slave thing, the big bad softnuckles might eat you! Hah!
Hardknuckles still walk on hands... seem kind of dumb to Goregek.
Run away dumb softknuckle! We gonna poke you more!
Run away softknuckle! Goregek gonna get you!
You just watch slave thing, Goregek take care of these hardknuckles!
Better not get in Goregek's way!
Get out of way silly slave thing! Goregek's kill!
There was hundreds of times these hardknuckles before Goregek.
Hah! Goregek the greatest hunter ever! Goregek get biggest hardknuckle!
Frenzyheart feed Kartak big-tongues so Kartak not eat us. That why we smarter than you, slave thing.

28215.text: Frenzyheart came here not long ago for new home... big-tongue homes pretty nice, so we maybe take those too. They ugly anyway.
Lot of strong Frenzyheart here. Dajik taught most of them. First time I teach something like you though. You not a Frenzyheart, you know.
Let's just eat bristlepine instead, okay? All done with chasing.
There reason Frenzyheart not chase back chickens. Look kind of dumb to lose to chicken.
Maybe you not notice, chicken move kind of fast.
Time for more smart Dajik tip! If Goregek let chickens out again, make Goregek get chickens back again.
I placed most of the spikes. Good amount of pointiness I think. You like?
Oh! Dajik has idea! Make chicken sounds and maybe they come to you!
Get the stuff off of body! Dajik hate it when he go skin something and there stuff in the way. So annoying.
Did you see face? Looked so scared, "Ah, big thing going to smash me!" Hah.
Hah! Maybe you learn a little after all!
Yes! Stab few more time just in case! Stab good!
Not sure how thing got here. Not matter if dead though.
We came for something, yes? Can't remember.
Make sure you not forget anything. I forgot stuff once.
Dajik not think he seen you eat anything. You eat sometimes, yeah?
I was going draw picture of best attack plan... but you have my chalk.
Time for more smart Dajik tip! Make sure thing dead before reach in mouth for loots.
Seem like there more wasps every time Dajik come back. Why they not run out?
Time for more smart Dajik tip! Try not to catch stinger with face. Not work so much.
In case you wonder, wasp sting not feel so good. No need to try.
Drone things not as tough as they look. Wasp things a bit nastier.
Time for more smart Dajik tip! Try not to catch stinger with face. Not work so much.
No! You killed queen thing! What have you... wait, nevermind. Sorry, that okay.
Dajik's last learner eaten by sand-thing. We do better this time though!
This not first queen slain by Frenzyheart. Seem like there always more.
Sometimes big-tongues try to come get crystals. Not now because they not like it when we kill them.
Time for more smart Dajik tip! Crystals work little too good for back scratch. No try.
Something big make pillars and crystals and everything. Frenzyheart not care much cause it not here anymore.
If you here to poke more softknuckles, Dajik going to poke you too. That a bad Goregek habit.
Huh... where are we? This not right. I not tell you find hardknuckles, did I?
Time for more smart Dajik tip! Lot of dead things mean lot of chance of being dead thing. Dajik leaving now.
Dead thing there already learn lesson of broken pillar. Leave this lesson for dumb, dead things. Going home now.
You all done with learning! Yup! All done! Dajik leave you and evil red pillar thing now.

28216.text: Dajik tried to show me ways of hunt, but I do better when I do things my way.
Bring back good meat and the camp treat you like high-shaman for a day. Good deal.
You should go let chickens out again and say Goregek did it. Never get old.
I not in a big hurry. We can rest here a while if want.
I not live here always... I traveled lot of world on my own not long ago. I like all the stories of beasts and dragons and gods and stuff.
Elder Harkek pretty good Frenzyheart. He help me a lot when I was littler and not liking Dajik.
Hahah! You see that? Lightning bolt hit him right in the head!
BOOM! That so good! More! More!
Zap!
We need to do this more often! This so funny... lightning hitting big-tongues everywhere!
Good one! It not even see it coming.
Hah! Leave some for Zepik too.
No more play?
Flame! Death! Destruction! The black fire rages within my heart! I must... release it! Hahah!
May not be great hunt, but this still fun after so many time.
You think they learn to keep Goregek away from chickens.
Goregek never "stumble" into chicken hut... Goregek always have to feed his dumb belly. Always one chicken missing when we catch them all.
You chickens are tougher than I thought! I'll have to improvise!
You pretty good! Natural at hunt, like me.
Goregek think he the boss of everyone, but he eat too much and hunt too little.
Dajik forget what he doing, where he at... sometime even forget his own name. Make him not so good teacher sometimes.
You ever fought big dragon or god or anything? Zepik like hearing stories.
Hah! This the fun part!
Eat it big-tongues!
Trust me - you going love this!
That lake near here actually full of sea things. Not sure how it all get here... maybe in floods?
I think one reason I like hunting big-tongues so much... they not as dumb as the other hunts. They give a real fight.
Mist big-tongues are smart with their shrine thing sometimes... cover whole area with mist and it get hard to find any.
Careful of big mistcaller guy... Zepik fought him once and barely got away. He lot stronger than rest of big-tongues here.
Enjoy ride! Call me when you get there.
My kind not welcome at broken pillar. I going back to hill - find me when you done.
Many Frenzyheart lost at broken pillar. Today is not Zepik's day to be lost too.
I thought about tricking big-tongues to come here, but it too dangerous for me. You have good luck and I meet you back at hill.
Bad plan to come here... many more adventures to be had before I risk this place. Be safe... I meet you later.
Not sure if you notice, but there rumbling sometimes from the water in the big hole. I think there something down there.
Big-tongues don't usually come down here anymore... I had a big fight and killed lots.
I always wonder where all the water go... doesn't make sense.
Vekjik likes finding big-tongues that wander too far to throw in the basin. He help me trap some of the dumb ones. You should watch him sometime... it pretty funny actually.
Battle here been going on for a while... these spark big-tongues have a lot more fight than the other ones.
Big-tongues here worship shrine, like at other places, but this shrine sometimes have a guardian. Careful if it shows up.
Feels good to hunt with a not dumb hunter. You good at this.
Maybe I not be the only one big-tongues fear much longer. You scary when in the fight.
Gorlocs are the bad-guys, just so you know.
I hope you planning something secret involving that big-tongue ending up dead.
If I step on its tail, it was an accident.
Normally I kill these things. You know that, yeah?
I not so happy about traveling with big-tongues.
I see what you doing... maybe if we treat it nice it will lead us back to more big-tongues.
Good to stay away from Kartak. He only a friend of Frenzyheart so long as we keep his belly full... and he's got a big belly.
I teach myself a lot of my big-tongue hunt here. Lot to kill.
Something about sound of battle make this place more relaxing than main hill.
Not mentioned much, but Kartak ate dozen Frenzyheart before became "friend."
Ever met Tartek? He one of our best fighters... leads in the northwest. I hear he captured one of the dragon things. No lie, I a little jealous.
Shaman Jakjek is quiet for a Frenzyheart, but still very strong. He probably the only reason Kartak not turned on more of us.

28217.text: The Injured Rainspeaker Oracle rises clumsily to its feet.
You tell us when it home time.

28229.text: More intruders? You'll soon learn, no one messes with the Venture Company!

28244.text: Now we will see why this ore is so important to the Scourge.
Korfax, what can you tell from this saronite?
Rayne, Rimblat, what about the power of nature and the elements?
Clearly this is getting us nowhere. We need to get this saronite to Highlord Fordring for further study.
Thank you for trying, my friends. We'll unlock its secrets. Hopefully before it's too late.

28256.text: So the oracle has decided to aid you, outlander. Very well, I will offer you what I know.
Your companion seeks the shardhorn patriarch Farunn, who holds himself aloof from his brothers.
Farunn walks the lands north of what your people call the Bittertide Falls. You will find him alone, but you will see he requires no defenders.
Return to your companion. Tell him to go forth and claim his prize in Farunn.
Once he has done so, tell him to leave this land in peace. He does not belong here.

28284.text: Oh, these are sticky! I wonder how they shoot the webbing?
ACK! Oh no, I webbed myself! It's sticky. MY HAIR!
Okay! Let me just see if I can fashion these disgusting parts into something useful.

28313.text: Yes, yes, we should do whatever we can to help them.
Longrunner, your fodder... err, people will be a valuable resource against the vrykul. Did I say resource? I meant, 'ally.' n

28315.text: Frenzyheart kill you if you come back. You no welcome here no more!

28317.text: %s sniffs the air, catching the scent of something unusual.

28325.text: You hear a low guttural growl from nearby.

28327.text: Shaman Vekjik comes out of the underbrush nearby.
You help Rainspeaker! I saw you help Rainspeaker! Traitor thing!
If you want to be friends with big-tongues, you not friends with Frenzyheart! I tell village! We no trust you anymore!
Shaman Vekjik scurries off towards Frenzyheart Hill.

28328.text: The only thing hurt is your pride, lad. Buck up!
Stop whining. You've still got your luck.
Calm down, lad, it's just birdshot!
Remember, $n, this is no sprint. The true test of a hunter tests his endurance over the course of a long expedition.

28340.text: Ah, you've finally arrived Prince Arthas. You're here just in the nick of time.
There's no need for you to understand, Arthas. All you need to do is die.

28347.text: Wright, have you finished that new concoction you've been working on? I'm tired of these spores filling up my shop!
Then put twice as much in next time!
Remember, kid: You're always more wrong than you think you are. Double It!
Only put half as much in next time.
That's what you always say. Sometimes I think you're never going to finish that thing.
Greetings! Please have a look around.
Let me know if you need help finding anything, $c.
Welcome. May I help you find something?

28355.text: Sir, our customers are complaining that there's not enough Maiden's Anguish in our Deadly Poisons.
Sir, I think we were close with the Lethargy Root in that last poison recipe.
I'm working on it, I just don't want to sell it until I'm happy with it. It shouldn't be long.
Sir, our customers are complaining that there's too much Deathweed in our Anesthetics.

28357.text: The Lich King will be pleased with this initiate.
Amidst the wretch, a champion has been found.
CHAOS! DOOM! DESTRUCTION! This one will claim them all!
Marvel at its tenacity and vigor! A champion has been found!
A harbinger of death is reborn...
Place upon it the trappings befitting a herald of Arthas.n
Stand and be measured! Rise, for your master awaits your arrival. Go now!n
Listen, death knight... Listen for the voice of your master. He calls to you now.
This one has awoken too soon. It retains emotion and memory...
You have been measured and found wanting...n

28374.text: I'm not here to be the keeper of your hatchlings, Dorian. I'm doing research of my own, as well.
No, not the cogs! Anything but the cogs!

28376.text: Well, I don't know. I was here tending the fire and discussing the drawbacks of cogs with Zootfizzle. That's pretty epic, too, in its own way.
It's your lucky day, Zootfizzle. $n has brought more hatchlings for you.
Well, you can always go back to the camp and help Weslex with all his cogs...

28383.text: Rise, minions. Rise and feast upon the weak!

28391.text: I return from the grave to do my master's bidding.
The voice... such splendor... Arthas... My king....
Reborn, I shall become an instrument of doom...
Dark energy courses through me... Such power! I hunger for more!
Death to all that oppose us!
I live only to serve the Lich King!
Woe unto those that dare oppose the Scourge!
I am reborn, my king, only to serve you.
I am an instrument of your destruction, my king! Command me!
A thousand-thousand lives I will sacrifice for you, my lord.
I am yours to command, my king!
There will be no survivors, my lord.
My king, the world will tremble in reverence...

28394.text: Where am I? What is this place?
Who... who are you? Who... what am I?
I hurt... suffering unbearable... end my pain... I beg of you!
I... I have awoken to a nightmare?

28401.text: $n, please come to me.  I'm here in Zim'Torga now.

28406.text: Remember this day, $n, for it is the day that you will be thoroughly owned.
I'm going to tear your heart out, cupcake!
I'm going to tear your heart out, cupcake!
The Lich King will see his true champion on this day!

28415.text: I thought I was done for!
I am in your debt, friend.

28416.text: I will not simply lay here and allow you to slay me! You will have to earn your right to draw another breath if you want to kill me, mortal!

28444.text: %s calls upon the mighty armies of the Scourge!
Armies of the Scourge, hear my call! The scarlet apocalypse has begun! Tear this land asunder and leave only death in your wake!

28451.text: What a fight you missed, Dorian! It was one for the ages!
There we were, riding into battle at full speed on the back of Stampy...
Everything was shaking all over the place. I could hardly steady my gun.
And then we saw her, the fearsome beast!
It took all of $n's skill to maintain control of Stampy.
The battle was a haze of blood, lead, and sweat. The broodmother's attacks came faster and faster!
But, in the end, $n and I prevailed through our wits and teamwork. And now we have this glorious trophy as a memento of our victory.
Do I detect a bit of jealousy, Dorian?

28472.text: As disciples of blood, you strive to master the very lifeforce of your enemies.
Be it by blade or incantation, blood feeds our attacks and weakens our foes.
True masters learn to make blood serve more than just their strength in battle.
Stripping energy from our foes, both fighting and fallen, allows us to persevere where lesser beings fall exhausted.
And every foe that falls, energy sapped and stolen, only further fuels our assault.
As masters of blood, we know battle without end...
We know hunger never to be quenched...
We know power never to be overcome...
As masters of blood, we are masters of life and death itself.  Against us, even hope falls drained and lifeless.

28473.text: You leave your material body behind!

28474.text: Step forth disciple. Show me what you have learned.
It is time for your learning to be put to the test. Step forth.
Do not let the ice in your blood slow your step. Prove your prowess, disciple.
You have stood and listened long enough. Step forth.
Prove that you understand my teachings, disciple.
It is time for your challenge disciple. Use my teachings well.
Its spells would be less threatening if its incantations were slowed by your icy touch...
Do not let it consider its next spell so freely, disciple... freeze its mind.
You are not overwhelmed just yet disciple... let the hungering cold of death halt this onslaught.
Frozen solid, ripe for the slaughter. Let loose a howling blast and shatter them into pieces, disciple.
Do not be frightened child... welcome the cold embrace of death...
Such is the price of failure.
Death is the reward for your weakness.
You have more learning ahead of you disciple. Return to your studies.
You have learned well. Continue on your path, disciple.

28479.text: Gods of old, we beseech you. What must we do? How can we save the gods of this land?

28486.text: M-mistress... might I b-brush your mighty steed...?
M-mistress... may I p-polish your armor...?
M-mistress... did you n-need more corpse dust, p-perhaps...?

28494.text: Death to the Zandalari and their puppets! Nothing can stop us now!

28495.text: Kill them! Kill them all and take back Zim'Torga!

28496.text: Hah! You'll not get my treasure!

28498.text: Your betrayal of the Drakkari Empire has borne me a new army.
I charge you now with the cleansing of Zul'Drak, Drakuru.
Fail me and it shall be your undoing...
Succeed, and even greater power shall be yours!
It is you who should suffer. Be content that your death is a quick one....
I spare your insignificant life as a reward for this amusing betrayal. There may yet be a shred of potential in you.
When next we meet I shall require much more to justify your life.

28511.text: The Eye of Acherus launches towards its destination.
The Eye of Acherus is in your control.

28514.text: But try they must or all will be lost. The Drakkari will be the death of both themselves and their gods!

28515.text: The spotted one must be sought. Their fates are entwined.

28516.text: But she is chained. A way must be found to free her.

28517.text: To her altar this mortal must travel. What they must do will not be easy. In the end it may prove impossible.

28518.text: Not sure how ol' Nass always finds his way back here. Must be by smell....

28521.text: Let's go to Zul'Drak he says. We can get to the bottom of this mess, he says...
One more lock of scourge hair gained, one more shred of dignity lost....

28529.text: Scourge! Do not let it escape!

28534.text: It is not yet your time, champion. Rise! Rise and fight once more!

28546.text: You wish to confront the master? You must first weather the storm!
The slightest spark shall be your undoing.
Your spark of life is... extinguished.

28548.text: The pure of heart will be allowed to remain in New Avalon. Those that the inquisitors find bereft of the holy Light will be turned away.
SILENCE! The Light has not abandoned us! The Light is stronger than ever among the pure!
We fight! We push them back, just as we have always done!
We are sending crusaders to reclaim what is rightfully ours! Any Scourge that stand in our way will be turned to ashes.

28557.text: Ungh... I... I think I pooped...
I... I got a sick grandma at home... I... I'm all she's got, $g mister:miss;.
I picked the wrong week to quit drinkin'!
I've got five kids, $g man:lady;! They'll die without me!
You don't have to do this! Nobody has to die!
Don't kill me! I only took this job for the benefits!
Let me live! I'll do whatever you say!

Pressure's too high! Open the pressure valve!
The still needs heat! Light the brazier!
Good job! Keep your eyes open, now.
That'll do. Never know what it'll need next...
Nicely handled! Stay on your toes!
Well done! Be ready for anything!
It's no good! I'm shutting it down...
We've done it! Come get the cask.

28568.text: Tastes like I'm drinking... engine degreaser!

28575.text: If Rhunok regains his strength, we all die!
There are intruders about. Slay them before they ruin everything!
The bear god must be kept enfeebled so that the prophet can finish the ritual.

28586.text: I am the greatest of my father's sons! Your end has come!
GRAAAAAH! Behold the fury of iron and steel!
Defend yourself, for all the good it will do!
How can it be...? Flesh is not... stronger!

28587.text: It is you who have destroyed my children? You... shall... pay!
Nothing is wasted in the process. You will see....
Life from lifelessness... death for you.
I will crush you beneath my boots!
%s prepares to shatter his Brittle Golems!
The master was right... to be concerned.
The armies of iron will conquer all!
You have cost me too much work!

28601.text: Fool!  You led us to the only being that could stand up to our armies!  You will never bring the Etymidian back to Northrend!

I will present your head to Abbendis myself!

28646.text: Aggggh!  I'm hit!  You're going to have to get us back!  Quick, before the plane explodes!
28646.comment: Pilot Vic to Vic's Flying Machine

28659.text: Ah, the hero. Your little friends said you would come. This certainly saves me the trouble of hunting you down myself.
I have weathered a hundred years of war and suffering. Do you truly think it wise to pit your mortal body against a being that cannot die? I'd venture you have more to lose.
Even shattered into countless pieces, the crystals all around weaken me... perhaps I should not have underestimated the titans so...
These two brave, ignorant fools despise each other, yet somehow they both spoke of you as a hero. Perhaps you just lack the will to choose a side... let me extend you that opportunity.
Artruis is shielded. You must choose your side quickly to break his spell.
Arthas once mustered strength... of the very same sort... perhaps his is the path that you will follow.

28660.text: Where do you expect us to stay? New Avalon cannot hold all of us!
What does the Light say to you now, Abbendis!
What do we do? We've lost everything!

28662.text: I didn't see the Light step in to save my wife and children!
The stables and mill are left abandoned! What will happen to our horses?

28665.text: Thank you for saving me, $n. This is the least that I could do to return the favor. Hold on tight. Here we go.
This doesn't look good. Whatever you do, don't fall off. There's a ton of nasty things in there!
Oh no... Quetz'lun is dead! Stay still. We'll sneak past the prophet.
We're spotted! Hang on. We have to get out of here!
I think we're safe now. Let's get back!
We made it! Take care, $n, and thanks again!

28667.text: Now you not catch us with back turned! Now we hurt you bad undead. BAD!

28668.text: You going die big bad undead thing! You not catch Zepik sleeping this time!

28671.text: What is this you pathetic, little worm? Come to die?
I recognize your stench. You're the one who stealthed by me on the back of that snow leopard runt!
Wait... STOP! You can't take back the power!!!

28683.text: You'll be hanging at the gallows soon...
How many more of you do I need to send back to the Lich King in pieces before he'll stop?
And keep the change, ya filthy animal!
Perhaps you'll think twice about stealin' one of Kitrik's horses next time, eh?
What a colossal waste of time.
At least make me work for it next time.

28684.text: This kingdom belongs to the Scourge. Only the dead may enter!
I should be grateful... but I long ago lost the capacity....
Keep an eye on that tunnel. We must not let anyone through!
I hear footsteps. Be on your guard.
I sense the living. Be ready.
We are besieged! Strike out and bring back their corpses!
We must hold the gate. Attack! Tear them limb from limb!
The gate must be protected at all costs. Rip them to shreds!

28710.text: The engine's blown!  Fly Vic's Flying Machine back to Lakeside Landing!

Here, da self-righteous crusaders be standin' in da way of our goal. Dey will fall!
Dis all soon gunna belong to da Lich King!
Da Drakkari be destroyin' their lands! Dey gunna be losin' dem... soon, mon.
Ahh, dere be our destiny... Gundrak!
Study dis place well, mon. Ya gonna be helpin' me conquer it!
Ahh yeah, mon! Dere be great glory ta be had here!
Da Lich King be sharin' his power wit dem who serve him well, mon.
Come to me now, $n. I must be speakin' wit ya.

28785.text: I've returned to invite you to my housewarming in the underworld!
I'd say come along quietly, but we both know that's not going to happen. My little friend here is going to ease your way into the afterlife.
Well done. I'll see to it that my prophet enjoys his eternal stay with me.

28787.text: Let's get the hell out of here.
Listen up, Venture Company goons! Rule #1: Never keep the prisoner near the explosives.
Or THIS is what you get.
It's getting a little hot over here. Shall we move on?
Oh, look, it's another cartload of explosives! Let's help them dispose of it.
You really shouldn't play with this stuff. Someone could get hurt.
We made it! Thank you for getting me out of that hell hole. Tell Hemet to expect me!

28788.text: Impressive, death knight. Return to me in the world of the living for your reward.

28793.text: Your disguise doesn't fool me, fleshling! Your defeat will please Drakuru!

28841.text: Where'd this come from? I better get this down to the ships before the foreman sees it!
I'll just leave it here and nobody will be the wiser!

28846.text: The grave calls to us all!

That's number 10! How many've you got?
Number 9! I could do this with my eyes closed!
11! It's gonna take a bigger effort than that to beat ol' Drostan!
I'm up to 15. Top that!
That's my 16th and I'm still going easy on ya!
You're going to have to pick it up, or this isn't going to be much of a competition.
Ha! 16! How many've you got? 10, maybe 11 if you're lucky?
That's my 25th kill. How far behind are you now?
26th! Are you going to start killing, or what?
My mother could hunt faster than you, $n.
Kill number 26 and I'm still just warming up.
Well, now that I've got a nice lead, I think I'll enjoy a little nap.
Well, that was a relaxing nap. How's the game hunting going over there?
I've got a nice lead, yet. Think I'll do some fishin'.
Well, now we've got a competition on our hands.
Just got number 41! How's that for skill?
41! Two-thirds of the way there. Better step it up!
Hey! I was just lining up a shot on that one. Kill stealer!
Argh, just now getting number 48. This is getting tough.
Someone's been killing all the game out from under me. Hard-won number 48, here.
Number 48. Startin' to slow down a bit, now.
Gotta go elsewhere to find some more game. Was hoping to be beyond 48 by now.
Ha, 54! In the home stretch now!
Number 54! No way I'm gonna let you beat me!
54! Surely an insurmountable lead!
That was 54! Soon you'll be congratulating me!

28859.text: Lesser beings, intruding here! A shame that your excess courage does not compensate for your stupidity!
None but the blue dragonflight are welcome here. Perhaps this is the work of Alexstrasza? Well, then, she has sent you to your deaths!
What could you hope to accomplish? To storm brazenly into my domain... to employ magic... against ME?
I am without limits here. The rules of your cherished reality do not apply. In this realm, I am in control!
I give you one chance. Pledge fealty to me, and perhaps I will not slaughter you for your insolence.
My patience has reached its limit. I will be rid of you!
You will not succeed while I draw breath!
28859.comment: Malygos - Begin to cast Deep Breath

28859.text: Your stupidity has finally caught up with you!
More artifacts to confiscate.
How very naive.

I had hoped to end your lives quickly, but you have proven more... resilient than I anticipated. Nonetheless, your efforts are in vain. It is you reckless, careless mortals who are to blame for this war. I do what I must, and if it means your extinction.... then SO BE IT!!
Few have experienced the pain I will now inflict upon you!
I will teach you ignorant children just how little you know of magic.
Watch helplessly as your hopes are swept away!
Your energy will be put to good use.
I am the Spell-Weaver! My power is infinite!
Your spirit will linger here forever!
ENOUGH! If you intend to reclaim Azeroth's magic, then you shall have it!
Now your benefactors make their appearance, but they are too late! The powers contained here are sufficient to destroy the world ten times over. What do you think they will do to you?
Submit!
%s takes a deep breath...
The powers at work here exceed anything you could possibly imagine!
I am unstoppable!
Alexstrasza, another of your brood falls!
Little more than gnats!
Your red allies will share your fate!
Still standing? Not for long.
Your cause is lost!
Your fragile mind will be shattered!
Unthinkable! The mortals will destroy... everything! My sister, what have you...
%s fixes his eyes on you!
%s goes into a berserker rage!

28860.text: It is my charge to watch over these eggs. I will see you burn before any harm comes to them!
Shadron! Come to me! All is at risk!
Tenebron! The eggs are yours to protect as well!
Vesperon, the clutch is in danger! Assist me!
Such is the price... of failure....
Your charred bones will litter the floor!
How much heat can you take?
All will be reduced to ash!
You will make a fine meal for the hatchlings.
You are at a grave disadvantage.
This is why we call you lesser beings!

28873.text: We gunna drive all da scourge outta Zul'Drak, mon - startin' with you!
I come to avenge my bruddas, mon!

28890.text: Rise, minion. Rise and fly for the Scourge!
Is Gothik the Harvester going to have to choke a geist?

28902.text: You have an enchanted tiki? YOU KILLED MY FAMILY!

28907.text: The sky itself feeds upon the suffering of the conquered!n
The Scarlet Crusade is powerless to stop us!n
The corpses of those that try only serve to feed our expanding host!
The Scarlet fleet lies in ruin upon the sundered coast!n
With each enemy slain, our strength grows! We mustn't relent! n
The Lich King has spoken to each of you! Let his words resonate among you once more!
Leave no survivors in your wake, brothers and sisters!
With the approaching darkness comes the end of the Scarlet Crusade. You will battle once more! For the Scourge! For the Lich King!

28912.text: Damn the Crusade! I think my ribs are broken and I might be bleeding internally.
I'll need to get my runeblade and armor... Just need a little more time.
I'm still weak, but I think I can get an anti-magic barrier up. Stay inside it or you'll be destroyed by their spells.
Maintaining this barrier will require all of my concentration. Kill them all!
There are more coming. Defend yourself! Don't fall out of the anti-magic field! They'll tear you apart without its protection!
I can't keep this barrier up much longer... Where is that coward?
The High Inquisitor comes! Be ready, death knight! Do not let him draw you out of the protective bounds of my anti-magic field! Kill him and take his head!
Stay in the anti-magic field! Make them come to you!
Stand your ground! Use my anti-magic barrier to dampen their spells!
The death of the High Inquisitor of New Avalon will not go unnoticed. You need to get out of here at once! Go, before more of them show up. I'll be fine on my own.
I'll draw their fire, you make your escape behind me.
Your High Inquisitor is nothing more than a pile of meat, Crusaders! There are none beyond the grasp of the Scourge!

28913.text: What, Orbaz? That he's a blood elf?
In life we were hated enemies - this is true...
But in death... We are the children of the damned. The orphaned sons and daughters of the Scourge.

28914.text: His weakness led to his capture.
Only the strong should survive. Not to mention...

28922.text: The gate has been breached! Quickly, divert forces to deal with these invaders!

28923.text: I have witnessed the rise and fall of empires... the birth and extinction of entire species... Over countless millennia the foolishness of mortals has remained the only constant. Your presence here confirms this.
My master has shown me the future, and you have no place in it. Azeroth will be reborn in darkness. Yogg-Saron shall be released! The Pantheon shall fall!
What hope is there for you? None!
Come closer. I will make it quick.
Your flesh cannot hold out for long.
What little time you had, you wasted!
You stare blindly into the abyss!
Your ignorance is profound. Can you not see where this path leads?
You cross the precipice of oblivion!
My death... heralds the end of this world.
