HELP! HELP!
I'll give you anything you want! Just let me live!
I'm too young to die!
RUN FOR YOUR LIVES!
SCOURGE!!! RUN!!!
Somebody save me!
Spare my life, $n! Please!
The Scourge has broken through! RUN AWAY! RUN AWAY!
The... They promised that we'd be safe...
Is nowhere safe from these monsters?
We're all gonna die!!!
Filthy coward! Get it over with...
Scourge scum... May the Light purge you from this world!
Come then, $c!
Die Scourge dog! DIE!
DIE!
I won't go down that easy!
Is this the best the Scourge can do?
You may take my life, but you won't take my freedom!
You're not taking me without a fight!
I assure you this much, Quimby, you won't be getting my vote next term!
I want on that last ship! Don't leave us!
If you don't come out, we'll tear this place apart!
My whole family's been killed! Where was the army when we needed them most?
Naxxramas is gone? Who cares! Acherus is here now and the death knights are killing everybody!
No more lies, Quimby! We want answers!
QUIMBY!!!!!!
So much for the Scarlet 'paradise!'
The Scourge are running freely through the streets!
This is a slap in the face! We demand answers!
We were promised safety! Security!
We're done for! Save us, Quimby!
What's 'Crimson Dawn!' We deserve to know the truth, Quimby!
Where are those ships going, Quimby! Tell us the truth!
You're useless, Quimby!
Everybody is dying! Help us!

28942.text: Ask for anything and you shall have it! Just spare my life!
HELP! HELP!
I'll give you anything you want! Just let me live!
I'm too young to die!
RUN FOR YOUR LIVES!
SCOURGE!!! RUN!!!
Somebody save me!
Spare my life, $n! Please!
The Scourge has broken through! RUN AWAY! RUN AWAY!
The... They promised that we'd be safe...
Is nowhere safe from these monsters?
We're all gonna die!!!
Filthy coward! Get it over with...
Scourge scum... May the Light purge you from this world!
Come then, $c!
Die Scourge dog! DIE!
DIE!
I won't go down that easy!
Is this the best the Scourge can do?
You may take my life, but you won't take my freedom!
You're not taking me without a fight!
I assure you this much, Quimby, you won't be getting my vote next term!
I want on that last ship! Don't leave us!
If you don't come out, we'll tear this place apart!
My whole family's been killed! Where was the army when we needed them most?
Naxxramas is gone? Who cares! Acherus is here now and the death knights are killing everybody!
No more lies, Quimby! We want answers!
QUIMBY!!!!!!
So much for the Scarlet 'paradise!'
The Scourge are running freely through the streets!
This is a slap in the face! We demand answers!
We were promised safety! Security!
We're done for! Save us, Quimby!
What's 'Crimson Dawn!' We deserve to know the truth, Quimby!
Where are those ships going, Quimby! Tell us the truth!
You're useless, Quimby!
Everybody is dying! Help us!

28948.text: Ahh... there you are. The master told us you'd be arriving soon.
Please, follow me, $n. There is much for you to see....
Ever since his arrival from Drak'Tharon, the master has spoken of the time you would be joining him here.
You should feel honored. You are the first of the master's prospects to be shown our operation.
The things I show you now must never be spoken of outside Voltarus. The world shall come to know our secret soon enough!
Here lie our stores of blight crystal, without which our project would be impossible.
I understand that you are to thank for the bulk of our supply.
These trolls are among those you exposed on the battlefield. Masterfully done, indeed....
We feel it best to position them here, where they might come to terms with their impending fate.
The blight slowly seeps into their bodies, gradually preparing them for their conversion.
This special preparation grants them unique powers far greater than they would otherwise know.
Soon, the master will grant them the dark gift, making them fit to serve the Lich King for eternity!
Stay for as long as you like, $n. Glory in the fruits of your labor!
Your service has been invaluable in fulfilling the master's plan. May you forever grow in power....

28951.text: Greetings! Please have a look around.
Let me know if you need help finding anything, $c.
Welcome. May I help you find something?

28952.text: I'M FREE, LITTLE DRAKKARI. TIME TO PAY FOR YOUR MANY TRESSPASSES!

28989.text: Greetings! Please have a look around.
Welcome. May I help you find something?
Let me know if you need help finding anything, $c.

28994.text: Welcome. May I help you find something?
Let me know if you need help finding anything, $c.
Greetings! Please have a look around.

28996.text: And now, Akali, my master will have your blood and I will take some of your power as well!
It is done. Run back to your masters. Run back to Har'koa. Tell her that I am coming!

28997.text: Let me know if you need help finding anything, $c.
Greetings! Please have a look around.
Welcome. May I help you find something?

28998.text: Behold, mon! We be creatin' da greatest Scourge army ever seen!
These be da first of many! We shall sweep across Zul'Drak like da wind....
What treachery is this?! You be payin' for this deceit with your life, mon!
The Scepter of Domination glows brightly! Use it now!
How could dis be? Da Lich King said he be havin' great plans for you, mon...
Ya done turned your back on destiny, mon. Now you gunna die!
Fool! Ya coulda been havin' great power, mon!
Your betrayal not gunna be slowin' me down none, mon.
I shoulda known not to be trustin' nobody!
I never needed ya, mon. I can crush Zul'Drak without ya!
Dis foolish treachery has cost ya your destiny!
Master, dis mortal scum be double-crossin' us. Dey must be made to suffer!

29001.text: You have come seeking deliverance? I have come to deliver!

29011.text: Acolytes, chain them all up! Prepare them for questioning!
Scourge filth! By the Light be cleansed!
The Crusade will purge your kind from this world!
It seems that I'll need to deal with you myself. The High Inquisitor comes for you, Scourge!

29021.text: And yet we see only doom in your future. It is your destiny that you do this, $n, but we fear that the prophet is too powerful for you and your friends. Still, you must try.

29022.text: Once more we hear your call, Khufu. We have wisdom for you and $n. You face great peril and must act swiftly or you all and Har'koa will die.

29023.text: The gusty essence of deceased Quetz'lun's wardens must be gathered to draw him near. To Har'koa must both of these rarities be delivered.

29024.text: The unblemished heart of the guardian must be secured to show defiance and strength. Jealous Zim'Rhuk keeps those who harbor it.

29028.text: What is this? I recognize you from when I killed Akali. You must be this $n that everyone is dreading.
You don't worry me, $g boy : girl;. Just the opposite - I look forward to killing you. Nothing will stand between me and Zim'Torga now!
How sad that only now do you grasp the truth - I wield the power of a god. You are a mere mortal. You cannot hope to defeat me!
You've meddled in affairs that were none of your business. You are nothing but a foreign invader. Prepare to die!
The prophet begins to cast a ritual of annihilation.
Very well, kitten. I see no need to delay your inevitable demise. I look forward to dealing with you just as soon as I finish off this fool!
NO! I will not be defeated!

29032.text: Come to finish the job, have you?
You'll look me in the eyes when...
$n, I'd recognize those horns anywhere... What... What have they done to you, $n?
You don't remember me, do you? Blasted Scourge... They've tried to drain you of everything that made you a righteous force of reckoning. Every last ounce of good... Everything that made you a tauren!
Think, $n. Think back. Try and remember the rolling plains of Mulgore, where you were born. Remember the splendor of life, $g brother:sister;. You were a champion of the tauren once! This isn't you.

Listen to me, $n. You must fight against the Lich King's control. He is a monster that wants to see this world - our world - in ruin. Don't let him use you to accomplish his goals. You were once a hero and you can be again. Fight, damn you! Fight his control!
There... There's no more time for me. I'm done for. Finish me off, $n. Do it or they'll kill us both. $n... Remember Mulgore. This world is worth saving.
Do it, $n! Put me out of my misery!

29043.text: Who wants to see Rejek's new helmet?
Rejek like! If helmet scares pups, Rejek can't wait to see what it does to big-tongue cowards!
Still warm, just the way Rejek likes it.
Rejek feel strong! Rejek crush big-tongue skulls between his hands!
Rejek and $n will teach the enemies of the Frenzyheart to fear us!

29050.text: YOU KEEP YOUR FILTHY DRAKKARI HANDS OFF OF THEM!
I THINK NOT. YOU WILL DROP YOUR IMMUNITY, CEASE YOUR RITUAL NOW AND RELEASE THEM!
Thank you. Once again you have saved us all. I will see you back at Zim'Torga.

29053.text: What's going on in there? What's taking so long, $n?

29061.text: Come to finish the job, have you?
$n, I'd recognize that face anywhere... What... What have they done to you, $n?
You don't remember me, do you? Blasted Scourge... They've tried to drain you of everything that made you a righteous force of reckoning. Every last ounce of good... Everything that made you a human!

Think, $n. Think back. Try and remember the hills and valleys of Elwynn, where you were born. Remember the splendor of life, $g brother:sister;. You were a champion of the Alliance once! This isn't you.

Listen to me, $n. You must fight against the Lich King's control. He is a monster that wants to see this world - our world - in ruin. Don't let him use you to accomplish his goals. You were once a hero and you can be again. Fight, damn you! Fight his control!
There... There's no more time for me. I'm done for. Finish me off, $n. Do it or they'll kill us both. $n... Remember Elwynn. This world is worth saving.
Do it, $n! Put me out of my misery!

29065.text: Come to finish the job, have you?
$n, I'd recognize that face anywhere... What... What have they done to you, $n?

You don't remember me? When you were a child your mother would leave you in my care while she served at the Temple of the Moon. I held you in my arms and fed you honey and sheep's milk to calm you until she would return. You were my little angel. Blasted Scourge... What have they done to you, $n?
You must remember the splendor of life, $g brother:sister;. You were a champion of the kaldorei once! This isn't you!

Listen to me, $n. You must fight against the Lich King's control. He is a monster that wants to see this world - our world - in ruin. Don't let him use you to accomplish his goals. You were once a hero and you can be again. Fight, damn you! Fight his control!
There... There's no more time for me. I'm done for. Finish me off, $n. Do it or they'll kill us both. $n... Remember Teldrassil, our beloved home. This world is worth saving.
Do it, $n! Put me out of my misery!

29067.text: Come to finish the job, have ye?
Well this son o' Ironforge would like...
$n, I'd recognize that face anywhere... What... What have they done to ye, $g lad:lass;?

Ye don't remember me, do ye? Blasted Scourge... They've tried to drain ye o' everything that made ye a righteous force o' reckoning. Every last ounce o' good... Everything that made ye a $g son:daughter; o' Ironforge!

Think, $n. Think back. Try and remember the snow capped mountains o' Dun Morogh! Ye were born there, $g lad:lass;. Remember the splendor o' life, $n! Ye were a champion o' the dwarves once! This isn't ye!

Listen to me, $n. Ye must fight against the Lich King's control. He's a monster that wants to see this world - our world - in ruin. Don't let him use ye to accomplish his goals. Ye were once a hero and ye can be again. Fight, damn ye! Fight his control!
There... There's no more time for me. I'm done for. Finish me off, $n. Do it or they'll kill us both. $n... For KHAAAAAAAAZZZ MODAAAAAANNNNNN!!!
Do it, $n! Put me out of my misery!

29068.text: Come to finish the job, have you?
If you'd allow me just one...
$n, I'd recognize that face anywhere... What... What have they done to you, $n?
You don't remember me, do you? Blasted Scourge... They've tried to drain you of everything that made you a pint-sized force of reckoning. Every last ounce of good... Everything that made you a gnome!
Think, $n. Think back. Try and remember Gnomeregan before those damned troggs! Remember the feel of an arclight spanner, $g brother:sister;. You were a champion of gnome-kind once! This isn't you.

Listen to me, $n. You must fight against the Lich King's control. He is a monster that wants to see this world - our world - in ruin. Don't let him use you to accomplish his goals. You were once a hero and you can be again. Fight, damn you! Fight his control!
There... There's no more time for me. I'm done for. Finish me off, $n. Do it or they'll kill us both. $n... Remember Gnomeregan! This world is worth saving.
Do it, $n! Put me out of my misery!

29070.text: Come to finish the job, have you?
You'll look me in the eyes when...
$n, I'd recognize those face tentacles anywhere... What... What have they done to you, $n?

You don't remember me, do you? Blasted Scourge... They've tried to drain you of everything that made you a righteous force of reckoning. Every last ounce of good... Everything that made you a draenei!
Think, $n. Think back. Try and remember the proud mountains of Argus, where you were born. Remember the splendor of life, $g brother:sister;. You were a champion of the draenei once! This isn't you.

Listen to me, $n. You must fight against the Lich King's control. He is a monster that wants to see this world - our world - in ruin. Don't let him use you to accomplish his goals. You were once a hero and you can be again. Fight, damn you! Fight his control!
There... There's no more time for me. I'm done for. Finish me off, $n. Do it or they'll kill us both. $n... Remember Argus. Don't let that happen to this world.
Do it, $n! Put me out of my misery!

29071.text: Come to finish the job, have you?
Ironic, isn't it? To be killed...
$n, I'd recognize that decay anywhere... What... What have they done to you, $n?

You don't remember me? We were humans once - long, long ago - until Lordaeron fell to the Scourge. Your transformation to a Scourge zombie came shortly after my own. Not long after that, our minds were freed by the Dark Lady.

A pact was made, $g brother:sister;! We vowed vengeance against the Lich King! For what he had done to us! We battled the Scourge as Forsaken, pushing them back into the Plaguelands and freeing Tirisifal! You and I were champions of the Forsaken!

Listen to me, $n. You must fight against the Lich King's control. He is a monster that wants to see this world - our world - in ruin. Don't let him use you to accomplish his goals - AGAIN. You were once a hero and you can be again. Fight, damn you! Fight his control!
There... There's no more time for me. I'm done for. Finish me off, $n. Do it or they'll kill us both. $n... Remember Tirisfal! This world is worth saving!
Do it, $n! Put me out of my misery!

29072.text: Come to finish the job, have you?
I want to die like an orc...
$n, I'd recognize that face anywhere... What... What have they done to you, $n?
You don't remember me, do you? Blasted Scourge... They've tried to drain you of everything that made you a righteous force of reckoning. Every last ounce of good... Everything that made you an orc!

Think, $n. Think back. Try and remember Durotar, $g brother:sister;! Remember the sacrifices our heroes made so that we could be free of the blood curse. Harken back to the Valley of Trials, where we were reborn into a world without demonic influence. We found the splendor of life, $n. Together! This isn't you. You were a champion of the Horde once!

Listen to me, $n. You must fight against the Lich King's control. He is a monster that wants to see this world - our world - in ruin. Don't let him use you to accomplish his goals. You were once a hero and you can be again. Fight, damn you! Fight his control!
There... There's no more time for me. I'm done for. Finish me off, $n. Do it or they'll kill us both. $n... For the Horde! This world is worth saving.
Do it, $n! Put me out of my misery!

29073.text: Come ta finish da job, mon?
Dis troll gonna stand for da...
$n, I'd recognize dem tusks anywhere... What... What have dey done ta you, mon?
You don't remember me, mon? Damn da Scourge! Dey gone ta drain you of everytin' dat made ya a mojo masta. Every last ounce a good... Everytin' dat made ya a troll hero, mon!

TINK, $n. Tink back, mon! We be Darkspear, mon! Bruddas and sistas! Remember when we fought da Zalazane and done took he head and freed da Echo Isles? MON! TINK! You was a champion of da Darkspear trolls!

Listen ta me, $g brudda:sista;. You must fight against da Lich King's control. He be a monster dat want ta see dis world - our world - be ruined. Don't let he use you ta accomplish he goals. You be a hero once and you be a hero again! Fight it, mon! Fight he control!
Der... Der's no more time for me. I be done for. Finish me off, $n. Do it or dey'll kill us both. $n... Remember Sen'jin Village, mon! Dis world be worth saving!
Do it, $n! Put me out a me misery!

29074.text: Come to finish the job, have you?
You'll look me in the eyes when...
$n, I'd recognize that face anywhere... What... What have they done to you, $n?

You don't remember me, do you? Blasted Scourge... They've tried to drain you of everything that made you a righteous force of reckoning. Every last ounce of good... Everything that made you a blood elf!

Think, $n. Think back. Try and remember the majestic halls of Silvermoon City, where you were born. Remember the splendor of life, $g brother:sister;. You were a champion of the sin'dorei once! This isn't you.

Listen to me, $n. You must fight against the Lich King's control. He is a monster that wants to see this world - our world - in ruin. Don't let him use you to accomplish his goals. You were once a hero and you can be again. Fight, damn you! Fight his control!
There... There's no more time for me. I'm done for. Finish me off, $n. Do it or they'll kill us both. $n... Remember Silvermoon. This world is worth saving.
Do it, $n! Put me out of my misery!

29076.text: Hrm, what a strange tree. I must investigate.
What's this!? This isn't a tree at all! Guards! Guards!

29112.text: Don't be ridiculous. Where would you even go if I did spare you? We just finished up eradicating your civilization. Remember?
Oh yes. Immensely. The pain will probably render you unconscious - hence the vat of slime you're floating in!
That's how you know it's working.
You idiot! That's What I'm Doing Right Now!
I AM going to kill you. What's the rush?

29113.text: Double your efforts! The final assault draws near!

29120.text: Soon the master's voice will call to you.
You shall experience my torment first hand!
Ahhh... RAAAAAGH! Never thought... I would be free of him....
Your armor is useless against my locusts!
Come forth, my brethren! Feast on their flesh!
I was king of this empire once, long ago. In life I stood as champion. In death I returned as conqueror. Now I protect the kingdom once more. Ironic, yes?

29173.text: Soldiers of the Scourge, stand ready! Prepare to unleash your fury upon the Argent Dawn!
The sky weeps at the glorious devastation of these lands! Soon, Azeroth's futile tears will rain down upon us!
Death knights of Acherus, the death march begins!
Soldiers of the Scourge, death knights of Acherus, minions of the darkness: hear the call of the Highlord!
RISE!
The skies turn red with the blood of the fallen! The Lich King watches over us, minions! Leave only ashes and misery in your destructive wake!
Kneel before the Highlord!
You stand no chance!
The Scourge will destroy this place!
Your life is forfeit!
Life is meaningless without suffering!
How much longer will your forces hold out?
The Argent Dawn is finished!
Spare no one!
What is this?! My... I cannot strike...
OBEY ME, BLADE!
You will do as I command! I am in control here!
I... I cannot... The blade fights me...
What is happening to me?
Power... wanes...
Ashbringer defies me...
Minions, come to my aid!
Stand down, death knights. We have lost. The Light... this place... no hope...
Save your breath, old man. It might be the last you ever draw.
Father!
Argh... what... is...
You... betrayed me. You betrayed us all, monster! Face the might of Mograine!
That day is not today...
Tirion!
So too do the Knights of the Ebon Blade. Although our kind has no place in your world, we will fight to bring an end to the Lich King. This I vow!
Thousands of Scourge rise up at the Highlord's command.
The army marches towards Light's Hope Chapel.
After over a hundred Defenders of the Light fall, Highlord Tirion Fordring arrives.
%s kneels in defeat before Tirion Fordring.
%s becomes himself again...and is now angry.
%s throws the Corrupted Ashbringer to Tirion, who catches it. Tirion becomes awash with Light, and the Ashbringer is cleansed.
%s collapses.
Light washes over the chapel ? the Light of Dawn is uncovered.

29175.text: Have you learned nothing, boy? You have become all that your father fought against! Like that coward, Arthas, you allowed yourself to be consumed by the darkness, the hate... feeding upon the misery of those you tortured and killed!
Your master knows what lies beneath the chapel. That is why he dares not show his face! He's sent you and your death knights to meet their doom, Darion.
What you are feeling right now is the anguish of a thousand lost souls! Souls that you and your master brought here! The Light will tear you apart, Darion!
We have all been witness to a terrible tragedy. The blood of good men has been shed upon this soil! Honorable knights, slain defending their lives -- our lives!
And while such things can never be forgotten, we must remain vigilant in our cause!n
The Lich King must answer for what he has done, and must not be allowed to cause further destruction in our world.
I make a promise to you now, brothers and sisters: the Lich King will be defeated! On this day, I call for a union.
The Argent Dawn and the Order of the Silver Hand will come together as one! We will succeed where so many before us have failed!n
We will take the fight to Arthas, and we will tear down the walls of Icecrown!
The Argent Crusade comes for you, Arthas!n
%s charges towards the Lich King, Ashbringer in hand and strikes the Lich King.

29178.text: Stand fast, brothers and sisters! The Light will prevail!

29183.text: You were right, Fordring. I did send them in to die. Their lives are meaningless, but yours...
How simple it was to draw the great Tirion Fordring out of hiding. You've left yourself exposed, paladin. Nothing will save you.
When next we meet, it won't be on holy ground, paladin.
%s casts a powerful spell, killing the Defenders and knocking back the others.
%s disappears. Tirion walks over to where Darion lay

29193.text: Why don't you Just Kill me Already
Is it too late to change my mind? How about you just kill me instead?

29194.text: Step forth disciple. Show me what you have learned.
It is time for your learning to be put to the test. Step forth.
Do not let the ice in your blood slow your step. Prove your prowess, disciple.
You have stood and listened long enough. Step forth.
Prove that you understand my teachings, disciple.
It is time for your challenge disciple. Use my teachings well.
Its spells would be less threatening if its incantations were slowed by your icy touch...
Do not let it consider its next spell so freely, disciple... freeze its mind.
You are not overwhelmed just yet disciple... let the hungering cold of death halt this onslaught.
Frozen solid, ripe for the slaughter. Let loose a howling blast and shatter them into pieces, disciple.
Do not be frightened child... welcome the cold embrace of death...
Such is the price of failure.
Death is the reward for your weakness.
You have more learning ahead of you disciple. Return to your studies.
You have learned well. Continue on your path, disciple.

29196.text: As disciples of blood, you strive to master the very lifeforce of your enemies.
29196.comment: Lord Thorval - (Part 1 of Speech To Deciples)

29196.text: Be it by blade or incantation, blood feeds our attacks and weakens our foes.
29196.comment: Lord Thorval - (Part 2 of Speech To Deciples)

29196.text: True masters learn to make blood serve more than just their strength in battle.
29196.comment: Lord Thorval - (Part 3 of Speech To Deciples)

29196.text: Stripping energy from our foes, both fighting and fallen, allows us to persevere where lesser beings fall exhausted.
29196.comment: Lord Thorval - (Part 4 of Speech To Deciples)

29196.text: And every foe that falls, energy sapped and stolen, only further fuels our assault.
29196.comment: Lord Thorval - (Part 5 of Speech To Deciples)

29196.text: As masters of blood, we know battle without end...
29196.comment: Lord Thorval - (Part 6 of Speech To Deciples)

29196.text: We know hunger never to be quenched...
29196.comment: Lord Thorval - (Part 7 of Speech To Deciples)

29196.text: We know power never to be overcome...
29196.comment: Lord Thorval - (Part 8 of Speech To Deciples)

29196.text: As masters of blood, we are masters of life and death itself.  Against us, even hope falls drained and lifeless.
29196.comment: Lord Thorval - (Part 9 of Speech To Deciples)

29227.text: My son! My dear, beautiful boy!
Nothing could have kept me away from here, Darion. Not from my home and family.
Darion Mograine, you are barely of age to hold a sword, let alone battle the undead hordes of Lordaeron! I could not bear losing you. Even the thought...n

My son, there will come a day when you will command the Ashbringer and, with it, mete out justice across this land. I have no doubt that when that day finally comes, you will bring pride to our people and that Lordaeron will be a better place because of you. But, my son, that day is not today.n
%s disappears, and the Lich King appears.

29228.text: You have been gone a long time, Father. I thought...
Father, I wish to join you in the war against the undead. I want to fight! I can sit idle no longer!
If I die, Father, I would rather it be on my feet, standing in defiance against the undead legions! If I die, let me die with you!
%s becomes a shade of his past, and walks up to his father.

29260.text: Sparklight's vehicle emporium is open for business!

29262.text: Rigspark's vehicle shop is open for business!

29266.text: It seems my freedom must be bought with blood!
Back in business! Now, to execute an exit strategy.
It would seem that a renegotiation is in order.
The air teems with latent energy... quite the harvest!
Plentiful, exploitable resources... primed for acquisition!
Intriguing... a high quantity of arcane energy is near. Time for some prospecting...

29280.text: Your sacrifice is a testament to your obedience.  Indeed you are worthy of this charge. Arise, and forever be known as Svala Sorrowgrave!
Your first test awaits you. Destroy our uninvited guests.

29281.text: My liege! I have done as you asked, and now beseech you for your blessing!

29302.text: Looks like you brought the whole family!  What's your business here, then?
Work?  You are aware this is a warzone, citizen?  What is your profession?
Her Majesty sends Dark Rangers!  Stand aside, boys!
You must be the sorriest bunch of recruits I've seen today!  Fall in formations and report to High Executor Anselm!
Aren't you a sorry sight!  I suppose you're a little better than yesterday's bunch.  Formations, now!  Report for duty!
Wipe that worthless grin off your faces, recruits!  If the High Executor sees you like that he will kill you all himself!

29304.text: Drakkari gonna kill anybody who tressspasss on these landsss!
I sssee now... Ssscourge wasss not... our greatessst enemy....
Minionsss of the scale, heed my call!
A thousssand fangsss gonna rend your flesh!
As %s falls, the altar set into the floor on his balcony begins to glow faintly.

29305.text: We fought back da Scourge. What chance joo thinkin' JOO got?
If our gods can die... den so can we....
Get ready for somethin'... much... BIGGAH!
Da ground gonna swallow you up!
As %s falls, the altar set into the floor on his balcony begins to glow faintly.

29306.text: I'm gonna spill your guts, mon!
Who needs gods when we ARE gods?
Say hello to my BIG friend!
Ain't gonna be nothin' left after this!
You wanna see power? I'm gonna show you power!

29308.text: The hum of magic energy in the air diminishes...
Intruders! Who trespasses in the Old Kingdom?
I will feast on your remains!
I will drink no blood before its time.
Still I hunger. Still... I... thirst.
Fresh, warm blood... it has been too long.
Your heartbeat is... music to my ears.
I am nowhere.... I am everywhere. I am the watcher unseen.

29309.text: The secrets of the deep shall remain hidden.
Sleep now in the cold dark....
Perhaps we will be allies soon.
The young must not go hungry....

29310.text: These are sacred halls! Your intrusion will be met with death!
Get up! You haven't suffered enough.
Do not expect your sacrilege... to go unpunished.
The elements themselves will rise up against the civilized world! Only the faithful will be spared!
Immortality can be yours, but only if you pledge yourself fully to Yogg-Saron!
Here, on the very borders of his domain, you will experience power you could have never imagined!
You have traveled long and risked much to be here! Your devotion shall be rewarded.
The faithful shall be exalted, but there is more work to be done. We will press on until all of Azeroth lies beneath his shadow!

29311.text: Gul'kafh an'shel. Yoq'al shn ky ywaq nuul.
Ywaq puul skshgn: on'ma yeh'glu zuq.
Ywaq maq oou; ywaq maq ssaggh. Ywaq ma shg'fhn.
They who dine on lost souls know only hunger.
Gaze into the void. It is the perpetuity in which they dwell.
They are the whisper on the shivering wind.
Their shadow will choke the land for eternity.
They drink your fear: it is the blood of life.
Where one falls, many shall take its place.
They do not die; they do not live. They are outside the cycle.

29313.text: I AM a force of nature!
I shall consume, decimate, devastate, and destroy! Yield now to the wrath of the pounding sea!
I will not be contained! Ngyah!!
Water can hold any form, take any shape... overcome any obstacle.

29315.text: Free to--mm--fly now. Ra-aak... Not find us--ekh-ekh! Escape!
Nasty little...A-ak, kaw! Kill! Yes, kill you!

29368.text: How predictable! But then, who would expect a rock to think like anything other than one?
If you're so eager to fight, I'll oblige you. But know that nothing you do here can prevent the completion of the iron colossus!

29369.text: Your mother was a wrench and your father smelled of seaforium!
You're not worth the scrap you're made from!
Your tinker must've made you from tin, you lazy piles of slag!
A pack of mechanical squirrels could mine faster than you!

29384.text: Free again? Keeper Mimir's work awaits.
Thank you, $r. I will join your struggle against the stormforged.
New directive: leave mine and return to Inventor's Library.
New directive: assist in the defeat of the iron dwarves.
Does not compute. Unit malfunctioning. Directive: shut down.

29394.text: Not yet, Ymiron, I have other plans for you. You will serve me better within Utgarde Pinnacle. And if these insects survive to find you again, you will get the chance to avenge your wife.

29419.text: We're here for civilian work, sir.

29429.text: Is it true?! Has someone finally come to get me out of this place?
No... no... that's not it, is it? That heartless lout probably sent you after the tools, didn't he?
Well... I guess I'll just keep an eye on the turrets... or something.

29434.text: Let me know when you're ready. I'd prefer sooner than later... what with the slowly dying from poison and all.
I'm going to bring the venom sac to Ricket... and then... you know... collapse. Thank you for helping me!

29437.text: Why you hurt Rageclaw? You crazy?
Rageclaw and troll friends no more!
You kill our pups! We kill you back!
You leave den the hard way!
You hurted the chief's lion seal! WHY YOU HURT LION SEAL??!
Why you smell so bad now? You smelled much less bad before!
Trolls is shameful. Trolls is killers!

29439.text: Why you hurt Rageclaw? You crazy?
Rageclaw and troll friends no more!
You kill our pups! We kill you back!
You leave den the hard way!

Why you smell so bad now? You smelled much less bad before!
Trolls is shameful. Trolls is killers!

29466.text: I can't believe it!  I'm free to go!
Time to hightail it!  Thanks, friend!

29489.text: Please... wait... stop! I don't know where the grand admiral is, but I'm sure we can work it out.
Did I mention that I have money and jewels? Don't kill me!
I have no idea where he's at. I haven't seen him since we landed!
Can anyone hear me? I'm being attacked!
Stop! I could be convinced to join you!
Not the face! Not the face!
How dare you! Do you have any idea who I am?

29490.text: I don't know where the grand admiral is. Go to hell!
You'll get nothing out of me!
I'll have your gizzard for breakfast!
You may kill me, but I'll never tell you what you want!
I am Scarlet Onslaught. We don't rat out our leaders!
You're just a filthy pawn of the Ebon Blade. Die!
No, I don't know where he is and if I did, I wouldn't tell you -- even if my life depended on it!
Your corpse will adorn my mast!

29491.text: Welcome. May I help you find something?
Greetings! Please have a look around.
Let me know if you need help finding anything, $c.

29519.text: You have made a grave error, fiend!
I was a soldier of the Light once... Look at what I have become...
They brand me unworthy? I will show them unworthy!
You will allow me a weapon and armor, yes?
I will win my freedom and leave this cursed place!
I will dismantle this festering hellhole!
There can be only one survivor!
HAH! You can barely hold a blade! Yours will be a quick death.
There is no hope for our future...
Sate your hunger on cold steel, $r!

29525.text: Thank you, thank you!  Time to get away from these crazy blue women!

29542.text: I will not die so quickly this time!

29560.text: Well done. Let's get this over with.
Come, Landgren, cough up your soul so that I can ask you a very important question.
YOU WILL TELL ME WHERE WESTWIND IS OR I WILL DESTROY YOUR SOUL!
Then you leave me no choice. I won't say that I won't enjoy this.
A hidden hollow? How very interesting. You've served your purpose, Landgren, but I'm afraid there'll be no resurrection for you this time!
Now that the unpleasantness is finished with, let's talk about you dealing with Grand Admiral Westwind.

STOP! It isn't worth it. I'll tell you where he is.
On the south end of the island is a cave -- a hidden hollow. The grand admiral has holed himself up in there, preparing for the final battle against the Lich King.

29573.text: %s gathers its mojo and surges forward!
As the last remnants of the %s seep into the ground, the altar set into the floor nearby begins to glow faintly.

29579.text: I... I can understand you now! Well, now that we can talk to each other, you have some explaining to do!
How did you get my communicator from the Explorers' League?
You have my thanks for dispatching the iron dwarves. But why would the Horde have an interest in me?
That wouldn't be Scout Vor'takh, would it? Even I know of his reputation for ruthlessness. He means to abduct me, then?
If you've seen the journal, then you know what I've been discovering. The titans' own creations are at war with each other!
Loken and his iron dwarf minions have ousted the Earthen from Ulduar and taken over the city.
If we spend our time and strength fighting with each other, Loken will use Ulduar's resources to destroy both Horde and Alliance.
Speak to the commander at your post, $g lad:lass;, and persuade him to abandon Vor'takh's foolish plan.

29611.text: People of Stormwind! Citizens of the Alliance! Your king speaks!
Today marks the first of many defeats for the Scourge! Death knights, once in service of the Lich King, have broken free of his grasp and formed a new alliance against his tyranny!
You will welcome these former heroes of the Alliance and treat them with the respect that you would give to any ally of Stormwind!

29614.text: The darkweaver metamorphizes into something terrible and demonic.
A terrible change comes over the %s as he cackles maniacally.
With a horrible outcry, the %s transforms into a demonic nightmare.
The darkweaver pierces you with an evil grin as he shifts into an entirely different form.
Now you know. Now you must die!
Even in death there will be no escape for you!
I shall feast upon your soul!
You will not leave this cavern alive!

29618.text: Net not stop me! No... net stop me.

29620.text: Gah! I spent too much time in that weak little shell.
Kirel narak! I am Mal'Ganis. I AM ETERNAL!
ENOUGH! I waste my time here. I must gather my strength on the homeworld.
My Onslaught will wash over the Lich King's forces!
Your death is in vain, tiny mortal.
Your time has come to an end.
You'll never defeat the Lich King without my forces. I'll have my revenge... on him AND you!

29621.text: How did you find me? Did Landgren tell?
You thought I would just let you kill me?
WHAT?! No matter. Even without my sphere, I will crush you! Behold my true identity and despair!
Unfortunate. The best was yet to come.

29626.text: Delicious morsels have come to visit! Shall I use your bombs to cook you?

29643.text: That right? Well why don't you go prance your merry little self over and grab them, eh?
That's strange... for a moment there, I could have swore you called me short.
Toss me?! Okay, that's it punk.
You better hope they don't survive it, lad.
Cause I'm just going to watch and laugh as they toss you in.
There's got to be a way in somewhere.
How'd the goblin leave his tools there then?
That's it, lad! It looks totally safe. Go for it, I'll be right behind ya!

29644.text: I don't know, Bailey... it's not so bad. We could throw a rock at the tools from here.
Well... I was just thinking... you're a bit smaller, so you're less likely to set off any of those mines.
No, no, no! Not short... it's just... well... maybe I could toss you across most of it?
That was close! You scared me.
There's a path right there... only a few mines at the end in between us and the tools.
We wait for the next adventurer to come through and we tell him that's the way to go... then after they set off the mines, we just walk in and grab the tools!
It really doesn't look like it, Bailey.
Oh... good point. How about right there? That looks clear... kind of.
Uh... that's okay. It still kind of hurts from last time.

29647.text: My brothers will come for me and then you will see what true power is!
Ugly little monsters, pray I don't get out!
Your torture only adds to my rage!
How long do you think this cage can hold me, fiends!
FREE!!! Soon you will feel the wrath of the storm king!

29650.text: It's those blasted iron dwarves again! Somehow, they found him before we did.
They're not going to give up until they find him. We can't allow that to happen, $n, and Brann knows it.
There are some rather cryptic instructions in this note. Brann must've had some kind of backup plan, but he can't keep evading capture forever...
It's up to you to find him before the irons do!

29655.text: Saragosa! What has become of you?

29677.text: The %s sniffs the ground to pickup the trail.
You've been seen! Use the net and ice slick to keep the dwarves away!
The frosthound has located the thief's hiding place. Confront him!
The %s has tracked the scent to its source.

29703.text: Another shiny, happy person.  Take care, $c!

29709.text: The proto-drake smells freedom and flies homeward!

29770.text: You dare?! Where is Baron Sliver? I would have words with him!

29775.text: Use of the Inventor's Disk detected. Emergency protocol gamma activated.
Norgannon's shell accounted for and secure. It will be available for transfer once user's identity has been verified.
Standby to verify identity as Keeper Mimir.
Identity verification failed. User is not Keeper Mimir.
The Inventor's Disk has fallen into the hands of an unauthorized user.  Activating defense protocol.
Impostor must be dealt with. The Inventor's Disk must be recovered.

29801.text: At last, the tyranny of the stormforged is at its end!
We've defeated Valduran and we'll fell his colossus.

29821.text: Oh, you freed him, did you? No matter, his death and reconstruction will only be slightly delayed.

29851.text: You're the one that's been disrupting things? This should be easy.

29858.text: My dear general, your time has come!

29880.text: I will feed you to the dogs!

29881.text: Kill them all... before they kill you.
They have turned against you. Now... take your revenge.
Tell yourself again that these are not truly your friends.
There is no escape. Not in this life. Not in the next.
You are a pawn of forces unseen.

29884.text: I will crush you under foot!
I'll wipe you off of my boots later!
LET THE STORM'S FURY CONSUME YOU!
IT IS THE WRATH OF THE STORM KING!
Algar the Chosen is at the Reliquary of Pain to the northeast.nPrince Navarius is on the other side of the Dead Fields to the east.
Algar the Chosen is at the Reliquary of Pain to the northeast.nPrince Navarius is on the other side of the Dead Fields to the east.
Farewell, friend. May we meet again under better circumstances. I'll never forget what you did for me!

29887.text: I will feed you to the dogs!
Your entrails will make a fine necklace.

29903.text: The iron dwarves followed you! Use the net and the ice slick to escape!
%s has tracked the scent to its source inside the cave.
Frostbite has tracked the scent to its source. Investigate the cave!

29915.text: You call that fighting? Let me go grab your dolly. Maybe she could teach you how to swing.
My dead grandmater, rest her soul, could beat you... even now!
I've half a mind to cut you both down where you stand! The other half isn't arguing!
Well hello, ladies. What do you think this is... Skorn?
You will practice until your lungs are bursting and your arms are aching, and then we'll really start!
Only the best of the best get a shot in Valhalas to go to Ymirheim. Everyone else dies... or worse!
Stop trying to hit him and HIT HIM already!
Are you trying to make me look bad? That's the only thing that you're good for today!

29919.text: My answer? Here's my answer, little messenger!
I will feed you to the dogs!

29932.text: Something stirs in the pool of mojo...

30007.text: This battle must be seen to be believed! Once a mild-mannered tuskarr fisherman, our next fighter turned to the life of a soulless mercenary when his entire family was wiped out by a vicious pack of lion seals and ill-tempered penguins! Now he's just in it for the gold! Ladies and gentlemen, ORINOKO TUSKBREAKER!!
The champion of the Winterax trolls has challenged you, $n! I hope you're ready!
Hailing from the distant mountains of Alterac, one of the fiercest competitors this arena has ever seen: KORRAK THE BLOODRAGER!!!
The battle is about to begin! Am I reading this card right? It... It's the nefarious magnataur lord, STINKBEARD! Yes, folks, STINKBEARD! $n doesn't stand a chance!
Do you feel that folks? The air is crackling with energy! That can only mean one thing...
The grand Amphitheater of Anguish awaits, $n. Remember, once a battle starts you have to stay in the arena. WIN OR DIE!
The grand Amphitheater of Anguish awaits, $n. Remember, once a battle starts you have to stay in the arena. WIN OR DIE!

Here we are once again, ladies and gentlemen. The epic struggle between life and death in the Amphitheater of Anguish! For this round we have $n versus the hulking jormungar, Yg... Yggd? Yggdoze? Who comes up with these names?! $n versus big worm!
Prepare to make your stand, $n! Get in the Amphitheater and stand ready! Remember, you and your opponent must stay in the arena at all times or you will be disqualified!
$n has defeated Yg... Yggg-really big worm!
$n has defeated Yg... Yggg-really big worm!
$n has defeated Yg... Yggg-really big worm!
$n has defeated Yg... Yggg-really big worm!
$n is victorious once more!
$n is victorious once more!
$n is victorious once more!
And with AUTHORITY, $n dominates the magnataur lord! Stinkbeard's clan is gonna miss him back home in the Dragonblight!
From the Savage Ledge of Icecrown, Vladof the Butcher and his mammoth, Enormos! There ain't gonna be a thing left of our challengers, folks! Prepare for a downpour of blood, guts and tears!
I DON'T BELIEVE IT! WE HAVE A NEW CHAMPION OF ANGUISH!!! Vladof the Butcher has been defeated by a ragtag crew of nobodies! Incredible finish!
All that's left of the challenger is a red stain on the floor!
Avert your eyes, ladies and gentlemen! It's a bloodbath!
Call in the clowns! It's turned into a circus in there!
OOOF! That one's gonna require the "scraper."
OUTTA NOWHERE -- WHAMO! DEAD!
They went down like a sack of orc skulls!

30012.text: I'm not afraid of anything -- bring it on!

30017.text: Stinkbeard comin' for you, little ones!

30019.text: I'll melt the flesh off your bones!
To burn my kingdom, you can't use fire! Come my servants, I am not ready to retire!

30020.text: Come, land-dwellers, face the fury of tusk and whisker!
Whisker! Where are you?! Assist me!

30022.text: Yes, my precious, we will tear them apart! For the one true king!
%s begins to spin, encased in a magical shield!

30023.text: Korrak has come, weaklings! Snowfall belongs to Winterax! Erm, Korrak mean to say amphitheater belong to Winterax!
No graveyard here for you to play wicked games on Korrak! DIE!

30024.text: For Neptulon! Strength of storm and sea, crush my enemies!
I am the baddest of the bad, the coolest of the cool! To my side, my elements, let us freeze and rule!

30025.text: Arise, brothers of the earth! Watch as Erathius destroys the mortals!
I'm the king of dirt, there is none higher! To my aid, minions - assist your sire!

30026.text: Al'Akir grant my enemies a cold, swift death!
I bring a gust so strong, it can knock down trees! Minions, assist me, they shall not do as they please!

30035.text: Thank you. I thought I was doomed.
I was certain I was going to die out here.
Let me fight by your side.
Let us fight the irons together!

30037.text: Haraak foln!
I'll eat your heart!
I will take pleasure in gutting you!
Die, maggot!
Your entrails will make a fine necklace.
I will feed you to the dogs!
Ugglin oo bjorr!
You're weak, old woman!
Hela take you!
I will feast in the halls of Ymirheim tonight and you will pour my mead, cur.
The runes foretold victory for me today!
Getting tired? Hahahahaha!
You'll sleep in the underworld tonight!
You'll wish you'd never been awakened, boy.
You complain much, like a shield-maiden!
You think you can challenge me, little $r?
Your race has no honor. But come anyway... you'll die like all the others!
By Thorim's beard, this should be good sport!
Come then, $r $c, I do not have all day!
It will not get me any closer to proving myself at Valhalas to kill you, but it should be entertaining!
If you seek death, you have found it!
A quick trip to the underworld for you, and a laugh for me. Sounds like a fair trade!
A Drakkari, one of the so-called Scarlet Onslaught, a gnome, a Hyldnir shield-maiden, and now you? Is this a joke?

30081.text: You dare to touch ME?! You won't keep me from proving myself to the Lich King!

30084.text: A Power Spark forms from a nearby rift!

30086.text: Taste my steel, little $g boy : girl;!
You fight well, little one. I am bested for now. We will meet again I assure you. When we do I will be better prepared!

30098.text: Anguish Ale!  Cold Anguish Ale here!

30107.text: I can't thank you enough for all of your help in putting together the keystone. Great things will come of this, I assure you.
Iron dwarves... everywhere.... they're making their way down from the top. They certainly are persistent.
They're trying to take down the plane! I can't pull up any steeper... you need to keep them off of us!
There are more up ahead - keep at it!
We're almost out... just a little bit farther.
Barring stray boulders from those giants, we should be clear... it seems a mess down there though.
Their numbers are unbelievable... I'm glad to hear King Stormheart came to your aid. I only hear good things of him - I think it's high time we meet.
Poor Creteus. He was a good keeper... I'm glad he at least got to see his task to completion, I imagine that's all that really mattered to him.
We're coming up on Frosthold. I would be very appreciative if you would introduce me to King Stormheart before you go. I believe we are both very much in his debt.

30146.text: Curse you!  You will not treat me like a beast!
Enough!  I will teach you some manners, wench!
I'd rather die fighting than live like a slave!
We will have revenge... some day.
You treat us worse than animals!

30152.text: No more will your minions assail the creatures of stone and their allies.
Well fought! The day is ours, but the war goes on!

30154.text: I'm not afraid of anything -- bring it on!

30186.text: Hey you! There are keys on the vrykul. Kill them, get a key and come over here to let me out of this damned cage!
It gets the key. It comes here. It opens the lock.
Think you could bust me out of this cage?
Good thing I don't really feel the cold.
I'm over here in this cage. You can't miss it!
Let me out and we'll fight side-by-side. The slaughter will be glorious!
Were you sent by Baron Sliver to get me out of this cage? Finally. Hurry up!
When you get me out of this cage, we're going to make them wish they were never awakened!
