30219.text: The worg sprints off in search of enemies.
The worg growls as it closes in on its prey.
The frostworg howls, exposing its prey!

30222.text: Found me, did ya? Now ya gotta die!
You won't live to speak of this!

30225.text: Eversong Woods, Dalfors. I'm thinking about how beautiful it was before Arthas cut a swathe of death through it...

30243.text: I will feed you to the dogs!
I will feed you to the dogs!
I will take pleasure in gutting you!
Your entrails will make a fine necklace.
Your entrails will make a fine necklace.

30250.text: I will take pleasure in gutting you!
I will feed you to the dogs!
Your entrails will make a fine necklace.

30274.text: Might grace you, $c. Let the Scourge feel the fury of a million lost souls!
Glory and strength to you, $c. I bless you with all the strength left in me. May this nightmare soon end!
Wisdom of the ages upon you, noble $c.
Thank you and farewell, friend. I must return to the Argent Vanguard.

30275.text: %s swipes at you with his claws!
%s shrieks in pain and twists around, grabbing you with his mouth!

30299.text: You didn't think that I was going to let you walk in here and take the Heart of the Storm, did you?
You may have killed Valduran, but that will not stop me from completing the colossus.

30300.text: The %s prepares to slam the ground in front of him!

30313.text: Temple of Invention verified to be intact.
Mechanical servants appear to have turned against each other. Several attendants have been piled together in an unorganized manner.
Remaining mechagnome guardians corrupted by unknown source.
Watcher Mimir verified to no longer be present. Analysis complete.
Temple of Winter verified to be in tact.
Temple guardians verified to be deceased. Sulfurous odor suggests that death resulted from a fire-based entity.
Previously established cold weather patterns at the temple have ceased.
Watcher Hodir verified to no longer be present. Analysis complete.
Temple of Life verified to be damaged beyond repair.
Evidence indicates a significant battle. The opponent of Watcher Freya estimated to be of similar size and strength to Watcher Freya.
Temple guardians are no longer present. Plant forms associated with temple are deceased.
Watcher Freya verified to no longer be present. Analysis complete.
Temple of Order verified to be in tact.
No indications of struggle are present. No guardians are present.
Watcher Tyr verified to no longer be present. Analysis complete.

30331.text: The deeds of your $r servant defy $g his:her; stature, Stormlord. $g His:Her; efforts have succeeded in softening the hearts of my people.
Never have such humble words come from mighty Thorim. I shall deliver your words to Dun Niffelem.
The events of that dark day are hereby forgiven by my people.  They shall never again be spoken of.
To signify our reforged friendship, I have something which belongs to you...
As the great explosion filled the region, my father cast a rune at the great hammer that it might not be had by our enemies. It was his final act...
We welcome the opportunity to fight by your side, mighty Thorim.
I must return to Dun Niffilem. We shall speak again soon, Stormlord.

30344.text: Quickly, climb aboard! We mustn't tarry here! There's no telling when this whole mountainside will collapse.

30377.text: You are dealing with a being that holds within it the consciousness of the most cunning, intelligent, and ruthless individuals to ever live.
The Lich King is unlike any foe that you have ever faced, Highlord. Though you bested him upon the holy ground of Light's Hope Chapel, you tread now upon his domain.n
You cannot win. Not like this...n
Nothing. There is nothing that you can do while the Light binds you. It controls you wholly, shackling you to the ground with its virtues.
Look upon the field, Highlord. The Lich King has halted your advance completely and won the upper hand!
The breach you created was sealed with Nerubian webbing almost as quickly as it was opened.
Your soldiers are being used as living shields to stave off artillery fire in the Valley of Echoes, allowing the forces of the Lich King to assault your base without impediment.
The Lich King knows your boundaries, Highlord. He knows that you will not fire on your own men. Do you not understand? He has no boundaries. No rules to abide. n

30381.text: And it very nearly didn't remember you. $N fought bravely against the North Wind to protect your story.
Your battle with the wind was hundreds of years ago, Stormhoof. You weakened it so much that it has been silent all these years.
But the North Wind did not silently accept defeat. Instead, it gathered power and bided its time, deciding the best revenge was to destroy your memory, and with it, your village.
The wind used its minions to distort the history of this place, changing the stories your people told, destroying the spirits of the honored dead.
It would've succeeded if $N and I hadn't tracked the North Wind's historical corruptions to their source: your ancient battle.
With my help, $N travelled back in time to your battle, and ensured that history was set right. The North Wind's fate was sealed, and your story restored.
This isn't right at all, $n. In the tale Wind Tamer Barah told me, Stormhoof was a hero, not a villain.
The North Wind is the ancient enemy of the taunka, a ruler among the elements, and the very force which bleeds the life from these ancient people.
They would rather die than bow before the North Wind. Something is amiss here.
It confirms our suspicions. The threads of time have been severed and rewoven in the wrong pattern. But, how?
There's no doubt that something has distorted the true history of Stormhoof and the warriors of Camp Tunka'lo. But, what?
No! The true voice of history will triumph. We will restore all you have destroyed!
$n, we must hurry and discover when the North Wind has started distorting the timeline. Only then can we defeat him and correct it.

30385.text: I give myself to the master!

30388.text: The horn! Use the horn on it while it's weak!
Go to the center of the temple and use the Horn of Elemental Fury!

30390.text: King Jokkum, you have summoned me?
Jokkum, son of Arngrim, I have always regretted my actions here. In my grief, I brought great harm to those closest to me.
I would ask your forgiveness for the suffering I have caused you and your people.
Krolmir... I thank you Jokkum. I hadn't dared hope it still existed. It shall soon see glorious battle once again!

30395.text: My brother, Stormhoof, was a far greater warrior than I. While I trained to be the chieftain of our clan, he prepared for a larger quest.
How could he be in danger? All he wanted was to give us power over the elements that made life harsh for us here.
He sought an artifact... a horn, I think. He left the village on a long journey in search of it.
I know that a terrible enemy pursued him after he won the horn, but I... I don't recall... what happened... next.
It is as though my memories are shrouded in mist. I cannot even recall what became of my brother. Is this how you mean that he is in danger?
The disturbances in the tomb, they must be involved. Look around you, $n. Do you see them?
Yes, they are at fault, but I am powerless to stop them. Will you warn the people of Tunka'lo, stranger, that their past and their ancestors are in danger?

30396.text: You seem eager to join your beloved Sif, brother.
Looks like you can still best me in a fair fight, little brother.
Unfortunately for you.... this fight is anything but fair!
Thanks to your little friend, you've left the Temple of Storms, where you were at your strongest.  Instead we fight closer to my master's power.
Minions!  Take my brother and his drake to their new dwellings.  Make sure the beast makes it alive.  I have special plans for the broodmother.
As for your life, mortal.  I will be generous.  After all... why would I destroy my most useful servant?  I waited for you for weeks inside that Hyldnir mine.
The shape wasn't mine, of course.  And had you not been so reckless, you would've seen past my illusion.  But you came through for me, and for that... I must thank you!

30399.text: It is time I put an end to my brother's madness.
Stand up and fight me, you worthless traitor!

30401.text: King Stormheart is putting you to the test, eh?  He must see something in you to begin with or I doubt he'd put you through such a sacred ritual.
I know you're new to our kind, so I'll catch you up a bit while we're on our way over.
Years back, my father and several other frostborn were returning from a trek across Dragonblight. There was a heavy blizzard... far worse than we've ever seen since.

They crossed a trail of blood-soaked snow and followed it to find a dwarf wandering and speaking in a dialect they couldn't make out... and not a dwarf of our kind mind you, but a mountain dwarf - something our kind had never seen before.

The dwarf seemed lost, having no memory of where he came from, or even of his own name. Not being the kind to leave a dwarven cousin to die in the snow, my father's party took him in and continued back towards Frosthold.

Not long later, out of nowhere, the snow burst before them and a jormungar the size of Veranus herself came down upon their party... one of them was swallowed whole before they even had time to react.

My father thought they were all doomed... but behind him, a furious roar rumbled across the snow, and he turned to see the mountain dwarf growing in size, his skin taking on a stone-like texture, and his hands sizzling with lightning.
The dwarf barreled forward with a sound like rolling thunder and hurled a shining metal hammer, lightning coursing over its surface, directly into the jormungar's throat.
The jormungar collapsed instantly, its head barely still attached to its convulsing body.  My father turned to the dwarf in awe and raised a fist in praise...
The stranger having no name of his own, my father deemed "Yorg," a name reserved for champions of legend. Years later, he now stands before us as Yorg Stormheart, King of the Frostborn.
King Stormheart has trained us well... turned us into even more fearsome warriors than we could have boasted during the time of our war with the Frost Giants.

And as one of the fiercest tests put upon a warrior of the frostborn, we are made to face a creature far larger than ourselves--giants, dragons, jormungar--as a testament to the fact that size will never be our weakness.
This is the test put before you this day. Return to us only once The Iron Watcher is dead, and be revered as a warrior of the frostborn.
He is slow from the rust of the ages... be quick on your feet and he will not best you. You have King Stormheart's favor - do not disappoint.

30403.text: As you jump into Nergeld, the rotting flesh of the construct comes to life.

30404.text: WHO DARES?! I AM GOING TO FLAY THE FLESH FROM YOUR BONES EVEN IF I HAVE TO DESTROY NERGELD TO GET TO YOU!
I'LL RISE AGAIN AND WHEN I DO I WILL HAVE MY REVENGE!

30405.text: By all the gods... it can't be... Muradin?!
Come on boy, there's no mistak'n it - it's definitely you. Don't ya recognize your younger brother?!
I can't believe this! You were dead! All accounts said so... what happened, Muradin. How did you get here?
Indeed! Magni will be so happy to see you too! He's gotten nothing but bad news for a long while now, but this changes everything!
He's here in Northrend brother, looking for you. A seer in Wintergarde brought word that you were not dead, and he left Ironforge immediately to come find you.
That's in the past, Muradin. Regrets won't change anything.
Aye, be safe Muradin. I'd join you, but I'm on top of the most amazing discovery the world has yet seen. I can't abandon it now.

30407.text: Let's get out of here! Quickly!
Faster, hero! We must get back to the Argent Vanguard and warn them of the impending attack!
There are hundreds of them! Maybe thousands! They will attack at any moment! I'm sure of it!
Had you not come along I would have died for sure!
They're planning a huge attack! We need to warn Highlord Fordring!
Thank you, friend, but we're not out of trouble yet!

30408.text: What's that? You talkin' to me, lad?
My brother... yes... I do have brothers...
Muradin clutches his head and reels for a moment as the memories rush back to him.
I... I dun know, Brann. I've been 'ere a long time... all I 'ave of me life before this place are flashes and nightmares.
It's good te see you though, brother. More than words can say.
Magni! Forgive me, the memories are comin' back slowly, brother.
The frostborn have been very good to me. They're strong people.
Not much, Magni. I've had nightmares of a human... tall... light hair... death black armor. His name rests on the tip of me tongue, but...
Aye, I know. I watched him turn... I watched him give up all that was right and I didn't lift a hand... I didn't even consider it until it was too late.
No... no they won't. But I can make this right... I have te. I'm goin' after the boy. I'll make'm answer for everything he's done.
I'm sure, Magni. I'll see this through, don't ya worry.
Go Brann. Bring me back an epic tale when we meet again. Farewell for now, brothers.

30409.text: You've come for the doctor's plans! You'll only find death!
I will never give you the information you seek!
You waste my time. I will tell you nothing!
I'll kill you little one and then I will add your body parts to what we're creating!
I will not let you destroy our hard work! Nergeld will be the end of you all!
When the doctor returns, your pitiful Shadow Vault will be laid to waste.
Nergeld is only the first of a new army of vargul-powered flesh giants. You've not known fear until now!
I have no time for this!

The doctor entrusted me with the plans to Nergeld, our flesh giant amalgamation made entirely of vargul! It will be the most powerful creation of its kind and a whole legion of them will be created to destroy your pitiful forces!

30411.text: Look Lagnus, I consider you a capable man, but my patience is wearing thin. I know that Muradin is here, can you point me to him or not?!
Brother! There you are! I can barely believe my eyes... you're alive!
It's so good to see you again, Muradin. And what's this I heard about you being a King in your own right now? The Bronzebeards were always destined to greatness.
So it seems! And you haven't lost any muscle yourself. Do you remember anything of what happened, Muradin? Fate has turned ill in your absence.
He's not the boy of your memories anymore, Muradin. He's become something else entirely.
Are you sure Muradin? I just got you back after years of thinking you were dead. I do not want to lose you again.
So be it then. I have to return to my people, brothers. Come back to me in one piece.

30449.text: You pose no threat, lesser beings! Give me your worst!
The least you could do is put up a fight!
Was that the best you can do?
I still have some... fight... in me-e-e...
I will pick my teeth with your bones!
Father was right about you, Sartharion. You ARE a weakling.
Aren't you tricky? I have a few tricks of my own...
Unlike you, I have many talents!
You pose no threat, lesser beings! Give me your worst!
A Vesperon Disciple appears in the Twilight!

30451.text: I fear nothing! Least of all you!
We... are superior! How could this... be?
I will take pity on you, Sartharion, just this once.
%s begins to open a Twilight Portal!
A Shadron Disciple appears in the Twilight!

30452.text: You have no place here! Your place... is among the departed!
Typical. Just as I was having fun...
I should not... have held back...
It is amusing to watch you struggle. Very well, witness how it is done!
Arrogant little creatures, to challenge powers you do not yet understand.
I am no mere dragon. You will find that I am much, much more.
Tenebron begins to hatch eggs in the Twilight!
Tenebron begins to hatch eggs in the Twilight!

30461.text: %s lets out a bellowing roar as she descends upon the nest.

30462.text: Easy there, girl!  Don't you recognize your old master?
I will see you at the Temple of Storms.  Looks like I'm going to have to break her in again.

30474.text: Fool! You will never defeat me!
I will never allow you to use the Horn of Elemental Fury against us! Die, weakling!

30475.text: Bethod's Sword?!! Very well, $r, I accept your challenge. But first, you must best my champions. Volgur! Squash this insect!
The thane spits as the first of his champions falls.
Brita, create a pincushion of this puny $c!
You may have defeated my champions, $c. I am something else entirely.
Pray to your gods for a quick death.

30479.text: This is Camp Tunka'lo, the village ruled by my brother, but I... I don't remember you.
The North Wind? It still troubles my people?
You both have my thanks and that of the village, though many will never know of your deeds.
I cannot remain here. I must return to my cairn where I belong, but when I see the ancestors again, it is I who will tell your story.

30501.text: Thane Illskar, you were challenged to honorable combat and failed.
You have been found wanting and are judged accordingly. Now rise, Thane Illskar the Damned!

30547.text: ...zzz... ..snrk... c'mere... gonna... gonna be Malowned... zzz..
...mrf... kids messin'.. with th' boxes... zzzz... teach 'em... lesson...

30549.text: Life is meaningless. It is in death that we are truly tested.
Bow to the might of the Scourge!
You will find no peace in death.
Enough prattling. Let them come. We shall grind their bones to dust.
Conserve your anger. Harness your rage. You will all have outlets for your frustrations soon enough.

30550.text: Do not trouble yourself, little tauren. Neither Stormhoof, nor you and your ally will stand in my way.
Even now, my power grows. I have long waited for the day when my revenge would be complete.
Stormhoof and his kin will be erased from history and these lands will be restored to their rightful owner!

30551.text: This whole situation seems a bit paranoid, don't you think?

30552.text: It's a strange order, you can't deny. Suspicious food? Under that definition, you should arrest Belfast!

30553.text: Orders are orders. If the Prince says jump...
Don't worry too much. By the time I went off duty, we hadn't found a scrap of befouled grain here.

30561.text: The soldiers are doing important work. The safety of the people is more important, Mal, if you're interested in your customers living to spend another day.

30570.text: The Stone Crow's closed today, sorry. There are too many health concerns, and I'm not about to have Ed under fire for supposedly making people sick.
I hate to disappoint people, but the Stone Crow's closed. If the kids from the orphanage were evacuated, I don't see why we should be open, either.

30571.text: What were you doing in my cellar? There's a food scare going on, and the last thing I need is strangers rummaging around in my goods! Shoo!
Hey! Stop rooting around in my cellar! Clear out!
I HEARD THAT! No more ale for you! Not a drop!

30631.text: Damn it, Olakin, get your arse back here! There's work to be done!
30631.comment: Darkrider Arly to Crusader Olakin Sainrith

30632.text: Your entrails will make a fine necklace.

30658.text: Prison guards, we are leaving! These adventurers are taking over! Go go go!
I'm locking the door. Good luck, and thank you for doing this.
You did it! You held the Blue Dragonflight back and defeated their commander. Amazing work!

30686.text: How dare you! I am the chief architect here and I make the final call on layouts! If you have a problem with my plans, feel free to file a grievance with Highlord Fordring. Now if you don't mind, I have work to attend!n

30714.text: Dying must have completely destroyed your ability to perform simple arithmetic. Can't you see that there is no way you're going to make that structure's layout work? It'll collapse!n

30718.text: I will take pleasure in gutting you!
I will feed you to the dogs!
Your entrails will make a fine necklace.

30725.text: Your entrails will make a fine necklace.

30751.text: I will take pleasure in gutting you!
I will feed you to the dogs!
Your entrails will make a fine necklace.

30824.text: Get on board, now! This whole mountainside could collapse at any moment.

30835.text: There is word from Jotunheim. The sleep-watchers there believe that they have found someone of significance.
Look like, my lady? A vrykul, I suppose. They did not actually show him to me. Ever since The Shadow Vault....
A name? Oh, yes, the name! I believe it was Iskalder.

30836.text: Describe this vrykul. What does he look like?
I am not interested in excuses. Perhaps they gave you a name?
Iskalder?! You fool! Have you no idea who that is? He's only the greatest vrykul warrior who ever lived!
Return to Jotunheim and tell them to keep him asleep until I arrive. I will judge this vrykul with my own eyes.

30838.text: You challenge death itself! Come then, "King." Face the might of Mograine!
I will see you back at the Valley of Echoes. Suffer well, ally.

30839.text: Too weak to finish your own battles? Very well then...
Anything else you need help with before I go? Right, I thought not...

30840.text: Say hello to my little friend!

30884.text: It's Iskalder! Quickly, use The Bone Witch's Amulet!
30884.comment: Originaly it as the Bonne witch guide

30891.text: The Blessed Banner of the Crusade has been planted.nDefend the banner from all attackers!

30894.text: The Lithe Stalker is weakened by the assault.

30897.text: Threat index threshold exceeded.  Celestial archive aborted. Security level heightened.
Additional background is relevant to your query: following global combat between Aesir and Vanir--

Unknown. Data suggests that impetus for global combat originated with prime designate Loken, who neutralized all remaining Aesir and Vanir, affecting termination of conflict. Prime designate Loken then initiated stasis of several seed races, including earthen, giants and vrykul, at designated holding facilities.

30898.text: Security breach in progress. Analysis of historical archives transferred to lower-priority queue. Countermeasures engaged.
Accessing... Creators arrived to extirpate symbiotic infection. Assessment revealed that Old God infestation had grown malignant. Excising parasites would result in loss of host--

Correct. Creators neutralized parasitic threat and contained it within the host. Forge of Wills and other systems were instituted to create new earthen. Safeguards were implemented, and protectors were appointed.
Designations: Aesir and Vanir. Or in the common nomenclature, storm and earth giants. Sentinel Loken designated supreme. Dragon Aspects appointed to monitor evolution on Azeroth.

30899.text: Warning: life form pattern not recognized. Archival processing terminated.  Continued interference will result in targeted response.
Critical threat index. Void analysis diverted. Initiating sanitization protocol.
Alert: security fail-safes deactivated. Beginning memory purge and...
System online. Life form pattern recognized.  Welcome, Branbronzan.  Query?
Accessing prehistoric data... retrieved. In the beginning the earthen were created to--
Accessing... In the early stages of it's development cycle, Azeroth suffered infection by parasitic necrophotic symbiotes.

Designation: Old Gods. Old Gods rendered all systems, including earthen, defenseless in order to facilitate assimilation. This matrix destabilization has been termed "the Curse of Flesh". Effects of destabilization increased over time.

30920.text: I not sure this safe, little geist.

30945.text: Iskalder, there you are. What is this? Engaged in battle already?
I know not how this was possible, but you must still be judged Iskalder. Wait... what is this?
Stay away from me creature! Do not touch me!
Ahahahahahaha! It is done. Return to my cave. We have much to discuss!

30953.text: Don't stop now, I've almost broken a sweat.
I know no death. I will... be back... for you...

30954.text: No shining army? No righteous words? It seems your 'honor' suits you no longer.
Such noble boasts, but in the end, we've brought you down to reality.
You too shall serve the Lich King.... your time comes.

30955.text: This? This is me taking control of you. This is me setting up my final revenge!

30956.text: I knew that you would come.
You have some fight in you. I'm impressed.
Welcome to the world of the unliving.

30992.text: Oh, bravo. Do you feel proud of yourself now that you've unleashed this terrible mistake?
I already had him scheduled for disposal, but I suppose we can speed up the process a bit.
It's a pity so many fine, and reusable, parts will go to waste...

30993.text: Patches get revenge on Doctor Sabnok!
Patches not going to be cut open or sewn up no more!

30994.text: No remedy seems to work - the entire city has sickened...
The soldiers are spreading panic with the rumors of bad food. Neighbors are accusing one another of poison. The city will fall into bedlam!
Everyone is falling ill - this is an epidemic!
I pray the illness I'm feeling is due to stress ulcers...
How can I possibly help the city in such a widespread crisis?
I'm at a loss. What can one simple man do in the face of disaster?

31003.text: BY THE LIGHT! Those damned monsters! Look at what they've done to our people!
Burn it down, boys. Burn it all down.
Let 'em come. They'll pay for what they've done!
We've done it, lads! We've taken the pinnacle from the Scourge! Report to Father Gustav at once and tell him the good news! We're gonna get to buildin' and settin' up! Go!

31013.text: Feast my children! Feast upon the flesh of the living!
Lay down your arms and surrender your souls!

31016.text: You dare to challenge me? You haven't earned the right!
Vardmadra?! Did the Lich King send you personally?
Very well. I will dispatch these creatures. It is only an inconvenience. Prepare to die!
Safirdrang, let them feel the chill of Icecrown!
STOP! Kneel you fools, it's the Lich King!
31016.comment: Overthane Balargarde to The Lich King
Overthane Balargarde to The Lich King
Overthane Balargarde to The Lich King

31017.text: Enough, Michael. Business is hurting enough with this scare as it is. We can use every copper.

31019.text: Look, I'm sorry, I really am, but all of my food is fresh!
Please, it's not my fault! If... if I give you a refund, maybe you can speak to a healer? I don't know what you expect me to do!

31021.text: Is something going on? I hear angry voices.

31023.text: I didn't touch it! I promise you!
Please, I'm just a delivery man!

31027.text: Look, I'll sell you shields today, but no maces. The last thing I want is for some innocent to get brained by one of my weapons.
I don't know how much longer I'll be open today with all the commotion outside. If you need something repaired, I'll take a quick look.
I hope you're not coming in here fixing for a fight. There are too many angry people on the streets today.

31028.text: Magistrate Barthilas is unavailable at the moment...

31029.text: Wrong, Balargarde. You WILL accept this challenge!

31029.comment: Possessed Vardmadra to The Lich King
Possessed Vardmadra to The Lich King

31033.text: We couldn't have done it without you, $g sir:ma'am;.
There goes the hero of the Vanguard!
You honor us with your presence, $n.
With your steadfast determination, we cannot fail!
Thank you, $n. From the bottom of my heart. Thank you.
We will battle along side you until the bitter end, $g sir:ma'am;!

31036.text: The first of the Horde towers has fallen! Destroy all three and we will hasten their retreat!
The second tower has fallen! Destroy the final tower and we will hasten their retreat!
The Horde towers have fallen! We have forced their hand. Finish off the remaining forces!

31057.text: Hello. Master Fras Siabi is not in at this time. Please come back tomorrow to Fras Siabi's Premium Tobacco! Beep!

31083.text: Honor guard stay where you are.
Vardmadra. I'd wondered where you disappeared to. How is Iskalder?
I see through your disguise, Lady Nightswood. YOU THINK THAT YOU CAN FOOL ME?!
You may continue your combat, overthane.
But nothing! Finish them! DO NOT FAIL ME, BALARGARDE!
31083.comment: The Lich King to Overthane Balargarde

31083.text: You have bested one of my finest, but your efforts are for naught.
The frozen heart of Icecrown awaits....

31091.text: The first of the Alliance towers has fallen! Destroy all three and we will hasten their retreat!
Lok'tar! The second tower falls! Destroy the final tower and we will hasten their retreat!
The Alliance towers have fallen! We have forced their hand. Finish off the remaining forces!

31108.text: Stop the Horde from retrieving the embers, $n. We cannot risk them having the advantage when the battle resumes!

31109.text: Destroy their foul machines of war, $n!

31125.comment: Archavon the Stone Watcher Leap Emote

31126.text: Ah, you've finally arrived Prince Arthas. You're here just in the nick of time.
There's no need for you to understand, Arthas. All you need to do is die.
I bought food from this stall just yesterday and now my family's taken ill!
My husband and children are sick in bed because of the poison you sold me!
Don't try to weasel out of this!
That... no, keep your filthy money! It won't help my family!
I think it's your grain that's making us sick!
Give us one good reason why we shouldn't set fire to these sacks!
You brought this down on us! I'd bet gold on it!
We were fine until we ate from this tainted grain of yours!
We want to speak to the magistrate!
What are we supposed to do?!

31127.text: We'll drag you out here if we have to!

31134.text: We finish this now, champions of Kirin Tor!
I will end the Kirin Tor!
So ends you defiance of the Spell-Weaver.
A valiant defense, but this city must be razed. I will fulfill Malygos's wishes myself!
The world has forgotten what true magic is! Let this be a reminder!
Who among you can withstand my power?

31135.text: Valhalas is yours to win or die in, $n. But whatever you do, stay within the bounds of the arena. To flee is to lose and be dishonored.
$n and $g his : her; comrades in arms have chosen to accept honorable combat within the sacred confines of Valhalas.
There can be only one outcome to such a battle: death for one side or the other. Let $n prove $g himself : herself; upon the bones of those outsiders who have fallen before!
The fallen heroes of Valhalas emerge from the ground to do battle once more!
$n has defeated the fallen heroes of Valhalas battles past. This is only a beginning, but it will suffice.
Prepare yourself. Khit'rix will be entering Valhalas from the southeast. Remember, do not leave the ring or you will lose the battle.
$n has accepted the challenge of Khit'rix the Dark Master. May the gods show mercy upon $g him : her; for Khit'rix surely will not.
Khit'rix the Dark Master skitters into Valhalas from the southeast!
Khit'rix the Dark Master has been defeated by $n and $g his : her; band of companions. Let the next challenge be issued!
Sigrid Iceborn has returned to the heights of Jotunheim to prove herself against $n.  When last they met, $n bested her in personal combat.  Let us see the outcome of this match.
Circling Valhalas, Sigrid Iceborn approaches to seek her revenge!
$n has defeated Sigrid Iceborn for a second time.  Well, this time $g he : she; did it with the help of $g his : her; friends, but a win is a win!
Carnage is coming!  Remember, no matter what you do, do NOT leave the battle ring or I will disqualify you and your group.
From the bowels of the Underhalls comes Carnage.  Brave and foolish $n has accepted the challenge.  $G He : She; and $g his : her; group stand ready to face the monstrosity.
Lumbering in from the south, the smell of Carnage precedes him!
The horror known as Carnage is no more.  Could it be that $n is truly worthy of battle in Valhalas?  We shall see.
Look to the southeast and you will see the thane upon the platform near Gjonner the Merciless when he shows himself. Let him come down.  Stay within the ring of Valhalas.
Thane Banahogg returns to Valhalas for the first time in ages to prove that the vrykul are the only beings worthy to fight within its sacred ring.  Will $n prove him wrong?
Thane Banahogg appears upon the overlook to the southeast!
Thane Banahogg the Deathblow has fallen to $n and $g his : her; fighting companions.  $G He : She; has but one challenge ahead of $g him : her;.  Who will it be?
It's too late to run now.  Do not leave the ring.  Die bravely, $n!
From the depths of Icecrown Citadel, one of the Lich King's chosen comes to put an end to the existence of $n and $g his : her; friends.
Warriors of Jotunheim, I present to you, Blood Prince Sandoval!
Without warning, Prince Sandoval magically appears within Valhalas!
The unthinkable has happened... $n has slain Prince Sandoval!
In defeating him, $g he : she; and $g his : her; fighting companions have proven themselves worthy of battle in this most sacred place of vrykul honor.
ALL HAIL $n, CHAMPION OF VALHALAS!
You were not prepared!

31159.text: Don't stop now, I've almost broken a sweat.
I know no death. I will... be back... for you...

31160.text: No shining army? No righteous words? It seems your 'honor' suits you no longer.
Such noble boasts, but in the end, we've brought you down to reality.
You too shall serve the Lich King.... your time comes.

31161.text: I knew that you would come.
You have some fight in you. I'm impressed.
Welcome to the world of the unliving.

31222.text: When I am done here, I am going to mount your heads upon the walls of Azjol-Nerub!

31235.text: Thank the Light for granting me another chance. And thank you, $n.
Without your help, I would've been doomed to a life of undeath among the Lich King's gruesome creations.
There will be time for a proper thanks later, but there is still a battle to be fought!

31237.text: You shouldn't have done that!  He's not going to like it.

31238.text: Come, Cloudwing. Let's do a lap.
Feeling as restless as I am, Cloudwing? Then let us fly!
%s sighs softly and rolls her shoulders.
%s yawns quietly into the palm of her hand.

31242.text: Ah, there you are! Remember me? Of course you do! Wait right there, I'm coming down.
I told you I'd be better prepared when next we met. I've fought and won the Hyldsmeet, trained at Valkyrion, and here I am.  Come and get some!

31254.text: Has Prince Arthas turned against us?
The rumors were true!  The prince has gone mad!

31258.text: I will take pleasure in gutting you!

31259.text: This is madness! Cease this foolish battle!
Brothers and sisters, we must remain united! The Lich King will never fall to a world divided!
Can you not see that you play right into the Lich King's hands? He wants you to kill each other!
Join the Argent Crusade! United, we shall destroy the Lich King!
Judgment day comes, brothers and sisters! Will you be prepared?
How much of our efforts are being wasted by attacking the Horde?
We must unite and focus our attention upon the true threat: THE LICH KING!

31261.text: This is madness! Cease this foolish battle!
Brothers and sisters, we must remain united! The Lich King will never fall to a world divided!
Can you not see that you play right into the Lich King's hands? He wants you to kill each other!
Join the Argent Crusade! United, we shall destroy the Lich King!
Judgment day comes, brothers and sisters! Will you be prepared?
How much of our efforts are being wasted by attacking the Alliance?
We must unite and focus our attention upon the true threat: THE LICH KING!

31277.text: ENOUGH!  You tiny insects are not worthy to do battle within this sacred place!  You do not fight with honor!  You do not even ascend!
Fight me and die you cowards!

31279.text: The Light's blessing be upon you for aiding me in my time of need, $n.
I've had my fill of this place. Let us depart.
You must tell my brothers that I live.
I have you to thank for my life. I will return to my comrades and spread word of your bravery. Fight the Scourge with all the strength you can muster, and we will be by your side.
Face your judgment by the Light!
You will never take me alive!

31283.text: Ah, the hand of the Ebon Blade has finally come to claim me. I tremble in fear.
Hah! That's all you've got? I'm surprised you even made it to the citadel.
The Lich King has given me power beyond your wildest nightmares. Behold!
The Lich King shall extinquish... every... last... one... of you.
There you are Darion! I was wondering when you'd crawl forth.

31290.text: Orbaz Bloodbane, self proclaimed hand of the Lich King.
Couldn't wait for me to be out of the way so that you could sieze control?
You'll never have what it takes to lead anything, Orbaz, not even a legion of mindless skeletons.

31301.text: You dare to think you have thwarted my will? That you have broken my plans?
Your feeble resistance has only hastened your doom.
So spout your platitudes and flail until you are spent. In the end, you will be mine, and Morbidus will be the harbinger of your death!
Morbidus, show them what happens to those who defy the will of their king!

31306.text: Knights of the Ebon Blade, prepare for battle!

31333.text: They must not discover the fate of the young paladin. Not yet.

31397.text: AHAHAHAHA... you'll join us soon enough!
I don't want to leave! I want to stay here!
NO! You're wrong! The voices in my head are beautiful!
I'll never return. The whole reason for my existence awaits below!
I must get further underground to where he is. I must jump!
Hit me again and you'll regret it!
Soon the master will reclaim me!

31412.text: Jaina, what happened at the Wrath Gate. It was a betrayal from within...
The Horde has lost the Undercity.
We now prepare to lay siege to the city and bring the perpetrators of this unforgivable crime to justice.
If we are forced into a conflict, the Lich King will destroy our divided forces in Northrend.
We will make this right, Jaina. Tell your king all that you have learned here.
Kor'kron, prepare transport to the Undercity.

31418.text: Thrall, what has happened? The King is preparing for war...
I will deliver this information to King Wrynn, Thrall, but...
Bolvar was like a brother to him. In the King's absence, Bolvar kept the Alliance united. He found strength for our people in our darkest hours. He watched over Anduin, raising him as his own.
I fear that the rage will consume him, Thrall. I remain hopeful that reason will prevail, but we must prepare for the worst... for war.
Farewell, Warchief. I pray that the next time we meet it will be as allies.

31419.text: Lady Proudmoore, the Warchief speaks the truth. This subterfuge was set in motion by Varimathras and Grand Apothecary Putress. It was not the Horde's doing.

As the combined Horde and Alliance forces began their assault upon the Wrath Gate, an uprising broke out in the Undercity. Varimathras and hordes of his demonic brethren attacked. Hundreds of my people were slain in the coup. I barely managed to escape with my life.

31423.text: Why is Thrall allowing this to happen to our city?

31425.text: What are all these Forsaken doing here?

31428.text: You will pay for what you've done! For the Argent Crusade!
Look! What's a frostwyrm doing here? It's coming straight for us.

31431.text: We are on the brink of all out war with the Alliance!
Tragic events have unfolded in Northrend. The Warchief is doing all that he can to keep us safe.
All services and shops are to remain closed until further notice! That is all!

31432.text: Destroy our raw materials, will you? Well, the master has a special plan in mind for you...

31433.text: When can we reopen our shops? I'm losing gold here!

31737.text: Nice work! We can only rest a moment.
On your feet, boys! Move, move move!
Thanks for keeping us covered back there! We'll hold the gate while we wait for reinforcements.

31773.text: The plague cauldron begins to boil vigorously!

31810.text: Right. Let's see if we can finish this keystone.
The keystone is completed! We've done it, $n!
Who knows what secrets await within Ulduar's archives? I'm off to discover them. Thank you again for your help, $n. Without it, I'd still be searching for that key.

31814.text: Welcome, Brann Bronzebeard. I am all that remains of this temple's guardian.
You have proven yourself as an explorer and seeker of knowledge.
You have been a steadfast ally to the Earthen.
You and your companion have proven yourselves in combat and in the pursuit of the keystone.
Your motives are pure. The keystone's parts shall be reunited. Go to Ulduar and learn the answers to your questions, Brann Bronzebeard.

31833.text: Quickly, catch your breaths before we press to the gate!
On your feet, men! Move, move move!
You've got some fight in you! Blood and honor, friend!

31882.text: I'll kill one just for you.
Destination reached - engaging in scouting mission.

31892.text: %s makes a strange noise that translates as laughter in your mind.

32149.text: At last... now I can rest.
My nightmare, is it finally over?
It was awful... I dreamt I was fighting against my friends.
I can't hear the screams anymore. Is this the end?
I'm so tired. Just let me rest for a moment.

32184.text: Uninvited guests!  Did you think you'd go unnoticed inside my dominion?
I must confess... you were not altogether unexpected.  I hope you find your final resting place... to your liking.
Last time we met, you had the advantage of fighting on holy ground.  You'll find that our situation has been... reversed.
I call your bluff.  You're a paladin after all.  Your obsession with redemption goes beyond the inane.
You surely wouldn't destroy humanity's only chance to redeem its most wayward son.  You'd sooner die!
You... will pay for that, old man.  Slay them all!

32204.text: An elite Blue Dragonflight squad appears from the portal!
A Portal Guardian defends the new portal!
A Portal Keeper emerges from the portal!
Adventurers, the door is beginning to weaken!
Only half of the door seal's strength remains! You must fight on!
32204.comment: Lieutenant Sinclari - Half Door Seal reains

32204.text: The door seal is about to collapse! All is lost if the Blue Dragonflight breaks through the door!

32222.text: I'll kill one just for you.
Destination reached - engaging in scouting mission.

32236.text: Wait a minute, I didn't activate my...?
I feel funny all of a sudden.  Er?!
Okay, who's the joker that threw an orb at me?
You've got it all wrong. I'm a subjugator!
It was an accident. I was framed. Don't drop me!

32239.text: It is time.  May the Light give us strength.
Keep your heads down and follow my lead.
Something's wrong... I sense a dark presence.
The Lich King is here.  May the Light guide our blades.
You sound a little too confident.  Especially considering the way our last encounter ended.
That might be, but I don't need to stand on holy ground to run that disembodied heart of yours with the Ashbringer.
The heart... the last remaining vestige of your humanity.  I had to stop it from being destroyed.  I had to see for myself.  And at last I'm sure...
Only shadows from the past remain.  There's nothing left to redeem!

32241.text: Tirion's down!  Defend him with your lives!

32273.text: How dare you interfere with our work!
The process is finally complete! My work here is done.

32295.text: I did what I had to, brother. You gave me no alternative.
And so ends the Nexus War.

This resolution pains me deeply, but the destruction, the monumental loss of life had to end. Regardless of Malygos' recent transgressions, I will mourn his loss. He was once a guardian, a protector. This day, one of the world's mightiest has fallen.

The red dragonflight will take on the burden of mending the devastation wrought on Azeroth. Return home to your people and rest. Tomorrow will bring you new challenges, and you must be ready to face them. Life... goes on.

32311.text: Take courage, crusaders.  You do not fight alone!
The Lich King is badly hurt.  We ought to stay behind and finish him.

32312.text: Quick, through the portal!  He won't stay down for long.
Patience... we will get our chance soon enough.  Be content that for once, it is Tirion who is in our debt.

32331.text: Whoa! You're me, but from the future!  Hey, my equipment got an upgrade.  Cool!
Here come the Infinites!  I've got to keep the hourglass safe.  Can you help?
This equipment looks cool and all, but couldn't we have done a little better?  Are you even raiding?
So, how does it all turn out in Icecrown?
Chromie said that if I don't do this just right, I might wink out of existence.  If I go, then you go!
I think I'm going to turn to drinking after this.
It might help if you could tell me how many of these guys we're going to fight.  You can remember that, right, grandpa?
I just want you to know that if we get through this alive, I'm making sure that we turn out better than you.  No offense.
Wait a minute!  If you're here, then that means that in the not-so-distant future I'm going to be you helping me?  Are we stuck in a time loop?!

32414.text: You've come to address the men, sir?

32442.text: The plague cauldron begins to boil vigorously!

32443.text: Rise, Sindragosa!  Rise and lead the Frostbrood into war!

32451.text: Sometimes it's nice to get away from the sanctum and get some fresh air.
Luckily, the Lich King's grasp has not reached Dalaran yet.
She said to meet her right here... maybe I'm in the wrong place?

32573.text: %s cries out and writhes in agony before passing out.

32576.text: A child has found a new toy! Crewman, take this infant's toy away!
Crewman, show this ant the might of the Kvaldir!
Crewman, tear this land walker apart!

32638.text: Why do you treat Hakmud like this, buddy?
What is Hakmud supposed to do now, buddy?
Hakmud cannot work under these conditions! Goodbye!
I thought we were friend, buddy! You leave Hakmud stranded?

32639.text: Goodbye! You were Gnimo's best friend ever!
Time for Gnimo to shut down.

32641.text: Hey, yea, I've always wanted to be stranded somewhere.
Oh, I see how it is... You're gonna do me like that, eh?
You're just gonna leave me here? How am I supposed to get home?

32642.text: Really, mon? Just like dat you be leavin' Mojodishu behind?
Dis bad mojo what you doin'. Don't say Mojodishu didn't warn ya!

32663.text: You sure we be goin' da right way, mon?
Nuttin' says luvin' like a little tap on da noggin.
Hee hee hee! Dis gunna be some fun, mon!
My troll bruddas be in for some real fun today, mon!
Time to play some troll tag, mon!
No, no, mon. Dere be no trolls here....
Ok, mon. Tell me when we be close to mah troll bruddas.
Ey, mon! Take me to mah troll bruddas!

32687.text: There goes the finest $c I have the honor of knowing.
A fine example of a $g man:woman;, that $n.
You couldn't ask for a finer person than $n, I say.
$n! Ah, fantastic to see you out and about. Busy as always, hm?

32692.text: There goes the finest $c I have the honor of knowing.
A fine example of a $g man:woman;, that $n.
You couldn't ask for a finer person than $n, I say.
$n! Ah, fantastic to see you out and about. Busy as always, hm?

32736.text: The view up here is amazing!
Too bad I left my light feathers at home... Slow Fall would work perfect here!

32738.text: The view up here is amazing!
Too bad I left my light feathers at home... Slow Fall would work perfect here!

32739.text: The view up here is amazing!
Too bad I left my light feathers at home... Slow Fall would work perfect here!

32740.text: The view up here is amazing!
Too bad I left my light feathers at home... Slow Fall would work perfect here!

32741.text: The view up here is amazing!
Too bad I left my light feathers at home... Slow Fall would work perfect here!

32800.text: The Light's blessing be upon you for aiding me in my time of need, $N.
I've had my fill of this place. Let us depart.
You must tell my brothers that I live.
I have you to thank for my life. I will return to my comrades and spread word of your bravery. Fight the Scourge with all the strength you can muster, and we will be by your side.
Face your judgment by the Light!
You will never take me alive!

32845.text: You will suffer for this trespass!
Tragic. To come so far, only to fail.
Winds of the north consume you!
I... I am released from his grasp... at last.
%s shatters the Rare Cache of Hodir!

32857.text: Whether the world's greatest gnats or the world's greatest heroes, you are still only mortal.
Stand still and stare into the light!
Let the storm clouds rise and rain down death from above!
The power of the storm lives on.
You rush headlong into the maw of madness!
This meeting of the Assembly of Iron is adjourned!

32865.text: Interlopers! You mortals who dare to interfere with my sport will pay.... Wait--you...
I remember you... in the mountains.... But you... what is this? Where am--
Do not hold back! Destroy them!
Impertinent whelps, you dare challenge me atop my pedestal? I will crush you myself!
Can't you at least put up a fight?
My patience has reached its limit!
I feel as though I am awakening from a nightmare, but the shadows in this place yet linger.
Sif... was Sif here? Impossible--she died at my brother's hand. A dark nightmare indeed....
I need time to reflect.... I will aid your cause if you should require it. I owe you at least that much. Farewell.
You! Fiend, you are not my beloved! Begone!
Behold the hand behind all the evil that has befallen Ulduar, left my kingdom in ruins, corrupted my brother, and slain my wife.
And now it falls to you, champions, to avenge us all. The task before you is great, but I will lend you my aid as I am able. You must prevail.

32867.text: You will not defeat the Assembly of Iron so easily, invaders!
You seek the secrets of Ulduar? Then take them!
My death only serves to hasten your demise.
This meeting of the Assembly of Iron is adjourned!

32871.text: Translocation complete. Commencing planetary analysis of Azeroth.
Stand back, mortals. I'm not here to fight you.
It is in the universe's best interest to re-originate this planet should my analysis find systemic corruption. Do not interfere.
Your actions are illogical. All possible results for this encounter have been calculated. The Pantheon will receive the Observer's message regardless of outcome.
See your world through my eyes: A universe so vast as to be immeasurable - incomprehensible even to your greatest minds.
The stars come to my aid!
%s begins to Summon Collapsing Stars!
Witness the fury of the cosmos!
%s begins to cast Big Bang!
You are out of time.
%s begins to cast Cosmic Smash!
Behold the tools of creation!

I have seen worlds bathed in the Makers' flames, their denizens fading without as much as a whimper. Entire planetary systems born and razed in the time that it takes your mortal hearts to beat once. Yet all throughout, my own heart devoid of emotion... of empathy. I. Have. Felt. Nothing. A million-million lives wasted. Had they all held within them your tenacity? Had they all loved life as you do?

Perhaps it is your imperfections... that which grants you free will... that allows you to persevere against all cosmically calculated odds. You prevail where the Titan's own perfect creations have failed.
I've rearranged the reply code - your planet will be spared. I cannot be certain of my own calculations anymore.
I lack the strength to transmit the signal. You must... hurry... find a place of power... close to the skies.
Do not worry about my fate, Bronzen. If the signal is not transmitted in time, re-origination will proceed regardless. Save... your world...
Analysis complete. There is partial corruption in the planet's life-support systems as well as complete corruption in most of the planet's defense mechanisms.
Begin uplink: Reply Code: 'Omega.' Planetary re-origination requested.
Farewell, mortals. Your bravery is admirable, for such flawed creatures.
Loss of life unavoidable.
I do what I must.

32872.text: %s surrounds itself with a crackling Runic Barrier!

32873.text: %s fortifies nearby allies with runic might!

32906.text: From your death springs life anew!
His hold on me dissipates. I can see clearly once more. Thank you, heroes.
You have strayed too far. Wasted too much time....
The swarm of the elements shall overtake you!

32913.text: I return you whence you came!

32914.text: This place will serve as your graveyard.

32915.text: Matron, the Conservatory has been breached!
Your corpse will nourish the soil.

32927.text: Nothing short of total decimation will suffice.
The world suffers yet another insignificant loss.
Death is the price of your arrogance.
The legacy of storms shall not be undone.
What have you gained from my defeat? You are no less doomed, mortals.
This meeting of the Assembly of Iron is adjourned!

32930.text: I will squeeze the life from you!

33027.text: Let me know if you need help finding anything, $c.
Welcome. May I help you find something?
Greetings! Please have a look around.

33113.text: Hostile entities detected. Threat assessment protocol active. Primary target engaged. Time minus 30 seconds to re-evaluation.
Threat assessment routine modified. Current target threat level: 0. Acquiring new target.
Total systems failure. Defense protocols breached. Leviathan unit shutting down.
Threat re-evaluated. Target assessment complete. Changing course.
Hostile entity's stratagem predicted. Re-routing battle function. Changing course.
*ALERT* Static defense system failure. Orbital countermeasures disabled.
Unauthorized entity attempting circuit overload. Activating anti-personnel countermeasures.
System malfunction. Diverting power to support systems.
System restart required. Deactivating weapons systems.

33118.text: Insolent whelps! Your blood will temper the weapons used to reclaim this world!
Arise, soldiers of the iron crucible! The Maker's will be done!
I will burn away your impurities!
BURN! Burn in the Maker's fire!
More scraps for the scrap heap.
Your bones will serve as kindling.

33134.text: HELP ME! Please get them off of me!
What do you want from me? Leave me alone!
The time to strike at the head of the beast will soon be upon us! Focus your anger and hatred on his minions!
Yes! YES! Show them no mercy! Give no pause to your attacks!
Let hatred and rage guide your blows!
The fiend of a thousand faces.
Tremble, mortals, before the coming of the end!

33196.text: Thorim, my lord!  Why else would these invaders have come into your sanctum but to slay you?  They must be stopped!
These pathetic mortals are harmless, beneath my station.  Dispose of them!
Impossible!  Lord Thorim, I will bring your foes a frigid death!

33210.text: Be on the lookout! Mole machines will be surfacing soon with those nasty Iron dwarves aboard!
Move quickly! She won't remain grounded for long!
We have lost our engineers, this will not end well!

33213.text: The veil of winter will protect you, champions!

33220.text: Can it really be? Free after all these years?
And now, I must return to the waters of the lake.

33233.text: Harpoon Turret is ready for use!

33235.text: You've defeated the Iron Council and unlocked the Archivum!  Well done, lads!
Now, this is what we call a nice find!
New orders! Unlock the entry to the Celestial Planetarium.
Four watchers? Sigils? Could ye be a little less cryptic, confounded machine?
I'll show ye access, ye wretched machine. Here it is again: Norgannon's key!
Looks just like all the other titan archives me lads have found... only older... and bigger.
Wait a second: this doesn't look right! Next to this blinking light... what's this Algalon signal?
Prime Designate? Where have I 'eard that before? By my grandfather's beard, Loken is Azeroth's Prime Designate. Loken's death triggered this!
Well? Who's on the listening side of the signal? What's going to happen?
Planetary re-origination? Speak plainly, ye blasted machine!
Hear that, lads? It's only the end of the world! Well, what are ye waiting for, ye rusty machine? Initiate Reply-code Alpha. All is well! Pints are on me!
Well, what's this Algalon going to be looking for with his diagnostics? What are our chances?
Blast it, lads. Looks like we've got a fight ahead of us.
How do we get the sigils from them, then? Just walk up to them and ask them nicely?
You're going to tell us how to... "un-compromise" the sigils, aren't you?
I've dreamed of roaming the halls of the titans for years. I never thought I'd be pitted against their creations.

33241.text: Eonar, your servant calls for your blessing!

33242.text: Golganneth, lend me your strength! Grant my mortal allies the power of thunder!

33244.text: Combat matrix enhanced. Behold wonderous rapidity!

33271.text: Your destruction will herald a new age of suffering!
You thought to stand before the legions of death and survive?
The black blood of Yogg-Saron courses through me! I. AM. UNSTOPPABLE!
The saronite vapors mass and swirl violently, merging into a monstrous form!
A saronite barrier appears around General Vezax!
General Vezax roars and surges with dark might!

33273.text: Are those winter hyacinths? For me?
It's been so long since a traveler has come here bearing flowers.
The lake has been too lonely these past years. The travelers stopped coming and evil came to these waters.
Your gift is a rare kindness, traveler. Please take this blade with my gratitude. Long ago, another traveler left it here, but I have little use for it.

33280.text: Your will is no longer your own.
Destroy them, minion! Your master commands it!

33285.text: It seems you still need more practice. Perhaps another time.
I have won. Better luck another time, friend.
I am afraid you will need more practice to defeat me.
That was a well fought battle. I yield to you.
It would seem I underestimated your skills. Well done.
I have been defeated. Good fight!

33287.text: Give us a moment to prepare to build the turrets.
Ready to move out, keep those dwarves off of our backs!
Fires out! Let's rebuild those turrets!

33288.text: BOW DOWN BEFORE THE GOD OF DEATH!
Look upon the true face of death, and know that your end comes soon!
Your fate is sealed. The end of days is finally upon you and ALL who inhabit this miserable little seedling. Uulwi ifis halahs gag erh'ongg w'ssh.

33293.text: New toys? For me? I promise I won't break them this time!
So tired. I will rest for just a moment!
I... I think I broke it.
I guess it doesn't bend that way.
I'm tired of these toys. I don't want to play anymore!
You are bad... Toys... Very... Baaaaad
Time for a new game! My old toys will fight my new toys!
%s's heart is exposed and leaking energy.
%s's heart is severed from his body.
%s begins to cause the earth to quake.
%s consumes a scrap bot to repair himself!

34102.text: Thank you all for attending this sermon. It's wonderful to see so many familiar faces!
Today I would like to touch on the three virtues of the Light.
These are dark and difficult times for us all. The armies of the Scourge amass to the south. Companions fall on the battlefield and rise to serve our enemy moments later.
Many of you have experienced a betrayal of trust.
Yet you persevere, as we all must. In these times, no one is a stranger to the virtue of tenacity. In the face of despair and hatred, we continue to stand true to our beliefs and fight on.
There can be no doubt as to your tenacity... but there are other virtues to consider.
Respect is the first virtue taught to those joining the path of the Light.
Look across the aisle to those you would call enemy. Despite the hatred that separates you, there are qualities to respect in your opponent. Their prowess should be acknowledged.
All of us gathered here have a concept of honorable combat. Conducting yourself with honor and treating your opponent as you wish to be treated shows respect.
Respect your opponent on the field, whether he be your brother or your sworn enemy. No matter where your beliefs truly lie, such respect is acknowledging a connection...
...and in acknowledging those connections, you are closer to the Light.
There is one further step on the path of Light: compassion.
Rivalries abound in this day and age. It is easy to see differences wherever you turn.
The challenge is in looking beyond appearances and understanding our similarities. Through this understanding, you can feel compassion for the losses others have suffered...
...even if the victim bears another banner.
By feeling and understanding compassion in enemy and ally alike, you reaffirm your connection with the world.
Acting on these tenets, these virtues, help make the world a place we all can appreciate. A world of honor and justice.
Think on my words, friends. In the darkness that surrounds us all, the Light is needed more than ever.
I'll be behind the confessional screen if anyone wishes to speak with me. Any doubts, any worries, any uncertainties I will happily soothe.
Take heart. Size isn't what matters, but how you use the skills you have.
What you lack in size you make up for in ambition and dedication, little one. Go with the Light.
Drink in moderation, then, my dwarven friend, but you may want to turn in your lance and reins for the time being. Go with the Light.
I understand your frustration. Your people are ferocious in battle, and this isn't what you're used to.
But this is a different sort of honorable combat. Difficult to adapt to, perhaps, but with your prowess I'm sure you'll show everyone the strength in your people.
Besides... while an axe can be a valuable tool in war, lances have their uses as well.
It may seem pointless, but try to find pride in a good fight. The time will come when all this practicing and competition will be put to good use.
And your hair looks wonderful.
Your heart is in the right place, and I know you seek to serve the Light. But these small strikes do little to the great undead host.
This tournament is helping to form a strong, concerted force, though it may not appear obvious. When we're ready, the eyes of the Crusade and all its champions will turn towards Icecrown.
We will bring the might of all races to the Lich King, and he will be defeated.
I know this does not seem like the obvious path to you, but it will bring you closer to the Light. Fight well, brother.
Oh, my. Do you feel remorseful, at least?
In coming here, you have made a grave mistake. These tournament grounds are a bastion of the Light, and your power cannot match it.
I am sorry, but you do not belong here, and you cannot be allowed to harm the innocents on the grounds.
Once more I apologize, but you chose this fate.

34526.text: Talk to me, Tahu. Something. Anything! I'm going stir-crazy.

I hear the "but" in your voice...
Do you think his teachings are wrong?
So are you going to bring this up to the elder?
I suppose so. It's not silly, though, what you said.
I see that thoughtful frown, Tahu.
But something is on your mind, right?
There's a phrase... "It's always darkest before the dawn." The dawn will come, though, Tahu. The sun will rise. The balance will shift back to where it should be.
%s smiles and gestures to the north.
Even on the glacier itself, the sun manages to peek through the gloom. I have hope, Tahu. I think we'll make it through this, no matter how dire it looks.
But I'd still rather be there on the front lines helping it happen rather than trying to placate myself with belief. We can't just sit around and hope it happens.
And through that hope, strengthen our side in the fight?

34528.text: All right, Aponi. I've enough on my mind to share. Have you ever spoken to the elves of Moonglade?
The elves speak of a moon goddess, did you know? They put great stock in the light given by the moon.
Just like her. The parallels I've heard are interesting. And it's no secret all druids, Shu'halo and elf alike, can call upon Mu'sha's light.
I wonder. Hamuul has guided us well, and I've learned so much from him. The legends say that our people were druids when time began...
...but what Hamuul teaches is what the elves know. The night elves. They put such stock in their moon goddess, as creatures of the night.
No! No, nothing like that. He is an elder for good reason, sister. Mu'sha is one of the Earthmother's eyes, and she watches over us. That isn't sinister.

But we're nothing if not people who strive for balance. Our warriors fight only when there is need. Our hunters take only what the tribes require to live, and use all they can when they do. The shaman stand as guide and mediator to the elemental spirits.
And while we, as druids, are guardians of nature, I wonder if we've overlooked a key aspect of balance in all things.
No, no. No need for him to trouble about a student's idle philosophizing while he entertains a friend.
Well, it isn't exactly a new thought, sister.
Sorry, sister. It's nothing to worry about.
I'm thinking about the front to the north. The one you're so eager to return to.

I know I'm counseling patience, Aponi, but I don't like remaining here any more than you do. Times are bleak, and failing to act only makes me worry that my idle hand may have been the one to turn the tide.
Still... there is balance in all things, even death. I simply hate the concept that such destruction and darkness might be necessary.
I know, sister. I know. We'll return to fighting one day. For now, though, maybe it's best to spread the word to others... give them the hope you have.

I'm sure Thrall will have his people under control...

35321.text: You ask much of me, Tirion, to sit and watch, trusting the savages to keep themselves in check.
Perhaps. I doubt the effectiveness of this gambit. We would be better served preparing our armies for the final assault.
But if my presence is required in these games to gain your support in the battle, then I will remain.  For now.

35361.text: I hope you'll see the merit of these events in time, Garrosh. We cannot win against the Scourge if we continue to war against one another.
Under my roof, gentlemen, I trust you will behave.
If you will follow me, then.
King Varian, Lady Jaina. Welcome to the tournament. Your place in the coliseum is waiting.
My people are here to ensure they honor the rules of engagement. It will do your subjects well to see you in the stands.
%s nods and gestures for his guests to follow.
Combatants of the Alliance and Horde! You are welcome under the banner of the Argent Crusade.
To the south lies our goal. We will march to the Citadel and cut out the heart of the Scourge where it dwells.
But this is no task to be taken lightly.
A massive attack with every able-bodied man would end in needless slaughter. Every soldier lost would rise as the enemy. Azeroth would be left defenseless against the undead threat.
Instead, we require a small, concentrated strike force for the attack to succeed. For that reason, we have created the Argent Tournament.
Within these walls, you will be tested. Your skill in combat will be matched against the fiercest dangers Northrend has to offer under the watchful eyes of your leaders.
Your prowess, your might, and your cunning will be under close watch. These games will determine the best Azeroth has to offer.
The victors will take their rightful place in the assault upon the Citadel. We will stand together in the face of evil, and Arthas WILL fall!

35368.text: Garrosh, I expect you to control yourself here. I do not want a repeat of the Violet Citadel.
We are guests here, Garrosh, and you will conduct yourself honorably.
Thank you for the invitation, Lord Fordring. We look forward to observing these games.
Of course, Tirion. I apologize for his outburst.  It will not be repeated.

35372.text: Pah! That was a show of strength, worthy of a leader. I only regret I did not kill that human before the mage interfered.
What honor is there in thrashing about with blunted sticks? This is a waste of time.
Words of a fool, you mean. The Horde will destroy the undead without your aid, human, or that of the pompous king.

35451.text: You spoiled my grand entrance, rat.
Did you honestly think an agent of the Lich King would be bested on the field of your pathetic little tournament?
I've come to finish my task.
My rotting flesh was just getting in the way!
I have no need for bones to best you!
No! I must not fail... again...

35458.text: Thank you, Highlord. Now, challengers, I will begin the ritual of summoning. When I am done a fearsome doomguard will appear!
A-HA! I've done it! Behold the absolute power of Wilfred Fizzlebang, master summoner! You are bound to me, demon!

Wilfred Fizzlebang to Wilfred Fizzlebang - Death

35474.text: Fools! Did you think our master blind? Did you think we did not know of this intrusion? Our elder sisters come, and there will be no escape from their wrath!
Our sisters have been captured! Fall back!

35476.text: Of course I was the one chosen to summon a demon for the competitors. I am Wilfred Fizzlebang, master summoner! Demons quail before the mere thought of being under my will!
Soon all the world will know the name of Wilfred!
It won't be long before Fizzlebang is a household word, used to scare children into bed! "Beware, or Fizzlebang will summon a mighty demon to eat you!"
I, Wilfred Fizzlebang, have been invited to this quaint tournament to make use of my extensive knowledge of the summoning arts. What better choice?

35501.text: The Warchief of the Horde, Thrall, and Overlord Garrosh Hellscream have arrived upon the tournament grounds! Clear the way to the entrance!
Highlord Tirion Fordring approaches the stage to address those gathered upon the tournament grounds! Make way to the stage area to attend him!
His Majesty, King Varian Wrynn, and Lady Jaina Proudmoore have touched down upon the tournament grounds! Make way!
The Val'kyr are attacking! Take cover!

35589.text: The Argent Crusade invites you to test your skills in honorable combat against other heroes of Azeroth at the Argent Tournament.
The champions of the world's great nations have gathered at the Argent Tournament Grounds in northeastern Icecrown to face all challengers.

35604.text: The Argent Crusade invites you to test your skills in honorable combat against other heroes of Azeroth at the Argent Tournament.
The champions of the world's great nations have gathered at the Argent Tournament Grounds in northeastern Icecrown to face all challengers.

35642.text: If you'll excuse me, I'm afraid I have other business I must attend to.  Please call on me again in the future.

35877.text: The Nerubians built an empire beneath the frozen wastes of Northrend. An empire that you so foolishly built your structures upon. MY EMPIRE.

36021.text: Do ye want ta live forever?

36024.text: Do ye want ta live forever?

36095.text: Champions, you're alive! Not only have you defeated every challenge of the Trial of the Crusader, but also thwarted Arthas' plans! Your skill and cunning will prove to be a powerful weapon against the Scourge. Well done! Allow one of the Crusade's mages to transport you to the surface!
Let me hand you the chests as a reward, and let its contents will serve you faithfully in the campaign against Arthas in the heart of the Icecrown Citadel!

36213.text: Shut your face, you gibbering idiot!

36217.text: I've got my eye on you, Faranell.
No abominations protecting you. No secrecy. No plotting in the dark.
If you so much as spit without my permission, this place shuts down. Forcefully.
Get that rotten nut to shut his trap!

36272.text: Great. We're not gutless, we're incompetent.

36296.text: Did they bother to tell you who I am and why I am doing this?
...or are they just using you like they do everybody else?
But what does it matter.  It is time for this to end.
Baxter! Get in here and help! NOW!
Apothecaries! Give your life for the Crown!

36476.text: %s begins to unleash a toxic poison cloud!

36477.text: Our work must not be interrupted! Ick, take care of them!
We could probably use these parts.
Arms and legs are in short supply! Thanks for your contribution!
Enough moving around! Hold still while I blow them all up!
Quickly! Poison them all while they're still close!
No, that one! That one! Get that one!
I've changed my mind, go get that one instead!
What are you attacking him for? The dangerous one is over there!
Wait! Stop! Don't kill me, please! I'll tell you everything!
What you seek is in the master's lair, but you must destroy Tyrannus to gain entry. Now, within the Halls of Reflection you will find Frostmourne. It... It holds the truth.
I swear it is true! Please, don't kill me!!

36479.text: Sentinel, I would speak with your High Priestess.
Must I? I doubt Tyrande has more pressing business.
The lure of power is great. Mistakes were made.
I will not return until I am heard. There is too much at stake.
There is change on the wind, and we cannot ignore it. I have traveled from the dust and ruin of the past to come to an accord.
The time may soon come when the kaldorei require the knowledge and skill we have to offer.
I will wait, Sentinel... but I will have my audience.
%s looks over at the moonwell with a sigh.
Calm yourself, Sentinel. I do not seek to use it. I am merely... remembering.
Enough. I have been apart from this for centuries. The well within this temple may be a pale spectre of the Well of Eternity, but it still holds the same... beauty. Purity.
I do not believe admiration and wistful thoughts are against the societal norm.
You were the one who challenged me for merely looking. I still await my audience with Tyrande.

36481.text: You must wait for an audience.
You show some nerve coming to Teldrassil, Highborne. Your kind are unwelcome here. We have not forgotten the War of the Ancients or the minds behind it.
And we would not see those mistakes repeated. Return to your exile.
Take your gaze off the moonwell, exile. The power within is not yours to wield.

36494.text: Tiny creatures under feet, you bring Garfrost something good to eat!
Axe too weak. Garfrost make better and CRUSH YOU.
Garfrost tired of puny mortals. Now your bones will freeze!
Garfrost hope giant underpants clean. Save boss great shame. For later.
Will save for snack. For later.
That one maybe not so good to eat now. Stupid Garfrost! BAD! BAD!
%s hurls a massive saronite boulder at you!

36497.text: Another soul to strengthen the host!
The vortex of the harvested calls to you!
I will sever your soul from your body!

36502.text: You dare look upon the host of souls? I SHALL DEVOUR YOU WHOLE!
You dare look upon the host of souls? I SHALL DEVOUR YOU WHOLE!
The swell of souls will not be abated! You only delay the inevitable.
The swell of souls will not be abated! You only delay the inevitable.
The swell of souls will not be abated! You only delay the inevitable.
SUFFERING! ANGUISH! CHAOS! RISE AND FEED!
SUFFERING! ANGUISH! CHAOS! RISE AND FEED!
SUFFERING! ANGUISH! CHAOS! RISE AND FEED!

Stare into the abyss and see your end.

36565.text: It has been the greatest honor of my life to serve with you, Hummel.

36597.text: So the Light's vaunted justice has finally arrived? Shall I lay down Frostmourne and throw myself at your mercy, Fordring?
You'll learn of that first hand. When my work is complete, you will beg for mercy -- and I will deny you. Your anguished cries will be testament to my unbridled power...
I'll keep you alive to witness the end, Fordring. I would not want the Light's greatest champion to miss seeing this wretched world remade in my image.
Come then, champions. Feed me your rage!
I will freeze you from within until all that remains is an icy husk.
Watch as the world around you collapses!
Val'kyr, your master calls!
Frostmourne hungers...
Frostmourne, OBEY ME!
Frostmourne feeds on the soul of your fallen ally!
Hope wanes...
The end has come!
Face now your tragic end.
%s begins to cast Defile!

No questions remain unanswered. No doubts linger. You ARE Azeroth's greatest champions. You overcame every challenge I laid before you. My mightiest servants have fallen before your relentless onslaught... your unbridled fury...
Is it truly righteousness that drives you? I wonder...

You trained them well, Fordring. You delivered the greatest fighting force this world has ever known... right into my hands - exactly as I intended! You shall be rewarded for your unwitting sacrifice.

Watch now as I raise them from the dead to become masters of the Scourge. They will shroud this world in chaos and destruction. Azeroth's fall will come at their hands -- and you will be the first to die.
I delight in the irony.
Impossible...
Now I stand, the lion before the lambs... and they do not fear.
They cannot fear...

36612.text: This is the beginning AND the end, mortals. None may enter the master's sanctum!

THE MASTER'S RAGE COURSES THROUGH ME!
